label: 1000 Genomes
definition: A cohort of individuals from 26 populations whose genomes are sequenced and genotyped by the 1000 Genomes Project to catalogue human genetic variation and provide a reference for studies of common disease.

label: AddNeuroMed Cohort
definition: A cohort of people with Alzheimer disease, mild cognitive impairment and healthy cognition, established in 2006 at centres in Finland, Italy, Greece, Poland, France and the United Kingdom to investigate longitudinal brain changes using magnetic resonance imaging.

label: Adenoma Prevention with Celecoxib trial
definition: A randomised trial cohort of adults at high risk of recurrent colorectal adenomas, recruited at centres in the United States, Australia, Canada and Great Britain, comparing celecoxib with placebo for prevention of colorectal adenomas and assessment of treatment safety.
diseases: at risk of: colorectal adenoma (MONDO:0005484)|at risk of: colorectal cancer (MONDO:0005575)

label: Advanced Study of Aortic Pathology
definition: A cohort of adults undergoing elective surgery for aortic valve or ascending aortic disease at Karolinska University Hospital in Stockholm, Sweden, recruited consecutively from 2007 for observational investigation of aortic pathology.
diseases: patients with: Ascending tubular aorta aneurysm (HP:0004970)|patients with: aortic valve disorder (MONDO:0003803)

label: Africa Wits-INDEPTH partnership for Genomics studies
acronyms: AWI-Gen|AWI-Gen, University of the Witwatersrand, Johannesburg
other synonyms: Africa Wits-INDEPTH Partnership for Genomic Studies
definition: A cohort of adults in rural and urban Burkina Faso, Ghana, Kenya and South Africa, established in 2012 and followed longitudinally to investigate genomic, environmental and behavioural influences on body composition and cardiometabolic disease.

label: Arthritis Research UK Osteoarthritis Genetics
definition: A case-control collection of people of European ancestry with severe osteoarthritis and unrelated controls from the United Kingdom, assembled for genome-wide investigation of genetic susceptibility to osteoarthritis.

label: Asian Cancer Project
definition: A case-control collection of Asian women with breast cancer and controls in Thailand contributing to investigation of genetic susceptibility to breast cancer.

label: Aspirin for Asymptomatic Atherosclerosis Study
definition: A randomised trial cohort of men and women aged 50–75 years in central Scotland without clinical cardiovascular disease but with a low ankle brachial index, comparing daily aspirin with placebo during 1998–2008 for prevention of cardiovascular events.
diseases: at risk of: atherosclerosis (MONDO:0005311)|at risk of: cardiovascular disorder (MONDO:0004995)

label: AtheroExpress
definition: A biobank of patients undergoing vascular surgery at University Medical Center Utrecht and formerly Antonius Hospital Nieuwegein, with vascular tissue, molecular measurements and at least three years of follow-up to investigate atherosclerotic plaques and subsequent cardiovascular events.
diseases: patients with: atherosclerosis (MONDO:0005311)|patients with: carotid stenosis (MONDO:0001612)

label: Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities Study
definition: A cohort of adults aged 45–64 years from Forsyth County, Jackson, Minneapolis suburbs and Washington County in the United States, followed prospectively to investigate atherosclerosis, cardiovascular risk factors and clinical cardiovascular disease.
diseases: population study of: atherosclerosis (MONDO:0005311)|population study of: cardiovascular disorder (MONDO:0004995)

label: Atopic Dermatitis Research Network
definition: A consortium of academic medical centres conducting clinical investigations in people with atopic dermatitis to understand skin immunity and susceptibility to bacterial and viral infections and to develop approaches to prevent infectious complications.

label: Australia Cancer Study
definition: A case-control collection of women with epithelial ovarian cancer and population controls in Australia, with cases recruited through the New South Wales and Victorian cancer registries alongside the Australian Ovarian Cancer Study to investigate ovarian-cancer risk.

label: Australian Ovarian Cancer Study
definition: A case-control collection of Australian women aged 18–79 years with newly diagnosed epithelial ovarian cancer and population controls, recruited during 2002–2006 to investigate ovarian-cancer susceptibility.

label: Australian Twin Registry
definition: A registry of volunteer twin pairs and higher-order multiples in Australia, enrolling members since the late 1970s to support health, medical and scientific research.

label: Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children
definition: A birth cohort of children and their families recruited through pregnancies in the Bristol area of the United Kingdom during 1990–1992, with later recruitment of eligible children, followed prospectively to investigate genetic and environmental influences on health and development across the life course.

label: Berlin-Frankfurt-Münster trials
definition: A project combining successive Berlin–Frankfurt–Münster treatment trials in children and adolescents with acute lymphoblastic leukaemia at centres in Germany, Austria and Switzerland to evaluate risk-adapted treatment, survival and toxicity.

label: Bladder Cancer Prognosis Programme
definition: A cohort of patients with newly diagnosed bladder cancer in the West Midlands, United Kingdom, recruited from December 2005 and followed prospectively to investigate lifestyle factors, molecular predictors, recurrence, progression and quality of life.

label: Brazilian Cohort
definition: A cohort of 45 babies from Rio Grande do Norte, Brazil, whose exomes provide population-specific reference variants for genetic investigation and diagnosis of rare diseases.

label: Breast Cancer Association Consortium
definition: A consortium of breast-cancer studies that pools participant-level tumour characteristics and epidemiological data to investigate breast-cancer risk factors and differences in the causes of tumour subtypes.

label: Bruneck study
definition: A cohort of residents of Bruneck, Italy, sampled by age and sex in 1990 and followed through repeated examinations to investigate atherosclerosis, cardiovascular disease and other age-related disorders.
diseases: population study of: atherosclerosis (MONDO:0005311)|population study of: cardiovascular disorder (MONDO:0004995)

label: Cancer and Leukemia Group B
definition: A consortium of institutional cancer trial cohorts, established in 1956 as the Acute Leukemia Group B, that coordinates trials of treatments for adult solid tumours and haematological malignancies to improve patient outcomes and investigate malignant disease biology.

label: Cancer Genome Atlas
other synonyms: The Cancer Genomic Atlas
definition: A project combining genomic characterisation of 33 cancer types through collaboration between the United States National Cancer Institute and National Human Genome Research Institute to map cancer-associated molecular changes and support prevention, diagnosis and treatment.

label: Cancer Prevention Study
other synonyms: American Cancer Society Prevention Study|Cancer Prevention Study II|Cancer Prevention Study II (including the Nutrition cohort)|Cancer Prevention Study-II
definition: A cohort of adult men and women across all United States states, the District of Columbia and Puerto Rico, enrolled by the American Cancer Society in 1982 and followed prospectively for mortality in relation to lifestyle, medical history and other exposures.

label: Cancer Prostate in Sweden
definition: A case-control collection of men with newly diagnosed prostate cancer and controls matched by age and residence in Sweden, used to investigate inherited susceptibility to prostate cancer.

label: Candesartan in Heart failure Assessment of Reduction in Mortality and morbidity
definition: A project combining three parallel placebo-controlled trials of candesartan in people with symptomatic heart failure, with reduced or preserved left ventricular function, across 26 countries, to evaluate mortality and hospitalisation; recruitment begins in March 1999.

label: Cardio-metabolic Genome Epidemiology Network
other synonyms: Cardio-metabolic Genome Epidemiology Study
definition: An ongoing collaborative network of member studies of Asian populations, including Japanese, Vietnamese and Sri Lankan people, whose participants were recruited in a population-based or hospital-based setting depending on the design of each member study, to investigate genetic and environmental factors, and their interactions, affecting cardiometabolic traits and disorders.

label: Cardiogenics Study
definition: A case-control collection of patients with myocardial infarction and unaffected controls recruited in Cambridge, Leicester, Lübeck, Regensburg and Paris for investigation of coronary-disease genetics, including gene expression in monocytes and macrophages.
diseases: patients with: coronary artery disorder (MONDO:0005010)|patients with: myocardial infarction (MONDO:0005068)

label: CARDIoGRAMplusC4D
definition: A consortium of coronary-disease genetic studies combining European, South Asian and East Asian case-control data to identify susceptibility variants for coronary artery disease and myocardial infarction. CARDIoGRAMplusC4D joins the Coronary Artery Disease Genome-wide Replication and Meta-analysis and Coronary Artery Disease Genetics consortia.
diseases: patients with: coronary artery disorder (MONDO:0005010)|patients with: myocardial infarction (MONDO:0005068)

label: Carolina Head and Neck Cancer Epidemiology
definition: A case-control collection of people with newly diagnosed squamous-cell head and neck cancer and controls matched by age, race and sex, recruited during 2002–2006 in 46 North Carolina counties to investigate cancer risk factors.
diseases: patients with: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (MONDO:0010150)

label: CARTaGENE cohort (CHU Sainte-Justine, Quebec, Canada)
definition: A biobank of men and women aged 40–69 years sampled from four metropolitan areas in Quebec, with prospective health information and biological specimens for investigating genetic and environmental determinants of chronic disease.

label: Center for Autism Research and Treatment
other synonyms: Autism Centre of Excellence|Geschwind Autism Center of Excellence|UCLA Autism Center of Excellence
definition: A research and clinical centre at the University of California, Los Angeles, that investigates autism, provides patient care and trains researchers and clinicians working with autistic children and adults and their families.

label: Center on Antisocial Drug Dependence
definition: A Colorado research centre founded in 1997 that investigates genetic contributions to adolescent externalising behaviours, including drug abuse and conduct disorder.

label: Centre dEtude du Polymorphisme Humain
definition: A research foundation, the Centre d’Etude du Polymorphisme Humain, that investigates human genetic variation, particularly in complex diseases, to improve understanding, diagnosis and personalised medicine.

label: Chicago Asthma Genetics
definition: A cohort of adults and children aged at least six years with clinically confirmed asthma, recruited through asthma clinics at the University of Chicago Medical Center for genetic investigation of asthma.

label: Children, Allergy, Milieu, Stockholm, Epidemiology
definition: A birth cohort of children enrolled at three to four months of age between 1994 and 1996 for prospective investigation of environmental, genetic and socioeconomic determinants of childhood asthma, allergic disease and their prognosis.
diseases: population study of: allergic disease (MONDO:0005271)|population study of: asthma (MONDO:0004979)
exposures: designed to study: exposure to allergen via inhalation (ECTO:0900047)|designed to study: exposure to child care environment (ECTO:0600002)

label: Cholesterol and Atherosclerosis Pharmacogenetics
definition: A cohort of African-American and White men and women completing six weeks of open-label simvastatin treatment to investigate genetic, demographic and clinical determinants of lipid-lowering response.

label: Cilento study
other synonyms: Italian Network on Genetic Isolates-Cliento
definition: A cohort of residents of the genetically isolated villages Campora, Gioi and Cardile in Cilento, southern Italy, providing genealogical and genomic data to investigate human genetic variation and the inherited determinants of complex traits and disease.

label: COIN
definition: A randomised trial cohort of patients with advanced colorectal cancer in the Continuous or Intermittent (COIN) trial, comparing uninterrupted oxaliplatin and fluoropyrimidine chemotherapy with planned treatment breaks to assess survival and treatment burden.

label: COIN-B
definition: A randomised trial cohort of patients with advanced colorectal cancer and no previous chemotherapy for metastases, recruited at 30 UK hospitals and one in Cyprus to compare intermittent chemotherapy combined with either intermittent or continuous cetuximab.

label: Colorectal Cancer Study of Austria
definition: A case-control collection of Austrian participants with colorectal cancer or colorectal polyps and colonoscopy-confirmed polyp-free controls, assembled to investigate genetic susceptibility to colorectal neoplasia.
diseases: patients with: colorectal cancer (MONDO:0005575)|patients with: polyp of large intestine (MONDO:0021392)

label: Consortium for the Longitudinal Evaluation of African Americans with Early Rheumatoid Arthritis
definition: A project combining longitudinal and cross-sectional registry cohorts of African Americans with rheumatoid arthritis recruited through United States clinical centres to investigate genetic, clinical and environmental determinants of disease severity.

label: Consortium of Minority Population Genome-Wide Association Studies of Stroke
definition: A consortium of stroke cohorts from minority populations, including African Americans, that combines genome-wide association results to identify genetic susceptibility to stroke.
diseases: patients with: ischemic stroke (MONDO:1060198)|patients with: stroke disorder (MONDO:0005098)

label: Cooperative Health Research in the Region of Augsburg
other synonyms: KORA - Cooperative Health Research in the Region Augsburg|KORA - Kooperative Gesundheitsforschung in der Region Augsburg
definition: A project combining population surveys, follow-up cohorts and an acute myocardial infarction registry in the Augsburg region, established in 1996 to extend MONICA and support epidemiological, genetic, health-economic and health-care research.

label: Copenhagen Hospital Biobank
definition: A biobank of patients receiving hospital care in the Capital Region of Denmark, established at Rigshospitalet in Copenhagen in February 2009 and subsequently expanded to other hospitals, retaining leftover clinical blood samples to enable research on health and disease.

label: CROATIA-Korcula Study
definition: A cohort of adult volunteers recruited on Korčula island, Croatia, from 2007 to 2014 for family-based, cross-sectional investigation of genetic variants associated with common diseases, including cardiovascular disease, diabetes, glaucoma and stroke.

label: Danish Glostrup Cohort
definition: A cohort of men and women in the Danish Glostrup population examined at age 60 to investigate inflammatory, haemostatic and genetic correlates of atherosclerosis.

label: Diabetes Genetics in Pakistan
definition: A case-control collection of people of Punjabi ancestry, predominantly originating from Mirpur, Pakistan, with type 2 diabetes or normal glucose regulation, assembled to investigate genetic susceptibility to diabetes and related glycaemic traits.

label: Diabetes in Mexico Study
definition: A cohort of people with type 2 diabetes and controls in Mexico City, Mexico, with a prospective design and genetic data used to investigate susceptibility to type 2 diabetes.

label: Diabetes Prevention Program
definition: A randomised trial cohort of people with impaired glucose tolerance and elevated fasting glucose recruited at 27 United States centres to compare lifestyle intervention, metformin and placebo for delaying or preventing type 2 diabetes.
diseases: at risk of: type 2 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005148)

label: Diabetes Reduction Assessment with Ramipril and Rosiglitazone Medication
definition: A randomised trial cohort of people with impaired fasting glucose or impaired glucose tolerance from 21 countries, assigned in a factorial design to ramipril, rosiglitazone or corresponding placebos to evaluate prevention of diabetes and effects on atherosclerosis.

label: Diabetes Research on Patient Stratification
definition: A project combining prospective European cohorts of people with prediabetes and newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes to discover biomarkers of glycaemic deterioration, treatment response and diabetes subtypes through repeated metabolic and molecular assessment.
diseases: patients with: prediabetes syndrome (MONDO:0006920)|patients with: type 2 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005148)

label: Dortmund Health Study
definition: A cohort of residents of Dortmund recruited during 2003–2004 and followed through questionnaires to investigate the frequency and consequences of headache and other chronic conditions, including their relationships with social factors.

label: Duke Cognition Cohort
other synonyms: Duke Memory study
definition: A cohort of adults in the United States with cognitive and genetic measurements contributing to research on genetic influences on general cognitive function.

label: DUNDEE
definition: A cohort of patients with high-grade serous ovarian cancer whose matched tumour and blood samples were collected through the Dundee bioresource facility, one of the four Scottish collection sites (Edinburgh, Glasgow, Dundee and Aberdeen) of the Scottish High Grade Serous Ovarian Cancer whole-genome sequencing study.

label: Durban Diabetes Study
other synonyms: APCDR Durban Diabetes Study
definition: A cohort of urban Black residents of eThekwini Municipality, South Africa, assessed in a population-based cross-sectional survey combining questionnaires, clinical measurements, biomarkers and genetic data to investigate chronic diseases and their risk factors.

label: Dutch and Belgian Lung Cancer Screening Trial
definition: A randomised trial cohort of current and former smokers selected from the Dutch and Belgian general population to compare low-dose computed-tomography screening with no screening for reduction of lung-cancer mortality.
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to Cigarette Smoking (ECTO:6000038)

label: Dutch Microbiome Project
other synonyms: Lifelines Dutch Microbiome Project
definition: A cohort of Dutch Lifelines participants providing faecal samples for metagenomic characterisation of gut microbial composition, function, virulence and antibiotic resistance in relation to health.

label: Edinburgh Stroke Study
definition: A cohort of patients with recent stroke recruited at Western General Hospital in Edinburgh, United Kingdom, from April 2002 to May 2005 and followed prospectively to investigate inflammatory markers, disability and mortality after stroke.

label: ENGAGE AF-TIMI 48
definition: A randomised trial cohort of people with atrial fibrillation in the multinational Effective Anticoagulation with Factor Xa Next Generation in Atrial Fibrillation–Thrombolysis in Myocardial Infarction 48 (ENGAGE AF-TIMI 48) trial, comparing edoxaban with warfarin for prevention of stroke and systemic embolism, with recruitment beginning in November 2008.

label: EPIGEN
other synonyms: EPIGEN-Brazil Initiative
definition: A project combining population-based genomic data from northeastern, southeastern and southern Brazil to investigate ancestry, admixture, kinship, inbreeding and deleterious genetic variation, known as the EPIGEN Brazil Initiative.

label: Erasmus Rucphen Family Study
definition: A cohort of descendants of 22 founder families and their spouses in southwest Netherlands, examined from 2002 to 2005 as part of the Genetic Research in Isolated Populations programme to identify genetic risk factors for complex disorders.

label: Estonian Biobank
other synonyms: Estonian Genome Center of the University of Tartu
definition: A biobank of volunteer adults aged at least 18 years resident throughout Estonia, linking blood samples, health examinations and questionnaires with national registries to support population-based genetic and health research.

label: European Prospective Investigation into Cancer
acronyms: EPIC|EPIC-EUROPE|European Investigation of Cancer and Nutrition (EPIC)
other synonyms: European Prospective Investigation into Cancer and Nutrition
definition: A cohort of men and women, mostly aged 35–70 years, recruited during 1992–2000 at 23 centres in ten European countries and followed prospectively to investigate relationships between nutrition, lifestyle, cancer and other diseases.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to eating behavior (ECTO:6000021)|designed to study: exposure to lifestyle (ECTO:6000015)|designed to study: exposure to nutrient (ECTO:9001695)

label: European Prospective Investigation of Cancer-Norfolk
definition: A cohort of men and women aged 39–79 recruited in Norwich and surrounding Norfolk communities in 1993–1997, followed through questionnaires and examinations to investigate diet, lifestyle and health as part of the European Prospective Investigation of Cancer.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to eating behavior (ECTO:6000021)|designed to study: exposure to lifestyle (ECTO:6000015)|designed to study: exposure to nutrient (ECTO:9001695)

label: EuroTARGET project
definition: A project combining prospectively recruited patients with metastatic renal cell cancer from 62 European centres and patients from previous studies to identify host and tumour biomarkers that predict response and toxicity during targeted therapy.

label: Extremely Low Gestational Age Newborns
definition: A birth cohort of infants born before 28 weeks of gestation at 14 sites, followed to investigate exposures associated with brain injury and subsequent neurological and developmental outcomes.
diseases: at risk of: brain injury (MONDO:0043510)|at risk of: cerebral palsy (MONDO:0006497)

label: Fatty Acid Sensor Study
definition: A cohort of participants receiving fish-oil supplementation for six weeks, with triglyceride measurements and genotyping used to investigate inherited variation in the metabolic response to omega-3 fatty acids.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to omega-3- fatty acid supplement via ingestion (ECTO:0070171)

label: Finnish Twin Cohort Study
definition: A project combining longitudinal Finnish twin cohorts established in the 1970s and 1990s, including the older twin cohort, FinnTwin12 and FinnTwin16, with repeated phenotyping and molecular measurements for investigation of health and disease.

label: FINRISK
definition: A project combining independently sampled Finnish adult population cohorts recruited through five-yearly health surveys during 1972–2012 and followed through national registers to monitor risk factors, health behaviours and non-communicable disease.

label: Flemish Gut Flora Project
definition: A cohort of volunteers from Flanders, Belgium, with health and lifestyle questionnaires, biological samples and genetic data assembled to investigate relationships between the gut microbiome, health and lifestyle.

label: Gabriel Advanced Survey
other synonyms: GABRIEL (a multidisciplinary study to identify the genetic and environmental causes of asthma in the European Community) Advanced studies|GABRIEL Advanced Studies|GABRIEL Advanced Survey|GABRIEL Advanced Surveys
definition: A multi-phase, stratified, cross-sectional population-based survey of school-aged children in rural regions of southern Germany, Austria and Switzerland and in Poland, run from 2006 within the EU-funded GABRIEL project: a screening questionnaire (phase I), a stratified random subsample with detailed farm-exposure questionnaires and blood, genetic and environmental samples (phase II), and in Bavaria an in-depth respiratory and environmental assessment (phase III), to determine the factors in farming environments that protect against asthma and atopic disease.
diseases: population study of: asthma (MONDO:0004979)|population study of: atopic IgE-mediated allergic disorder (MONDO:0005202)
exposures: designed to study: exposure to farm (ECTO:1000034)

label: GCAT Genomes for Life
definition: A cohort of adults aged 40–65 years in Catalonia, Spain, followed prospectively in Genomes for Life (GCAT) to assess epidemiological, genomic and epigenomic contributions to chronic disease.

label: GENESIS
definition: A case-control collection of French women with breast cancer and an affected sister, without a detected BRCA1 or BRCA2 mutation, together with unaffected sisters and unrelated controls. GENESIS (GENE SISters) investigates inherited breast-cancer susceptibility alongside environmental factors and tumour characteristics.

label: Genetic Analysis of Multiple Sclerosis
definition: A case-control collection of people with multiple sclerosis from multiple countries and controls from Sweden, the United Kingdom and published studies, assembled to identify genetic variants associated with multiple-sclerosis susceptibility.

label: Genetic Consortium for Anorexia Nervosa
definition: A consortium of anorexia-nervosa sample collections assembled internationally for genome-wide and exome-array analyses of genetic susceptibility to anorexia nervosa in collaboration with the Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium 3.

label: Genetic Epidemiology of Asthma in Costa Rica
other synonyms: Genetic Epidemiology of Asthma in Costa Rica Study|Genetics of Asthma in Costa Rica Study
definition: A cohort of families in Costa Rica, including extended pedigrees and parent–child trios with asthma probands, assembled to identify common and rare genetic determinants of asthma and related phenotypes through sequencing and family-based analyses.

label: Genetic Overlap between Metabolic and Psychiatric traits
definition: A case-control collection of people in Greece with schizophrenia, type 2 diabetes or both, analysed alongside population controls from Greek cohorts to investigate shared genetic susceptibility to the two disorders.
diseases: patients with: schizophrenia (MONDO:0005090)|patients with: type 2 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005148)

label: Genetic Prostate cancer risk stratification for targeted screening
definition: A cohort of men aged 40–69 with a family history of prostate cancer, recruited through London clinics, a UK prostate cancer study and public advertisements to evaluate genetic risk assessment and prostate biopsy for targeted prostate cancer screening.

label: Genetic Research in Isolated Populations
other synonyms: Genetic Research in Isolated|Genetic Research in Isolated Population
definition: A project combining family-based and population-based investigations of a genetically isolated population in southwest Netherlands, initiated in 1995 as Genetic Research in Isolated Populations to identify genetic factors in neuropsychiatric, cardiovascular and metabolic disorders.

label: Genetics of diabetes Audit and Research
other synonyms: UK Type 2 Diabetes Genetics Consortium|UK Type 2 Diabetes Genetics Consortium Collection|UK Type 2 Diabetes Genetics Consortium collection|United Kingdom Type 2 Diabetes Genetics Consortium
definition: A cohort of people with type 2 diabetes and non-diabetic controls in Tayside, Scotland, recruiting from 1998 and linking biological samples to longitudinal health records to investigate genetic and environmental determinants of diabetes onset, progression and treatment response.

label: Genetics of Healthy Aging
definition: A cohort of siblings aged at least 90 years and younger controls aged 50–75 years, recruited during 2004–2008 in 11 European countries to investigate genetic determinants of healthy ageing and longevity.

label: GenomeAsia 100K project
other synonyms: GenomeAsia Phase 2|GenomeAsia, Phase 2
definition: A cohort of people from diverse population groups across Asia whose genomes are sequenced by the GenomeAsia 100K Project, to catalogue genetic variation, population structure, disease associations and founder effects and to support genetic analyses: a pilot phase sequenced people of population groups from countries across Asia, and a second phase (GenomeAsia Phase 2) added people recruited from the healthcare delivery systems of Pakistan, India and Bangladesh and from isolated South Asian population groups.

label: German Multiple Myeloma Study Group
definition: A consortium of multiple-myeloma clinical trial cohorts coordinated through centres across Germany to evaluate treatment strategies for patients at different disease stages.

label: Ghana Prostate Study
other synonyms: Ghana Prostate
definition: A case-control collection of men in Accra, Ghana, recruited from population screening and Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital between 2004 and 2012 to investigate prostate-cancer risk factors.

label: Glaucoma Inheritance Study in Tasmania
definition: A cohort of people with glaucoma and their relatives in Tasmania, Australia, recruited through affected probands identified in 1994–1996 and assessed with pedigrees and eye examinations to investigate familial primary open-angle glaucoma.

label: Greece Hellenic Isolated Cohorts
definition: A project combining the MANOLIS cohort from mountainous villages in Crete and the Pomak cohort from mountainous northern Greece to investigate genetic determinants of complex traits in founder populations.

label: Health and Retirement Study
definition: A cohort of adults aged over 50 years and their households in the United States, surveyed every two years from 1992 to investigate changes in health, cognition, economic circumstances, work, retirement and family relationships during ageing.

label: Health2000 Study
definition: A cohort of adults in mainland Finland sampled for health interviews and examinations in 2000–2001, primarily at age 30 or older, to characterise public-health problems, their determinants and treatment, and functional and work capacity.

label: Heart Protection Study
definition: A randomised trial cohort of adults aged 40–80 at increased risk of coronary death, recruited in 1994–1997 to evaluate simvastatin and antioxidant vitamins, each against placebo, for prevention of mortality and major vascular events.
diseases: at risk of: coronary artery disorder (MONDO:0005010)

label: Hoorn Diabetes Care System
definition: A cohort of people with type 2 diabetes receiving primary care in West-Friesland, the Netherlands, enrolling from 1998 and assessed annually to investigate the course of diabetes, its complications and treatment.

label: Hospital Discharge Register Sweden
definition: A registry of people discharged from inpatient care in Sweden, initiated in 1964 and nationwide since 1987, recording somatic and psychiatric diagnoses for longitudinal population research.

label: Human Genetics Initiative
definition: A project combining clinical data and biological materials from psychiatric genetic studies in a shared National Institute of Mental Health repository, organised into disorder-related collections to support research on mental illness.

label: Hunter Community Study
definition: A cohort of men and women aged 55–85 residing in Newcastle, New South Wales, Australia, followed longitudinally with questionnaires, clinical assessments, biological samples and linked health records to investigate health and ageing.

label: Icelandic Cancer Registry
definition: A registry of people diagnosed with cancer in Iceland, established in 1954 to record nationwide cancer diagnoses and support cancer research.

label: Identification of Men with a genetic predisposition to ProstAte Cancer
definition: A cohort of men aged 40–69 years from families with BRCA1 or BRCA2 mutations, including mutation carriers and age-matched non-carriers, undergoing annual prostate-specific antigen testing in an international investigation of targeted prostate-cancer screening.

label: IIBDGC genotyped CD study
definition: A cohort of genotyped patients with Crohn's disease collected through the International Inflammatory Bowel Disease Genetics Consortium at sites in Europe, North America and Australia to investigate genetic susceptibility and gene–environment interactions.

label: Indiana Sisters Study
other synonyms: Indiana Fragility Study|Indiana Genetics of Bone Fragility Study|Indiana Sisters Osteoporosis Study|Indiana cohort|Study of Indiana Women
definition: A cohort of premenopausal women of European-American ancestry, with an extended European-American and African-American sample, providing bone-density and genetic measurements for investigation of inherited variation in skeletal traits.

label: INfancia y Medio Ambiente Project
other synonyms: INfancia y Medio Ambiente [Environment and Childhood] Project
definition: A project combining cohorts of pregnant women and their children from seven Spanish areas to investigate environmental exposures and child health through coordinated assessments, questionnaires and biological sampling.

label: International Cancer Genome Consortium-Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia
other synonyms: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia Genome Project|ICGC CLL Genome Project
definition: A cohort of patients with chronic lymphocytic leukaemia whose tumour genomes are analysed within the International Cancer Genome Consortium to identify alterations involved in disease development and progression and potential diagnostic and therapeutic targets.
diseases: patients with: B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia (MONDO:0004948)

label: International Headache Genetics Consortium
definition: A consortium of headache clinic and population-based cohorts that combines genome-wide association data from migraine cases and controls of European ancestry to identify genetic susceptibility loci for migraine.

label: International Multiple Sclerosis Genetics Consortium
definition: A consortium of research groups that combines multiple sclerosis case collections from people of European descent across 15 countries with control datasets to investigate genetic susceptibility to multiple sclerosis.

label: International Schizophrenia Consortium
definition: A consortium of schizophrenia case-control collections that combines genome-wide genetic data, including European-ancestry samples, to investigate inherited susceptibility to schizophrenia and shared genetic risk with bipolar disorder.

label: Italian Network on Genetic Isolates Studies
definition: A network of Italian studies of genetically isolated populations, among them Val Borbera, Friuli Venezia Giulia, Carlantino and Cilento, combining genomic and phenotypic data to investigate genetic variation and complex traits.

label: Leeds Melanoma Cohort
definition: A cohort of patients aged 18–75 with newly diagnosed stage I–IIIA primary melanoma, recruited in England from 2000 to 2012 and followed to investigate factors associated with tumour thickness and melanoma survival.

label: Leiden Longevity Study
definition: A cohort of families containing at least two long-lived siblings, with men aged at least 89 years and women at least 91 years, and information on their relatives and spouses, assembled to identify inherited determinants of exceptional longevity.

label: LifeLines
other synonyms: Lifelines
definition: A cohort of residents of the northern Netherlands and their families, recruited during 2006–2013 across three generations, with repeated examinations, questionnaires and stored biological samples to investigate environmental, phenotypic and genomic influences on chronic disease and healthy ageing.

label: Living Biobank
other synonyms: Singapore Living Biobank
definition: A biobank of healthy Chinese and Malay participants from Singapore's Multi-Ethnic Cohort and Singapore Health 2012 collections, assembled for phenotype recall investigations of carriers of genetic variants with substantial effects.

label: Los Angeles component of The Womens Contraceptive and Reproductive Experiences Study
definition: A case-control collection of White and African-American women aged 35–64 in Los Angeles, United States, with invasive breast cancer or no previous breast cancer, contributing to the Women's Contraceptive and Reproductive Experiences investigation of breast cancer risk factors.

label: Lothian Birth Cohorts
other synonyms: Lothian Birth Cohort
definition: A research programme comprising two cohorts, the Lothian Birth Cohorts of 1921 and 1936, whose members took an intelligence test at age 11 in the Scottish Mental Surveys of 1932 and 1947 and were recruited in older age, mostly in Edinburgh and the Lothians, for repeated study of cognitive ageing.

label: Lund Stroke Register
definition: A registry of people with a first-ever stroke in the Lund-Orup district, identified through prospective and retrospective surveillance to describe stroke ascertainment, hospitalisation and patient outcomes.

label: Marseille Thrombosis Association Study
definition: A cohort of unrelated patients with documented venous thrombosis recruited at La Timone Hospital in Marseille, France, in 1994–2005, excluding recognised major thrombophilias, for investigation of genetic susceptibility to venous thrombosis.

label: Mexican Biobank
definition: A biobank of individuals from rural and urban localities across all 32 Mexican states, linking genome-wide genotypes to disease and complex-trait information to investigate population history and genetic and environmental contributions to health.

label: MIRAGE
definition: A cohort of families including siblings discordant for Alzheimer disease, with African-American and white family samples, assembled for genetic investigation through the Multi-Institutional Research on Alzheimer Genetic Epidemiology (MIRAGE) programme.

label: Molecular Genetics of Schizophrenia Collaboration
definition: A consortium of schizophrenia case-control collections from three National Institute of Mental Health repository studies, including people of European and African-American ancestry, combining genetic data to identify schizophrenia-susceptibility variants.

label: MOnica Risk, Genetics, Archiving and Monograph
definition: A project combining prospective population cohorts from European countries to examine cardiovascular risk factors and their associations with subsequent stroke and other cardiovascular events.

label: Monitoring of Trends and Determinants in Cardiovascular Disease
definition: A project combining standardised cardiovascular surveillance in populations aged 35–64 years across 26 countries in Europe, North America and the Western Pacific to relate changes in mortality and morbidity to risk factors and medical care.

label: Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis

other synonyms: EORTC-SPECTA RP1759 Study|SPECTA RP-1759-AYA

diseases: patients with: diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (MONDO:0018905)

label: SARS-CoV-2 Vaccine Response in Cancer trial
other synonyms: CORSA study|CORSA trial
definition: A prospective multicentre cohort of patients with haematological malignancies and healthy controls recruited by the Istituto Romagnolo per lo Studio dei Tumori in Italy to investigate the immunological response to mRNA SARS-CoV-2 vaccines.
diseases: patients with: hematopoietic and lymphoid cell neoplasm (MONDO:0044881)

label: Schizophrenia Exome Sequencing Meta-analysis consortium
definition: An international consortium that meta-analyses exome sequences of schizophrenia cases and controls contributed by member studies to identify genes in which rare coding variants confer risk of schizophrenia.

label: Severe Childhood Onset Obesity Project
other synonyms: SCOOP Cohort|Severe Childhood Onset Obesity Project UK|Severe Childhood Onset Obesity Project United Kingdom
definition: A United Kingdom cohort of individuals of European ancestry with severe early-onset obesity, a subset of the Genetics of Obesity Study, used to identify common and rare variants contributing to severe obesity.

label: SG10K Pilot
other synonyms: SG10K_Pilot
definition: A collection of 4,810 Singapore Chinese, Malays and Indians whose whole genomes were sequenced in the pilot phase of the SG10K project, a precursor of PRECISE-SG100K, to characterise Asian genetic diversity and improve imputation in Asian populations.

label: STRAT-PARK
other synonyms: STRAT-PARK initiative
definition: A longitudinal cohort study in Norway that aims to stratify neurodegenerative parkinsonisms into biological subtypes using biomarkers, including mitochondrial function in muscle biopsies from people with Parkinson's disease and healthy controls.
diseases: patients with: Parkinson disease (MONDO:0005180)|patients with: parkinsonian disorder (MONDO:0021095)

label: STREP GENE
other synonyms: Genetics and Severe Streptococcal Infections|STREP GENE: Genetics and Severe Streptococcal Infections
definition: A collection of survivors of invasive group A streptococcal disease in the United Kingdom, recruited through a patient group or identified from a tissue bank at Imperial College London and genotyped genome-wide to investigate host genetic susceptibility.
diseases: patients with: Severe Streptococcus pyogenes infection (HP:5210014)

label: Stroke Investigative Research and Education Network
definition: An H3Africa case-control study of stroke in sub-Saharan Africa that recruits stroke cases and matched controls at hospital and community sites in Ghana and Nigeria to evaluate genetic and environmental risk factors for stroke in people of African ancestry.

label: Study Into Lean and Thin Subjects
definition: A cohort of about 1,600 persistently thin, healthy adults with a body mass index below 18 kg/m2 and no chronic disease or eating disorder, recruited through primary care in the United Kingdom from 2005 to investigate the genetic basis of thinness.

label: SweGen
definition: A whole-genome sequence resource of 1,000 individuals selected as a cross-section of the Swedish population, mostly from the Swedish Twin Registry with a smaller set from the Northern Sweden Population Health Study, providing a national reference of genetic variation.

label: Sys4MS cohort
other synonyms: Sys4MS
definition: A prospective cohort of patients with multiple sclerosis recruited at European centres by the Sys4MS project, with clinical, imaging and omics data to develop systems medicine models of the disease.

label: Therapeutically Applicable Research to Generate Effective Treatments
other synonyms: NCI TARGET|TARGET cohort
definition: A National Cancer Institute initiative that assembles cohorts of children with hard-to-treat cancers, including leukaemias, neuroblastoma, Wilms tumour and osteosarcoma, for comprehensive molecular characterisation to accelerate the development of markers and therapies.
diseases: patients with: acute lymphoblastic leukemia (MONDO:0004967)|patients with: acute myeloid leukemia (MONDO:0018874)|patients with: childhood malignant neoplasm (MONDO:0006517)|patients with: kidney Wilms tumor (MONDO:0019004)|patients with: neuroblastoma (MONDO:0005072)|patients with: osteosarcoma (MONDO:0009807)

label: TRACERx
other synonyms: TRAcking Cancer Evolution through therapy|TRAcking non-small cell lung Cancer Evolution through therapy
definition: A prospective cohort of patients with early-stage non-small cell lung cancer recruited across the United Kingdom, whose tumours are sampled in multiple regions before and through therapy to investigate intratumour heterogeneity and clonal evolution in relation to outcome.
diseases: patients with: non-small cell lung carcinoma (MONDO:0005233)

label: TransplantLines
definition: A single-centre prospective cohort study and biobank at the University Medical Center Groningen, the Netherlands, of recipients of all types of solid organ transplant and of living organ donors, with gut microbiome characterisation linked to clinical phenotypes.

label: TrypanoGEN
other synonyms: TrypanoGEN project
definition: An H3Africa collection of cases, controls and latent infections from seven populations of Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ivory Coast, Guinea, Cameroon and Zambia where trypanosomiasis is endemic, sequenced to discover genetic variants associated with responses to sleeping sickness infection.
data collection locations: Cameroon|Democratic Republic of the Congo|Guinea|Ivory Coast|Uganda|Zambia

label: Tumor Profiler
other synonyms: Tumor Profiler Study|Tumour Profiler Study
definition: An observational Swiss study that applied multi-omic and functional tumour profiling to samples from patients with metastatic melanoma, metastatic epithelial ovarian cancer and acute myeloid leukaemia to assess the value of in-depth profiling for clinical decision support.

label: Type 2 Diabetes Genetic Exploration by Next-generation sequencing in multi-Ethnic Samples
definition: A consortium of United States and United Kingdom groups that sequenced the exomes of 6,546 type 2 diabetes cases and 6,457 controls of African American, East Asian, South Asian, Hispanic and European ancestry, drawn from member cohorts, to assess common, low-frequency and rare variants in diabetes risk.

label: Uganda General Population Cohort
acronyms: GPC|MRC/UVRI GPC|UGR|UVRIGPC|Uganda General Population Cohort/Uganda Genome Resource/ MRC Uganda
other synonyms: APCDR Uganda|Uganda Genome Resource
definition: A population-based cohort of about 6,400 individuals from a geographically defined rural community in south-west Uganda, established in 1989 and genotyped and sequenced by the African Partnership for Chronic Disease Research as the Uganda Genome Resource.

label: British Heart Foundation Family Heart Study
other synonyms: BHF Family Heart Study|UK BHF CAD/MI cohort
definition: A collection of families from across the United Kingdom with at least two siblings affected by premature coronary artery disease (myocardial infarction, angina verified by exercise testing or angiography, or coronary revascularisation before the 66th birthday, each verified from hospital or general practice records), recruited from April 1998 to November 2003 with British Heart Foundation funding through the media and general practices, after a pilot phase using the coronary disease databases of the lead centres in Leeds and Leicester, to study the genetic basis of premature coronary artery disease; affected siblings, and unaffected siblings where available, were interviewed by telephone and gave blood for DNA.
diseases: patients with: Premature coronary artery atherosclerosis (HP:0005181)|patients with: myocardial infarction (MONDO:0005068)

label: UK Blood Service Control Group
other synonyms: National Blood Bank Service|National Blood Service|National Blood Survey cohort|UK Blood Services controls|UK National Blood Service controls
definition: A collection of blood donors recruited through the UK Blood Services as a population control set for the Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium and later genetic association studies.

label: UK10K
definition: A project that sequenced the genomes of 4,000 participants of the TwinsUK and ALSPAC cohorts and the exomes of 6,000 individuals selected for extreme phenotypes and rare diseases, to find low-frequency and rare variants contributing to disease in the United Kingdom.

label: UK10K Rare Neuromuscular Disorders cohort
other synonyms: The Rare Neuromuscular Disorders cohort|UK10K_RARE_NEUROMUSCULAR
definition: A collection of patients with rare neuromuscular disorders, contributed by Francesco Muntoni's group, that formed part of the rare disease arm of the UK10K project and was exome and genome sequenced to find causal variants.

label: University of Washington ovarian carcinoma cohort
other synonyms: UW cohort
definition: A cohort of 56 patients with primary, treatment-naive ovarian carcinoma at the University of Washington whose tumours were RNA sequenced to relate BRCA and immune configurations to response to platinum-based chemotherapy.

label: UPTIDER
other synonyms: UPTIDER - monocentric post-mortem tissue donation program|breast cancer post-mortem tissue donation program
definition: A monocentric post-mortem tissue donation programme at UZ Leuven, Belgium, in which women with metastatic breast cancer donate primary, metastatic and normal tissues after death for multi-region molecular profiling.

label: VIVO Biobank
definition: A United Kingdom biobank of pathological samples from over 600 patients with rhabdomyosarcoma and other childhood cancers, with detailed clinical annotation, supporting whole-genome and transcriptome sequencing to identify risk biomarkers.

label: West Coast Prostate Cancer Dream Team
other synonyms: West Coast Dream Team Cohort
definition: A cohort of patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer whose metastasis biopsies and plasma were collected by the Stand Up To Cancer and Prostate Cancer Foundation West Coast Dream Team at United States west coast centres for genome, methylome and transcriptome sequencing.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Ankylosing Spondylitis
other synonyms: WTCCC ankylosing spondylitis collection
definition: The Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium's collection of ankylosing spondylitis cases from the United Kingdom, analysed in a genome-wide case-control association study against the 1958 British Birth Cohort and UK Blood Service control collections.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Autoimmune Thyroid Disease
other synonyms: WTCCC autoimmune thyroid disease collection
definition: The Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium's collection of autoimmune thyroid disease cases from the United Kingdom, analysed in a genome-wide case-control association study against the 1958 British Birth Cohort and UK Blood Service control collections.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Bipolar Disorder
other synonyms: WTCCC bipolar disorder collection
definition: The Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium's collection of bipolar disorder cases from the United Kingdom, analysed in a genome-wide case-control association study against the 1958 British Birth Cohort and UK Blood Service control collections.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Breast cancer
other synonyms: WTCCC breast cancer collection
definition: The Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium's collection of breast cancer cases from the United Kingdom, analysed in a genome-wide case-control association study against the 1958 British Birth Cohort and UK Blood Service control collections.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Coronary Artery Disease
other synonyms: Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) cohort|WTCCC CAD|WTCCC coronary artery disease collection|Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium CAD
definition: The Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium's collection of coronary artery disease cases from the United Kingdom, analysed in a genome-wide case-control association study against the 1958 British Birth Cohort and UK Blood Service control collections.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Hypertension
other synonyms: Hypertension cohort (HT)|WTCCC hypertension collection
definition: The Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium's collection of hypertension cases from the United Kingdom, analysed in a genome-wide case-control association study against the 1958 British Birth Cohort and UK Blood Service control collections.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Inflammatory Bowel Disease
other synonyms: WTCCC Crohn's disease collection|WTCCC inflammatory bowel disease collection
definition: The Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium's collection of inflammatory bowel disease cases from the United Kingdom, analysed in a genome-wide case-control association study against the 1958 British Birth Cohort and UK Blood Service control collections.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Multiple Sclerosis
other synonyms: WTCCC multiple sclerosis collection
definition: The Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium's collection of multiple sclerosis cases from the United Kingdom, analysed in a case-control association scan of nonsynonymous SNPs against controls from the 1958 British Birth Cohort.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Rheumatoid Arthritis
other synonyms: WTCCC for RA|WTCCC rheumatoid arthritis collection
definition: The Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium's collection of rheumatoid arthritis cases from the United Kingdom, analysed in a genome-wide case-control association study against the 1958 British Birth Cohort and UK Blood Service control collections.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Tuberculosis
other synonyms: WTCCC tuberculosis collection
definition: The Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium's collection of tuberculosis cases and controls from Africa, analysed in a genome-wide case-control association study using African samples as controls.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Type 1 Diabetes
other synonyms: WTCCC case-control study for T1D|WTCCC type 1 diabetes collection
definition: The Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium's collection of type 1 diabetes cases from the United Kingdom, analysed in a genome-wide case-control association study against the 1958 British Birth Cohort and UK Blood Service control collections.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Type 2 Diabetes
other synonyms: Type 2 Diabetes Cohort (T2D)|WTCCC type 2 diabetes collection
definition: The Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium's collection of type 2 diabetes cases from the United Kingdom, analysed in a genome-wide case-control association study against the 1958 British Birth Cohort and UK Blood Service control collections.

label: Charles F. and Joanne Knight Alzheimer Disease Research Center
other synonyms: Charles F. and Joanne Knight Alzheimer's Disease Research Center|Knight ADRC Memory and Aging Project|Knight Alzheimer Disease Research Center|Knight Alzheimer's Disease Research Center|Washington University Memory & Aging Project
definition: A cohort of research volunteers recruited over more than 40 years by the Charles F. and Joanne Knight Alzheimer Disease Research Center at Washington University in St. Louis, United States, largely through its Memory and Aging Project and Memory Diagnostic Clinic, and followed with cognitive, neuropsychological, imaging, fluid biomarker, genomic and multi-omic assessments to study Alzheimer disease and related dementias.
diseases: patients with: Alzheimer disease (MONDO:0004975)|patients with: Lewy body dementia (MONDO:0007488)|patients with: dementia (MONDO:0001627)|patients with: frontotemporal dementia (MONDO:0017276)

label: Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
other synonyms: Alzheimers Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
definition: A multi-site longitudinal cohort of cognitively normal older adults and people with mild cognitive impairment or mild Alzheimer disease, recruited from 2004 at over 60 clinical sites in the United States and Canada by the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative, a public-private partnership, to evaluate neuroimaging, fluid biomarker and clinical measures of Alzheimer disease progression.
diseases: patients with: Alzheimer disease (MONDO:0004975)|patients with: cognitive disorder (MONDO:0002039)

label: Dominantly Inherited Alzheimer Network
other synonyms: The Dominantly Inherited Alzheimer Network
definition: An international longitudinal cohort of asymptomatic and symptomatic carriers of autosomal dominant Alzheimer disease mutations and their non-carrier family members, followed by a network of Alzheimer disease centres coordinated from Washington University in St. Louis with standard clinical, cognitive, neuroimaging and fluid biomarker protocols to determine the pathochronology of the disease.
diseases: at risk of: early-onset autosomal dominant Alzheimer disease (MONDO:0015140)

label: Barcelona-1
other synonyms: Barcelona-1, MútuaTerrassa University Hospital|Longitudinal observational study from the Memory and Disorder unit at the University Hospital Mutua de Terrassa
definition: A longitudinal observational memory-clinic cohort of about 300 people at baseline, diagnosed with Alzheimer disease dementia, other dementias, mild cognitive impairment or subjective memory complaints, assembled at the Memory Disorders Unit of the University Hospital Mútua de Terrassa near Barcelona, Spain, with cerebrospinal fluid and amyloid PET biomarkers collected for selected participants.
diseases: patients with: Alzheimer disease (MONDO:0004975)|patients with: cognitive disorder (MONDO:0002039)|patients with: dementia (MONDO:0001627)

label: Stockholm-Tartu Atherosclerosis Reverse Networks Engineering Task
other synonyms: Stockholm-Tartu Atherosclerosis Reverse Engineering Task|Stockholm-Tartu Atherosclerosis Reverse Network Engineering Task
definition: A cohort of patients with coronary artery disease undergoing coronary artery bypass grafting, with comparison patients undergoing other open-heart surgery, enrolled at the Department of Cardiac Surgery of Tartu University Hospital in Estonia, whose vascular and metabolic tissues and blood were genotyped, RNA-sequenced and proteomically profiled to study gene regulation underlying cardiometabolic disease.

label: Million Veteran Program
other synonyms: VA Million Veteran Program
definition: An observational cohort and mega-biobank of veterans enrolled since 2011 at recruiting sites of the Department of Veterans Affairs health care system in the United States, combining questionnaires, electronic health records and blood samples for genomic testing to study genetic influences on health and disease.
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to occupation (ECTO:0001591)

label: Chinese Imaging Genetics study
other synonyms: Chinese Imaging Genetics|Chinese Imaging Genetics cohort
definition: A cohort of healthy Chinese Han adults aged 18–30 years recruited at research centres in mainland Chinese cities by the Chinese Imaging Genetics (CHIMGEN) study, collecting genomic, neuroimaging, environmental and behavioural data to identify genetic and environmental factors associated with neuroimaging and behavioural phenotypes.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to air pollution (ECTO:8000036)

label: African American Study of Kidney Disease and Hypertension
other synonyms: AASK Cohort Study|African American Study of Kidney disease and hypertension
definition: A cohort of African American adults aged 18–70 with hypertensive chronic kidney disease, enrolled at clinical centres across the United States in a randomized trial of antihypertensive drug regimens and blood-pressure goals (1995–2001) and then followed in the AASK Cohort Study to identify risk factors for progressive kidney disease.

label: Amsterdam Dementia Cohort
definition: A cohort of patients who have visited the memory clinic of the Alzheimer Center Amsterdam at VU University Medical Center (now Amsterdam UMC, location VUmc) in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, since the center opened in 2000 and consented to the research use of their clinical data, numbering almost 7,000 individuals by 2019. Patients undergo a one-day diagnostic screening that includes neuropsychological testing, MRI, EEG and lumbar puncture, are asked to consent to the storage of blood, DNA and cerebrospinal fluid in the center's biobank, and are mostly followed up annually; the ongoing observational study combines patient care with research on early diagnosis, heterogeneity and vascular factors in dementia.
diseases: patients with: Alzheimer disease (MONDO:0004975)|patients with: cognitive disorder (MONDO:0002039)|patients with: dementia (MONDO:0001627)

label: Protein Aggregation and Neurotransmitter Deficits Study
other synonyms: Protein Aggregation and Neurotransmitter Deficits|Protein Aggregation and Neurotransmitter Deficits in Parkinson Disease
definition: A longitudinal cohort of people with Parkinson disease and healthy older controls studied by the Campbell Research Lab in the Section of Movement Disorders at Washington University in St. Louis, United States, assessed every two years with MRI, motor, gait and cognitive testing, optional lumbar puncture and clinical interview to understand the role of brain proteins and neurotransmitters in Parkinson disease symptoms compared with healthy aging.

label: Protein and Imaging Biomarkers of Parkinson Disease Study
other synonyms: Protein and Imaging Biomarkers in Parkinson’s disease study
definition: A longitudinal cohort of people with Parkinson disease and healthy older controls studied by the Campbell Research Lab in the Section of Movement Disorders at Washington University in St. Louis, United States, assessed every three years with MRI, motor, gait and cognitive testing, optional lumbar puncture, amyloid and cholinergic PET and clinical interview to relate clinical symptoms to brain changes in Parkinson disease compared with healthy aging.

label: BioBank Japan
other synonyms: BioBank Japan Project
definition: A patient-based biobank established in 2003 at the Institute of Medical Science, the University of Tokyo, by the BioBank Japan Project, with a first cohort of about 200,000 patients diagnosed with any of 47 common diseases, enrolled at 12 cooperative medical institutes across Japan from June 2003 to March 2008, whose DNA was collected at baseline and serum and clinical information annually until 2013, and a second cohort of about 67,000 new patients with 38 diseases enrolled in fiscal years 2013–2017, together about 267,000 patients with 51 diseases, built as infrastructure for genomic research and the implementation of personalized medicine.

label: Age, Gene/Environment Susceptibility-Reykjavik Study
other synonyms: Aging Gene-Environment Susceptibility - Reykjavik Study
definition: A cohort of older men and women born in 1907–1935, drawn from the population-based Reykjavik Study followed in Iceland by the Icelandic Heart Association and re-examined from 2002 with detailed cardiovascular, neurocognitive, musculoskeletal and metabolic phenotypes to study genetic susceptibility and gene–environment interaction in disease and disability in old age.

label: Stanford Alzheimer's Disease Research Center
other synonyms: Iqbal Farrukh and Asad Jamal Stanford Alzheimer's Disease Research Center|Stanford Iqbal Farrukh and Asad Jamal ADRC
definition: A longitudinal observational cohort of volunteers followed by the Stanford Alzheimer's Disease Research Center (the Iqbal Farrukh and Asad Jamal Stanford ADRC) at Stanford University, California, one of the US National Institute on Aging-funded Alzheimer's Disease Research Centers, comprising people with Alzheimer disease, dementia with Lewy bodies, Parkinson disease or mild cognitive impairment and cognitively unimpaired older adults, who undergo standardized clinical, neurological and neuropsychological assessments following National Alzheimer's Coordinating Center procedures and give blood and cerebrospinal fluid used in proteomic and genetic studies, in line with the center's focus on Alzheimer disease and Lewy body disorders.
diseases: patients with: Alzheimer disease (MONDO:0004975)|patients with: dementia (MONDO:0001627)|patients with: synucleinopathy (MONDO:0000510)

label: Canadian Longitudinal Study on Aging
definition: A national stratified cohort of 51,338 women and men aged 45–85 years recruited in 2011–2015 from all 10 Canadian provinces, comprising a telephone-interviewed Tracking cohort and an in-person Comprehensive cohort providing physical assessments and blood and urine samples, assembled as a longitudinal research platform for studying health and aging.

label: Jackson Heart Study
definition: A community-based cohort of 5,302 African American adults, including a nested family cohort, enrolled from the three counties of the Jackson, Mississippi metropolitan area, with extensive medical, social, physical and biochemical measurements and genomic DNA, to study cardiovascular and related diseases in African Americans.

label: UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project
other synonyms: Pharma Proteomics Project|UK Biobank Pharma Plasma Proteome|UKB Pharma Plasma Proteome
definition: A sub-cohort of 54,219 UK Biobank participants, mostly a random selection of baseline participants plus individuals chosen by consortium members and participants in the COVID-19 repeat-imaging study, whose plasma proteomes were profiled by the UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project, a precompetitive consortium of biopharmaceutical companies, to map genetic and health associations of circulating proteins.

label: Mass General Brigham Biobank
other synonyms: MGB Biobank|Partners Biobank|Partners Health|Partners HealthCare Biobank|Partners Healthcare Biorepository|Partners Healthcare System Biobank|Partners study
definition: A healthcare-based biobank of more than 140,000 consenting patients of the Mass General Brigham network in the Greater Boston area of Massachusetts, enrolled since 2010 at Massachusetts General Hospital, Brigham and Women’s Hospital and local sites, linking biological samples, genomic data and health records to study genetic and environmental influences on disease in clinical practice.

label: Cardiovascular Health Study
definition: A population-based longitudinal cohort of men and women aged 65 years and older sampled from Medicare eligibility lists in four US communities (Forsyth County, North Carolina; Sacramento County, California; Washington County, Maryland; Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania) from 1989, with mostly Black participants added in 1992–1993, to identify factors related to the onset and course of coronary heart disease and stroke in older adults.
diseases: population study of: coronary artery disorder (MONDO:0005010)|population study of: stroke disorder (MONDO:0005098)

label: Framingham Heart Study
definition: A community-based, multi-generational cohort begun in 1948 with the Original Cohort of 5,209 men and women aged 30–62, a random sample of the adult population of Framingham, Massachusetts, and extended by the Offspring Cohort of 5,124 of their children and the children's spouses (1971), the Third Generation Cohort of 4,095 grandchildren (2002–2005), the New Offspring Spouse Cohort (2003–2005) and the ethnically diverse Omni cohorts, begun in 1994 among residents of Framingham and surrounding towns and extended in 2003–2005, all examined approximately every 2–4 years to define cardiovascular disease risk factors and, increasingly, the genetic and molecular epidemiology of cardiovascular and other diseases.

label: Rhineland Study
other synonyms: Rheinland Studie|The Rhineland Study
definition: An ongoing population-based cohort of people aged 30 or above living in two geographically defined areas of Bonn, Germany, invited in random order by the German Centre for Neurodegenerative Diseases (DZNE) for deep phenotyping, imaging and omics studies of health and ageing.

label: European Prospective Investigation into Cancer and Nutrition-Potsdam
other synonyms: European Investigation into Cancer and Nutrition, Potsdam study|European Prospective Investigation of Cancer-Potsdam
definition: A population-based prospective cohort of 27,548 adults from Potsdam and the surrounding area in eastern Germany, drawn at random from the population registers and recruited in 1994–1998, when the women were 35–64 and the men 40–64 years old; one of the two German centres of the European Prospective Investigation into Cancer and Nutrition (the other is EPIC-Heidelberg), run by the German Institute of Human Nutrition Potsdam-Rehbruecke to study diet, nutritional status and lifestyle in relation to the incidence of cancer and other chronic diseases such as type 2 diabetes.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to eating behavior (ECTO:6000021)|designed to study: exposure to lifestyle (ECTO:6000015)|designed to study: exposure to nutrient (ECTO:9001695)

label: Hispanic Community Health Study/Study of Latinos
other synonyms: Hispanic Community Health Study|Hispanic Community Health Study / Study of Latinos|Study of Latinos
definition: A multicentre community-based cohort of 16,415 men and women aged 18–74 who self-identify as Hispanic or Latino, of Mexican, Puerto Rican, Dominican, Cuban and Central and South American background, recruited in 2008–2011 through two-stage random sampling of households in defined communities in the Bronx, Chicago, Miami and San Diego in the United States, to study the prevalence of and risk factors for heart, lung, blood and sleep disorders, diabetes, kidney and liver function and other chronic conditions, and the health effects of immigration and acculturation.

label: Busselton Health Study
definition: A community-based longitudinal cohort of residents of the town and Shire of Busselton in south-western Western Australia, surveyed since 1966 and including related and unrelated individuals of predominantly European ancestry, whose 1994/95 follow-up provided blood samples for genetic studies of cardiovascular, respiratory and metabolic traits.

label: Swedish Infrastructure for Medical Population-Based Life-Course and Environmental Research
definition: A Swedish research infrastructure combining two large ongoing population-based cohorts, the Cohort of Swedish Men and the Swedish Mammography Cohort, whose randomly selected subsamples from Västmanland and Uppsala were clinically examined with genotyping and biosampling for life-course studies of health.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to lifestyle (ECTO:6000015)

label: Swedish CArdioPulmonary bioImage Study
definition: A national multicentre population-based cohort of 30,154 Swedish men and women aged 50–64, randomly recruited in 2013–2018 from the national population register in six areas adjacent to six Swedish university hospitals and characterised with imaging, large-scale omics and epidemiological data to improve risk prediction of cardiopulmonary diseases and study their mechanisms.
diseases: population study of: cardiovascular disorder (MONDO:0004995)|population study of: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (MONDO:0005002)|population study of: metabolic disease (MONDO:0005066)

label: Malmö Offspring Study
definition: A family-based cohort of the adult children and grandchildren of participants in the Malmö Diet and Cancer Study–Cardiovascular Cohort in Malmö, Sweden, identified from Swedish Tax Agency registers and invited by mail, and examined from 2013 (4,721 participants aged 18–71 by 2020) with genotyping and cardiovascular, respiratory, metabolic, cognitive, dietary and gut and oral microbiota phenotyping, to study family traits of chronic disease across three generations.

label: Metabolic Syndrome in Men Study
other synonyms: Metabolic Syndrome In Men|Metabolic Syndrome in Men
definition: A population-based cohort of 10,197 middle-aged and older Finnish men from a single site in north-eastern Finland, examined in 2005–2010 with detailed metabolic phenotyping, oral glucose tolerance tests, metabolomics and extensive genotyping and sequencing, and followed up to study nongenetic and genetic risk factors for type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular disease.
diseases: population study of: cardiovascular disorder (MONDO:0004995)|population study of: type 2 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005148)

label: Qatar Genome Program
other synonyms: Qatar Genome Project
definition: A national whole-genome sequencing programme of the Qatar Foundation that sequences volunteers from the Qatar Biobank and combines their genomes with the biobank's phenotype data to study the Qatari and wider Arab and Middle Eastern populations at the molecular level.

label: Trøndelag Health Study
other synonyms: HUNT Study|Nord-Trøndelag Health Study
definition: A population-based cohort of the adult population of Trøndelag County, Norway, in which all residents of Nord-Trøndelag aged 20 or over have been invited to repeated surveys since 1984–86, extended to Sør-Trøndelag in 2017–19, collecting questionnaires, interviews, clinical examinations, laboratory measurements and biological samples on a broad range of health topics.

label: Simons Foundation Powering Autism Research for Knowledge
other synonyms: Simons Foundation Powering Autism Research
definition: A US cohort, launched by the Simons Foundation Autism Research Initiative (SFARI), of individuals living in the United States with a professional diagnosis of autism spectrum disorder together with their parents and an unaffected sibling, recruited nationwide through 21 clinical sites and social media and taking part remotely online, with questionnaires and saliva samples for genetic analysis (exome sequencing and genome-wide genotyping, later also whole-genome sequencing). It collects genomic, environmental and longitudinal behavioural and medical data, returns genetic results to participants, and recontacts them and connects them with researchers for new studies; it enrolled 18,089 individuals with autism and 28,515 of their family members in its first 12 months of recruitment, to May 2017.

label: Chronic Renal Insufficiency Cohort Study
other synonyms: CRIC Study|Chronic Renal Insufficiency Cohort
definition: A multicentre prospective observational cohort of 5,499 racially and ethnically diverse adults with chronic kidney disease, recruited at seven clinical centres in the United States in two phases, 2003–2008 (adults aged 21 to 74 with an estimated glomerular filtration rate of 20–70 mL/min/1.73 m²) and 2013–2015 (adults aged 45 to 79 with more preserved kidney function, eGFR 45–70), and followed with annual clinic visits, six-monthly telephone contacts and annual blood and urine collection to examine risk factors for the progression of chronic kidney disease and cardiovascular disease.

label: Systematic and Combined Analysis of Olink Proteins
other synonyms: SCALLOP Consortium|Systematic and Combined AnaLysis of Olink Proteins
definition: A consortium of principal investigators of cohort studies from the general population, clinical trials and disease-specific patient collections that have Olink proteomics and genome-wide genotyping data, combining summary-level data to discover and follow up genetic associations with plasma protein levels (pQTLs) and identify causal protein biomarkers of disease.

label: China Medical University Hospital Biobank
other synonyms: China Medical University Hospital|China Medical University Hospital Precision Medicine Project|HiGenome
definition: A hospital-based cohort of patients of China Medical University Hospital, an academic medical centre in Taichung, Taiwan, and its affiliated hospitals, recruited through the hospital's Precision Medicine Project, begun in 2018 to collect biospecimens from patients attending for medical visits, from densely populated towns and districts across Taiwan. About 413,000 participants enrolled from 2018 to 2021 were genotyped on the custom Taiwan Precision Medicine (TPMv1) array and linked to their electronic medical records from 2003 to 2021 (the HiGenome resource; 323,397 passed ancestry and quality control), for genome-wide, phenome-wide and polygenic risk score studies in the Taiwanese Han population.

label: Religious Orders Study and Rush Memory and Aging Project
other synonyms: Religious Orders Study/Rush Memory and Aging Project
definition: A pair of harmonized longitudinal clinical-pathologic cohort studies of aging and Alzheimer's disease run at Rush University, the Religious Orders Study (from 1994, nuns, priests and brothers from across the United States) and the Rush Memory and Aging Project (from 1997, lay persons from northeastern Illinois), whose older participants enrol without dementia and agree to annual clinical evaluations and organ donation.

label: Mayo Clinic Biobank
other synonyms: MAYO clinic biobank|The Mayo Clinic study
definition: A clinic-based prospective cohort of about 57,000 adult Mayo Clinic patients who are US residents, enrolled at Rochester, Minnesota, Jacksonville, Florida and La Crosse, Wisconsin, established to supply control groups for case-control studies, form a prospective cohort for common outcomes and support electronic health record and genotype-driven research.

label: HOLBAEK Study
other synonyms: The Danish Childhood Obesity Biobank|The Danish Childhood Obesity Data- and Biobank|The Holbaek Study
definition: A Danish cohort of children and adolescents, formerly called The Danish Childhood Obesity Biobank, run since 2009 from the Children's Obesity Clinic at Copenhagen University Hospital Holbæk, that combines an obesity clinic cohort with a BMI above the 90th percentile, included continuously and followed longitudinally during multidisciplinary obesity treatment, with a population-based reference cohort recruited cross-sectionally from schools in 11 municipalities in Zealand; by 2020 it held data on more than 5,250 obesity clinic and more than 4,200 population-based participants, with biosamples, genotyping and cardiometabolic phenotyping, as a platform for research on childhood obesity and its complications.

label: FinnGen
other synonyms: FinnGen Biobank|FinnGen study
definition: A public–private partnership research project in Finland that combines genotype data from newly collected and legacy samples of about 500,000 participants of a nationwide network of Finnish biobanks with digital health data from national health registers, to provide genetic insights into disease in an isolated population enriched for low-frequency variants.

label: NIHR BioResource Rare Diseases Study
other synonyms: NIHR BioResource for Rare Diseases|NIHR BioResource-Rare Diseases|National Institutes of Health Research BioResource-Rare Diseases Study
definition: A cohort of patients with rare diseases or extreme measurements of quantitative traits, their affected relatives and controls, enrolled mainly at National Health Service hospitals in the United Kingdom between 2012 and 2017 under the coordination of the NIHR BioResource at the University of Cambridge, whose whole genomes were sequenced to provide genetic diagnoses and discover aetiological variants within routine healthcare.

label: Australian Imaging, Biomarker & Lifestyle Flagship Study of Ageing
other synonyms: Australian Imaging, Biomarker & Lifestyle study|Australian Imaging, Biomarker and Lifestyle Flagship Study of Ageing|Australian Imaging, Biomarkers and Lifestyle flagship study of aging|The Australian Imaging, Biomarkers and Lifestyle Study
definition: A longitudinal cohort of volunteers aged over 60 in Australia, including people with Alzheimer's disease, mild cognitive impairment and healthy controls, recruited at centres in Perth and Melbourne and reassessed at 18-month intervals with cognitive testing, blood biomarkers, lifestyle questionnaires and amyloid PET and MRI imaging to study predictors of Alzheimer's disease and cognitive decline.
diseases: patients with: Alzheimer disease (MONDO:0004975)|patients with: cognitive disorder (MONDO:0002039)

label: PopGen Biobank
other synonyms: Biobank PopGen|Biobank popgen|PopGen cohort|The Population Genetic Cohort
definition: A population-based biobank in the most northern part of Germany, run from Kiel University, that recruits patients through complete ascertainment in a geographically confined area together with population controls, covering cardiovascular, neuropsychiatric and environmental diseases, to estimate population-specific genotypic risks for complex diseases.

label: Diabetic Nephropathy Cohort
