other synonyms: INVENT Consortium|International Network Against Venous Thrombosis
definition: An international consortium that meta-analyses genome-wide association studies of venous thromboembolism from many case-control and population studies (30,234 cases and 172,122 controls from 18 studies in its 2019 analysis, 29 studies in later case-only analyses) to identify genetic risk factors for venous thromboembolism and its subtypes.

label: Los Angeles Bladder Cancer Study
other synonyms: Los Angeles BC ca–co study
definition: A population-based case-control study of bladder cancer in Los Angeles County, United States, with cases aged 25–64 diagnosed in 1987–1996 identified through the Los Angeles County Cancer Surveillance Program and matched neighbourhood controls, used to study lifestyle and genetic risk factors for bladder cancer.

label: Influence of Life-style factors on Development of the Immune System and Allergies in East and West Germany plus Air Pollution and Genetics on Allergy Development
other synonyms: Influence of Life-style factors on Development of the Immune System and Allergies in East and West Germany|Lifestyle Immune System Allergy study|Lifestyle-Immune System-Allergy Plus Environment and Genetics Study
definition: A prospective population-based German birth cohort of 3,097 healthy term newborns born between 1997 and 1999 and recruited in obstetric hospitals in Munich, Leipzig, Wesel and Bad Honnef, followed through childhood and adolescence to study the influence of lifestyle, environmental exposures such as air pollution, and genetics on the development of the immune system and allergic diseases.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to emissions from petroleum combustion (ECTO:7000156)|designed to study: exposure to lifestyle (ECTO:6000015)

label: Mayo Clinic Venous Thromboembolism Study
other synonyms: GENEVA Study of Venous Thromboembolism|Mayo Venous Thromboembolism Case–Control Study|Mayo Venous Thromboembolism Study
definition: A case-control study at the Mayo Clinic, Rochester, Minnesota, of adults with objectively diagnosed venous thromboembolism and age- and sex-matched controls, supplemented by Olmsted County residents with incident venous thromboembolism and matched controls, used for candidate-gene, genome-wide and whole-genome sequencing studies of venous thromboembolism risk.

label: Multicase-Control Study in Spain
other synonyms: Multi-case Control Study, Spain|Spanish Multicenter Case-Control Study|Spanish multicase-control study
definition: A multicase-control study in Spain that recruited hospital-based cases of several common cancers, including breast, colorectal and prostate cancer, and population-based controls in 2008–2013, to study environmental, lifestyle and genetic risk factors for these cancers.
diseases: patients with: B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia (MONDO:0004948)|patients with: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|patients with: colorectal cancer (MONDO:0005575)|patients with: prostate cancer (MONDO:0008315)
exposures: designed to study: exposure to drinking water (ECTO:7000125)|designed to study: exposure to nitrate via ingestion (ECTO:0900332)

label: Microisolates in South Tyrol Study
other synonyms: MICROS study|Micro-isolates in South Tyrol Study|genetic study of three population microisolates in South Tyrol
definition: A population-based family study of about 1,300 adults from Stelvio, Vallelunga and Martello, three small, historically isolated villages of the Val Venosta (Vinschgau) in South Tyrol, Italy, surveyed by the European Academy of Bozen/Bolzano (EURAC) in 2002–2003 and 2007, with reconstructed genealogies, to study the genetic epidemiology of Mendelian and complex diseases.

label: MrOS Sweden
other synonyms: MrOs Sweden|Osteoporotic Fractures in Men (MrOs) Sweden study|Osteoporotic Fractures in Men Study SWE|Swedish MrOS
definition: A prospective population-based multicentre study of 3,014 men aged 69–81, randomly selected from the Swedish national population register and examined at hospitals in Malmö, Gothenburg and Uppsala in 2001–2004, the Swedish part of the Osteoporotic Fractures in Men study, set up to identify risk factors for osteoporosis and fracture.
diseases: population study of: bone fracture (MONDO:0005315)|population study of: osteoporosis (MONDO:0005298)

label: New England Bladder Cancer Study
other synonyms: New England Bladder Cancer Case-Control Study
definition: A population-based case-control study of bladder cancer among residents of Maine, New Hampshire and Vermont, United States, with cases newly diagnosed in 2001–2004 and population controls frequency-matched on age, sex and state, used to study environmental, dietary and genetic risk factors for bladder cancer.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to arsenic in water via ingestion (ECTO:0080000)|designed to study: exposure to drinking water (ECTO:7000125)|designed to study: exposure to environmental contaminant (ECTO:0000931)

label: NINDS Parkinson's Disease dataset
other synonyms: NINDS PD dataset|NINDS Parkinson's Disease|National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke Parkinson's Disease dataset
definition: A collection of Parkinson's disease patients and neurologically normal controls whose samples are held in the NINDS repository at the Coriell Institute and were genotyped genome-wide and publicly released through dbGaP (phs001172, including phs000089) for studies of genetic risk of Parkinson's disease.

label: NPDPSC pathology-confirmed rpAD
definition: A set of about 115 autopsied people referred with rapidly progressive dementia resembling prion disease to the National Prion Disease Pathology Surveillance Center at Case Western Reserve University between 2009 and 2017, in whom neuropathology, prion protein typing, PRNP sequencing and record review excluded prion disease and confirmed Alzheimer's disease, whole-genome sequenced from frozen brain tissue for genetic studies of rapidly progressive Alzheimer's disease.

label: Outcome Modifying Genes in Sickle Cell Disease
other synonyms: Duke University Outcome Modifying Genes study|Outcome Modifying Genes in SCD|TOPMed OMG-SCD
definition: A cross-sectional observational cohort of more than 800 adult patients with sickle cell disease enrolled between 2002 and 2015 at sickle cell centres in the southeastern United States, coordinated from Duke University, to study genetic associations with clinical outcomes.

label: Oxford Parkinson's Disease Centre Discovery Cohort
other synonyms: OPDC Discovery Cohort|Oxford Discovery|Oxford Parkinson Disease Centre Discovery Cohort|Oxford Parkinson’s Disease Centre cohort study
definition: A population-based incidence cohort of people diagnosed with Parkinson's disease within the previous 3.5 years, recruited by the Oxford Parkinson's Disease Centre from 11 hospitals across the Thames Valley, England, between 2010 and 2014, and followed with motor, cognitive and non-motor assessments to study Parkinson's disease progression and subtypes.

label: Australian Alcohol and Nicotine Studies
other synonyms: Alcohol Research using Australian twins and their families|Australian Twin-Family Studies|Australian Twin-Family Studies on Nicotine and Alcohol Genetics|Australian twin-family study of alcohol use disorder|Nicotine Addiction Genetics study / Interactive Research Project Grants
definition: A family sample of sibships ascertained through the Australian Twin Registry, with diagnostic interviews and blood or buccal DNA, members of which were genotyped genome-wide to study genetic contributions to alcohol use and dependence and nicotine dependence.
diseases: patients with: alcohol dependence (MONDO:0007079)|patients with: nicotine dependence (MONDO:0008575)
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to alcohol abuse (ECTO:6000009)|participants with exposure: exposure to alcohol consumption (ECTO:0001082)|participants with exposure: exposure to tobacco smoking (ECTO:6000029)

label: Parkinson's Disease Biomarkers Program
other synonyms: NINDS Parkinson's Disease Biomarkers Program|Parkinson Disease Biomarkers Program|Parkinson's Disease Biomarker Program|Parkinson's Disease Biomarkers Project
definition: A longitudinal multi-project collection of clinical data and biosamples from people with Parkinson's disease at different stages, other parkinsonism, essential tremor and controls, established in 2012 by the US National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke as a consortium of biomarker discovery projects with standardized procedures and a shared data management resource.

label: Pakistan Genomic Resource
other synonyms: Pakistan Genome Resource|Pakistan Genomics Resource
definition: A growing biobank and national consortium of case–control studies in Pakistan that aims to enrol one million participants (about 250,000 from 48 clinical sites in 17 cities by September 2023) across some 50 diseases, with whole-exome sequencing and recontact, used for genetic association and loss-of-function studies.

label: Pharmacogenetics of Nicotine Addiction Treatment
other synonyms: Pharmacogenetics of Nicotine Addiction Treatment (PNAT)-2 clinical trial|Pharmacogenetics of Nicotine Addiction and Treatment clinical trial
definition: A multicentre, randomised, placebo-controlled smoking-cessation trial (NCT01314001) run from 2010 to 2014 at four academic medical centres in the United States and Canada, in which 1246 treatment-seeking smokers stratified by nicotine metabolite ratio were assigned to placebo, nicotine patch or varenicline.
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to Cigarette Smoking (ECTO:6000038)

label: Riesgo de Enfermedad TROmboembólica VEnosa
other synonyms: RETROVE study|Riesgo de Enfermedad Tromboembolica Venosa
definition: A Spanish case-control study of venous thromboembolism, based at the Hospital de la Santa Creu i Sant Pau in Barcelona, whose cases had a first venous thromboembolism and were sampled after 6–12 months of anticoagulant treatment, with healthy controls recruited from the general population, used to study genetic and plasma determinants of venous thromboembolism.

label: Recurrent Venous Thromboembolism Risk Stratification Evaluation
other synonyms: REVERSE I study|REVERSE cohort study
definition: A multicentre prospective cohort of 646 patients with a first unprovoked major venous thromboembolism, enrolled from 12 tertiary care centres in 4 countries while on oral anticoagulation 5–7 months after the event and followed after stopping anticoagulation (to September 2006), to derive a clinical decision rule identifying patients at low risk of recurrent venous thromboembolism.

label: Suivi Temporaire Annuel Non-Invasif de la Santé des Lorrains Assurés Sociaux
other synonyms: STANISLAS Family Study|STANISLAS cohort|STANISLAS study|STANISLAS study cohort
definition: A single-centre longitudinal family cohort of 4,295 people from 1,006 families of the Lorraine region, recruited in 1993–1995 at the Center for Preventive Medicine in Nancy, France, and re-examined over about 20 years, to study the familial and genetic determinants of cardiovascular and metabolic traits.

label: Strong Heart Study
definition: A cohort of 4,549 self-identified American Indian adults aged 45 years or older, recruited in 1989–1991 from tribal communities in Arizona, Oklahoma, North Dakota and South Dakota, United States, and followed through repeated examinations to estimate cardiovascular disease rates and risk factors in American Indians.

label: South London Ethnicity and Stroke Study
definition: A stroke study in which 1,200 black and 1,200 white stroke patients were prospectively recruited between 1999 and 2010 from three hospitals covering a contiguous area of South London, United Kingdom, with black African and African Caribbean community controls from general practice lists in the same catchment area (1999–2012), to study stroke subtypes and the genetic and other risk factors for stroke in African and African Caribbean people.

label: SLI Consortium cohort
other synonyms: SLI Consortium|SLI Consortium Cohort
definition: A collection of nuclear families, each ascertained through a proband with receptive and/or expressive language skills more than 1.5 SD below the age norm, gathered by the SLI Consortium from five clinical and epidemiological sites across the United Kingdom for linkage and association studies of specific language impairment.

label: US Servicemen's Testicular Tumor Environmental and Endocrine Determinants Study
other synonyms: NCI United States Servicemen's Testicular Tumor Environmental and Endocrine Determinants Study|The US Servicemen's Testicular Tumor Environmental and Endocrine Determinants Study
definition: A case-control study of testicular germ cell tumours among US military servicemen aged 18–45 with serum stored in the Department of Defense Serum Repository, comparing men diagnosed on active duty in 2002–2005 with matched controls to study environmental, endocrine and genetic risk factors.
diseases: patients with: testicular germ cell tumor (MONDO:0010108)
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)

label: Tromsø Study
other synonyms: The Tromso Study|The Tromsø Study|Tromso Study
definition: A population-based study of residents of the municipality of Tromsø, Norway, run by UiT The Arctic University of Norway, begun in 1974 and repeated in seven surveys (Tromsø1–Tromsø7) that together enrolled 45,473 people, as a multipurpose health survey of chronic diseases and their risk factors.

label: Texas Bladder Cancer Study
other synonyms: Houston Bladder Cancer Study
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of bladder cancer in Texas, United States, with newly diagnosed, previously untreated cases recruited at the University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center and Baylor College of Medicine and matched controls, used for genome-wide and pathway studies of bladder cancer susceptibility.

label: Asia Breast Cancer Consortium
definition: A consortium of breast cancer genetic association studies in women of Asian ancestry, with studies in mainland China, Taiwan, South Korea and Japan (genome-wide data on about 24,000 cases and 25,000 controls by 2020), formed to discover breast cancer susceptibility loci in Asian populations.

label: Atrial Fibrillation Genetics Consortium
other synonyms: AFGen Consortium|Atrial Fibrillation Genetics (AFGen) consortium
definition: A consortium of cohort and case-control studies with genome-wide genotype data that pools them in meta-analyses of genome-wide association studies of atrial fibrillation, to identify genetic loci for atrial fibrillation; together with the Broad AF Study, its studies formed the majority of the 2018 multi-ethnic meta-analysis of more than half a million individuals.

label: ASPirin in Reducing Events in the Elderly
other synonyms: ASPREE trial|Aspirin in Reducing Events in the Elderly|The ASPirin in Reducing Events in the Elderly trial
definition: A placebo-controlled randomized trial of daily low-dose aspirin in 19,114 community-dwelling adults aged 70 or over (65 or over for US minorities) in Australia and the United States without prior cardiovascular events, dementia or independence-limiting physical disability, followed as a cohort after the trial to study healthy ageing.

label: Austrian Stroke Prevention Study
definition: A prospective single-centre population-based study of community-dwelling elderly people without stroke or dementia, randomly selected from the community register of Graz, Austria, and enrolled between 1991 and 2004, examining the effects of vascular risk factors on brain structure and function in normal ageing.
diseases: population study of: cerebrovascular disorder (MONDO:0011057)|population study of: stroke disorder (MONDO:0005098)

label: Austrian Stroke Prevention Family Study
other synonyms: ASPS Family Study
definition: A family-based extension of the Austrian Stroke Prevention Study in Graz, Austria, for which ASPS participants and their first-degree relatives were invited between 2006 and 2013 (419 individuals from 176 families), examined with clinical history, neurological examination, brain MRI, laboratory tests, cognitive testing and vascular risk factor assessment to study the cerebral effects of vascular risk factors.
diseases: population study of: cerebrovascular disorder (MONDO:0011057)|population study of: stroke disorder (MONDO:0005098)

label: B-Vitamins for the PRevention Of Osteoporotic Fractures
other synonyms: B Vitamins for the Prevention of Osteoporotic Fractures (B-PROOF) Trial|B-PROOF study|B-vitamins for the prevention of osteoporotic fractures
definition: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of 2,919 people aged 65 and older with elevated homocysteine, recruited in 2008–2011 mainly through municipal registries around research centres in Rotterdam, Amsterdam and Wageningen, the Netherlands, testing whether two years of vitamin B12 and folic acid supplementation reduce osteoporotic fracture incidence.
diseases: at risk of: bone fracture (MONDO:0005315)|at risk of: osteoporosis (MONDO:0005298)

label: Canadian Partnership for Tomorrow's Health
other synonyms: Canadian Partnership for Tomorrow Project
definition: A pan-Canadian prospective cohort platform, established by the Canadian Partnership Against Cancer in June 2008 as the Canadian Partnership for Tomorrow Project, that federates regional cohorts (seven across ten provinces, among them CARTaGENE and the Ontario Health Study; 307,017 participants aged 30–74 from 8 provinces in five cohorts in its 2018 profile) with harmonized questionnaire, physical measurement and biosample data and linkage to administrative health databases, to study how genetics, behaviour and environment affect cancer and other chronic diseases.

label: DeCOI cohort
definition: A cohort of about 1,220 mainly vaccine-naive individuals with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection, across the full spectrum from asymptomatic to critical COVID-19, recruited early in the pandemic at 16 sites in Germany and South Tyrol, Italy, by a national host-genetics consortium built on the German COVID-19 Omics Initiative, with whole genome sequencing to study host genetic factors in COVID-19.

label: EU-RLS-GENE consortium
other synonyms: International EU-RLS-GENE consortium
definition: An international consortium of restless legs syndrome case collections recruited by expert clinicians in movement-disorder and sleep clinics in Europe, Canada and the United States, with ancestry-matched population or hospital controls, pooled (7,248 cases and 19,802 controls) for genome-wide association studies of restless legs syndrome.

label: Familial Influences on Literacy Abilities
other synonyms: Familial Influences On Literacy Abilities
definition: A Dutch family dataset of 483 children from 307 nuclear families and 505 adults, including parents, assessed for word and nonword reading fluency, phonological awareness and rapid automatized naming to study genetic influences on reading and language.

label: Female Lung Cancer Consortium in Asia
other synonyms: the Female Lung Cancer Consortium in Asia
definition: An international consortium of lung cancer studies of never-smoking Asian women from mainland China, Hong Kong, Singapore, Taiwan, South Korea and Japan, pooling genome-wide data to identify genetic risk factors for lung cancer, particularly adenocarcinoma, in this population.
diseases: patients with: lung adenocarcinoma (MONDO:0005061)|patients with: lung cancer (MONDO:0008903)

label: GlobalGout Genetics Consortium
definition: An international consortium of gout genetics research groups, named as a collective author of a genome-wide association analysis of gout in 2.6 million people, whose own case-control sample set (New Zealand/Ardea Biosciences/EuroGout: 4,713 people with self-reported clinically diagnosed gout or gout meeting the 1977 ARA classification criteria and 2,151 controls, of self-reported European ancestry) was genotyped for that study on the Illumina CoreExome array.

label: Growing Up in Singapore Towards healthy Outcomes
other synonyms: GUSTO birth cohort|Growing Up in Singapore Towards Healthy Outcomes|Growing Up in Singapore Towards healthy Outcomes (GUSTO) mother-offspring cohort
definition: A birth cohort in Singapore that enrolled 1468 pregnant women aged 18 years or over at their first-trimester dating scan at the two major public maternity units in 2009–2010 and follows the mothers and their children, to evaluate how early-life exposures influence later metabolic function, body composition and development.

label: Hawaii Adenoma Study
other synonyms: Hawaiian Adenoma Case-Control Study|Hawaiian Adenoma Study
definition: A case-control study of first-time colorectal adenoma among Caucasian, Japanese and Native Hawaiian adults on Oahu, Hawaii, United States, with cases from the Hawaii site of the PLCO screening trial and Kaiser Permanente Hawaii clinics (1995–2006) and controls with normal endoscopy, used to study risk factors for colorectal neoplasia.

label: Henry Ford Heart Failure Pharmacogenomic Registry
other synonyms: HF pharmacogenomic registry
definition: A prospective registry of Black and White patients with heart failure enrolled within the Henry Ford Health System in Detroit, Michigan, from 2007 to 2015, with genotyping and pharmacy claims data, designed to discover ways to predict heart failure prognosis and responses to heart failure therapies.

label: HS Program for Research and Care Excellence
other synonyms: Hidradenitis Suppurativa Program for Research and Care Excellence|Program for Research and Care Excellence
definition: A cohort of patients with hidradenitis suppurativa recruited at the University of North Carolina Department of Dermatology in the United States from August 2018 (753 patients by July 2021, later expanded to 986), providing clinical data and DNA for genetic association studies of the disease.

label: IARC Multicenter Case-Control Study
other synonyms: Central Europe GWAS|IARC GWAS|IARC lung cancer GWAS|International Agency for Research on Cancer Study
definition: A multicentre hospital-based case–control study of lung cancer coordinated by the International Agency for Research on Cancer in Romania, Hungary, Slovakia, Poland, Russia and the Czech Republic, whose genome-wide genotyped cases and controls form the IARC lung cancer GWAS used by international lung cancer consortia.

label: Identification and prevention of Dietary- and lifestyle-induced health EFfects In Children and infantS
other synonyms: IDEFICS study|IDEFICS/I.Family cohort
definition: A multi-centre European population-based cohort of 16,228 children aged 2 to 9 years examined in 2007–2008 in Belgium, Cyprus, Estonia, Germany, Hungary, Italy, Spain and Sweden, with a community-based obesity-prevention intervention, followed into adolescence by the I.Family study to identify dietary and lifestyle risk factors for childhood overweight and metabolic disorders.
diseases: population study of: metabolic disease (MONDO:0005066)|population study of: obesity disorder (MONDO:0011122)|population study of: obesity disorder (MONDO:0011122)
exposures: designed to study: exposure to Physical Activity (ECTO:6000039)|designed to study: exposure to eating behavior (ECTO:6000021)|designed to study: exposure to lifestyle (ECTO:6000015)

label: Insulin Resistance Atherosclerosis Study
other synonyms: The Insulin Resistance Atherosclerosis Study
definition: A multiethnic cohort of over 1,600 Hispanic, non-Hispanic white and African American men and women aged 40–69 years with normal, impaired or diabetic glucose tolerance, recruited at four clinical centres in California, Texas and Colorado, United States, to study the relationships between directly measured insulin resistance, atherosclerosis and cardiovascular disease.
diseases: population study of: atherosclerosis (MONDO:0005311)|population study of: cardiovascular disorder (MONDO:0004995)|population study of: type 2 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005148)

label: Personalized Medicine Research Project
other synonyms: Marshfield Clinic|Marshfield Clinic Personalized Medicine Research Project|Marshfield PMRP|Marshfield Personalized Medicine Research Project Biobank
definition: A population-based biobank cohort of about 20,000 adults living in 19 zip codes around Marshfield, Wisconsin, United States, recruited by the Marshfield Clinic from 2002, who provided DNA, serum and plasma samples linked to their electronic medical records for genetic and gene–environment research.

label: MD Anderson Cancer Center lung cancer study
other synonyms: MD Anderson Cancer Center Lung Cancer Study|MD Anderson Cancer Center Study|MD Anderson Cancer Center lung cancer study (MDACC)|Texas-GWA study
definition: A hospital-based case–control study of lung cancer at The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center in Houston, Texas, of ever-smoking patients of European ancestry and frequency-matched ever-smoking controls, genotyped genome-wide to find lung cancer susceptibility loci and later pooled in international lung cancer consortia.
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to Cigarette Smoking (ECTO:6000038)

label: MD Anderson Cancer Center melanoma study
other synonyms: GENEVA Melanoma study|High Density SNP Association Analysis of Melanoma|High Density SNP Association Analysis of Melanoma: Case-Control and Outcomes Investigation|MD Anderson Cancer Center Study
definition: A hospital-based case–control study of cutaneous melanoma at The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center, with non-Hispanic white patients and cancer-free controls (friends or acquaintances accompanying patients) recruited between 1998 and 2008, genotyped genome-wide to find melanoma susceptibility loci.

label: National Center for Geriatrics and Gerontology Biobank
other synonyms: NCGG Biobank|National Center for Geriatrics and Gerontology
definition: A biobank at the National Center for Geriatrics and Gerontology in Obu, Japan, holding DNA samples and clinical data from tens of thousands of patients with dementia and other age-related conditions and cognitively normal older adults from the NCGG hospital and a neighbourhood cohort, used for genetic studies of dementia and ageing in the Japanese population.

label: Nulliparous Pregnancy Outcomes Study: Monitoring Mothers-to-Be
definition: A prospective multicentre US cohort of 10,038 nulliparous women with singleton pregnancies recruited in the first trimester at eight clinical sites between 2010 and 2013 and followed through pregnancy, to study the factors that contribute to adverse pregnancy outcomes such as preterm birth, preeclampsia and gestational diabetes.
diseases: population study of: Premature birth (HP:0001622)|population study of: gestational diabetes (MONDO:0005406)|population study of: preeclampsia (MONDO:0005081)|population study of: pregnancy disorder (MONDO:0024575)|population study of: pregnancy disorder with abortive outcome (MONDO:0041526)

label: Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort
definition: A population-based study of youths aged 8–21 living in the greater Philadelphia area, United States, recruited through the Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia Center for Applied Genomics from non-psychiatric paediatric clinics and assessed with clinical, neurocognitive and neuroimaging measures to describe how genetics affects brain development and cognitive functioning in adolescence.

label: ProHealth Study
definition: A study within Kaiser Permanente Northern California that ascertained African-American prostate cancer cases, genotyped together with the Research Program on Genes, Environment and Health cohort and the California Men's Health Study for genome-wide association studies of prostate cancer.

label: Radiogenomics Consortium
other synonyms: Radiogenomic Consortium
definition: An international consortium, established in 2009, of cohorts of cancer patients treated with radiotherapy (for prostate, head and neck, breast and lung cancer, among others) that shares genotype and normal-tissue toxicity data and develops meta-analysis methods to identify genetic variants associated with radiation-induced toxicity.
diseases: patients with: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|patients with: cancer (MONDO:0004992)|patients with: head and neck cancer (MONDO:0005627)|patients with: lung cancer (MONDO:0008903)|patients with: prostate cancer (MONDO:0008315)

label: Study of Epidemiology and Risk Factors in Cancer Heredity
other synonyms: Studies of Epidemiology and Risk Factors in Cancer Heredity|Study of Epidemiology and Risk factors in Cancer Heredity
definition: A population-based case-control study in East Anglia, UK, run from Cambridge with Cancer Research UK funding, in which people with cancer registered with the Eastern Cancer Registration and Information Centre and controls attending general practice in East Anglia provide data and DNA to study genetic susceptibility to cancers including breast and prostate cancer.
diseases: patients with: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|patients with: cancer (MONDO:0004992)|patients with: colorectal cancer (MONDO:0005575)|patients with: ovarian cancer (MONDO:0008170)|patients with: prostate cancer (MONDO:0008315)

label: SEARCH for Diabetes in Youth
other synonyms: SEARCH for Diabetes in Youth Study
definition: An observational multicentre study in the United States of physician-diagnosed diabetes in people under 20 years old, ascertaining prevalent and incident cases in geographically defined populations and health plans, with interviews, examinations and laboratory measurements, to estimate the prevalence, incidence and classification of diabetes in youth.

label: Swedish Rheumatology Quality Register Biobank
other synonyms: SRQ biobank|Swedish Rheumatology Quality Register’s biobank
definition: A biobank of the Swedish Rheumatology Quality Register holding blood samples, linked to register data, from more than 5500 patients with rheumatoid arthritis in Sweden who have early disease or are starting a biological disease-modifying drug, used for genetic and treatment-response research.

label: Swedish Rheumatology Quality Register
definition: A nationwide quality register of patients with rheumatic diseases, established in Sweden in the mid-1990s and used by most Swedish rheumatologists to monitor the disease course of patients as part of standard care.

label: Skåne University Hospital memory clinic cohort
definition: A clinical sample of patients with Alzheimer's disease evaluated at the memory disorder unit of Skåne University Hospital, Sweden, with physical, neurological and psychiatric examination, a clinical interview, cognitive testing, APOE genotyping and brain imaging, whose cerebrospinal fluid Alzheimer's biomarker data were used in a genome-wide association meta-analysis.

label: Toledo Study for Healthy Aging
other synonyms: Toledo Study of Healthy Aging
definition: A population-based study of 2,488 people aged 65 and older in the province of Toledo, Spain, selected by two-stage random sampling from the municipal census and covering institutionalised and community-dwelling persons in rural and urban settings, with data collected from 2006 to study frailty and healthy ageing.

label: Berlin Aging Study II
definition: A multidisciplinary, multi-institutional cohort of about 1,600 older adults aged 60–80 and 600 younger adults aged 20–35 recruited as volunteers in the Berlin metropolitan area, Germany, with baseline assessments completed in 2014 across geriatrics, internal medicine, immunology, genetics, psychology, sociology and economics, to identify factors associated with healthy versus unhealthy ageing; a subsample of the older group was re-examined in 2018–2020 in the GendAge study.

label: Rotterdam Study II
other synonyms: Rotterdam Study, second cohort|second cohort of the Rotterdam Study
definition: The second cohort of the Rotterdam Study, a prospective population-based cohort of 3,011 inhabitants of Ommoord, a suburb of Rotterdam in the Netherlands, who had moved to the district or turned 55 since the first cohort began, enrolled from 2000 and re-examined about every 5 years to study determinants of chronic diseases in older adults.

label: MrOS Malmö
definition: The Malmö sub-cohort of MrOS Sweden: 1,005 men aged 69–81, randomly selected from the Swedish national population register and examined at hospital in Malmö, Sweden, in 2001–2004, to identify risk factors for osteoporosis and fracture.
diseases: population study of: bone fracture (MONDO:0005315)|population study of: osteoporosis (MONDO:0005298)

label: Longitudinal Aging Study Amsterdam
definition: An ongoing prospective cohort study of older adults in the Netherlands, started in 1992 with a nationally representative sample aged 55–84 and refreshed with further cohorts in 2002, 2012 and 2024, to describe determinants, trajectories and consequences of changes in physical, cognitive, emotional and social functioning.

label: Finnish Gestational Diabetes Study
other synonyms: The Finnish Gestational Diabetes (FinnGeDi) Study
definition: A multicentre Finnish study of women who gave birth in 2009–2012, with a prospective genetic case-control arm of 1,146 pregnant women with gestational diabetes and 1,066 without, their children and the children’s fathers, recruited at seven hospitals, and a national register-based arm, to study the causes and consequences of gestational diabetes.

label: MrOS Gothenburg
definition: The Gothenburg sub-cohort of MrOS Sweden: 1,010 men aged 69–81, randomly selected from the Swedish national population register and examined at hospital in Gothenburg, Sweden, in 2001–2004, to identify risk factors for osteoporosis and fracture.
diseases: population study of: bone fracture (MONDO:0005315)|population study of: osteoporosis (MONDO:0005298)

label: African Ancestry Anthropometry Genetics Consortium
other synonyms: African American Anthropometry Genetics Consortium|African Ancestry Anthropometry Genetics
definition: A consortium of genome-wide association studies of individuals of African ancestry that meta-analyses results from participating studies (up to about 53,000 individuals for body mass index) to discover and fine-map genetic loci for adiposity and other anthropometric traits.

label: Accelerating Medicines Partnership Parkinson's Disease
other synonyms: Accelerating Medicines Partnership: Parkinson's Disease|Accelerating Medicines Partnership–Parkinson’s Disease
definition: A public–private research programme managed by the Foundation for the National Institutes of Health that harmonizes whole-genome sequencing, RNA expression and clinical data from multiple Parkinson's disease cohort studies, including PPMI, PDBP, the Harvard Biomarkers Study and BioFIND, on a shared platform for Parkinson's disease research.

label: Salus in Apulia Study
other synonyms: Great Age study|Salus in Apulia|Salus in Apulia aging cohort
definition: A population-based cohort of older adults aged 65 and over, recruited from the electoral rolls of Castellana Grotte, Bari, in Apulia, southern Italy, by the National Institute of Gastroenterology 'Saverio de Bellis' Research Hospital as a public health initiative funded by the Italian Ministry of Health and the Apulia Regional Government, to study ageing, frailty, cognitive decline and related conditions.

label: Beijing Atherosclerosis Study
definition: A case-control collection of Han Chinese participants from Beijing, China, with myocardial infarction cases verified by hospital records and cardiologists and controls randomly selected from a community-based survey of cardiovascular risk factors in Beijing, assembled to study genetic susceptibility to coronary artery disease and atherosclerosis.
diseases: patients with: coronary artery disorder (MONDO:0005010)|patients with: myocardial infarction (MONDO:0005068)

label: BIObanks Netherlands Internet Collaboration
other synonyms: BIONIC consortium|BIONIC project|Biobanks Netherlands Internet Collaboration
definition: A nation-wide Dutch collaborative project that combines genotype data from sixteen population and clinical cohorts in the Netherlands with uniform, DSM-based phenotyping of major depressive disorder, pooled centrally for genetic mega-analysis of depression.
diseases: population study of: major depressive disorder (MONDO:0002009)

label: Bone Mineral Density in Childhood Study
definition: A multiethnic longitudinal study of healthy children at five clinical centres in the United States, enrolled from 2002–2003 at ages 6 to 16 years (1,554 children), with a later enrolment wave of 5- and 19-year-olds, measured annually by dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry for up to 6 years, established to provide reference curves for bone mineral content and density by age, sex and race.

label: Canadian Breast Cancer Study
definition: A population-based case-control study of women aged 20–80 with in situ or invasive breast cancer diagnosed from April 2005 to May 2009 in Metro Vancouver, British Columbia, and Kingston, Ontario, Canada, with cases from the BC Cancer Registry and controls from the Screening Mammography Program of BC in Vancouver, and cases and controls from the Hotel Dieu Breast Assessment Program in Kingston.

label: NIHR Cambridge BioResource
other synonyms: Cambridge BioResource|Cambridge NIHR BioResource|National Institute for Health Research Cambridge BioResource
definition: A panel of volunteers in Cambridge, England, including blood donors registered with NHS Blood and Transplant, who have consented to be recalled for research studies by genotype or phenotype; the Cambridge centre of the NIHR BioResource, funded by the NIHR Cambridge Biomedical Research Centre and NHS Blood and Transplant.

label: Consortium of Investigators of Modifiers of BRCA1 and BRCA2
other synonyms: Consortium of Investigators of Modifiers of BRCA1/2|Consortium of Investigators of Modifiers of BRCA1/BRCA2
definition: An international consortium of research groups that collect DNA and clinical data from carriers of BRCA1 and BRCA2 mutations, established to identify genetic modifiers of breast and ovarian cancer risk in mutation carriers; it began with about 30 affiliated groups and later brought together more than 60 studies.
diseases: at risk of: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|at risk of: ovarian cancer (MONDO:0008170)

label: UROMOL project
other synonyms: CNIO/UROMOL study|UROMOL cohort|UROMOL study
definition: A European multicentre prospective study of patients with non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer, with tumour multi-omics and germline genotype data and clinical follow-up for recurrence and progression, used to define molecular subtypes of the disease and in genetic studies of bladder cancer.
diseases: patients with: superficial urinary bladder carcinoma (MONDO:0004200)

label: Cardiometabolic Risk in Chinese Study
other synonyms: CRC Study|Cardiometabolic Risk in Chinese
definition: A community-based health examination survey cohort of 6,431 adults aged 18–93 years randomly selected in 2009 from residents of the urban area of Xuzhou, Jiangsu, China, by Xuzhou Central Hospital, to study cardiometabolic risk factors such as insulin resistance, prediabetes, hypertension and early atherosclerosis.

label: Cooperative Research Centre Cohort
other synonyms: CRC Australia|Cooperative Research Centre (CRC) Cohort
definition: A cohort of clozapine-treated patients with schizophrenia recruited by the Cooperative Research Centre from inpatient and outpatient clinics around Melbourne, Australia, with symptom severity (PANSS) assessments, contributing to genetic studies of clozapine treatment outcome.

label: Consortium for Refractive Error and Myopia
definition: An international consortium of cohorts of European and Asian ancestry that pools cohort-level genome-wide association results to study refractive error, myopia and ocular biometric traits such as axial length and corneal curvature.
diseases: population study of: myopia (MONDO:0001384)|population study of: refractive error (MONDO:0004892)

label: Doetinchem Cohort Study
other synonyms: Doetinchem Cohort
definition: A population-based cohort study in Doetinchem, the Netherlands, started by the Dutch National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) as a monitoring study of cardiovascular risk factors, in which 12,404 inhabitants aged 20–59, drawn as an age- and sex-stratified sample of the population register, were examined in 1987–1991 and two-thirds of them were re-invited to repeated rounds, to study lifestyle and other determinants of health, functioning and chronic disease over the life course.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to Physical Activity (ECTO:6000039)|designed to study: exposure to alcohol consumption (ECTO:0001082)|designed to study: exposure to lifestyle (ECTO:6000015)|designed to study: exposure to nutrient (ECTO:9001695)|designed to study: exposure to smoking (ECTO:6000013)

label: Genes-environments & Admixture in Latino Americans
other synonyms: Genes- Environments & Admixture in Latino Americans study
definition: A clinic-based case-control study of self-identified Latino children and young adults aged 8–22 years with and without asthma, recruited at centres in the mainland United States and Puerto Rico under the University of California, San Francisco, to study the genetic and environmental basis of childhood-onset asthma.
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)

label: Groningen Expert Center for Kids with Obesity Drenthe study
other synonyms: GECKO Drenthe birth cohort|GECKO Drenthe cohort|The Groningen Expert Center for Kids with Obesity Drenthe study
definition: A population-based Dutch birth cohort of children of almost 3,000 pregnant women living in the province of Drenthe in the northern Netherlands, recruited in 2006, followed to study early risk factors for overweight and obesity in childhood.
diseases: population study of: Overweight (HP:0025502)|population study of: obesity disorder (MONDO:0011122)

label: Genes and Environment in Multiple Sclerosis
other synonyms: Genes and Environment for MS|Genes and Environment in MS
definition: A Swedish population-based case-control study of multiple sclerosis in which prevalent cases fulfilling the McDonald criteria were identified from the Swedish MS registry and controls were randomly selected from the national population register, with lifestyle and environmental questionnaires and blood samples for genetic analyses.
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)|designed to study: exposure to Solar radiation (ECTO:8000061)|designed to study: exposure to air pollution (ECTO:8000036)|designed to study: exposure to alcohol (ECTO:9000026)|designed to study: exposure to smoke (ECTO:7000059)|designed to study: exposure to smoking (ECTO:6000013)

label: Georgia Stress and Heart Study
other synonyms: Georgia Stress and Heart study
definition: A prospective cohort of normotensive children of African or European ancestry aged 5–16 years in 1989, recruited through a county-wide public school screening in Richmond County, Georgia, United States, and re-evaluated repeatedly into adulthood to study the development of cardiovascular risk factors from childhood to adulthood.

label: Health and Ageing in Africa: A Longitudinal Study of an INDEPTH Community in South Africa
other synonyms: Health and Aging in Africa: A Longitudinal Study of an INDEPTH Community in South Africa
definition: A longitudinal population study of more than 5000 adults aged 40 and older in Bushbuckridge, rural Mpumalanga, South Africa, recruited in 2014–2015 within the Agincourt Health and Demographic Surveillance System, collecting socio-demographic, infection history and cognitive data to study health and ageing.

label: Agincourt Health and Socio-demographic Surveillance System
other synonyms: Agincourt Health and Demographic Surveillance System|Agincourt health and socio-demographic surveillance system
definition: A health and socio-demographic surveillance system of about 90,000 people in rural northeast South Africa close to the Mozambique border, established in 1992, which updates resident status and vital events annually and hosts observational cohorts and trials across the life course on health, population and social transitions.

label: Health2006 Study
other synonyms: Health2006 cohort
definition: A population-based cohort of 3,471 adults aged 18–69, randomly sampled from the Danish Central Personal Register in the southern part of Copenhagen and examined in 2006–2008 at the Research Centre for Prevention and Health in Glostrup, Denmark, to study general health, allergy, diabetes and cardiovascular disease.

label: Heidelberger Langzeitstudie zu Risikofaktoren und Diagnose chronischer Erkrankungen
other synonyms: HeiDE study
definition: A longitudinal population-based study of 5,133 adults from the German city of Heidelberg and its surroundings, started in the 1990s with a baseline battery of health-related personality questionnaires to characterise associations between personality and somatic disease, and later followed up and genotyped.

label: Heart Failure Molecular Epidemiology for Therapeutic Targets Consortium
other synonyms: HERMES Consortium|Heart Failure Molecular Epidemiology for Therapeutic Targets
definition: A global collaboration of 51 studies from 11 countries with genome-wide genotyping and data on heart failure events and prognosis, including population-based cohorts, hospital-based electronic health record cohorts, case-control studies and clinical trials, formed to conduct large-scale genetic association studies of heart failure risk, prognosis and subtypes.

label: International Glaucoma Genetics Consortium
other synonyms: International Glaucoma Genetic Consortium
definition: A large international consortium established to identify glaucoma risk genes through large-scale genome-wide meta-analysis of primary open-angle glaucoma and related traits such as intraocular pressure, vertical cup-to-disc ratio and central corneal thickness, across populations of European, Asian and African ancestry.

label: International HIV Controllers Study
other synonyms: International HIV controllers Study Cohort
definition: A multinational study that recruited HIV-1 controllers, people with HIV whose plasma viral load stays below 2000 RNA copies/ml (at least three measurements over at least 12 months) without antiretroviral therapy, for genome-wide association analysis of host genetic effects on the control of HIV infection.

label: Immunomodulation and Multiple Sclerosis Epidemiology
other synonyms: Immunomodulation and MS Epidemiology|Immunomodulation and Multiple Sclerosis Epidemiology study
definition: A set of Swedish post-marketing (phase IV) cohorts of patients with multiple sclerosis treated with novel disease-modifying drugs, followed through the Swedish MS registry to monitor the long-term safety and risks of immunomodulatory treatments.

label: International Parkinson Disease Genomics Consortium
other synonyms: International Parkinson's Disease Genomics Consortium
definition: An international research alliance founded in 2009 of more than 100 scientists who pool genetic, clinical and functional data from Parkinson's disease case-control cohorts worldwide for collaborative genetics research on Parkinson's disease, with recent efforts in East Asia and Africa.

label: Japan PGx Data Science Consortium Database
other synonyms: JPDSC database
definition: A collection of 2994 healthy Japanese volunteers assembled by the Japan Pharmacogenomics Data Science Consortium, with genotypes of 2.5 million SNPs and 5 HLA loci and 121 kinds of clinical information, as control data for pharmacogenomics studies of drug safety and efficacy.

label: Justification for the Use of Statins in Prevention: an Intervention Trial Evaluating Rosuvastatin
other synonyms: JUPITER trial|Justification for the Use of Statins in Primary Prevention: An Intervention Trial Evaluating Rosuvastatin
definition: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of rosuvastatin 20 mg daily for the primary prevention of cardiovascular disease in 17,802 apparently healthy men aged 50 or over and women aged 60 or over with low LDL cholesterol but elevated high-sensitivity C-reactive protein, funded by AstraZeneca and stopped early for efficacy after a median follow-up of 1.9 years.

label: KOALA Birth Cohort Study
other synonyms: Child, parents and health: lifestyle and genetic constitution|Koala Birth Cohort Study
definition: A prospective Dutch birth cohort of healthy pregnant women enrolled from October 2000 to 2002, recruited from a cohort study on pregnancy-related pelvic girdle pain ('conventional lifestyles') and, for contrast, through organic food shops, anthroposophic doctors and midwives, Steiner schools and dedicated magazines ('alternative lifestyles'), and their children, set up to identify lifestyle and other early-life factors that influence atopic disease and followed into young adulthood.
diseases: population study of: atopic IgE-mediated allergic disorder (MONDO:0005202)
exposures: designed to study: exposure to eating behavior (ECTO:6000021)|designed to study: exposure to human milk (raw) via ingestion (ECTO:0070224)|designed to study: exposure to lifestyle (ECTO:6000015)|designed to study: exposure to organism (ECTO:3000000)

label: Mayo Clinic Breast Cancer Study
definition: A clinic-based case-control study of breast cancer begun in February 2001 at Mayo Clinic, Rochester, Minnesota, enrolling women aged 18 or over with invasive breast cancer who lived in the six-state region of Mayo Clinic's primary service population, and cancer-free controls frequency-matched on age, race and region from Mayo Clinic's general internal medicine practice.

label: Mayo Mammography Health Study
definition: A prospective breast screening cohort of 19,924 women aged 35 or over, resident in Minnesota, Iowa or Wisconsin and without a history of breast cancer, enrolled when having a screening mammogram at Mayo Clinic, Rochester, from October 2003 to September 2006, to study mammographic density and breast cancer risk.

label: North American Rheumatoid Arthritis Consortium
other synonyms: NARAC dataset
definition: A collection of families with multiple siblings affected by rheumatoid arthritis, gathered in the United States by the North American Rheumatoid Arthritis Consortium using well-defined clinical criteria and a severe-phenotype selection of probands, later extended with case-control collections (NARAC-II, NARAC-III), for linkage and association studies of rheumatoid arthritis genetics.

label: National Biobank of Korea
definition: The central national biobank of South Korea, opened by the Korea National Institute of Health as the hub of the Korea Biobank Network with regional hospital biobanks, which holds and distributes biospecimens and data from general-population cohort studies such as the Korean Genome and Epidemiology Study and from hospital patients for biomedical and public health research.

label: Northern Sweden Health and Disease Study
other synonyms: Northern Sweden Health and Disease Study cohort|Northern Swedish Health and Disease Study Cohort
definition: A population-based prospective cohort of more than 140,000 participants in Norrbotten and Västerbotten, the two northernmost regions of Sweden, initiated in the mid-1980s and managed by Umeå University, combining three sub-cohorts (the Västerbotten Intervention Programme, the expanded Northern Sweden MONICA study and the Mammography Screening Project) with over 240,000 stored blood samples, for research on the aetiology, prevention and early detection of cancer, cardiovascular and other diseases.

label: Ontario Familial Breast Cancer Registry
other synonyms: Ontario Breast Cancer Family Registry|Ontario site of the Breast Cancer Family Registry
definition: The Ontario site of the Breast Cancer Family Registry, which enrolled women with invasive breast cancer diagnosed in 1996–1998 identified through the Ontario Cancer Registry (all those aged 20–54 at high genetic risk and random samples of others, with high-risk cases diagnosed in 2001–2002 added), together with their relatives and population controls, to study the genetic epidemiology of breast cancer.

label: Prolonged Anticoagulation During eighteen months vs placebo after Initial Six-month treatment for a first episode of idiopathic Pulmonary Embolism
other synonyms: PADIS-PE randomized clinical trial|PADIS-PE trial|Prolonged Anticoagulant During Eighteen Months vs Placebo After Initial Six-month Treatment for a First Episode of Idiopathic Pulmonary Embolism
definition: A randomised, double-blind trial in which 371 adults with a first unprovoked pulmonary embolism, after six months of vitamin K antagonist treatment, were randomised to a further 18 months of warfarin or placebo and followed between 2007 and 2014 at 14 French centres, comparing recurrent venous thromboembolism and major bleeding.

label: Polish Breast Cancer Study
other synonyms: NCI Polish Breast Cancer Study|Polish Women's Breast Cancer Study
definition: A population-based case-control study of breast cancer in Warsaw and Łódź, Poland, in 2000–2003, funded by the intramural programme of the US National Cancer Institute, in which cases were women aged 20–74 with newly diagnosed in situ or invasive breast cancer identified through a rapid identification system at participating hospitals and through cancer registries.

label: Predicting Risk Of Cancer At Screening
other synonyms: Breast Screening Programme (NHSBSP) in Greater Manchester|PROCAS Study
definition: A cohort of women aged 47–73 recruited from 2009 at routine NHS Breast Screening Programme appointments in Manchester, UK, who completed risk-factor questionnaires and had breast density measured, a subset also giving DNA, to study breast cancer risk prediction at screening.

label: Qingdao Twin Registry
other synonyms: Qingdao Twins Registry
definition: A registry of twins and multiples of all ages in Qingdao, China, initiated in 1998 as part of the Chinese National Twin Registry, with more than 11,000 twin pairs recruited and adolescent, adult and elderly twin cohorts sampled for studies of chronic disease, metabolic disorders, health behaviours and ageing.

label: Chinese National Twin Registry
definition: A population-based twin registry in China, established in 2001, which includes data on over 61,000 twin pairs from 11 provinces or cities and collects biological specimens from disease-concordant and disease-discordant twin pairs, to analyse genetic and environmental influences on chronic diseases, especially cardiovascular diseases.

label: Reproductive Genetics Consortium
other synonyms: ReproGen consortium
definition: An international network of investigators that meta-analyses genome-wide association study data from many cohorts to identify genetic variants and genes affecting reproductive ageing and reproductive timing, such as age at menarche and age at natural menopause.

label: Singapore and Sweden Breast Cancer Study
other synonyms: CAncer Hormone Replacement Epidemiology in Sweden|Cancer Hormone Replacement Epidemiology Study|Cancer Hormone Replacement Epidemiology in Sweden|Cancer Hormone Replacement Epidemiology in Sweden Study|Cancer hormone replacement epidemiology in Sweden|Singapore and Sweden Breast/Endometrial Cancer Study|Singapore and Swedish Breast Cancer Study|Singapore and Swedish Breast/Endometrial Cancer Study|Sweden and Singapore Breast Cancer Study
definition: A population-based case-control study of postmenopausal breast cancer in women aged 50–74 born in Sweden, with incident cases identified through the Swedish regional cancer registries and controls randomly selected from the Swedish population register, enrolled in 1993–1995, with ethical approval at Karolinska Institutet and funding from Singapore (A*STAR) and the US.
diseases: patients with: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|patients with: endometrial cancer (MONDO:0011962)

label: Samuel Lunenfeld Research Institute Study
other synonyms: Lung Cancer Study from Canada|Samuel Lunenfeld Research Institute lung cancer study|Toronto lung cancer study
definition: A hospital-based case–control study of lung cancer in Toronto, Canada, run by the University of Toronto and the Samuel Lunenfeld Research Institute of Mount Sinai Hospital, whose genome-wide genotyped cases and controls contribute to international lung cancer consortia.

label: Seoul National University Bundang Hospital cohort
other synonyms: SNUBH cohort|Seoul National University Bundang Hospital gastric cancer cohort
definition: A hospital-based case–control cohort of patients with gastric cancer and non-cancer controls aged 26–80 recruited at the Digestive Disease Center of Seoul National University Bundang Hospital, South Korea, with genome-wide genotypes, Helicobacter pylori status and lifestyle data, used to study genetic risk of gastric cancer by histological type and sex.

label: Tohoku Medical Megabank Community-Based Cohort Study
acronyms: CommCohort|TMM|TMM CommCohort|TMM CommCohort Study|ToMMo CommCohort Study
other synonyms: Tohoku Medical Megabank Community-Based Cohort (TMM) Study|Tohoku Medical Megabank Community-based Cohort Study
definition: A community-based cohort of adults aged 20 years or over living in Miyagi or Iwate Prefecture, Japan, of whom 87,865 consented to join through health check-ups and assessment centres of the Tohoku Medical Megabank Project, to assess the long-term impact of the Great East Japan Earthquake and gene–environment interactions in major diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease, with genome and metabolome information.
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to earthquake (ECTO:8000011)

label: Tohoku Medical Megabank Project Birth and Three-Generation Cohort Study

other synonyms: TMM Birth and Three-Generation Cohort Study|Tohoku Medical Megabank Project Birth and Three Generations Cohort Study
definition: A birth and three-generation cohort in Japan conducted since July 2013 by the Tohoku Medical Megabank Organization of Tohoku University and the Iwate Tohoku Medical Megabank Organization, recruiting pregnant women and their fetuses as probands together with the fathers, grandparents, siblings and extended family members, with genome and omics information, to study disease risk across generations.
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to earthquake (ECTO:8000011)

label: TRacking Adolescents' Individual Lives Survey Clinical Cohort
other synonyms: TRAILS clinical cohort|Tracking Adolescents Individual Lives Survey (TRAILS) Clinical Cohort
definition: A Dutch clinical cohort of 543 children who had been referred to a child psychiatric outpatient clinic in the Northern Netherlands before the age of 11, enrolled from 2004 alongside the TRAILS population cohort and followed from about age 11 with repeated assessments of mental health and development into young adulthood.

label: Taiwan-US Diabetic Retinopathy Study
other synonyms: Taiwan USA Diabetes Retinopathy|Taiwan–US Diabetic Retinopathy Study
definition: A collection of Chinese people with type 2 diabetes in Taiwan, with and without proliferative diabetic retinopathy, assembled from 1996 to 2011 by Taiwanese and US investigators for genetic studies of diabetic retinopathy.
diseases: patients with: diabetic retinopathy (MONDO:0005266)|patients with: type 2 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005148)

label: Breakthrough Generations Study
other synonyms: Generations Study|UK Breakthrough Generations Study
definition: A UK general-population cohort started in 2003 that recruited 112,049 participants aged 16–102 by 2011 through a generational referral method, in which women recruited directly nominated female friends and relatives, collecting detailed questionnaires and blood samples repeatedly over decades to investigate breast cancer aetiology.

label: DiaGene Study
definition: A multicentre prospective cohort of people with type 2 diabetes, with diabetes-free controls included at baseline, in the city of Eindhoven, the Netherlands, extensively phenotyped to study the aetiology of type 2 diabetes and its micro- and macrovascular complications.

label: Copenhagen Prospective Studies on Asthma in Childhood
other synonyms: Copenhagen Prospective Studies on Asthma
definition: A Danish clinical research programme, the Copenhagen Prospective Studies on Asthma in Childhood, made up of mother-child birth cohorts: COPSAC2000, a high-risk cohort of 411 children of mothers with a doctor's diagnosis of asthma, enrolled in the first month of life, and COPSAC2010, a cohort of 700 children born to unselected mothers from Denmark.

label: ProHealth Kaiser GWAS
definition: A multiethnic genome-wide association study sample of prostate cancer from Kaiser Permanente health plan members in California, combining prostate cancer cases from three Kaiser Permanente studies (the Research Program on Genes, Environment and Health, the ProHealth Study and the California Men's Health Study) with men of the Genetic Epidemiology Research on Aging cohort without a prostate cancer diagnosis as controls (7,783 cases and 38,595 controls; 80.3% non-Hispanic white, 4.9% African American, 7.0% East Asian and 7.8% Latino).

label: Genetics of Pancreatic Beta-cell Failure in Mexican-Americans
definition: A family study of Mexican Americans in the Los Angeles area, United States, designed to identify genetic determinants of pancreatic β-cell function, which recruited non-diabetic women with a history of gestational diabetes mellitus, their adult family members, and women without a history of gestational diabetes.
diseases: at risk of: gestational diabetes (MONDO:0005406)|at risk of: type 2 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005148)

label: Gene-Lifestyle Interactions in Dental Endpoints
other synonyms: Gene-Lifestyle Interactions and Dental Endpoints|Gene-Lifestyle Interactions and Dental Endpoints Consortium|Gene-Lifestyle Interactions in Dental Endpoints consortium
definition: An international consortium of epidemiological cohorts from Europe, the United States and Japan with detailed clinical information on dental diseases, within which genome-wide association studies of dental caries and periodontitis are conducted and meta-analysed.
diseases: population study of: dental caries (MONDO:0005276)|population study of: periodontitis (MONDO:0005076)

label: Harvard Aging Brain Study
other synonyms: Harvard aging brain study
definition: A longitudinal observational study of cognitively normal older adults, designed to distinguish normal ageing from preclinical Alzheimer's disease, with demographic, clinical, neuropsychological, clinical biomarker and neuroimaging data, including amyloid PET acquired at Massachusetts General Hospital in Boston, United States.

label: Hong Kong Osteoporosis Study
definition: A prospective cohort study of osteoporosis and fracture in Southern Chinese women and men recruited from the community in Hong Kong between 1995 and 2010, with questionnaire, anthropometric and clinical assessments at baseline and long-term follow-up through linkage to the Hong Kong Hospital Authority's territory-wide electronic health records.
diseases: population study of: bone fracture (MONDO:0005315)|population study of: osteoporosis (MONDO:0005298)

label: Study of Asthma Phenotypes and Pharmacogenomic Interactions by Race-Ethnicity
other synonyms: Study of Asthma Phenotypes and Pharmacogenomic Interactions by Race-ethnicity
definition: An ongoing study at Henry Ford Health System of members of the health system aged 12–56, with and without a clinical diagnosis of asthma, from southeast Michigan and the Detroit metropolitan area, United States, enrolled with a staff-administered questionnaire and lung function testing to study asthma phenotypes and pharmacogenomic interactions across racial and ethnic groups.

label: South Asian Birth Cohort
other synonyms: SouTh Asian BiRth CohorT|SouTh Asian biRth cohorT|SouTh Asian birth cohoRT|South Asian Birth Cohort Study
definition: A prospective birth cohort of pregnant South Asian women aged 18–40 and their offspring, recruited in urban Bangalore and rural Solur in Karnataka, India, and in the Peel region of Ontario, Canada, with questionnaires, anthropometry, a glucose tolerance test, and blood and DNA samples in pregnancy, newborn measurements and follow-up of the children to age 3, to study the environmental and genetic determinants of adiposity among South Asians.

label: TRanslational Initiative on Unique and novel strategies for Management of Patients with Heart failure
other synonyms: Translational Initiative on Unique and Novel Strategies for Management of Patients With Heart Failure|Translational Initiative on Unique and Novel Strategies for Management of Patients with Heart Failure|Translational Initiative on Unique and novel strategies for Management of Patients with Heart failure
definition: The clinical cohort of the TRIUMPH biomarker programme: an observational prospective study of adults admitted with acute heart failure, newly diagnosed or decompensated chronic, to 14 hospitals in the Netherlands between September 2009 and December 2013, with repeated blood sampling during one year of follow-up to validate prognostic biomarkers.

label: Australian Stroke Genetics Collaborative
other synonyms: Australian Stroke Genetics Collaboration
definition: A case-control sample for genome-wide association studies of ischaemic stroke and its subtypes, comprising stroke patients of European ancestry admitted to four clinical centres in Australia (Gosford Hospital, John Hunter Hospital in Newcastle, The Queen Elizabeth Hospital in Adelaide and Royal Perth Hospital) between 2003 and 2008, and population controls from the Hunter Community Study.

label: Early Growth Genetics Consortium
definition: A consortium that facilitates joint analysis of genetic data from multiple studies to identify human genomic loci influencing traits related to early growth, from the fetus to young adulthood, such as birth weight and length, gestational duration, head circumference, childhood body mass index and obesity, and pubertal growth.

label: Oxford Vascular Study
other synonyms: Oxford Vascular study
definition: A population-based incidence study of all acute vascular events in a defined population covered by nine primary care practices in Oxfordshire, United Kingdom, in which patients presenting with such events, including transient ischaemic attack and stroke, have been ascertained prospectively since 2002 and followed up.
diseases: patients with: stroke disorder (MONDO:0005098)|patients with: transient ischemic attack (MONDO:0005264)|patients with: vascular disorder (MONDO:0005385)

label: Prospective Epidemiological Risk Factor Study
other synonyms: Prospective Epidemiologic Risk Factor study|Prospective Epidemiologic and Risk Factor study|Prospective Epidemiological Risk Factor cohort|Prospective Epidemiological Risk Factor study|prospective epidemiological risk factor study
definition: A prospective observational cohort of postmenopausal Danish women enrolled in 1999–2001, all of whom had previously taken part in randomised placebo-controlled trials or been screened for earlier studies at the Center for Clinical and Basic Research in Copenhagen or Aalborg, established to identify risk factors for age-related diseases and linked to the Danish health registries.

label: Multiethnic Genome-wide Scan of Prostate Cancer
other synonyms: A Multiethnic Genome-wide Scan of Prostate Cancer
definition: A nested case-control genome-wide association study of prostate cancer within the Multiethnic Cohort Study, in which men of African American, Japanese American and Latino ancestry living in Hawaii and California with incident invasive prostate cancer, found by linkage to the SEER cancer registries, and controls matched on ethnicity, area of residence and age at cohort entry were genotyped under the Gene Environment Association Studies (GENEVA) initiative.

label: Army Study to Assess Risk and Resilience in Servicemembers
other synonyms: Army Study To Assess Risk and rEsilience in Servicemembers|Army Study to Assess Risk and Resilience in Service Members|Army Study to Assess Risk and Resilience in Service members|Army study to assess risk and resilience in servicemembers|The Army Study to Assess Risk and Resilience in Servicemembers
definition: A multicomponent epidemiological and neurobiological study of United States Army soldiers, funded by the US Army and the National Institute of Mental Health and carried out in 2009–2014. Its component studies combined Army administrative records with representative surveys of new soldiers, of active-duty soldiers and of brigade combat teams deploying to Afghanistan, some with neurocognitive tests and blood samples, and case-control studies of suicide attempts and deaths, to identify risk and resilience factors for suicidal behaviour and related mental disorders; its survey respondents are followed up in the Army STARRS Longitudinal Study (STARRS-LS).
diseases: population study of: Suicide behaviors (HP:5200330)|population study of: mental disorder (MONDO:0005084)
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to occupation (ECTO:0001591)

label: Barbados Asthma Genetics Study
other synonyms: Barbados Genetics of Asthma Study|The Genetics and Epidemiology of Asthma in Barbados
definition: A family-based asthma genetics study initiated in Barbados in 1993 on nuclear and extended families, self-reported as African Caribbean, of paediatric asthmatic probands referred from local polyclinics or the Accident and Emergency Department of the Queen Elizabeth Hospital, with recruitment continuing through the Chronic Disease Research Centre in Barbados.

label: CECILE Breast Cancer Study
other synonyms: CECILE Breast cancer Study|CECILE Study|CECILE study
definition: A population-based case-control study of breast cancer in two French départements, Côte d'Or and Ille-et-Vilaine, in which women under 75 years of age with invasive or in situ breast carcinoma diagnosed from April 2005 to March 2007 and population controls frequency-matched to them by age, recruited over the same period, were interviewed in person by trained nurses, most also giving a blood sample; it has been used to study occupational, environmental and genetic risk factors for breast cancer.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to occupation (ECTO:0001591)|designed to study: exposure to organochlorine compound (ECTO:0001152)

label: Cardiovascular Health Improvement Project
definition: A longitudinal cardiovascular biobank of patients treated at the Frankel Cardiovascular Center of Michigan Medicine, the University of Michigan health system, which has recruited since 2013, mainly patients with aortic disease, and links their genotype data to electronic health records and family history data.
diseases: patients with: aortic disorder (MONDO:0005561)|patients with: cardiovascular disorder (MONDO:0004995)

label: GENetic and clinical Predictors Of treatment response in Depression
definition: A multicentre randomised controlled trial in primary care in Bristol, Birmingham and Newcastle, United Kingdom, in which adults aged 18–74 with a new episode of depression (an ICD-10 depressive episode and a Beck Depression Inventory score of at least 15), recruited from September 2005, were randomly allocated to citalopram or reboxetine to identify genetic and clinical predictors of response to antidepressant treatment.

label: Tyypin 1 Diabetekseen Sairastuneita Perheenjäsenineen
definition: A Finnish collection of people with type 1 diabetes, most of them diagnosed in childhood, together with members of their families, which has contributed cases, controls and parent–offspring trios to international genetic studies of type 1 diabetes.

label: Indianapolis-Ibadan Dementia Project
other synonyms: Indianapolis Ibadan Dementia Study
definition: A longitudinal, prospective, population-based study of two elderly community-dwelling populations, African Americans in Indianapolis, Indiana, and Yoruba in Ibadan, Nigeria, aged 65 years or older and free of dementia when enrolled in 1992 and 2001, who were re-evaluated every 2-3 years by in-home screening followed by clinical diagnostic assessment, to compare the incidence of dementia and Alzheimer disease between the two sites using identical methods.
diseases: population study of: Alzheimer disease (MONDO:0004975)|population study of: dementia (MONDO:0001627)

label: European Study into Digestive Illnesses and Genetics
other synonyms: European Study of Digestive Diseases and Genetics|PanGenEU Study|PanGenEU case-control study|PanGenEU study
definition: A multicentre case-control study of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma carried out at centres in Spain, Italy, Sweden, Germany, the United Kingdom and Ireland in 2009-2014 and 2016-2018, which recruited newly diagnosed patients aged 18 and older and, as controls, sex-, age- and area-matched hospital in-patients without cancer whose primary diagnoses were not associated with known risk factors for the disease (population-based controls in Ireland and Sweden), and collected lifestyle, environmental-exposure and medical-history information by in-person interviews.

label: Seoul Breast Cancer Study
definition: A multicentre case-control study of female breast cancer conducted in Seoul, South Korea, since 1995, which recruited women with histologically confirmed incident breast cancer at university hospitals in Seoul, among them Seoul National University Hospital and Asan Medical Center, and cancer-free controls from health examinees at the same hospitals or in community health screening programmes, collecting risk-factor information by face-to-face interviews with a structured questionnaire.

label: Molecular Epidemiology of non-Hodgkin lymphoma
other synonyms: SF Bay Area NHL2 study|University of California at San Francisco Molecular Epidemiology of Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma study
definition: A population-based case-control study of non-Hodgkin lymphoma in the San Francisco Bay Area, California, that enrolled residents of six Bay Area counties aged 20-85 with incident non-Hodgkin lymphoma diagnosed from 2001 through 2006, identified through the cancer registry by rapid case ascertainment, and controls found by random-digit dialling and from Medicare lists, frequency-matched to the cases on age, sex and county, with in-person interviews, blood or buccal specimens and expert re-review of the cases' pathology.

label: Janssen lifetime suicide attempt cohort
definition: A case-control sample for lifetime suicide attempt of people of European ancestry, drawn from participants of six clinical trials conducted by Janssen Research & Development, with clinician-diagnosed major depressive disorder, schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder or bipolar disorder, and from control samples of the NINDS Human Genetics Repository at the Coriell Institute and of BioIVT, with lifetime suicide-attempt history taken from clinical interview and medical records.
diseases: patients with: Suicide behaviors (HP:5200330)|patients with: bipolar disorder (MONDO:0004985)|patients with: major depressive disorder (MONDO:0002009)|patients with: schizoaffective disorder (MONDO:0005487)|patients with: schizophrenia (MONDO:0005090)

label: Enhancing NeuroImaging Genetics through Meta-Analysis Consortium
other synonyms: ENIGMA Consortium|Enhancing NeuroImaging Genetics through Meta Analysis|Enhancing NeuroImaging Genetics through Meta-Analysis
definition: An international collaborative network of neuroimaging and genetics researchers at institutions worldwide, organised into working groups, that pools and meta-analyses brain MRI and genetic data from many sites, including patient populations, to find genetic and other factors that affect brain structure and function in health and disease; its first project was a genome-wide association study of hippocampal and intracranial volume.

label: Tirschenreuth Study
other synonyms: Prospective Covid-19 Cohort Tirschenreuth|Tirschenreuth COVID-19 cohort study
definition: A prospective population-based cohort of inhabitants aged 14 or older of the county of Tirschenreuth in north-eastern Bavaria, Germany, one of the German counties hardest hit by SARS-CoV-2 in spring 2020, randomly selected with stratification by sex and municipality, who gave blood samples and questionnaires at a baseline survey in June-July 2020 and at follow-ups in November 2020 and April 2021, to determine SARS-CoV-2 seroprevalence and its course over time, including undetected infections, the durability of antibody responses and new infections.
diseases: population study of: COVID-19 (MONDO:0100096)|population study of: COVID-19 (MONDO:0100096)

label: Amsterdam Cohort Studies on HIV infection and AIDS
other synonyms: Amsterdam Cohort Studies|Amsterdam Cohort Studies on HIV Infection and AIDS|Amsterdam cohort studies on HIV infection and AIDS
definition: A prospective cohort study of HIV infection and AIDS in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, a collaboration of the Public Health Service of Amsterdam, Amsterdam University Medical Centers, Sanquin Blood Supply and other partners, which since 1984 has followed an open cohort of men who have sex with men and from 1985 until 2016 followed a cohort of people who use drugs, to study the prevalence, incidence and risk factors of HIV infection and AIDS and the natural history of HIV-1 infection, and to carry out intervention studies and evaluate prevention programmes.
diseases: at risk of: AIDS (MONDO:0012268)|at risk of: HIV infectious disease (MONDO:0005109)
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to drug abuse (ECTO:6000008)

label: Broad Cardiovascular Disease Initiative Study
other synonyms: Broad CardioVascular Disease initiative study
definition: A multi-study case–control collection at the Broad Institute, an extension of the Broad AF study, focused on cardiovascular diseases including atrial fibrillation, mitral valve prolapse, atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia, supraventricular tachycardia and bradyarrhythmia, whose samples' DNA was imported to the Broad and jointly genotyped. It was funded as part of a collaboration between the Broad Institute and Bayer AG.
diseases: patients with: Bradycardia (HP:0001662)|patients with: Supraventricular tachycardia (HP:0004755)|patients with: Supraventricular tachycardia (HP:0004755)|patients with: atrial fibrillation (MONDO:0004981)|patients with: cardiovascular disorder (MONDO:0004995)|patients with: mitral valve prolapse (MONDO:0004910)

label: Canadian Multicentre Osteoporosis Study
other synonyms: Canadian MultiCentre Osteoporosis study
definition: A population-based prospective cohort of men and women aged 25 years and older, recruited in 1995–1997 by random telephone contact from within 50 km of nine regional centres across Canada, and followed with annual mailed questionnaires, repeated interviews and bone density measurements to study osteoporosis and fractures; a youth cohort aged 16–24 was added in 2004–2006.
diseases: population study of: bone fracture (MONDO:0005315)|population study of: osteoporosis (MONDO:0005298)

label: Cardiovascular and Metabolic Disease Etiology Research Center-High Risk
other synonyms: Cardiovascular and Metabolic Disease Etiology Research Center-High Risk Cohort|Cardiovascular and Metabolic Diseases Etiology Research Center-High Risk Cohort|Cardiovascular and Metabolic disease Etiology Research Center-HIgh risk cohort
