definition: A multicentre Spanish study of patients of European ancestry with acute ischaemic stroke, admitted to the emergency rooms of Vall d'Hebron Hospital in Barcelona and other Spanish hospitals and treated with recombinant tissue plasminogen activator (r-tPA), set up to find genetic variants associated with haemorrhagic transformation and death after thrombolysis.

label: Genetics Network Rheumatology Amsterdam
definition: A prospective collection of Dutch patients with rheumatoid arthritis meeting the 1987 American College of Rheumatology criteria, recruited from the outpatient rheumatology clinics of the VU University Medical Center, the Jan van Breemen Institute and the Academic Medical Center/University of Amsterdam in the Amsterdam region of the Netherlands, together with healthy blood-donor controls from the same region, which the Genetics Network Rheumatology Amsterdam contributed to genetic studies of rheumatoid arthritis susceptibility and of response to anti-TNF therapy.

label: Genetics of Recurrent Early-Onset Depression
other synonyms: GenRED project|Genetics of Recurrent Early-Onset major Depression|Genetics of Recurrent Early-onset Depression
definition: A collaborative study run at six sites in the United States with NIMH support that recruited people with recurrent DSM-IV major depressive disorder beginning before age 31 and a parent or sibling with recurrent major depression beginning before age 41, as a sample for molecular genetic studies of depression whose biological materials and clinical data are made available through the NIMH repository. Its first phase (GenRED I) recruited families with affected sibling pairs, with their parents and some unaffected siblings, for linkage studies, and its second (GenRED II) further probands for association studies.

label: Genomics Research in Cardiovascular Disease
other synonyms: GenRIC study|Genomics Research in Cardiovascular disease|Korean GenRIC
definition: A Korean case-control study of coronary artery disease whose cases are patients with angiographically confirmed coronary artery disease (myocardial infarction, stable or unstable angina) from three teaching hospitals in Seoul (Samsung Medical Center, Seoul National University Hospital and Yonsei University College of Medicine), and whose controls come from the Health Examinees (HEXA) population cohort of the Korean Genome Epidemiology Study.

label: Genetic Etiologies of Primary-Open angle Glaucoma Study
other synonyms: Genetic Etiologies of POAG|Genetic Etiologies of Primary Open-Angle Glaucoma|Genetic Etiologies of Primary-Open angle Glaucoma|Genetic Etiology Primary Open-Angle Glaucoma|Massachusetts Eye and Ear Infirmary|Massachusetts Eye and Ear Infirmary case control group|Massachussetts Eye and Ear Infirmary
definition: A clinic-based case-control study of primary open-angle glaucoma, begun at the Massachusetts Eye and Ear Infirmary in 1996 with National Eye Institute funding to find genetic loci for the disease, whose cases came mainly from the infirmary's Glaucoma Service and whose controls were mostly patients attending its comprehensive ophthalmology service for routine eye examinations or spouses of patients, with others found at regional glaucoma screenings in Massachusetts.

label: GeparSixto trial
other synonyms: GBG 66|GEPARSIXTO Trial|GEPARSIXTO study|GeparSixto|GeparSixto study
definition: A multicentre, randomised, open-label phase II neoadjuvant trial run in Germany by the German Breast Group in patients with triple-negative or HER2-positive early breast cancer, which tested whether adding carboplatin to anthracycline- and taxane-based chemotherapy (given with trastuzumab and lapatinib for HER2-positive and bevacizumab for triple-negative disease) increases the rate of pathological complete response.
diseases: patients with: HER2 positive breast carcinoma (MONDO:0006244)|patients with: triple-negative breast carcinoma (MONDO:0005494)

label: German Affected-Sib-Pair Study
other synonyms: German sib-pair study
definition: A family study of asthma in Germany whose families have at least two children with confirmed clinical asthma, ascertained at multiple centres and phenotyped by trained staff to a common protocol for the German Asthma Genetics Group; its families were used for genome-wide linkage scans of asthma and later as a replication sample in genetic association studies of asthma.

label: Genetic Epidemiology Study of Breast Cancer by Age 50
other synonyms: Genetic Epidemiologic Study of Breast Cancer by Age 50
definition: A population-based case-control family study of breast cancer in women diagnosed before age 50 in Germany, whose cases were all incident breast cancers diagnosed in 1992–1995 in two regions, Rhein-Neckar-Odenwald and Freiburg, identified by surveying the clinics serving those regions, and whose controls were residents of the study regions selected at random from population registries and matched to cases by age and region.
diseases: patients with: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|patients with: breast carcinoma in situ (MONDO:0004658)

label: Danish General Suburban Population Study
definition: A general population study of residents aged over 20 of Næstved municipality in Zealand, Denmark, recruited in 2010–2013, whose participants underwent a health examination, completed questionnaires and gave blood samples at baseline, with linkage to public registers for follow-up, established to facilitate epidemiological and genetic research.

label: G-FAST
definition: A study of carriers of BRCA1 or BRCA2 pathogenic variants based at Ghent University Hospital, Belgium, which contributes its carriers' genotype and phenotype data to the Consortium of Investigators of Modifiers of BRCA1/2 (CIMBA) for studies of genetic modifiers of breast, ovarian and prostate cancer risk in carriers.
diseases: at risk of: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|at risk of: ovarian cancer (MONDO:0008170)

label: Groningen Genetics of Atrial Fibrillation Study
definition: A collection of individuals with atrial fibrillation and age- and sex-matched controls, assembled at the University Medical Center Groningen, the Netherlands, as a genotype and phenotype repository for genetic studies of atrial fibrillation, whose cases come from three hospital-based atrial fibrillation cohorts (the AF-Risk, Young-AF and Biomarker-AF studies) and whose controls come from the GIPS-III trial and the PREVEND community cohort of Groningen.

label: Greek Health Randomized Aging Study
definition: A cross-sectional health and nutrition study of urban Greek adults aged 60 years and over, a randomly selected group of members of the Centers of Open Protection for the Elderly in the Athens region recruited between 2004 and 2008, assessed with standardized anthropometric, biochemical and clinical procedures and extensive questionnaires to investigate the interactions among socioeconomic, lifestyle, dietary, psychological and biochemical factors that determine the health status of elderly Greeks.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to eating behavior (ECTO:6000021)|designed to study: exposure to lifestyle (ECTO:6000015)

label: German Hodgkin Study Group
definition: A clinical trials group, whose Trial Coordination Center belongs to Department I of Internal Medicine of the University of Cologne, Germany, that runs controlled, prospective, randomized trials for all stages of Hodgkin lymphoma, recruiting patients from across Europe, to optimise diagnostics, therapy and follow-up care; genetic studies use Hodgkin lymphoma patients ascertained through it.

label: Glioma International Case-Control Study
other synonyms: Glioma International Case Control Consortium|Glioma International Case Control study
definition: A multisite case-control study of glioma run by the Genetic Epidemiology of Glioma International Consortium, which in 2010–2013 recruited, under a common protocol and questionnaire with blood sample collection, adults aged 18–80 with newly diagnosed, histologically confirmed glioma and controls (visitors accompanying cancer patients, clinic-based or population-based controls, depending on the site) at 14 sites in the United States, Denmark, Israel, Sweden and the United Kingdom, to study environmental and genetic risk factors for glioma.
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)

label: Genetics In Familial Thrombosis
definition: An affected-sibling family study of venous thromboembolism based at Leiden University Medical Center, the Netherlands, which recruited small thrombophilic families in which at least two siblings had objectively confirmed venous thromboembolism at a young age (before 45), to identify new genetic susceptibility loci for venous thromboembolism.

label: Genomic Imaging Göttingen
other synonyms: Genomic Imaging Goettingen|Genomic Imaging Gottingen
definition: A sample of healthy young adults of European ancestry, established at the Center for Translational Research in Systems Neuroscience and Psychiatry of the University of Göttingen and recruited through advertisements at the University of Göttingen and the University Medical Center Göttingen, excluding people with past or present psychiatric disorders, a family history of psychiatric disorders, recent substance abuse, or neurological or metabolic disease, who are genotyped and undergo brain magnetic resonance imaging, including functional MRI.

label: Genes in Myopia Study
other synonyms: GEnes in Myopia (GEM) study|Genes in Myopia study
definition: An Australian family and twin study of the genetics of myopia and other refractive errors, established in Melbourne in 2004, which recruited probands with myopia and a family history of it (contacted through the database of the Melbourne Excimer Laser Group) together with their family members, and adult twins from Victoria through the Australian Twin Registry, with a detailed eye examination, ocular biometry, questionnaire and blood sample for DNA.

label: Genetic and Immunological Studies of European and African HIV-1+ Long Term Non-Progressors
other synonyms: Genetic and Immunological Studies of European and African HIV-1 Long Term Non-Progressors|Genetic and Immunological Studies of European and African HIV-1+ Long Term Non Progressors|Genetic and Immunological Studies on HIV+ European and African LTNP
definition: A European-African consortium project of the European Commission's Sixth Framework Programme on the genetics and immunology of HIV-1 long-term non-progression, and its French-Italian cohort of untreated, HIV-1-infected Caucasian long-term non-progressors (CD4+ T-cell counts above 500/μL for more than seven years after infection without antiretroviral therapy) drawn from the French asymptomatic long-term cohort, the Italian ELVIS study and the Chelsea and Westminster cohort. The cohort was genotyped genome-wide and compared with seroconverters of the French PRIMO cohort to find host genetic factors of long-term non-progression, and it contributed to the International Collaboration for the Genomics of HIV.

label: GISSI-Prevenzione trial
other synonyms: GISSI Prevenzione|GISSI-Prevenzione|GISSI-Prevenzione study|Gruppo Italiano per lo Studio della Sopravvivenza nell'Infarto miocardico (GISSI) -Prevenzione trial
definition: A multicentre Italian randomized trial of the Gruppo Italiano per lo Studio della Sopravvivenza nell'Infarto miocardico (GISSI) in which patients surviving a recent (3 months or less) myocardial infarction, with no limits of age and sex, were randomly assigned from October 1993 to September 1995 in a factorial design to supplements of n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids, vitamin E, both, or none for 3.5 years, with death, non-fatal myocardial infarction and stroke as the combined primary endpoint.

label: Glasgow Stroke Sample
other synonyms: Glasgow ImmunoChip Study|Glasgow, Scotland ImmunoChip Study Samples
definition: A hospital-based collection of patients with ischaemic stroke attending the cerebrovascular service of the Western Infirmary, Glasgow, Scotland, recruited between 1990 and 2004 as part of an ongoing study of genetic and circulating biomarkers in stroke, all with brain imaging and extracranial carotid ultrasound, analysed against shared WTCCC controls from the 1958 Birth Cohort in the MEGASTROKE consortium’s genome-wide association study of stroke.

label: Primary Open-Angle Glaucoma Genes and Environment Study
other synonyms: Glaucoma Gene Environment Initiative|Glaucoma Genes and Environment Study|Glaucoma Genes and Environment study|The Glaucoma Genes and Environment Study|The Primary Open-Angle Glaucoma Genes and Environment (GLAUGEN) Study
definition: A case-control genome-wide association study of primary open-angle glaucoma in the United States, part of the NIH Gene Environment Association Studies (GENEVA) initiative, which assembled cases and controls from three studies: the clinic-based Genetic Etiologies of Primary Open-Angle Glaucoma project of the Massachusetts Eye and Ear Infirmary, and cases and matched controls from the glaucoma-at-risk cohorts of the Nurses' Health Study and the Health Professionals Follow-up Study, to find genetic loci and gene–environment interactions for the disease.

label: Gliogene study
other synonyms: GLIOGENE study|Gliogene Consortium|Gliogene family study|Gliogene: A Familial Brain Tumor Study
definition: An international family study of non-syndromic glioma run by the Gliogene Consortium (Genetic Epidemiology of Glioma International Consortium) to find glioma susceptibility genes, first by genome-wide linkage analysis: between 2007 and 2011 its 14 centres in the United States, Sweden, Denmark, the United Kingdom and Israel recruited families with at least two pathologically confirmed intracranial primary gliomas among first- to third-degree relatives, found by screening glioma patients in clinics, by review of medical records or through the internet, and collected questionnaires from probands and blood or saliva samples from living affected relatives.

label: GliomaScan
other synonyms: GliomaScan Consortium|GliomaScan consortium
definition: A genome-wide association study of glioma led by the US National Cancer Institute, genotyped at the NCI Core Genotyping Facility, that pooled incident glioma cases and matched or previously genotyped controls from 19 studies, mostly prospective cohorts of the United States, Europe and Australia (among them ATBC, CPS-II, the Nurses' Health Study, the Health Professionals Follow-up Study, PLCO, NSHDS and the Melbourne Collaborative Cohort Study), together with case-control studies (among them the Sweden and Denmark arm of INTERPHONE) and the case-only Gliogene study.

label: GMetS
other synonyms: GMetS (France)
definition: A French type 2 diabetes case-control sample, whose DNA samples were managed by the CNRS UMR 8199 Genomic and Metabolic Disease unit in Lille, genotyped on the Metabochip and contributed to the stage 2 replication of the DIAGRAM consortium's 2012 type 2 diabetes meta-analysis.

label: Gut Microbiota and Obesity Study
definition: A population-based case-control study of overweight or obese adults and age- and sex-matched normal-weight controls aged 35–54 years, noninstitutionalized residents of two urban districts of Shanghai, China (Luwan and Zhabei), recruited from November 2007 to January 2008 to investigate the effects of gut microbiota and environmental factors on obesity and related metabolic disorders.
diseases: patients with: Overweight (HP:0025502)|patients with: obesity disorder (MONDO:0011122)

label: Genentech Human Genetics Initiative Cancer Immunology Cohort 2020 Q2
definition: A collection of germline whole-genome sequencing data, assembled by Genentech's Human Genetics Initiative, from patients in seven Roche/Genentech phase 3 trials of the anti-PD-L1 antibody atezolizumab, alone or combined with chemotherapy or bevacizumab, and their standard-of-care control arms in six cancers (IMvigor211, IMpower150, IMpower130, IMpower131, IMpower133, IMmotion151 and IMpassion130), sequenced from blood samples given under the trials' optional research biosample consent.
diseases: patients with: non-small cell lung carcinoma (MONDO:0005233)|patients with: renal cell carcinoma (MONDO:0005086)|patients with: small cell lung carcinoma (MONDO:0008433)|patients with: triple-negative breast carcinoma (MONDO:0005494)|patients with: urothelial carcinoma (MONDO:0040679)

label: Guangzhou Nutrition and Health Study
definition: A community-based prospective cohort of adults aged 40 to 83 at baseline living in Guangzhou, China, which joins the original Guangzhou Nutrition and Health Study, recruited between 2008 and 2013 from communities across the city through local advertisements, health talks and referrals, with the controls of a case-control study of hip fractures recruited in 2009-2015. Participants are followed up about every three years with lifestyle, dietary, body composition, imaging and multi-omics assessments, including genome-wide genotyping, serum metabolome and proteome and gut microbiome, to study the nutritional, environmental and genetic determinants of metabolic disease.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to nutrient (ECTO:9001695)

label: Genetics of Brain Structure and Function Study
other synonyms: Genetics of Brain Structure|Genetics of Brain Structure and Function|Genetics of Brain Structure and Function study
definition: A family-based imaging genetics study of Mexican Americans in San Antonio, Texas, United States, which recruited members of the extended pedigrees of the San Antonio Family Heart Study and the San Antonio Family Gallbladder Study, with the children and grandchildren of their probands, for brain magnetic resonance imaging and neuropsychological and psychiatric assessment at the University of Texas Health Science Center at San Antonio, to localise, identify and characterise genes and quantitative trait loci that influence brain structure and function.

label: Geelong Osteoporosis Study
definition: A prospective, population-based cohort study of adults in south-eastern Australia, in which women were randomly recruited from the general population in 1993–1997, with further women aged 20–29 years recruited at the 10-year follow-up, and a random age-stratified sample of men aged over 20 years was recruited from the Barwon Statistical Division through the Australian electoral roll in 2001–2006, followed with repeated assessments of bone mineral density, fractures and other musculoskeletal and general health outcomes.

label: Genetic Risk Assessment of Defibrillator Events
other synonyms: GRADE Multicenter Study
definition: A prospective multicentre observational study at seven hospitals and practices in Pennsylvania, Georgia, Massachusetts and Ohio of adults with a left ventricular ejection fraction of 30% or less who had received a new implantable cardioverter-defibrillator or an ICD generator change within the previous five years, followed yearly for up to five years for appropriate ICD shocks and for death, heart transplant or ventricular assist device placement, with blood drawn at enrolment to relate genetic polymorphisms to these outcomes.
diseases: patients with: Left ventricular systolic dysfunction (HP:0025169)

label: Genetic characteristics of coRonary Artery disease in ChiNese young aDults
other synonyms: GRAND study|Genetic characteristics of coronary artery disease in Chinese young adults|Genetics and clinical characteristics of coRonary Artery disease in the ChiNese young aDults|clinical and genetic characteristics of coronary artery disease in Chinese young adults
definition: A prospective multicentre, hospital-based, coronary angiography-based case-control study in China, coordinated from Zhongshan Hospital, Fudan University, that recruited adults at 38 cardiac centres between May 2017 and April 2019, centred on patients with early-onset coronary artery disease (onset at 45 years or younger) and older controls (65 years or older) without angiographic coronary disease, to identify genetic factors in the susceptibility to and outcomes of early-onset coronary artery disease.

label: Göttingen Research Association for Schizophrenia
other synonyms: GRAS Data Collection|GRAS cohort|GRAS data collection|GRAS sample|Gottingen Research Association for Schizophrenia
definition: A cross-sectional data collection of patients with schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder in Germany, recruited from 2005 by a single travelling team of investigators at 23 collaborating psychiatric hospitals, among them inpatients, outpatients, residents of sheltered homes and forensic patients, and phenotyped with more than 3,000 data points per patient, with healthy blood-donor controls recruited in Göttingen for genetic analyses, built as the basis for phenotype-based genetic association studies of schizophrenia.
diseases: patients with: schizoaffective disorder (MONDO:0005487)|patients with: schizophrenia (MONDO:0005090)

label: Genomic Research Cohorts for CCMB Diabetes Study
other synonyms: Genomic Research Cohort for CCMB Diabetes Study
definition: A collection of Indian cohorts brought together for genetic studies of type 2 diabetes by the Genomic Research on Complex Diseases group at the CSIR-Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (CCMB), Hyderabad, including the Indian Diabetes Prevention Study 3, the Pune Maternal Nutrition Study and the Wellcome Genetics (WellGen) study, whose type 2 diabetes cases (by history, treatment or WHO 1999 oral glucose tolerance criteria) and normoglycaemic controls were genotyped genome-wide.

label: Groningen Renal Hemodynamic Cohort Study Group
other synonyms: Groningen Renal Hemodynamic Cohorts
definition: An ongoing research programme at the renal function unit of the University Medical Center Groningen, the Netherlands, that hosts and harmonises a series of studies of renal hemodynamics, mainly in healthy volunteers, under a common protocol of integrated measurement of renal hemodynamics and extracellular volume, with standardised methods and calibration over time; participants are typically studied on a standardised dietary sodium intake.

label: Gilda Radner Familial Ovarian Cancer Registry
other synonyms: Familial Ovarian Cancer Registry
definition: A self-referred registry of families with two or more cases of ovarian cancer among blood relatives, or with a cancer syndrome possibly related to ovarian cancer, established in 1981 at Roswell Park Cancer Institute in Buffalo, New York, United States, which receives family cancer information from throughout the United States, obtains detailed family histories, documents cancers through medical records and pathology review, and collects and stores biological samples from registry participants for research on familial ovarian cancer.

label: Gilda Radner Hereditary Cancer Program
other synonyms: Gilda Radner Hereditary Cancer Early Detection Program
definition: A research program at Cedars-Sinai Medical Center, Los Angeles, launched as the Gilda Radner Hereditary Cancer Early Detection Program, that from 1991 enrolled women at elevated risk of cancer because of their family histories, among them carriers of BRCA1 and BRCA2 mutations, offered them ovarian cancer screening and, once it became clinically available, BRCA genetic testing, and keeps their serum samples and lymphoblastoid cell lines in a biorepository for later studies.

label: Greek Recurrent Myocardial Infarction Cohort
definition: A cohort of survivors of myocardial infarction in Greece, followed for recurrent events, whose participants have been genotyped and profiled for gene expression after the index infarction to study the genetics of recurrent myocardial infarction and of cardiometabolic traits.

label: Brain Genomics Superstruct Project
other synonyms: Harvard/MGH Brain Genomics Superstruct Project
definition: A neuroimaging genetics study of clinically normal participants, mostly young adults aged 18 to 35, recruited from the Boston community, United States, in 2008–2012 through ongoing research studies at Harvard University and Massachusetts General Hospital that shared a common acquisition protocol, who underwent structural and functional magnetic resonance imaging, gave saliva for DNA and completed demographic, health, behavioural, cognitive and personality assessments, to link individual differences in brain structure and function to behaviour and genetic variation.

label: UK2 GWAS
other synonyms: UK2 GWAS of breast cancer
definition: The second UK genome-wide association study of breast cancer, funded by the Wellcome Trust and Cancer Research UK, whose cases are women with breast cancer from UK cancer genetics clinics, recruited through the Familial Breast Cancer Study, and from UK oncology clinics, recruited through the POSH study, and whose controls come from the 1958 Birth Cohort and the UK National Blood Service, genotyped by the Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium 2.

label: Health2 T2D Study
definition: A type 2 diabetes case-control sample of Korean adults contributed by the Korea National Institute of Health to the Asian Genetic Epidemiology Network's type 2 diabetes meta-analysis. Its cases, with type 2 diabetes of onset at age 40 or older, were drawn from the population-based Health2 cohort of the Korean Genome and Epidemiology Study; its controls, without diabetes or anti-diabetic medication and with normal fasting glucose, came partly from the Health2 cohort (those older than 60 with a normal oral glucose tolerance test) and partly from the Health Examinee (HEXA) shared control study. It was genotyped genome-wide on the Affymetrix Genome-Wide Human SNP Array 6.0.

label: Hannover Breast Cancer Study
other synonyms: Hannover breast cancer study
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of breast cancer at Hannover Medical School, Germany, whose cases are women who received radiotherapy for breast cancer there between 1995 and 2003 and whose controls are female blood donors at the same school, collected in 2005.

label: HangAmDan-B1-Investigator Initiated Trial
other synonyms: HangAmDan-B1-Investigator Initiated Trial study
definition: A randomized, multi-center, open-label clinical trial in the Republic of Korea, registered as KCT0005414, that compared the safety and efficacy of afatinib alone with afatinib combined with HAD-B1 (HangAmDan-B1), a traditional Korean medicine herbal formulation, in patients with locally advanced or metastatic EGFR-mutation-positive non-small cell lung cancer enrolled at six centres, and ran from February 2021 to April 2023.
diseases: patients with: non-small cell lung carcinoma (MONDO:0005233)

label: Hannover-Almaty Endometrial Cancer Study
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of endometrial cancer in Kazakhstan, whose own investigators genotyped its samples with TaqMan assays for the final replication stage of a 2012 genome-wide association study of endometrial cancer, and whose data were used again in a 2013 study of inflammation pathway genes and endometrial cancer risk.

label: Healthy Aging Longitudinal Study in Taiwan
other synonyms: healthy aging longitudinal study in Taiwan
definition: A population-based longitudinal study of ageing, established and funded by the National Health Research Institutes in Taiwan, which in 2009–2013 enrolled community-dwelling adults aged 55 and above, systematically sampled from household registries around a regional hospital in each of seven areas in northern, central, southern and eastern Taiwan, and follows them with home interviews and hospital-based clinical examinations with blood and urine collection every five years and annual telephone contacts, to study physical functioning, chronic and cardiovascular disease, neuropsychiatric health, and genetic and environmental factors in frailty and successful ageing.

label: Heredity and Phenotype Intervention Heart Study
other synonyms: Amish HAPI Heart Study|Amish Heredity and Phenotype Intervention (HAPI) Heart Study|Amish Heredity and Phenotype Intervention Heart Study|HAPI Heart Study|Heredity and Phenotype Intervention (HAPI) Heart Study
definition: A study of relatively healthy adults, aged 20 or over and from large families, of the Old Order Amish of Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, initiated in 2002 to measure cardiovascular responses to four short-term interventions (a cold pressor stress test, a high-salt diet, a high-fat challenge and aspirin therapy) and to identify the genetic and environmental determinants of these responses.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to high fat diet intake (ECTO:2000073)|designed to study: exposure to sodium chloride via ingestion (ECTO:0900473)

label: Heart Attack Risk in Puget Sound
definition: A population-based case-control study of early-onset myocardial infarction in King, Pierce and Snohomish counties, Washington, United States, whose cases were men under 50 and women under 60 with a first myocardial infarction diagnosed between 1991 and 2002, ascertained through medical record review at all acute care facilities in those counties, and whose controls, matched on age and sex and free of cardiovascular disease, were identified by random digit dialling in the same counties; it is one of the six studies of the Myocardial Infarction Genetics Consortium.

label: Human Biological Data Interchange Repository
other synonyms: HBDI collection|HBDI repository|Human Biological Data Interchange|U.S.A. Human Biological Data Interchange
definition: A publicly available collection of DNA samples and immortalized cell lines from families with type 1 diabetes, chiefly multiplex families and largely from the United States, built up from 1990 by the Human Biological Data Interchange in Philadelphia from pedigrees obtained through questionnaires sent to members of the Juvenile Diabetes Foundation, and used in genetic linkage and association studies of type 1 diabetes.

label: Harvard Biomarkers Study
other synonyms: Harvard Biomarker Study|Harvard NeuroDiscovery Center Biomarker Study
definition: A longitudinal biomarker cohort study run jointly by Brigham and Women's Hospital and Massachusetts General Hospital in Boston, following patients with Parkinson's disease, patients with other neurodegenerative diseases and healthy controls at structured in-person study visits with biobanked samples, to accelerate the discovery and validation of molecular diagnostic and progression markers of early-stage Parkinson's disease.
diseases: patients with: Alzheimer disease (MONDO:0004975)|patients with: Parkinson disease (MONDO:0005180)

label: Hispanic Colorectal Cancer Study
definition: A population-based study of men and women over 21 years of age who self-identified as Hispanic and had a first diagnosis of colorectal cancer after 1 January 2008, identified through the California Cancer Registry or directly from hospitals in the Los Angeles region (LAC + USC County Hospital and the USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center), from whom risk-factor and dietary questionnaires, pathology reports and saliva samples for genotyping were collected.

label: Hwasun Cancer Epidemiology Study-Colon and Rectum Cancer
other synonyms: Hwasun Cancer Epidemiology Study–Colon and Rectum Cancer
definition: The colorectal cancer arm of the Hwasun Cancer Epidemiology Study, a hospital-based case-control study of multiple cancers in South Korea. Its cases are patients newly diagnosed with colorectal cancer at Chonnam National University Hwasun Hospital, a cancer hospital in Jeollanam-do province, between April 2004 and February 2013, excluding secondary or recurrent cancers, and its controls are participants in the Korean Community Health Survey in Jindo and Bosung counties of Jeollanam-do in 2010 to 2012.

label: Health2 Study
other synonyms: Health 2|Health2 cohort|Health2 project|Health2 study
definition: A population-based cohort of the Korean Genome and Epidemiology Study (KoGES), set up by the Center for Genome Science of the Korea National Institute of Health, made up of community-based cohorts of adults aged 40–69 in five rural areas of South Korea (Wonju, Pyeongchang, Gangneung, Geumsan and Naju), and later counted as part of the KoGES Cardiovascular Disease Association Study (CAVAS). It served as a replication and case-control sample in Korean genetic association studies of type 2 diabetes, blood pressure, lipids and blood cell traits.

label: Helsinki Breast Cancer Study
other synonyms: Helsinki Breast Cancer Project
definition: A hospital-based breast cancer case-control study at Helsinki University Central Hospital in southern Finland, whose cases are consecutive, unselected breast cancer patients from the hospital's Departments of Oncology (1997-1998 and 2000) and Surgery (2001-2004) together with familial breast cancer patients from its Departments of Oncology and Clinical Genetics (from 1995), and whose controls are healthy women from the same region.

label: Hereditary Breast and Ovarian cancer study in the Netherlands
other synonyms: HEBON study|Hereditary Breast and Ovarian Cancer Research Group Netherlands|Hereditary Breast and Ovarian Study Netherlands|Hereditary Breast and Ovarian cancer study, the Netherlands
definition: An ongoing nationwide retrospective cohort study with prospective follow-up of members of families carrying BRCA1 or BRCA2 mutations in the Netherlands, begun in 1999, whose participants are invited once they learn their carrier status through clinical genetic testing at the Dutch university medical centres and family cancer clinics. It is run by the Hereditary Breast and Ovarian Cancer Research Group Netherlands, coordinated by the Netherlands Cancer Institute in Amsterdam, and collects data through questionnaires, medical records and linkage with the Netherlands Cancer Registry.
diseases: at risk of: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|at risk of: ovarian cancer (MONDO:0008170)

label: Hawaii Endometrial Cancer Study
definition: A population-based case-control study of endometrial cancer in Hawaii, United States, whose cases were ascertained between 1988 and 1993 and whose controls were matched to them on age and ethnicity, with mainly non-white participants. It is one of the studies of the Epidemiology of Endometrial Cancer Consortium (E2C2), and its samples were genotyped at Vanderbilt University for the final replication stage of a 2012 genome-wide association study of endometrial cancer.

label: Healthy Lifestyle in Europe by Nutrition in Adolescence Study
other synonyms: HELENA Cross-Sectional Study|HELENA Study|HELENA cross-sectional study|HELENA study|Healthy Lifestyle in Europe by Nutrition in Adolescence Cross-Sectional Study|Healthy Lifestyle in Europe by Nutrition in Adolescence study
definition: A multicentre cross-sectional study of adolescents aged 12.5 to 17.5 years in ten European cities (Stockholm, Athens, Heraklion, Rome, Zaragoza, Ghent, Lille, Dortmund, Vienna and Pecs), carried out from October 2006 to December 2007 within the European Union-funded HELENA project, which selected adolescents through randomly chosen schools by multi-stage random cluster sampling stratified by geographical location, age and socioeconomic status, and measured diet, physical activity, fitness and body composition with harmonised methods, with fasting blood samples from a randomly selected subsample, to describe the nutritional status and lifestyle of European adolescents.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to Physical Activity (ECTO:6000039)|designed to study: exposure to eating behavior (ECTO:6000021)|designed to study: exposure to nutrient (ECTO:9001695)

label: Hellenic Longitudinal Investigation of Aging and Diet
definition: A population-based, multidisciplinary longitudinal study of older adults in Greece, randomly selected at age 65 or over from the municipality registries of Marousi, a suburb of Athens, and of the city of Larissa and its rural surroundings, with baseline evaluations from 2011 to 2015 and follow-up evaluations thereafter, designed to estimate the prevalence and incidence of Alzheimer's disease, other dementias, mild cognitive impairment and other neuropsychiatric conditions of ageing and to study their associations with nutrition in this Mediterranean population.
diseases: population study of: Alzheimer disease (MONDO:0004975)|population study of: cognitive disorder (MONDO:0002039)|population study of: dementia (MONDO:0001627)
exposures: designed to study: exposure to nutrient (ECTO:9001695)

label: Helsinki Ovarian Cancer Study
definition: A case-control study of epithelial ovarian cancer in Helsinki, Finland, whose ovarian cancer patients and healthy controls take part in the genetic association studies of the Ovarian Cancer Association Consortium.

label: Hertfordshire Cohort Study
other synonyms: Hertfordshire cohort study
definition: A population-based cohort of men and women born in 1931–1939 in Hertfordshire, United Kingdom, who still lived there in 1998–2004, when they completed a home interview and a clinic visit for a detailed health assessment, and some of whom were followed up in later waves, recruited initially to investigate the relationship between growth in infancy and the risk of adult diseases and since used to study musculoskeletal and general health in older age.

label: Health, Risk Factors, Training and Genetics Family Study
other synonyms: HERITAGE Family Study|HEalth, RIsk factors, exercise Training And Genetics Family Study|Health, Risk Factors, Exercise Training and Genetics Family Study
definition: A family study, run by a consortium of universities in the United States and Canada, of sedentary white and Black families (both parents and adult offspring aged 17 to 65) who were tested, put through the same 20-week graded aerobic exercise training programme and re-tested, designed to document the role of the genotype in the cardiovascular, metabolic and hormonal responses to regular exercise.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to exercise (ECTO:6000002)

label: Heart Failure: A Controlled Trial Investigating Outcomes of Exercise Training
other synonyms: Heart Failure - A Controlled Trial Investigating Outcomes of Exercise TraiNing|Heart Failure: a Controlled Trial Investigating Outcomes of Exercise Training
definition: A randomized controlled trial, funded by the US National Institutes of Health, that enrolled adult patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (left ventricular ejection fraction ≤35%) and NYHA class II-IV symptoms despite optimal therapy, at 82 centers in the United States, Canada and France from April 2003 to February 2007, comparing usual heart-failure care with usual care plus supervised and then home-based aerobic exercise training, and including a genetic sub-study.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to exercise (ECTO:6000002)

label: Health Habits and Opinions study
definition: A 1990 follow-up survey of the twins of the Virginia 30,000 study of twins and their relatives (the 1988 Mid Atlantic Twin Registry study, a kinship sample drawn from Virginia's vital records and supplemented by a national mailing to members of the American Association of Retired Persons, which had answered a Health and Life Styles questionnaire in the late 1980s), in which twins aged 40 to 93 were surveyed again about two years later on many of the same measures, including a Wilson-Patterson inventory of political attitudes.

label: Hispanic/Latino Anthropometry Consortium
definition: A consortium of studies and consortia of adults of Hispanic/Latino heritage, or of Native American heritage, from Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico, Peru and the United States, among them the CANDELA consortium, that meta-analyses their genome-wide association results in discovery and replication stages to find and fine-map genetic loci for anthropometric traits such as body mass index, height and waist-to-hip ratio.

label: Hannover-Jena Endometrial Cancer Study
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of endometrial cancer in Germany, whose cases were women aged 31–89 recruited at the Friedrich Schiller University of Jena or at Hannover Medical School after a diagnosis of histologically confirmed primary incident endometrial carcinoma between 2004 and 2010, who were interviewed there and gave peripheral blood for DNA, with epidemiological data from questionnaires and tumour stage and histology from pathology and clinical reports. Its cases were genotyped in the genome-wide association studies of the Endometrial Cancer Association Consortium.

label: Hannover-Jena Ovarian Cancer Study
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of ovarian cancer in Germany whose cases were patients attending the gynaecology clinics of Hannover Medical School or Friedrich Schiller University Jena and whose controls were healthy female blood donors at Hannover Medical School; one of the member studies of the Ovarian Cancer Association Consortium.

label: Hong Kong Breast Cancer Study
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of breast cancer in women in Hong Kong, supported by the Hong Kong Sanatorium and Hospital, that contributes genotyped cases and controls to the Breast Cancer Association Consortium's studies of women of Asian ancestry.

label: Hong Kong Study
definition: A hospital-based case–control study of lung cancer among ethnic Chinese in Hong Kong, whose cases were lung cancer patients aged 18 to 80 years who underwent tumour resection at Queen Mary Hospital and Grantham Hospital and whose controls were patients of comparable age with non-cancer diagnoses at Queen Mary Hospital; its never-smoking women were genotyped in the genome-wide association study of the Female Lung Cancer Consortium in Asia.

label: Harvard Lung Cancer Study
other synonyms: Harvard lung cancer study
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of lung cancer at Massachusetts General Hospital in Boston, begun in 1992, whose cases are adults with primary lung cancer confirmed by a hospital lung pathologist and whose controls are cancer-free friends or spouses of cancer or surgery patients at the same hospital, with interviewer-administered questionnaires on smoking, occupational and family history.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to smoking (ECTO:6000013)

label: Hannover-Minsk Breast Cancer Study
definition: A breast cancer case-control study in Belarus whose cases were recruited in 2002-2008 at the N.N. Alexandrov Institute for Oncology and Medical Radiology in Minsk or at five regional oncology centres (Gomel, Mogilev, Grodno, Brest and Vitebsk), and whose controls were women attending general medical examinations at gynaecology clinics in those regions, women attending the Institute for Inherited Diseases in Minsk, female blood donors in Minsk and healthy relatives of cases; one of the member studies of the Breast Cancer Association Consortium.

label: Hannover-Minsk Ovarian Cancer Study
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of epithelial ovarian cancer in Belarus whose cases were Belarusian patients recruited at the N.N. Alexandrov Institute for Oncology and Medical Radiology in Minsk and whose controls were healthy Belarusian women volunteers recruited over the same period at the Institute for Inherited Diseases or the Institute for Transfusion Medicine in Minsk; one of the member studies of the Ovarian Cancer Association Consortium.

label: Healthy Nevada Project
definition: A population health study of adult volunteers in Nevada, established in 2016 by Renown Health and the Desert Research Institute in Reno with targeted recruitment in rural and socioeconomically deprived areas of northern Nevada, that links participants' genetic data (genotyping from 2016, Helix Exome+ sequencing from 2018) with their Renown Health electronic health records.

label: Hawaii Ovarian Cancer Study
other synonyms: Hawaii Ovarian Cancer Case-Control Study
definition: A population-based case-control study of ovarian cancer in Hawaii, USA, whose cases were identified by rapid case ascertainment through the Hawaii Tumor Registry from 1993 to 2008 and whose controls were randomly selected from the Hawaii Department of Health's annual survey of representative households and matched to cases on age and ethnicity, with data collected by interview; one of the member studies of the Ovarian Cancer Association Consortium.

label: Hoorn Study
definition: A population-based cohort study of glucose metabolism and vascular disease in the Netherlands, begun in 1989 with men and women aged 50-74 randomly selected from the population register of the town of Hoorn, who underwent oral glucose tolerance tests and were re-examined in 1996-1998, 2000-2001 and 2005-2007.

label: Hormones and Ovarian Cancer Prediction Study
other synonyms: Hormones and Ovarian Cancer Prediction|Hormones and Ovarian Cancer Prediction study|Hormones and Ovarian cancer PrEdiction|Novel Risk Factors and Potential Early Detection Markers for Ovarian Cancer
definition: A population-based case-control study of epithelial ovarian cancer run from the University of Pittsburgh, which enrolled women with primary epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube or peritoneal cancer diagnosed from 2003 who lived in western Pennsylvania, eastern Ohio and western New York State, identified from hospital tumour registries, clinical practices and pathology databases, and interviewed participants at home.
diseases: patients with: fallopian tube cancer (MONDO:0002158)|patients with: ovarian carcinoma (MONDO:0005140)|patients with: peritoneum cancer (MONDO:0002087)

label: Helsinki Sudden Death Study/Tampere Coronary Study
other synonyms: Helsinki Sudden Death Study
definition: A Finnish forensic autopsy series of men aged 35 to 69 who died out of hospital, combining consecutive autopsies in Helsinki in 1991-1992 (the Helsinki Sudden Death Study) and in Tampere in 2001-2004 (the Tampere Coronary Study), in which coronary artery disease was assessed at autopsy from coronary stenosis of 50% or more, old or acute myocardial infarction, or sudden cardiac death from plaque rupture and thrombosis.
diseases: population study of: coronary artery disorder (MONDO:0005010)

label: Hubei Type 2 Diabetes Studies
definition: A type 2 diabetes case-control sample of unrelated Han Chinese from Hubei province, China, made up of people with type 2 diabetes and nondiabetic controls, genotyped as one of three independent replication populations in a genome-wide association study of type 2 diabetes in Chinese Hans.

label: Oxford Family Blood Pressure Study
other synonyms: Oxford Family Blood Pressure cohort
definition: A family cohort of white British nuclear and extended families from Oxford, United Kingdom, recruited from 1993 through a proband with essential hypertension in the upper 5% of the blood pressure distribution, with other family members collected regardless of their blood pressure, for quantitative genetic study of hypertension, left ventricular mass and other cardiovascular risk factors; families were recalled for further cardiovascular phenotyping, including electrocardiography, echocardiography and cardiac magnetic resonance imaging.

label: Hannover-Ufa Breast Cancer Study
definition: A German-Russian breast cancer case-control study based at the Institute of Biochemistry and Genetics of the Ufa Scientific Center, Russian Academy of Sciences, whose cases are consecutive breast cancer patients diagnosed in 2000-2008 at two oncology centres in Bashkortostan and Siberia, Russia, and whose controls are healthy volunteers selected in 2002-2008 from population studies in the same regions.

label: Hebrew University Genetic Resource
other synonyms: Hebrew university geneomic resource AJ schizophrenia case-control sample
definition: A repository of DNA samples from Ashkenazi Jewish people, collected and held at the Hebrew University in Israel, that includes patients with schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder recruited from hospitalised inpatients at seven medical centres in Israel, patients with diabetes and healthy volunteers, among them controls collected through the Israeli Blood Bank; its schizophrenia cases and controls form a case-control sample used in genome-wide association studies of schizophrenia.
diseases: patients with: schizoaffective disorder (MONDO:0005487)|patients with: schizophrenia (MONDO:0005090)

label: Molecular Genetic Studies of Breast- and Ovarian Cancer in Hungary
other synonyms: Hungarian Breast and Ovarian Cancer Study|Molecular Genetic Studies of Breast and Ovarian Cancer in Hungary
definition: A Hungarian study of inherited breast and ovarian cancer, run by the Hungarian Breast and Ovarian Cancer Study Group at the Department of Molecular Genetics of the National Institute of Oncology in Budapest, which contributes carriers of pathogenic BRCA1 and BRCA2 variants and their data to the Consortium of Investigators of Modifiers of BRCA1/2 (CIMBA).
diseases: at risk of: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|at risk of: ovarian cancer (MONDO:0008170)

label: Hannover-Ufa Ovarian Cancer Study
definition: An epithelial ovarian cancer case-control study of women in Russia, named for its Hannover (Germany) and Ufa (Russia) partners and funded by the German Research Foundation and the Rudolf-Bartling Foundation, that contributes cases and controls to the Ovarian Cancer Association Consortium's genotyping projects.

label: HYPERGENES–European Network for Genetic-Epidemiological Studies
other synonyms: European Network for Genetic-Epidemiological Studies|HYPERGENES–European Network for Genetic-Epidemiological Studies: building a method to dissect complex genetic traits, using essential hypertension as a disease model|Hypergenes|Hypergenes - European Network for Genetic-Epidemiological Studies|Hypergenes - European Network for Genetic-Epidemological Studies
definition: A European Union Seventh Framework Programme project on the genetics of essential hypertension, coordinated from the University of Milan, that assembled hypertensive cases, normotensive controls and population samples from extensively characterised cohorts in different European regions (northern Europe, continental Italy and Sardinia), among them the FLEMENGHO/EPOGH cohort, the Wandsworth Heart and Stroke Study, the Milano-Sassari cohort and the SOPHIA cohort, for a two-stage genome-wide association study.

label: Harvard i2b2
other synonyms: Harvard i2b2 sample|Integrating Biology & the Bedside
definition: A major depressive disorder case-control sample of the Psychiatric Genomics Consortium from the Partners HealthCare System in the United States, assembled with the i2b2 (Informatics for Integrating Biology and the Bedside) centre, whose cases were identified by natural language processing of electronic medical records with psychiatrist review (an ICD-9 diagnosis of major depressive disorder, confirmed on record review, with depression either responsive to an SSRI or unresponsive to at least two antidepressant trials) and whose controls came from neuroimaging studies, screened by self-reported psychiatric history.

label: Irish Affected Sib Pair Study of Alcohol Dependence
other synonyms: GFG, Irish Affected Sib Pair Study of Alcohol Dependence|Irish Affected Sib-Pair Study of Alcohol Dependence
definition: A family study of alcohol dependence in Ireland and Northern Ireland that between 1998 and 2002 recruited probands meeting DSM-IV criteria for alcohol dependence, ascertained in community alcoholism treatment facilities and public and private hospitals and with all four grandparents born in Ireland or Great Britain, together with their siblings and parents, all interviewed by clinically trained interviewers, probands and siblings with a modified Semi-Structured Assessment for the Genetics of Alcoholism and parents with a modified Structured Clinical Interview for DSM.
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to alcohol abuse (ECTO:6000009)

label: Italian Atherosclerosis, Thrombosis, and Vascular Biology Study
other synonyms: Italian ATVB Study|Italian Atherosclerosis Thrombosis and Vascular Biology|Italian Atherosclerosis, Thrombosis and Vascular Biology Study
definition: A prospective, nationwide case-control study of early-onset myocardial infarction involving 125 coronary care units in Italy, whose cases were patients hospitalised for a first myocardial infarction before the age of 45 who underwent coronary angiography and whose controls were healthy, unrelated blood donors or staff of the same hospitals, matched by age, sex and geographical origin, recruited between 1994 and 2007.

label: International BRCA1/2 Carrier Cohort Study
other synonyms: International BRCA1/2 carirer cohort study
definition: An international collaborative prospective cohort study of carriers of BRCA1 or BRCA2 pathogenic variants that pools nationwide and centre-based carrier studies, including EMBRACE in the United Kingdom and Ireland, GENEPSO in France and HEBON in the Netherlands and smaller studies in other European countries and Quebec, Canada; participants were recruited from cancer genetics centres between 1997 and 2011 and followed actively by questionnaire and, where possible, by pathology, cancer and death registry linkage and medical records, to study breast and ovarian cancer risks and their modifiers in carriers.
diseases: at risk of: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|at risk of: ovarian cancer (MONDO:0008170)

label: Iceland Bladder Cancer Study
definition: A case-control sample of Icelanders assembled by deCODE genetics for genome-wide association studies of urinary bladder cancer, with cases identified through the Icelandic Cancer Registry and recruited from 2001 by trained nurses through special recruitment clinics, donating a blood sample and answering a lifestyle questionnaire, and controls drawn from other ongoing genome-wide studies at deCODE.

label: Indiana Biobank Liver cohort
definition: A case-control sample drawn from the Indiana Biobank, the statewide biobank of Indiana University, Purdue University and the University of Notre Dame whose participants are recruited in person from participating clinics and linked to the Indiana Network for Patient Care, comprising participants with chronic liver disease identified from ICD-9/10 codes and confirmed by chart review, among them patients with cirrhosis attributed to alcohol or to metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease, and liver disease-free controls without liver-specific codes or abnormal liver tests, assembled for genetic studies of cirrhosis.

label: Inflammatory Bowel Disease in South-Eastern Norway
other synonyms: IBSEN study|Inflammatory Bowel South-Eastern Norway|Inflammatory Bowel disease in South-Eastern Norway
definition: A population-based inception cohort of all patients newly diagnosed with inflammatory bowel disease (ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease) from 1990 to 1993 while living in four counties of south-eastern Norway, each matched for age and sex with five controls drawn from the Norwegian Population Register, set up to establish the incidence of the disease in the region and followed prospectively for its natural course at 1, 5, 10, 20 and 30 years.
diseases: patients with: Crohn disease (MONDO:0005011)|patients with: ulcerative colitis (MONDO:0005101)

label: integrated Cancer Repository for Cancer Research
other synonyms: integrated Cancer Data Repository for Cancer research
definition: An umbrella repository of collaborative cancer-specific registries, among them the Pancreatic Cancer Collaborative Registry, the Breast Cancer Collaborative Registry and the Thyroid Cancer and Tumor Collaborative Registry, developed and maintained by the Fred & Pamela Buffett Cancer Center at the University of Nebraska Medical Center in Omaha, through which participating hospitals in the Midwestern United States enrol cancer patients, high-risk individuals and controls and collect questionnaire data on a common core of demographic, lifestyle, family history and quality-of-life items, clinical and follow-up data and biospecimens for cancer research.

label: International Cohort Collection for Bipolar Disorder
definition: A consortium of investigators in the United States, the United Kingdom and Sweden, established to accelerate genome-wide association studies of bipolar disorder and its clinical subtypes by applying high-throughput phenotyping methods, which brings together bipolar disorder cases and unaffected controls from the Sweden Bipolar Disorder Cohort, the Bipolar Disorder Research Network in the United Kingdom, a University of Southern California collection and a Massachusetts General Hospital collection identified from electronic health records, all genotyped at the Broad Institute.

label: IrsiCaixa Foundation Acute/Recent HIV-1 Infection Cohort
other synonyms: IrsiCaixa Foundation Acute/Recent HIV-1 Infection cohort
definition: A cohort of people with acute or recent HIV-1 infection in Barcelona, Spain, held by the IrsiCaixa Foundation (IrsiCaixa AIDS Research Institute), one of the cohorts that contributed HIV-1-infected participants to the genome-wide studies of the International Collaboration for the Genomics of HIV.

label: International Consortium on the Genetics of Heroin Dependence - Alcohol Related Conditions
other synonyms: Alcohol Related Conditions
definition: The Alcohol Related Conditions (ARC) subset of the genome-wide association data set of the International Consortium on the Genetics of Heroin Dependence, a case-control study of heroin dependence held in dbGaP as phs000277; it is one of the three subsets of that data set, which were genotyped on three different arrays, and was genotyped on the Illumina HumanCNV370-Quad.

label: International Consortium on the Genetics of Heroin Dependence - Center for Inherited Disease Research
other synonyms: Center for Inherited Disease Research
definition: The Center for Inherited Disease Research (CIDR) subset of the genome-wide association data set of the International Consortium on the Genetics of Heroin Dependence, a case-control study of heroin dependence held in dbGaP as phs000277; it is one of the three subsets of that data set, which were genotyped on three different arrays, and was genotyped on the Illumina Human660W-Quad.

label: International Consortium on the Genetics of Heroin Dependence - Research on Alcohol and Tobacco Related Phenotypes
other synonyms: Research on Alcohol and Tobacco Related Phenotypes
definition: The Research on Alcohol and Tobacco Related Phenotypes (RATRP) subset of the genome-wide association data set of the International Consortium on the Genetics of Heroin Dependence, a case-control study of heroin dependence held in dbGaP as phs000277; it is one of the three subsets of that data set, which were genotyped on three different arrays, and was genotyped on the Illumina Human610-Quad.

label: International COPD Genetics Network
definition: A family-based study of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease funded by GlaxoSmithKline, whose pedigrees of probands with COPD and their siblings, characterised by spirometry, serve as a replication and testing cohort in COPD genome-wide association studies and genetic risk-score meta-analyses (1,103 pedigrees in the 2017 meta-analysis of 16,707 subjects).
diseases: patients with: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (MONDO:0005002)

label: Study to investigate the genetics of in situ carcinoma of the ductal subtype
other synonyms: A study to Investigate the genetiCs of In situ Carcinoma of the ductaL subtypE|ICICLE study|Study to Investigate the Genetics on In Situ Carcinoma of the Ductal|study to Investigate the genetics of In situ Carcinoma of the ductaL subtype
definition: A UK case-control study of genetic predisposition to ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS) of the breast, which between 2007 and 2012 recruited women aged 60 or under with a current or past diagnosis of DCIS, identified from local pathology reports at more than 100 hospitals throughout the United Kingdom, and healthy controls without a family history of breast cancer (often friends or non-blood relatives of cases), with a blood sample and a questionnaire on reproductive, medical and family history and hormone use.
diseases: patients with: ductal breast carcinoma in situ (MONDO:0005023)

label: International Collaborative Study on Hypertension in Blacks
definition: A population-based survey of blood pressure, hypertension and associated risk factors such as obesity among adults of West African origin living in societies at different stages of social and economic development, which examined age-stratified samples at seven sites in Nigeria, Cameroon, Jamaica, St. Lucia, Barbados and metropolitan Chicago in the United States under a standardized protocol with centrally trained field staff; its Nigerian base sample, recruited in Ibadan and Igbo-Ora in Oyo State, later provided the sampling frame for genotyped cohorts.

label: Hospital Clínic Primary HIV-1 Infection Cohort
other synonyms: Hospital Clinic Primary HIV-1 Infection Cohort|Hospital Clinic-IDIBAPS Acute/Recent HIV-1 Infection Cohort|Hospital Clinic-IDIBAPS Acute/Recent HIV-1 Infection cohort|Hospital Clinic-IDIBAPS cohort
definition: A prospective single-centre cohort that has enrolled, since 1997, all patients with acute or recent HIV-1 infection (within 180 days of infection) evaluated at the Hospital Clínic in Barcelona, Spain, identified by detectable viraemia with a negative HIV serology or by documented seroconversion within the previous six months.

label: Italian Cohort Naïve Antiretrovirals
other synonyms: ICONA Cohort Study|ICONA Foundation Study|ICONA cohort|Icona Foundation Study|Icona cohort|Italian COhort of Naives to Antiretrovirals|Italian Cohort of naïves to antiretrovirals
definition: A nationwide, multicentre, observational prospective cohort of people with HIV in Italy, set up in 1997, that enrols adults who are naive to antiretroviral therapy at enrolment through Italian infectious diseases centres and follows them over time; it is run under the ICONA Foundation Study protocol.

label: Intern Health Study
definition: A multi-institutional prospective cohort study of stress and depression in physicians in the United States, which invites incoming interns each year before they start the first year of residency training (from 2007) and follows them from the end of medical school through internship, recording depressive and anxiety symptoms and their risk factors by repeated questionnaires and a daily mood smartphone app, with DNA collected by mail for genetic studies of depression under stress.
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to occupation (ECTO:0001591)

label: Icelandic Kidney Stone Registry
other synonyms: Icelandic Kidney Stone Disease Registry|Icelandic Kidney Stone Disease Registry at LUH
definition: A registry of patients with kidney stone disease in Iceland, kept at Landspitali – The National University Hospital of Iceland in Reykjavik and established in 2008 in conjunction with a nationwide study of kidney stone disease that searched the computerised records of all major hospitals and medical imaging centres in Iceland for codes indicating kidney stones; its patients with confirmed radiopaque stones who had given blood to the genetic research programmes of deCODE genetics were the Icelandic cases of deCODE's genetic association studies of kidney stones.

label: Carotid Intima-Media Thickness (IMT) and IMT-Progression as Predictors of Vascular Events in a High-Risk European Population
other synonyms: Carotid Intima Media Thickness [IMT] and IMT-progression as predictors of vascular events in a high risk European population|IMPROVE study
definition: A multicentre prospective cohort study of European adults aged 54 to 79 years with at least three vascular risk factors but no previous cardiovascular or cerebrovascular events, enrolled at seven centres in Finland, France, Italy, the Netherlands and Sweden and followed for vascular events by visits at 15 and 30 months and a final telephone interview, to assess carotid intima-media thickness and its progression as predictors of vascular events.

label: IMSGC UK
other synonyms: International Multiple Sclerosis Genetics Consortium UK
definition: A UK case-control sample of the International Multiple Sclerosis Genetics Consortium, comprising patients with multiple sclerosis (McDonald criteria) of European descent recruited in the United Kingdom and healthy control subjects from the Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium, genotyped on the Affymetrix 500K platform and used as one stratum of the consortium's genome-wide association meta-analyses.

label: IMSGC US
other synonyms: International Multiple Sclerosis Genetics Consortium US
definition: The United States stratum of the International Multiple Sclerosis Genetics Consortium's genome-wide association data on multiple sclerosis: people with multiple sclerosis of European descent recruited in the US, genotyped on the Affymetrix 500K array and matched with healthy control subjects from the National Institute of Mental Health, analysed as a separate stratum (beside the consortium's UK stratum) in the consortium's meta-analyses of multiple sclerosis susceptibility and severity.

label: Indian Diabetes Consortium
other synonyms: INdian DIabetes COnsortium
definition: A nationwide collaborative biorepository of DNA, plasma and serum from people with and without type 2 diabetes in India's two major ethnic groups (Indo-European and Dravidian speakers), collected from 2003 to 2011 with anthropometric and clinical measurements by the Indian Diabetes Consortium to study the genetic, epigenetic and environmental causes of type 2 diabetes in Indians undergoing socioeconomic transition, re-sampling the same areas at intervals to follow the effects of urbanisation.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to lifestyle (ECTO:6000015)

label: Industrial Cohorts Research Group
definition: A Danish and Dutch occupational research group whose pooled surveys of occupational asthma, drawn from population-based or prospective cohort studies of workers exposed to allergens and irritants (agricultural dust or animals in the Danish SUS study, the Dutch Omega study and the Veterinarian’s Health Study; wheat flour and amylase in the Dutch Bakers health surveillance project; wood dust in the Danish Wood Dust Cohort of furniture workers; isocyanates in Dutch industrial spray painters), provided prevalent asthma cases and industry-, sex- and age-matched controls, as the INDUSTRIAL subgroup of the GABRIEL Consortium, to the genome-wide meta-analysis of asthma of the Trans-National Asthma Genetic Consortium.
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to allergen (ECTO:0000726)|participants with exposure: exposure to dust (ECTO:7000001)|participants with exposure: exposure to dust from plant parts (ECTO:7000033)|participants with exposure: exposure to isocyanates (ECTO:9002153)|participants with exposure: exposure to lipopolysaccharide (ECTO:9000215)|participants with exposure: exposure to wood (ECTO:7000034)

label: International Head and Neck Cancer Epidemiology Consortium
other synonyms: INHANCE Consortium
definition: An international consortium of research groups leading epidemiological studies of head and neck cancer, mostly case–control studies in North and South America, Europe and Asia, which pools their individual-level data in a common database to share comparable data, study rare subgroups such as never smokers and coordinate laboratory analyses of the causes of head and neck cancer, including genome-wide association studies of cancers of the upper aerodigestive tract.
diseases: patients with: head and neck cancer (MONDO:0005627)

label: Interdisciplinary Health Research International Team on Breast Cancer Susceptibility
other synonyms: INHERIT BRCAs research program|INterdisciplinary HEalth Research International Team on BReast CAncer susceptibility|Interdisciplinary Health Research Internal Team Breast Cancer Susceptiblity|Interdisciplinary Health Research International Team Breast Cancer Susceptibility
definition: A research programme based at the Centre Hospitalier Universitaire de Québec and Laval University, Canada, that has recruited high-risk French-Canadian families with breast and/or ovarian cancer (several affected close relatives, or a known BRCA1 or BRCA2 mutation) through a network of referring clinicians across Quebec since 1996, for BRCA1 and BRCA2 mutation testing and studies of inherited susceptibility to breast and ovarian cancer.
diseases: at risk of: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|at risk of: ovarian cancer (MONDO:0008170)

label: India–Scotland Partnership for Precision Medicine in Diabetes
other synonyms: INSPIRED project|INSPIRED study|INdia-Scotland Partnership for pRecision mEdicine in Diabetes
definition: A research partnership funded by the UK National Institute for Health Research between the University of Dundee, Scotland, and Dr Mohan's Diabetes Specialities Centre and Madras Diabetes Research Foundation, Chennai, India, that brings together diabetes data resources from India and Scotland, chiefly a cohort of Asian Indians with type 2 diabetes from the electronic medical records of Dr Mohan's Diabetes Specialities Centre (DMDSC) and the East Scotland Diabetes Cohort (ESDC) of white Europeans with type 2 diabetes from Tayside and Fife, for precision-medicine studies comparing type 2 diabetes in Asian Indians and white Europeans.

label: International Collaborative Study of Cardiovascular Disease in Asia
definition: A population-based survey of cardiovascular disease and its risk factors (hypertension, hypercholesterolaemia, diabetes, obesity, smoking and physical inactivity) in nationally representative samples of adults aged 35–74 in China and Thailand, selected in 2000–2001 by multistage stratified cluster sampling; its Chinese participants, from ten provinces, were followed up in 2007–2008, 2012–2015 and 2018–2020 as one of the three sub-cohorts of the China-PAR project on incident atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.

label: Interplay Between Genetic Susceptibility and External Factors
other synonyms: INTERGENE cohort|INTERGENE study|INTERplay between GENEtic susceptibility and external factors
definition: A population-based prospective cohort of the INTERGENE research programme, set up to study the interplay between genetic and environmental risk factors for chronic disease, in which a random sample of adults aged 24 to 77 drawn from the population registers of an urban-rural area of western Sweden (Västra Götaland County, about half of them living in Gothenburg) was examined in 2001-2004 and re-examined in 2014-2016, with follow-up of health outcomes through linkage to the Swedish national registers.
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)

label: INTERPHONE study
other synonyms: INTERPHONE international case-control study|Interphone Study|Interphone study
definition: A multinational case-control study of glioma, meningioma, acoustic neurinoma and parotid gland tumours in residents aged 30 to 59, carried out with a common core protocol by sixteen centres in thirteen countries (Australia, Canada, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Israel, Italy, Japan, New Zealand, Norway, Sweden and the United Kingdom) with cases diagnosed during 2000–2004, set up to investigate whether mobile phone use and the radiofrequency fields it emits increase the risk of these tumours, and also collecting information on other potential risk factors.
diseases: patients with: acoustic neuroma (MONDO:0001569)|patients with: glioma (MONDO:0021042)|patients with: meningioma (MONDO:0016642)|patients with: parotid gland neoplasm (MONDO:0021243)
exposures: designed to study: exposure to radiowave radiation (ECTO:8000054)

label: Istituto Oncologico Veneto Hereditary Breast and Ovarian Cancer Study
other synonyms: Instituto Oncologico Veneto Hereditary Breast and Ovarian Cancer Study
definition: A study of hereditary breast and ovarian cancer at the Istituto Oncologico Veneto (IOV–IRCCS) in Padua, Italy, whose women and men carrying pathogenic BRCA1 or BRCA2 variants are contributed to the Consortium of Investigators of Modifiers of BRCA1 and BRCA2 (CIMBA).
diseases: at risk of: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|at risk of: ovarian cancer (MONDO:0008170)

label: Lymphoma Specialized Program of Research Excellence Molecular Epidemiology Resource Cohort Study
other synonyms: Iowa-Mayo SPORE|Iowa-Mayo SPORE Molecular Epidemiology Resource|Lymphoma SPORE Molecular Epidemiology Resource|Molecular Epidemiology Resource|University of Iowa/Mayo Clinic Specialized Program of Research Excellence Molecular Epidemiology Resource
definition: An observational epidemiology cohort of consecutive patients with newly diagnosed lymphoma (including Hodgkin lymphoma and chronic lymphocytic leukaemia), US residents aged 18 or over enrolled within 9 months of diagnosis at the Mayo Clinic in Rochester, Minnesota, and the University of Iowa in Iowa City from September 2002 to June 2015 as part of the University of Iowa/Mayo Clinic Lymphoma Specialized Program of Research Excellence (SPORE), set up to identify clinical, epidemiological, germline genetic, tumour and treatment factors that affect lymphoma outcomes and survivorship.
diseases: patients with: B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia (MONDO:0004948)|patients with: Hodgkins lymphoma (MONDO:0004952)|patients with: lymphoma (MONDO:0005062)

label: Identifying Prostate Cancer Genes
definition: A case–control study of prostate cancer in African American men in Maryland, United States, with cases from the Johns Hopkins Hospital and Sidney Kimmel Cancer Center and controls from men undergoing prostate cancer screening at the same institutions, one of the studies of the African Ancestry Prostate Cancer (AAPC) GWAS consortium's genome-wide association studies of prostate cancer in men of African ancestry.

label: Portuguese Oncology Institute-Porto Breast Cancer Study
other synonyms: Portuguese Oncology Institute–Porto Breast Cancer Study
definition: A study at the Portuguese Oncology Institute of Porto (IPO-Porto), Portugal, of carriers of pathogenic BRCA1 or BRCA2 variants, supported by the Liga Portuguesa Contra o Cancro, which contributes its participants and their genotypes to the Consortium of Investigators of Modifiers of BRCA1/2 (CIMBA).

label: IPO-Porto study
other synonyms: IPO-Porto Prostate Cancer study
definition: A hospital-based case–control study of prostate cancer at the Portuguese Oncology Institute of Porto (IPO-Porto), Portugal, whose cases are men with early-onset and/or familial prostate cancer and whose controls are blood donors, contributing to the PRACTICAL consortium's genome-wide association and polygenic risk studies of prostate cancer.

label: Internet-based Students Health Research Enterprise
other synonyms: Internet-based Students HeAlth Research Enterprise|Internet-based Students' Health Research Enterprise|i-Share cohort|i-Share project|i-Share study|internet-based Students Health Research Enterprise
definition: An ongoing prospective internet-based cohort (e-cohort) of students aged 18 or over who are enrolled at a university or other higher education institution in France and can read French, recruiting since February 2013 with the support of the universities of Bordeaux, Versailles and Nice, which collects online questionnaires on sociodemographic and academic characteristics, health status, personal and family medical history, lifestyle and mental health to study the health of university students over ten years.

label: International Studies of Infarct Survival
other synonyms: ISIS case-control study|International Study of Infarct Survival
definition: The programme of the International Studies of Infarct Survival (ISIS) collaborative group, which ran large randomised trials of treatments for suspected acute myocardial infarction (ISIS-1 to ISIS-4) through collaborating hospitals, and its case-control study in more than 100 UK hospitals, in which blood was taken from ISIS-3 patients on admission and, in the early 1990s, surviving patients of the ISIS-3 and ISIS-4 trials aged 30-79, their siblings and children, and those relatives' spouses, who served as controls, completed postal questionnaires on smoking and other habits and were asked for blood, for studies of smoking, blood markers and genetic variants in relation to the risk of non-fatal myocardial infarction.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to Cigarette Smoking (ECTO:6000038)

label: Investigation of Serial Studies to Predict Your Therapeutic Response with Imaging And molecular analysis 2
other synonyms: Investigation of Serial Studies to Predict Your Therapeutic Response With Imaging and Molecular Analysis 2|Investigation of Serial Studies to Predict Your Therapeutic Response with Imaging And moLecular analysis 2|Investigation of Serial studies to Predict Your Therapeutic Response with Imaging And molecular anaLysis 2
definition: An ongoing adaptive phase II platform clinical trial, run collaboratively by academic investigators, the US National Cancer Institute, the US Food and Drug Administration and industry under the Foundation for the NIH Biomarkers Consortium, conducted at multiple clinical sites in the United States with participants continuously enrolled since 2010, testing novel neoadjuvant therapeutic agents and biomarkers in women with locally advanced, high-risk breast cancer.

label: Stanford Insulin Suppression Test Cohort
other synonyms: Stanford IST|Stanford IST Cohort|Stanford IST cohort
definition: A cohort of non-diabetic adults of European ancestry pooled from studies of insulin resistance carried out at Stanford University over about ten years, whose insulin sensitivity was measured directly by the insulin suppression test (as steady-state plasma glucose) and who were genotyped genome-wide for genetic studies of insulin sensitivity and related traits.

label: Italian Gene-Environment Interactions in Lymphoma Etiology
other synonyms: Gene-environment interactions in lymphoma etiology|Italian Gene-Environment Interactions in Lymphoma Etiology study|Multicenter Italian study on gene-environment interactions in lymphoma etiology: translational aspects
definition: A multicentre case-control study of lymphoma of any subtype carried out in 2011–2017 in six Italian centres (Perugia, Florence, Novara, Verona, Cagliari and Nuoro in Sardinia, and Bari and Taranto in Apulia), whose cases are incident lymphoma patients and whose controls, frequency-matched to cases by age and sex, are cancer-free hospital patients in most centres and a random sample of the general population in Cagliari and Nuoro, interviewed about lifetime occupational history and other exposures to study gene-environment interactions in lymphoma etiology.
diseases: patients with: lymphoma (MONDO:0005062)|patients with: plasma cell myeloma (MONDO:0009693)
exposures: designed to study: exposure to glyphosate (ECTO:9002138)

label: Jamaican Adolescent Asthma Study
definition: A cross-sectional study of the prevalence of asthma and allergies in Jamaican adolescents whose mothers had been recruited into the Jamaica Perinatal Mortality Survey of 1986, which included all children born in Jamaica in September–October 1986; children from Kingston, St Andrew and St Catherine were contacted at ages 11 and 16 in a child development study and again at 18, and asthma was ascertained with a modified International Study of Asthma and Allergies in Childhood (ISAAC) questionnaire validated in the Jamaican population and, for adults followed in clinic since birth, from medical records. It is one of the asthma genetics studies of the Consortium on Asthma among African-ancestry Populations in the Americas (CAAPA).
