diseases: population study of: allergic disease (MONDO:0005271)|population study of: asthma (MONDO:0004979)

label: Japanese Centenarian Study
definition: A study of exceptional longevity, approved by the ethics committee of Keio University School of Medicine, that enrols centenarians from throughout Japan, with an emphasis on semi-supercentenarians aged 105 or more whose ages are validated with the Basic Resident Registration Card, together with referent subjects (spouses of centenarians' offspring and healthy younger volunteers), and whose genotyped cases and geographically matched controls serve as a Japanese case-control set in genetic studies of extreme old age.

label: Japanese Genetic Study Consortium for Alzheimer's Disease
other synonyms: Japanese Genetic Consortium for Alzheimer Disease|Japanese Genetic Study Consortium for AD|Japanese Genetic Study Consortium of Alzheimer’s Disease
definition: A case-control collection of blood samples from Japanese patients with clinically validated late-onset Alzheimer's disease meeting the NINCDS-ADRDA criteria and from elderly people without signs of dementia living unassisted in the local community, gathered by the members of the Japanese Genetic Study Consortium for Alzheimer's Disease for candidate-gene and genome-wide association studies of Alzheimer's disease in the Japanese population.

label: Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine Atrial Fibrillation Genetics Study
other synonyms: Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine Atrial Fibrillation Genetics Cohort|The Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine Atrial Fibrillation Genetics Study
definition: A clinical case collection of the Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine that since September 2008 has collected samples and clinical information from patients over 18 years of age referred for catheter ablation of symptomatic, drug-refractory atrial fibrillation, taken before the ablation procedure, for genetic studies of atrial fibrillation.

label: Joslin Kidney Study
definition: A longitudinal observational study, led from the Research Division of the Joslin Diabetes Center in Boston, of adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes attending the Joslin Clinic, enrolled in several cohorts from 1991 onwards with the aim of taking all eligible patients with albuminuria and a similar number drawn at random from those with normoalbuminuria, and followed for the development and progression of diabetic kidney disease, including kidney function decline and end-stage kidney disease.

label: Japanese Female Lung Cancer Collaborative Study
definition: A collaborative hospital-based case-control study of lung cancer in ethnic Japanese that enrolled patients with no history of cancer who were histologically diagnosed with lung cancer, and age- and sex-matched first-visit outpatients of the same period confirmed to have no cancer or history of neoplasia, at the Aichi Cancer Center Research Institute and the National Cancer Center Hospital; its never-smoking female cases and controls form the Japanese study of the Female Lung Cancer Consortium in Asia.

label: Jerusalem Lipid Research Clinic Study
other synonyms: Jerusalem LRC|Jerusalem LRC Longitudinal Study|Jerusalem LRC Prevalence Study|Jerusalem LRC longitudinal study|Jerusalem Lipid Research Clinic|Jerusalem Lipid Research Clinic cohort study|Jerusalem Lipid Research Clinic prevalence study
definition: A population-based cohort study in Jerusalem, Israel, begun in 1976–1979 as a cardiovascular prevalence study that followed the protocols of the North American Lipid Research Clinics prevalence studies, examining full age cohorts of 17-year-old Jewish residents of Jerusalem and many of their parents to describe plasma lipids and lipoproteins; samples of both generations were re-examined in later phases, the young participants at about 30 and 43 years of age in its longitudinal study.

label: Japanese Millennium Genome Project
other synonyms: Japanese Millenium Genome Project|Japanese Millennium Cohort|Millennium GPJ|The Japanese Millennium Genome Project
definition: A Japanese collaborative sample, assembled within the nationally based cooperative Millennium Genome Project for genetic studies of hypertension, that combines seven independent cohorts for studies of cardiovascular diseases and related risk factors: the Ohasama, Shigaraki, Takashima, Suita and Nomura studies, general-population studies of community residents recruited through medical check-ups, and the Yokohama and Matsuyama cohorts of employees of large manufacturing industries.

label: Human genetic determinants of severe malaria in North East Tanzania
other synonyms: Joint Malaria Programme, Kilimanjaro Christian Medical Centre
definition: A matched case-control study of severe malaria in children aged 3 months to 10 years in Muheza, Tanga region, north-eastern Tanzania, carried out in 2006–2008 by the Joint Malaria Programme (Kilimanjaro Christian Medical Centre, Moshi) with the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine. Its cases were children admitted to Teule Hospital with severe malaria, recruited within a study of severe febrile illness, and its controls were healthy children from the community individually matched on parental tribal origin, ward of residence and age; its clinical data and DNA samples were contributed to MalariaGEN Consortial Project 1 and used in candidate-gene and genome-wide association studies of severe malaria.

label: Karelia Allergy Study
definition: A study begun in 1998 that compares allergic symptoms and diseases, atopic sensitisation and their environmental and microbial determinants in children and adults of the adjacent Finnish and Russian parts of Karelia, areas that are geoclimatically similar but socio-economically distinct.
diseases: population study of: allergic disease (MONDO:0005271)|population study of: asthma (MONDO:0004979)
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)|designed to study: exposure to lifestyle (ECTO:6000015)

label: French West Indies Prostate Cancer Study
other synonyms: French West Indies Prostate cancer Study|French West Indies Prostate cancer Study (from Karukera, the original Caribbean name of Guadeloupe)|Karuprostate study
definition: A case-control study of prostate cancer in Guadeloupe, French West Indies, carried out between 2004 and 2007, whose cases are men newly diagnosed with prostate cancer in Guadeloupe in that period and whose controls are a random sample of men over 44 years old invited to the free health screening programme of the French national health insurance.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to chlordecone (ECTO:9000553)

label: Kawasaki Aging and Wellbeing Project
definition: A prospective longitudinal cohort study of community-dwelling residents of Kawasaki City in the Greater Tokyo Area, Japan, aged 85 to 89 and without limitations in basic activities of daily living at baseline, enrolled at hospitals in the city between March 2017 and December 2018, to study the trajectories of functional decline, frailty and cognitive impairment at advanced age and the genetic, biological, behavioural and socioenvironmental factors that delay or modify them.

label: Validation Cohort of Korean Brain Aging Study for the Early Diagnosis and Prediction of AD
other synonyms: Korean Brain Aging Study for the Early Diagnosis and Prediction of AD
definition: The independent, nationwide validation cohort of the Korean Brain Aging Study for the Early Diagnosis and Prediction of Alzheimer's disease (KBASE), which recruited cognitively normal people and people with subjective cognitive decline, mild cognitive impairment or Alzheimer's disease dementia at nine memory clinics across South Korea from April 2015 to August 2016 under the same criteria as KBASE, and followed them annually for three years, to reconfirm biomarkers identified in KBASE and to find risk and prognostic factors for Alzheimer's disease.
diseases: patients with: Alzheimer disease (MONDO:0004975)|patients with: cognitive disorder (MONDO:0002039)

label: Kuopio Breast Cancer Project
definition: A breast cancer study in eastern Finland whose cases are women seen at Kuopio University Hospital between 1990 and 1995 because of a breast lump, mammographic abnormality or other breast symptom and found to have breast cancer, and whose controls were selected from the National Population Register over the same years, matched to cases by age and long-term area of residence.

label: Kathleen Cuningham Foundation Consortium for Research into Familial Breast Cancer / Australian Ovarian Cancer Study
other synonyms: Kathleen Cuningham Foundation Consortium for research into Familial Breast Cancer/Australian Ovarian Cancer Study
definition: A breast cancer case-control set contributed to the Breast Cancer Association Consortium (BCAC) that combines, as cases, the index (youngest affected) cases of BRCA1- and BRCA2-mutation-negative multiple-case breast and breast-ovarian cancer families recruited since 1998 through family cancer clinics across Australia and New Zealand by the Kathleen Cuningham Foundation Consortium for Research into Familial Breast Cancer (kConFab), and, as controls, women identified from the electoral rolls across Australia in 2002–2006 by the Australian Ovarian Cancer Study (AOCS).

label: Kansas-City Osteoporosis Study
other synonyms: Kansas City Osteoporosis Study|Kansas City osteoporosis study
definition: A cross-sectional study of osteoporosis and related traits, including bone mineral density and body composition, in randomly recruited adults of European ancestry living in and around Kansas City, Missouri.

label: Kilifi severe malaria case-control study
other synonyms: KEMRI-Wellcome Research Programme, Kilifi
definition: A case-control study of severe Plasmodium falciparum malaria in children of Kilifi County on the coast of Kenya, carried out by the KEMRI-Wellcome Trust Research Programme in the area of the Kilifi Health and Demographic Surveillance System: its cases are children younger than 14 years admitted with severe malaria to the high-dependency ward of Kilifi County Hospital, and its controls are infants aged 3–12 months born in the same area between August 2006 and September 2010 who were recruited to a cohort study of genetic susceptibility to childhood diseases. It is the Kenyan partner study of the Malaria Genomic Epidemiology Network's multicentre case-control study of severe malaria (Consortial Project 1), whose samples were used in MalariaGEN's candidate-gene and genome-wide association studies.

label: King Faisal Specialist Hospital and Research Center cohort
other synonyms: KFSH&RC cohort
definition: A hospital-based cohort of indigenous Arabs from all five regions of Saudi Arabia referred for cardiology care to the King Faisal Specialist Hospital and Research Center, a tertiary care hospital in Riyadh, who gave blood samples for genotyping and access to their electronic health records for phenotypes, together with a population reference group of indigenous Arabs without known cardiometabolic disease representing 28 Saudi tribes; it was set up with Massachusetts General Hospital to study polygenic scores for cardiometabolic disease in Arabs.

label: Kick It at Swope III
other synonyms: Kick It at Swope 3|Kick-it-at-Swope (KIS)-3
definition: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial (NCT00666978), conducted from December 2007 to May 2010 at an urban community-based clinic in Kansas City, Missouri, of sustained-release bupropion combined with health education counselling for smoking cessation in African American light smokers (10 or fewer cigarettes per day) aged 18 or older; the third of the Kick It at Swope trials.
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to Cigarette Smoking (ECTO:6000038)

label: Human genetic determinants of severe malaria in Kumasi, Ghana
other synonyms: Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology
definition: A prospective, unmatched case-control study of severe malaria conducted in August 2006 – December 2008 in the Kumasi Metropolitan District, Ashanti Region, Ghana, with ethics approval from Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital and the Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology. Its cases were children aged 3 months to 12 years with severe malaria admitted to the Paediatric Emergency Unit of Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital, its controls were cord-blood samples collected in the same hospital's labour ward, and blood was also taken from the biological parents of cases (family trios); its clinical data and DNA samples were contributed to MalariaGEN Consortial Project 1.

label: Korean Children-Adolescents Study
other synonyms: Korean Child-Adolescent Cohort Study|Korean Childhood|Korean Children-Adolescents Cohort Study
definition: An open prospective cohort of Korean children, conducted by the Korea National Institute of Health, that enrolled children on entry to elementary school at age 7 (from 2005, at four elementary schools in Gwacheon) or in the fourth grade at age 10 in Seoul and Gyeonggi Province, and followed them annually from 2005 to 2020 to identify early risk factors for obesity and associated metabolic diseases; genotyped subsets were used in genome-wide association studies of childhood obesity and of liver enzyme levels.
diseases: population study of: metabolic disease (MONDO:0005066)|population study of: obesity disorder (MONDO:0011122)

label: Kuwait Obesity and Diabetes Genetics Programme
other synonyms: Kuwait Obesity Diabetes Genetic Program
definition: A genetics programme on obesity and diabetes in Kuwait, supported by the Kuwait Foundation for the Advancement of Sciences, whose participants' genome-wide genotype and body mass index data were contributed to multi-ancestry genome-wide association meta-analyses of body mass index and height.

label: Korean Epithelial Ovarian Cancer Study
other synonyms: Korean epithelial ovarian cancer study
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of epithelial ovarian cancer and benign epithelial ovarian neoplasms in Korea, which enrolled women with incident, histologically confirmed epithelial ovarian tumours at major general hospitals in Seoul and Gyeonggi-do, and as controls women without ovarian cancer undergoing health screening at general hospitals, collecting standardized interview questionnaires and biological specimens and following up the cases, to study the epidemiological and molecular risk factors and natural history of epithelial ovarian cancer in Koreans.
diseases: patients with: ovarian benign neoplasm (MONDO:0000646)|patients with: ovarian carcinoma (MONDO:0005140)

label: Korean Hereditary Breast Cancer Study
other synonyms: KOHBRA Study|Korean Hereditary Breast Cancer study
definition: A prospective, nationwide study of hereditary breast and ovarian cancer in Korea, established in May 2007, that enrols, at many hospitals across the country, breast cancer patients at high risk of carrying a BRCA1/2 mutation (those with a family history of breast or ovarian cancer, or diagnosed at 40 or younger, with bilateral breast cancer or another BRCA-related primary cancer, or male) and family members of BRCA1/2 mutation carriers, all of whom receive genetic counselling and BRCA testing. Its first phase (2007–2010) estimated the prevalence of BRCA1/2 mutations, and its second (2010–2013) studied the clinical characteristics, prognosis and environmental and genetic modifiers of BRCA-related breast cancer.
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)

label: Cooperative Health Research in the Region of Augsburg F3
definition: The ten-year follow-up examination of the KORA S3 survey, conducted in 2004/05, which re-examined participants of the 1994/95 S3 survey, a population-based random sample of residents aged 25–74 of the city of Augsburg and surrounding counties in southern Germany, within the KORA research platform.

label: Cooperative Health Research in the Region of Augsburg F4
definition: The follow-up examination of the KORA S4 survey, conducted in 2006–2008, which re-examined participants of the 1999–2001 S4 survey, a population-based sample of residents aged 25–74 of the city of Augsburg and two adjacent counties in southern Germany, within the KORA research platform; its participants were examined again seven years later in the FF4 follow-up.

label: Korean Osteoporosis Study at Asan Medical Center
other synonyms: Korean osteoporosis study at Asan Medical Center|Korean osteoporosis study in Asan Medical Center
definition: A hospital-registered, clinic-based, cross-sectional study of postmenopausal Korean women at Asan Medical Center in Seoul, South Korea, with fractures ascertained by self-report and radiographs, used in genetic studies of osteoporotic fracture.

label: Cooperative Health Research in the Region of Augsburg S3
other synonyms: third MONICA survey
definition: The third population-based survey of the Augsburg MONICA project, conducted in 1994/95 and continued within the KORA research platform, which examined a random sample of residents aged 25–74 of the city of Augsburg and surrounding counties in southern Germany; its participants were re-examined ten years later in the KORA F3 follow-up (2004/05).

label: Cooperative Health Research in the Region of Augsburg S4
other synonyms: KORA-Survey 2000
definition: A population-based survey of the KORA research platform (the KORA-Survey 2000), conducted from October 1999 to July 2001, which examined residents of German nationality aged 25–74 living in the city of Augsburg and two adjacent counties in southern Germany, identified through the population registration office; its participants were re-examined in the KORA F4 follow-up (2006–2008).

label: Seoul Colorectal Cancer Study
other synonyms: Korea-Seoul Colorectal Cancer Study|Seoul CRC Study|Seoul Study|The Seoul CRC Study
definition: A multicentre hospital-based case-control study of colorectal cancer in South Korea, whose cases were colorectal cancer patients admitted to two university hospitals and one general cancer hospital in the Seoul Metropolitan Area between 1995 and 2004, and whose controls were inpatients with non-neoplastic conditions at the same hospitals in the same period; it contributes to the genetic studies of the Asia Colorectal Cancer Consortium.

label: Kangbuk Samsung Cohort Study
definition: A prospective cohort study of Korean adults attending health screening examinations at Kangbuk Samsung Hospital, South Korea, set up to study the natural history, prognosis and genetic and environmental determinants of a wide range of health traits and diseases, whose participants have consented since 2011 to linkage with national registries of death, cancer and medical use, and some of whom have been genotyped. It is distinct from the hospital's retrospective Kangbuk Samsung Health Study of routinely collected screening data.

label: Kursk State Medical University Study
other synonyms: Kursk State Medical University (KSMU) Study
definition: A case-control study of asthma in adults of Russian origin from Central Russia, run by Kursk State Medical University, whose patients with asthma were recruited at the Department of Pulmonology of Kursk Regional Clinical Hospital in 2003–2004 and compared with controls matched for age and sex; further adult patients with asthma and healthy subjects from the same population were recruited in 2007–2008 for genome-wide association studies of asthma.

label: Leiden 85-plus Study
other synonyms: Leiden 85-Plus Study|Leiden 85-plus study
definition: A population-based prospective cohort study of the oldest old in the city of Leiden, the Netherlands, which enrolled all inhabitants who turned 85 between September 1997 and September 1999 in the month of their 85th birthday and examined them with interviews and clinical examinations at baseline and yearly for five years, to study health, functioning and well-being in very old age; an earlier survey under the same name studied the prevalence of morbidity in the whole population of Leiden aged 85 and over, living independently or in institutions.

label: Los Angeles County Asian-American Breast Cancer Case-Control Study
other synonyms: Los Angeles County Asian–American Breast Cancer case–control study
definition: A population-based case-control study of incident breast cancer among Asian American women in Los Angeles County, California, whose cases, ascertained through the Los Angeles Cancer Surveillance Program, are Chinese, Japanese or Filipino women aged 25–74 with histologically confirmed primary breast cancer diagnosed between 1996 and 2006, and whose controls were recruited from the neighbourhoods where the cases lived, frequency-matched on specific Asian ethnicity and five-year age group.

label: Los Angeles Study of Aggressive Prostate Cancer
other synonyms: Los Angeles Aggressive Prostate Cancer Study|University of Southern California – Los Angeles Prostate Cancer Study
definition: A population-based case-control study of aggressive prostate cancer in Los Angeles County, California, run from the University of Southern California, whose cases were identified through the Los Angeles County Cancer Surveillance Program and whose controls, men without prostate cancer frequency-matched to cases on age, were identified by a neighbourhood walk algorithm, with some controls drawn from the Multiethnic Cohort; it includes men of European, Latino and African ancestry.

label: Los Angeles County Case-Control Studies of Ovarian Cancer
other synonyms: Los Angeles County Case-Control Study of Ovarian Cancer
definition: Population-based case-control studies of ovarian cancer among women resident in Los Angeles County, California, United States, run at the Keck School of Medicine of the University of Southern California, in which cases with newly diagnosed ovarian cancer were identified through the county's SEER cancer registry (the Cancer Surveillance Program) and controls were recruited from the cases' neighbourhoods and matched on race/ethnicity and age; the studies take part in the Ovarian Cancer Association Consortium under the code USC.

label: Latvian Diabetic Nephropathy Study
other synonyms: LatDiane study|Latvian diabetic nephropathy study
definition: A longitudinal study, started in 2013, of adults in Latvia with type 1 diabetes diagnosed before the age of 40, with insulin treatment started within one year of diagnosis and C-peptide below 0.3 nmol/L, excluding those with chronic kidney disease other than diabetic kidney disease, who are examined, give blood and urine samples and answer questionnaires at baseline and at follow-up visits every three years, to study diabetic kidney disease and the other complications of diabetes. It is part of the InterDiane consortium.
diseases: patients with: diabetic kidney disease (MONDO:0005016)|patients with: type 1 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005147)

label: Leeds Bladder Cancer Study
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of bladder cancer in Leeds, England, whose cases were patients of the urology department of St James's University Hospital and whose controls came from the hospital's otolaryngology and ophthalmology departments, recruited from August 2002 to March 2006. It takes part in the International Consortium of Bladder Cancer.

label: Lung Cancer Cohort Consortium
other synonyms: Lung Cancer Consortium
definition: An international consortium of prospective cohort studies in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia, established in 2010 within the US National Cancer Institute Cohort Consortium, that pools harmonized risk-factor and lung cancer outcome data on the cohorts' participants, and prediagnostic blood samples of lung cancer cases and matched controls for biomarker studies, for research on lung cancer aetiology, risk prediction and early detection.

label: Kentucky Lung Cancer Research Initiative
other synonyms: LCRI DoD Lung Cancer Study
definition: A population-based case-control study of lung cancer in southeastern, Appalachian Kentucky, United States, run by the Markey Cancer Center and the University of Kentucky with Department of Defense funding, which from January 2012 to September 2014 recruited newly diagnosed cases through the Kentucky Cancer Registry and controls from the same region by random-digit dialling, and collected blood, toenail, urine, water, soil and radon samples, residential GPS mapping and an epidemiologic, occupational and health-history questionnaire, to study the region's very high lung cancer rates.

label: Lung Cancer Study from Estonia
other synonyms: lung cancer GWAS from Estonia|lung cancer study from Estonia
definition: A hospital-based case–control study of lung cancer in Estonia, whose cases were lung cancer patients enrolled in Estonian hospitals between 2002 and 2006 and whose controls were randomly selected from the population-based cohort of the Estonian Genome Project; genotyped genome-wide with support from the University of Tartu, it was one of the five case–control studies of the IARC lung cancer genome-wide association study and was pooled in the lung cancer meta-analyses of the TRICL consortium.

label: Mayo-Perlegen Linked Efforts to Accelerate Parkinson's Solutions Collaboration
other synonyms: Mayo-Perlegen LEAPS (Linked Efforts to Accelerate Parkinson's Solutions) Collaboration|Mayo-Perlegen Linked Efforts to Accelerate Parkinson's Solutions|Mayo-Perlegen Linked Efforts to Accelerate Parkinsons Solutions
definition: A two-tiered case-control study of Parkinson disease at the Mayo Clinic, Rochester, Minnesota, genotyped genome-wide on a Perlegen platform, whose cases were enrolled prospectively from the clinical practice of the Mayo Clinic's Department of Neurology from June 1996 to May 2004 among residents of Minnesota and the four surrounding states and assessed by a movement-disorders neurologist, and whose controls were unaffected siblings of cases (tier 1) or unrelated population controls matched on sex and age (tier 2), all screened for parkinsonism.

label: Leuven Endometrial Cancer Study
other synonyms: Leuven Endometrial Study|Leuven Endometrium Study
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of endometrial cancer at the Leuven University Hospital in Belgium, whose cases were white women aged 27–80 diagnosed with endometrial cancer, identified by active surveillance of the hospital's electronic patient files, with clinical data recorded at interview at diagnosis and from pathology reports. In genetic analyses its cases were compared with controls from blood donors of the Leuven Multidisciplinary Breast Centre study, and they were genotyped in the genome-wide association studies of the Endometrial Cancer Association Consortium.

label: Lung Health Study
other synonyms: US Lung Health Study
definition: A randomized clinical trial run at ten clinical centres in the United States and Canada, which between 1986 and 1989 enrolled smokers aged 35-59 with mild-to-moderate airway obstruction and randomized them to a smoking-cessation intervention (with an inhaled bronchodilator or a placebo inhaler) or usual care, to determine whether smoking cessation and bronchodilator treatment reduce the rate of decline of lung function, with long-term follow-up of respiratory symptoms and mortality.
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to Cigarette Smoking (ECTO:6000038)

label: Long Island Breast Cancer Study Project
definition: A federally mandated, population-based case-control study of breast cancer among women living in Nassau and Suffolk counties on Long Island, New York, United States, whose cases were newly diagnosed with a first primary in situ or invasive breast cancer between August 1996 and July 1997; cases and controls were interviewed and gave blood and urine, and long-term residents gave household dust, soil and water samples, to determine whether breast cancer risk is associated with environmental exposures, and the cases were later followed up to study prognosis.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to DDT (ECTO:9000281)|designed to study: exposure to organochlorine compound (ECTO:0001152)|designed to study: exposure to polychlorobiphenyl (ECTO:9000068)|designed to study: exposure to polycyclic arene (ECTO:9000433)

label: LIFE Child Study
other synonyms: LIFE Child|LIFE Child study|Leipzig Research Centre for Civilization Diseases (LIFE) Child Study
definition: A population-based prospective longitudinal cohort study of children and adolescents in the city of Leipzig, Germany, run since July 2011 by the Leipzig Research Centre for Civilization Diseases (LIFE) at Leipzig University, made up of a birth cohort recruited in pregnancy, a health cohort and an obesity cohort, whose participants have repeated medical, psychological and sociodemographic assessments and give biological samples from fetal life to adulthood, to monitor normal growth, development and health and to study non-communicable diseases such as childhood obesity, atopy and mental health problems.

label: LifeGen Consortium
other synonyms: LifeGen consortium
definition: A consortium of population studies, mainly from Europe, Australia and North America and of European or African ancestry, that ran a common protocol relating their genotyped participants' genomes to the survival of those participants' parents, and meta-analysed the results with UK Biobank in a genome-wide association study of human longevity.

label: Linz Peripheral Arterial Disease Study
other synonyms: Linz Peripheral Arterial Disease (LIPAD) Study|Linz Peripheral Arterial Disease study
definition: A prospectively designed hospital-based case-control and follow-up study of lower extremity peripheral arterial disease in Linz, Austria, which enrolled consecutively, from April 2000 to April 2002, all patients with symptomatic chronic atherosclerotic peripheral arterial disease admitted to the Konventhospital Barmherzige Brueder Linz, and from 2001 to 2004 controls without atherosclerotic disease admitted to the same hospital for minor health problems, matched by age, sex and diabetes status, to evaluate biomarkers and genetic variants for peripheral arterial disease and the long-term outcome of the patients through the Austrian Mortality Registry.

label: Lithuanian Diabetic Nephropathy Study
definition: A study of people with type 1 diabetes at the Lithuanian University of Health Sciences in Kaunas, Lithuania, run with the Finnish Diabetic Nephropathy Study group as the Lithuanian part of the InterDiane project, to identify clinical, genetic and environmental risk factors for the late complications of type 1 diabetes, in particular genes related to diabetic nephropathy.
diseases: patients with: diabetic kidney disease (MONDO:0005016)|patients with: type 1 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005147)

label: Longitudinal Investigation of Thromboembolism Etiology
other synonyms: CHS Longitudinal Investigation of Thromboembolism Etiology Study|longitudinal investigation of thromboembolism etiology
definition: A prospective study of venous thromboembolism occurrence in the United States that pools two multi-center, longitudinal, population-based cohort studies of white and African American men and women, the Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities (ARIC) Study and the Cardiovascular Health Study (CHS).

label: Liver Biopsy Cohort
definition: A cross-sectional study of adults of European descent who underwent liver biopsy for suspected non-alcoholic steatohepatitis or for severe obesity, consecutively enrolled at the Metabolic Liver Diseases outpatient service and bariatric surgery centre of the Fondazione IRCCS Ca' Granda Ospedale Policlinico in Milan and at Palermo University Hospital, Italy, and in the Northern Savo Hospital District in Kuopio, Finland, excluding people with excess alcohol intake or other causes of liver disease, and used to study the genetics of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease.
diseases: at risk of: metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MONDO:0013209)

label: Lung Institute of Western Australia Asthma Genetic Cohort
other synonyms: LIWA cohort|Lung Institute of Western Australia
definition: A collection of adults of European ancestry with physician-diagnosed mild, moderate or severe asthma, recruited through the Lung Institute of Western Australia from specialty asthma clinics and hospital databases, together with non-asthmatic controls selected at random from the metropolitan telephone directory, assembled for studies of the genetics of asthma and its severity.

label: Liverpool Lung Project
other synonyms: Liverpool Lung Cancer Project|Liverpool lung cancer study
definition: A molecular epidemiological study of lung cancer in a defined area of Merseyside, England, with a high incidence of lung cancer, made up of a case-control study of newly diagnosed lung cancer cases matched 2:1 on age and sex, and a prospective cohort followed for ten years, to build a lung cancer risk model from epidemiological and molecular genetic risk factors and to find markers of preclinical carcinogenesis for early detection.
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)

label: Leukotriene Modifier Or Corticosteroid or Corticosteroid-Salmeterol Trial
other synonyms: Leukotriene Modifier Or Corticosteroid or Corticosteroid-Salmeterol trial|Leukotriene Modifier or Corticosteroid Salmeterol study|Leukotriene Modifier, or Corticosteroid Salmeterol study
definition: A randomised, double-blind trial of the American Lung Association Asthma Clinical Research Centers, run at centres in the United States from 2003 to 2006, in which people whose asthma was well controlled on twice-daily low-dose inhaled fluticasone were assigned to continue it or to switch to once-daily montelukast or once-daily fluticasone plus salmeterol for 16 weeks, to test whether treatment could be stepped down without loss of asthma control.

label: Effectiveness of Low Dose Theophylline as an Add-on Treatment in Asthma trial
other synonyms: Effectiveness of Low Dose Theophylline as Add On Therapy for the Treatment of Asthma|Effectiveness of Low Dose Theophylline as Add-On Therapy in the Treatment of Asthma|LoDo Trial
definition: A randomised, double-masked, placebo-controlled trial of the American Lung Association Asthma Clinical Research Centers in which people with poorly controlled asthma were assigned to add once-daily low-dose theophylline, montelukast or placebo to their existing medication and were followed for 24 weeks, to compare the rate of episodes of poor asthma control.

label: Learning on Genetics of Schizophrenia Spectrum
other synonyms: LOGOS cohort|LOGOS project|Learning On Genetics Of Schizophrenia Spectrum|Learning on Genetics of Schizophrenia|Learning on Genetics of Schizophrenia Spectrum study
definition: A Greek study of healthy young male army conscripts, randomly selected and recruited from June 2008 in waves at the Greek Army Training Camp in Heraklion, Crete, within their first two months of service and screened to exclude mental and physical illness, who were assessed on schizophrenia-related intermediate phenotypes (prepulse inhibition of the startle reflex, cognition, personality and schizotypal traits) and gave DNA, to study the genetics of the schizophrenia spectrum.

label: LonGenity study
other synonyms: LonGenity Study|LonGenity cohort|Longenity study
definition: A longitudinal cohort study at the Institute for Aging Research of the Albert Einstein College of Medicine in the Bronx, New York, which from 2008 enrolled Ashkenazi Jewish adults aged 65 or older from the New York City area without significant cognitive, visual or hearing impairment, comparing offspring of parents with exceptional longevity (at least one parent surviving to 95) with offspring of parents with usual survival, and follows them until death with biomarkers, genotyping, proteomics and cognitive and frailty assessments to study healthy ageing.

label: Action for Health in Diabetes
definition: A randomised clinical trial at 16 centres in the United States that assigned overweight or obese people aged 45 to 76 with type 2 diabetes to an intensive lifestyle intervention for weight loss, through reduced caloric intake and increased physical activity, or to diabetes support and education, with major cardiovascular events as the primary outcome; after the intervention ended, follow-up of the cohort continued as a study of ageing-related outcomes.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to Physical Activity (ECTO:6000039)|designed to study: exposure to calorie restrictive diet intake (ECTO:2000065)

label: LOOP study
other synonyms: Atrial Fibrillation Detected by Continuous ECG Monitoring Using Implantable Loop Recorder to Prevent Stroke in High-Risk Individuals
definition: A Danish randomised clinical trial, Atrial Fibrillation Detected by Continuous ECG Monitoring Using Implantable Loop Recorder to Prevent Stroke in High-Risk Individuals, which randomised 6,004 individuals aged 70 years or older without atrial fibrillation but with risk factors for atrial fibrillation and stroke to screening with an implantable loop recorder, with anticoagulation upon detection of atrial fibrillation, or usual care; its participants’ genetic data are used to evaluate polygenic scores for atrial fibrillation.
diseases: at risk of: atrial fibrillation (MONDO:0004981)|at risk of: stroke disorder (MONDO:0005098)

label: Leukaemia Research Fund CLL4 trial
other synonyms: Leukaemia Research CLL-4 trial|UK Leukemia Research Fund CLL4 trial
definition: The patients of the Leukaemia Research Fund CLL4 trial, a UK randomised phase III trial that between 1999 and 2004 assigned previously untreated patients with chronic lymphocytic leukaemia requiring treatment (Binet stage progressive A, B or C) to first-line chlorambucil, fludarabine, or fludarabine plus cyclophosphamide. Markers measured at trial entry were used to study prognosis, and blood samples from a subset of its patients were genotyped for the UK genome-wide association studies of chronic lymphocytic leukaemia and for studies of germline variants and patient outcome.
diseases: patients with: B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia (MONDO:0004948)

label: Lovelace Smokers Cohort
other synonyms: Lovelace Smokers cohort|Lovelace Smokers' Cohort|Lovelace smokers cohort
definition: A community-based volunteer cohort of current and former smokers aged 40 to 75 from the greater Albuquerque area of New Mexico, established in 2001 at the Lovelace Respiratory Research Institute to study sputum and blood biomarkers for lung cancer risk and the development of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, with repeated spirometry and questionnaires and follow-up for lung cancer incidence and death.
diseases: at risk of: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (MONDO:0005002)|at risk of: lung cancer (MONDO:0008903)
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to smoking (ECTO:6000013)

label: Lung Cancer in the Young study
other synonyms: LUCY-study|LUng Cancer in the Young|LUng Cancer in the Young study
definition: A German multicentre study of lung cancer diagnosed at the age of 50 or younger, run by the Institute of Epidemiology of the Helmholtz Zentrum München and the Department of Genetic Epidemiology of the University of Göttingen with 31 recruiting clinics across Germany from 2000, which collected a nationwide family sample (young patients with their parents, siblings, children and spouses) and a case–control sample with population controls from the KORA surveys, with epidemiological data on medical history, education, occupation, family history of cancer and smoking, and blood samples from which DNA and lymphoblastoid cell lines were prepared.

label: Lutherstadt Wittenberg Bladder Cancer Study
other synonyms: Lutherstadt Wittenberg bladder cancer study|The Lutherstadt Wittenberg study
definition: A hospital-based case–control study of bladder cancer in Lutherstadt Wittenberg, Germany, whose cases were patients with confirmed bladder cancer enrolled at the Department of Urology of the Paul Gerhardt Foundation from 1995 to 1999 and whose controls were patients of the same department admitted for benign urological diseases and enrolled from 2000 to 2005; occupational history, exposure to occupational bladder carcinogens, smoking and family history of bladder cancer were documented for cases and controls.

label: Macedonian Breast Cancer Study
definition: A case-control study of breast cancer in North Macedonia, run by the Research Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology "Georgi D. Efremov" of the Macedonian Academy of Sciences and Arts in Skopje with patients from the University Clinic of Radiotherapy and Oncology and the Acibadem-Sistina and Re-Medika hospitals, that contributes to the Breast Cancer Association Consortium.

label: MACBRCA
other synonyms: The Ohio State University Comprehensive Cancer Centre
definition: A study of carriers of pathogenic BRCA1 or BRCA2 variants in North Macedonia, run by the Research Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology "Georgi D. Efremov" of the Macedonian Academy of Sciences and Arts with the University Clinic of Radiotherapy and Oncology, Adzibadem-Sistina Hospital and Re-Medika Hospital, which contributes carriers to the Consortium of Investigators of Modifiers of BRCA1/2 (CIMBA).
diseases: at risk of: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|at risk of: ovarian cancer (MONDO:0008170)

label: Multicenter Asthma Genetics in Childhood Study
other synonyms: Multicentre Asthma Genetics in Childhood Study|followMAGICS
definition: An observational study of children with physician-diagnosed asthma recruited from secondary and tertiary care centres in Germany and Austria for the genetics of childhood asthma, whose cases have been compared in genome-wide association studies with controls from the German arm of the International Study of Asthma and Allergies in Childhood Phase II, and whose participants were re-examined as adolescents and young adults in a follow-up stage, followMAGICS.

label: Malignant Ovarian Cancer Study
other synonyms: Danish MALOVA ovarian cancer study|Danish MALOVA study|Danish Malignant Ovarian Cancer Study|Danish Malignant Ovarian Tumor Study|MALOVA Ovarian Cancer Case-Control Study|MALignant OVArian cancer study
definition: A Danish population-based case-control study of the Danish Cancer Society, in which women aged 35 to 79 diagnosed in 1994 to 1999 with ovarian cancer or a borderline ovarian tumour in the municipalities of Copenhagen and Frederiksberg and the surrounding counties, and controls drawn at random from the female population of the same area through the Central Population Register, gave questionnaire data, blood and tumour tissue, to identify risk factors and prognostic factors for ovarian cancer.
diseases: patients with: borderline epithelial tumor of ovary (MONDO:0016093)|patients with: ovarian cancer (MONDO:0008170)

label: Sydney Memory and Ageing Study
other synonyms: Sydney MAS
definition: A longitudinal cohort of non-demented, community-dwelling people aged 70 to 90, recruited by random approach from the electoral roll in two areas of Sydney, Australia, and begun in 2005 to examine the clinical characteristics and prevalence of mild cognitive impairment and related syndromes and the rate of change in cognitive function over time, with annual telephone reviews and periodic detailed neuropsychiatric and medical assessments.

label: Mid-Atlantic Twin Registry
other synonyms: Mid Atlantic Twin Registry|Mid-Atlantic Twin Registry of Virginia Commonwealth University
definition: A population-based registry of twins and their families, primarily born or living in Virginia, North Carolina and South Carolina and ascertained mainly from birth records (and formerly school records), formed in 1997 by merging the Virginia Twin Registry (established around 1975) with the North Carolina Twin Registry, with South Carolina added in 1998; based at Virginia Commonwealth University, it recruits its twins into research studies, collects data and DNA, and keeps a DNA repository.

label: Mauritius study
other synonyms: Mauritius Study
definition: A type 2 diabetes case-control sample of adults of self-reported South Asian ancestry in Mauritius, drawn from a population-based survey of people aged 20 years and older undertaken in 1998, one of the national surveys of 1987, 1992 and 1998 that included a 2-hour 75-g oral glucose tolerance test.

label: Mayo lung cancer GWAS
other synonyms: Mayo genome-wide association study
definition: A case-control sample of lung cancer patients who had never smoked, identified and recruited at Mayo Clinic, Rochester, Minnesota, between 1997 and 2008, and never-smoking community residents matched to them by age, sex and ethnic background, genotyped for a genome-wide association study of lung cancer in never smokers.

label: Mayo Clinic-MD Anderson-Memorial Sloan Kettering Pharmacogenomics Research Network Breast Cancer Aromatase Inhibitor Pharmacogenomics Study
other synonyms: M3 study|Mayo Pharmacogenetics Research Network Aromatase Inhibitor AI Study|Mayo-MDA-MSK PGRN AI pharmacogenomic trial|PGRN Aromatase Inhibitor Pharmacogenomics Trial
definition: A study of postmenopausal women with resected early-stage oestrogen receptor-positive breast cancer, recruited at Mayo Clinic, MD Anderson Cancer Center and Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center under the NIGMS-funded Pharmacogenomics Research Network, who were treated with adjuvant anastrozole 1 mg daily and had blood drawn before and during therapy for DNA and for plasma drug and hormone measurements, set up to study genetic variation in response to aromatase inhibitors.
diseases: patients with: estrogen-receptor positive breast cancer (MONDO:0006512)

label: Milan Breast Cancer Study Group
definition: A case-control study of breast cancer in Milan, Italy, whose cases are patients with familial or early-onset breast cancer who test negative for BRCA1 and BRCA2 mutations, ascertained from 2000 at two large cancer centres in Milan, and whose controls are female blood donors recruited at two Milan centres from 2004 and 2007; it is one of the studies of the Breast Cancer Association Consortium.

label: Muenster Cervical Artery Dissection Collection
other synonyms: Muenster cervical artery dissection collection
definition: A collection of patients with cervical artery dissection at the University of Münster, Germany, one of the centres collaborating with the CADISP consortium that recruited patients of European origin, applying the inclusion criteria of the CADISP study, for the second sample (CADISP-2) of the 2015 genome-wide association study of cervical artery dissection.

label: Mexico City Childhood Asthma Study
other synonyms: Mexico Childhood Asthma Study
definition: A case–parent trio study of childhood asthma in Mexico City, supported by the Intramural Research Program of the US National Institute of Environmental Health Sciences, which recruited children aged 5 to 17 with asthma, diagnosed by a paediatric allergist from clinical symptoms and response to treatment, together with their biological parents, between June 1998 and November 2003 at the paediatric allergy clinic of the Hospital Infantil de México Federico Gómez, a large public hospital in central Mexico City; parents completed questionnaires on the children's asthma symptoms and risk factors, including environmental tobacco smoke, the children had skin prick tests and lung function tests, and blood was taken from children and parents for DNA, from which the trios were genotyped genome-wide.

label: Mind Clinical Imaging Consortium
other synonyms: MCIC collection|MIND Clinical Imaging Consortium|Mind Clinical Imaging Consortium study of schizophrenia
definition: A cross-sectional study of schizophrenia conducted by the Mental Illness and Neuroscience Discovery Institute (now the Mind Research Network) at the University of New Mexico, the University of Minnesota, Massachusetts General Hospital and the University of Iowa, which collected clinical, cognitive, structural, functional and diffusion MRI and genetic data under a common protocol from people with schizophrenia, recruited where possible early in their illness, and sex- and age-matched controls, to identify neuroimaging biomarkers of schizophrenia.

label: Prostate Cancer Case-Control Studies at MD Anderson
definition: Epidemiological case-control studies of prostate cancer conducted since 1996 by the University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center in the Houston metropolitan area, whose cases, not restricted by Gleason score, stage or PSA, were accrued from institutions of the Houston Medical Center and whose controls were identified by random-digit dialling or among hospital visitors and frequency-matched to cases on age and race, with lifestyle, demographic and family-history data collected by a standardised questionnaire.

label: MD Anderson lymphoma case-control study
other synonyms: MD Anderson lymphoma case control study
definition: A case-control study of lymphoma in Texas, USA, whose cases came from the MD Anderson Cancer Center and whose controls came from the Kelsey Seybold Clinics, and which contributed cases and controls to the replication stages of genome-wide association studies of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (2014), marginal zone lymphoma (2015) and chronic lymphocytic leukemia (2016).

label: MD Anderson Ovarian Cancer Study
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of ovarian cancer in Texas, USA, that takes part in the Ovarian Cancer Association Consortium under the study code MDA and whose cases and controls were genotyped for the consortium's genome-wide association studies of epithelial ovarian cancer.

label: MD Anderson Renal Cell Cancer Study
other synonyms: MD Anderson RCC Study
definition: A population-based case-control study of renal cell carcinoma run from the University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center in Houston since 2002, whose cases are Texas residents with newly diagnosed, histologically confirmed renal cell carcinoma identified from the appointment schedules of MD Anderson's urology and genitourinary oncology departments, and whose controls are cancer-free Texas residents found by random-digit dialling and frequency-matched to cases by age, sex, ethnicity and county of residence, with an in-person interview and a blood sample from each participant.

label: MDD2000+ study
other synonyms: MDD2000 Study|MDD2000+ project|MDD2000+ sample
definition: A genome-wide association study of major depressive disorder that combined unrelated cases and screened controls from several sources genotyped on different platforms: Australian twins and their families recruited through the Australian Twin Registry by the Queensland Institute of Medical Research, the Netherlands Study of Depression and Anxiety, the Netherlands Twin Registry, patients of psychiatric hospitals in Scotland recruited by the University of Edinburgh, and controls from the Molecular Genetics of Schizophrenia study in the United States.

label: Mayo Endometrial Cancer Study
other synonyms: Mayo Clinic Endometrial Cancer Study
definition: A clinic-based series of women with endometrial cancer at Mayo Clinic in the United States, whose cases were contributed to the genome-wide association studies of the Endometrial Cancer Association Consortium (ECAC).

label: MedGenome case-control study
other synonyms: MedGenome CAD case-control study|MedGenome study
definition: A case-control study of coronary artery disease conducted by MedGenome in India, whose cases and controls were recruited from outpatient clinics and hospitals in five Indian cities (Kochi, Jaipur, Coimbatore, Chennai and Bangalore) and genotyped to test a framework for assessing a genome-wide polygenic score for coronary artery disease in South Asians.

label: MEta-analysis of type 2 DIabetes in African Americans Consortium
other synonyms: MEta-analysis of type 2 DIabetes in African Americans consortium
definition: A consortium of studies with African American participants that meta-analyses genome-wide association studies of type 2 diabetes in African Americans to investigate the genetic architecture of the disease in this population; its parent studies include ARIC, CARDIA, CFS, CHS, eMERGE, FamHS, FIND, GeneSTAR, GENOA, HANDLS, Health ABC, HUFS, IPM Biobank, IRAS, IRASFS, JHS, MESA, MESA Family, SCCS, SIGNET-REGARDS, WFSM and WHI.

label: Melbourne Epidemiological Study of Childhood Asthma
other synonyms: Melbourne Asthma Study
definition: A population-based prospective study of childhood asthma, also known as the Melbourne Asthma Study, initiated in 1964 by Howard Williams of the Royal Children’s Hospital, Melbourne, Australia, which recruited four asthma or wheeze groups and a control group of children aged 7 and has followed them into their seventh decade, providing the first prospective evidence linking childhood asthma to the development of COPD; its participants contributed to the Australian Asthma Genetics Consortium’s genome-wide association study.

label: Metabolic Syndrome Berlin Potsdam Study
other synonyms: Metabolic Syndrome Berlin Potsdam study|Metabolic Syndrome Berlin-Potsdam|Metabolisches Syndrom Berlin Potsdam
definition: A cross-sectional study of the metabolic syndrome in Germany whose participants, randomly recruited from Berlin, Potsdam and their surroundings, underwent a 75 g oral glucose tolerance test with insulin measurements and nutritional assessment, and included people with normal glucose metabolism as well as people with impaired glucose metabolism or type 2 diabetes; part of it was later re-examined in a follow-up study.
diseases: population study of: metabolic syndrome X (MONDO:0011565)|population study of: type 2 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005148)

label: Metformin Response cohort
definition: A cohort of patients of Kaiser Permanente Northern California, United States, established with funding from GlaxoSmithKline in collaboration with the University of California San Francisco and Kaiser Permanente Northern California for a genome-wide association study of extreme responders to metformin: patients who met the study criteria were invited, gave blood samples for genotyping, and had their drug response taken from the electronic health record. Its participants with type 2 diabetes who had a sulfonylurea added to initial metformin therapy formed one of the data sets of the MetGen Plus and DIRECT genome-wide meta-analysis of glycaemic response to sulfonylureas.

label: Metabolic Syndrome Cohort
other synonyms: Mexican Metabolic Syndrome cohort|metabolic syndrome cohort
definition: A prospective observational cohort of apparently healthy adults aged 20 or over whose parents and grandparents were born in Mexico, recruited from 2007 to 2011 at workplaces, homes and medical units in urban centres of central Mexico (Mexico City, Aguascalientes, León, Toluca and Cuernavaca) and re-examined about three years later, to study the incidence of type 2 diabetes, hypertension and cardiovascular disease; its samples are processed centrally at the Instituto Nacional de Ciencias Médicas y Nutrición in Mexico City.
diseases: population study of: cardiovascular disorder (MONDO:0004995)|population study of: hypertensive disorder (MONDO:0005044)|population study of: type 2 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005148)

label: Mexican ancestry in Los Angeles, California
other synonyms: Mexican ancestry in Los Angeles, California, USA
definition: A collection of DNA samples from people of Mexican ancestry in Los Angeles, California, one of the seven population samples added in phase 3 of the International HapMap Project and used as a reference for human genetic variation.

label: Minority GWAS African American study
definition: A genome-wide association study of colorectal cancer in African Americans, part of a 'Minority GWAS' effort alongside a Japanese study, that pooled African American cases and controls identified from the Multiethnic Cohort, the Colorectal Cancer Family Registry, the Southern Community Cohort Study, the MD Anderson Cancer Center, the University of North Carolina CanCORS and Rectal Cancer studies and the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal and Ovarian Cancer Screening Trial.

label: Myaesthenia Gravis GWAS
other synonyms: Myasthenia Gravis GWAS
definition: A set of healthy Norwegian controls, recruited through the Norwegian Bone Marrow Donor Registry of the Institute of Immunology, Oslo University Hospital, whose genome-wide genotypes were generated on the Illumina 550 chip by the Myasthenia Gravis Genetic Consortium and shared as external control data for genome-wide association studies.

label: MGH Cardiology and Metabolic Patient Cohort
other synonyms: Cardiology and Metabolic Patient Cohort study at Massachusetts General Hospital|Cardiovascular and Metabolic Patient cohort|MGH Cardiology and Metabolic Patient cohort|Massachusetts General Hospital Cardiology and Metabolic Patient cohort
definition: A cohort of outpatients at Massachusetts General Hospital with recorded demographic data, medical and medication history and a resting electrocardiogram, many of whom also underwent an oral glucose tolerance test, genotyped genome-wide for genetic studies of cardiometabolic traits such as the QT interval, insulin secretion and body mass index.

label: Massachusetts General Hospital Stroke Study
other synonyms: MGH Stroke Study
definition: The stroke genetics studies of Massachusetts General Hospital in Boston, United States, analysed together under this name: the Genetics of Cerebral Hemorrhage on Anticoagulation (GOCHA) study of people over 55 with acute primary haemorrhagic stroke and controls from ambulatory clinics, and the Genes Affecting Stroke Risk and Outcome Study (GASROS), a single-centre prospective cohort of adults with acute ischaemic stroke who presented to the hospital from 2003 to 2011, with controls matched on age, sex and race or ethnicity.
diseases: patients with: intracerebral hemorrhage (MONDO:0013792)|patients with: ischemic stroke (MONDO:1060198)

label: Minority GWAS Japanese study
definition: A genome-wide association study of colorectal cancer in people of Japanese ancestry that pooled cases and controls from the Multiethnic Cohort Study, the Colorectal Cancer Family Registry, the Japan Public Health Center-based Prospective Study and case-control studies in Hawaii and in Fukuoka and Nagano, Japan, first analysed in a trans-ethnic meta-analysis with a parallel African American study.

label: Midspan Family Study
other synonyms: MIDSPAN Family Study|MIDSPAN family study|Midspan family study|Renfrew-Paisley (Midspan) family study
definition: A general population study of families in the towns of Renfrew and Paisley in the west of Scotland, in which the locally resident adult offspring, aged 30 to 59, of couples who had taken part in the Renfrew and Paisley general population survey of 1972 to 1976 were surveyed in 1996 by questionnaire, clinical examination, spirometry and blood samples and then followed up for cardiovascular disease and death, to study familial and intergenerational influences on cardiovascular and respiratory health.

label: Myocardial Infarction Genetics Consortium
other synonyms: MI Genetics Consortium Study
definition: An international consortium of myocardial infarction and coronary artery disease case-control studies, formed for a genome-wide association study of early-onset myocardial infarction (men aged 50 or younger, women 60 or younger) and age- and sex-matched controls from sites in Boston and Seattle in the United States, Sweden, Finland, Spain and Italy, and later extended with further case-control cohorts for exome and gene sequencing studies of coronary artery disease.

label: Microarray in Node-Negative and 1 to 3 Positive Lymph Node Disease May Avoid Chemotherapy
other synonyms: EORTC 10041/BIG 03-04|EORTC 10041/BIG 3-04|Microarray In Node-Negative and 1 to 3 Positive Lymph Node Disease May Avoid Chemotherapy Study|Microarray in Node-negative Disease May Avoid Chemotherapy
definition: A randomized phase III trial of the European Organisation for Research and Treatment of Cancer (EORTC 10041/BIG 3-04) that enrolled women aged 18–70 years with operable early-stage invasive breast cancer and up to three positive lymph nodes at institutions in nine European countries from 2007 to 2011, to test whether the 70-gene signature (MammaPrint), used with clinical-pathological criteria, can select patients for adjuvant chemotherapy.

label: Michigan, Mayo, AREDS, Pennsylvania Cohort Study
other synonyms: Age related Macular Degeneration (AMD)-- Michigan, Mayo, AREDS, Pennsylvania (MMAP) Cohort Study|MMAP Cohort|MMAP Cohort Study|Michigan, Mayo, Age-Related Eye Disease Study, Pennsylvania|Michigan/Mayo Clinic/AREDS/UPENN
definition: A case-control collection for a joint genome-wide association study of age-related macular degeneration, assembled by researchers from the University of Michigan, the Mayo Clinic, the University of Pennsylvania and the Age-Related Eye Disease Study group with National Eye Institute intramural investigators, who contributed patients with advanced macular degeneration (geographic atrophy, neovascularisation or large drusen) and examined unaffected controls enrolled from 1998 through ophthalmology clinics in Michigan, Pennsylvania, Minnesota and Texas and through the Age-Related Eye Disease Study, genotyped together at the Center for Inherited Disease Research.

label: Mayo Clinic Ovarian Cancer Case-Control Study
other synonyms: Mayo Clinic Ovarian Cancer Case Control Study|Mayo Clinic Ovarian Cancer Case–Control Study|Mayo Clinic Ovarian Cancer Study
definition: A clinic-based case-control study of ovarian cancer run at the Mayo Clinic in the United States, whose cases are women with ovarian cancer diagnosed from 2000 onwards who attended the Mayo Clinic from a six-state surrounding region, and whose controls are healthy women seeking a general medical examination at the Mayo Clinic, frequency-matched to cases on age and region of residence.

label: Modena HIV Surveillance Cohort
other synonyms: Modena Cohort
definition: An HIV surveillance cohort in Modena, Italy, which since 1985 has collected data on new cases of HIV infection in adults, and which contributed to the host genomics studies of the International Collaboration for the Genomics of HIV.

label: Modifier Study of Quantitative Effects on Disease
definition: A study of BRCA1 and BRCA2 mutation carriers in the Czech Republic, run by investigators at the Masaryk Memorial Cancer Institute in Brno and Charles University in Prague with United States collaborators, that contributes carriers' genotype and cancer data to the Consortium of Investigators of Modifiers of BRCA1 and BRCA2 (CIMBA) for studies of genetic modifiers of breast and ovarian cancer risk.
diseases: at risk of: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|at risk of: ovarian cancer (MONDO:0008170)

label: Moffitt Cancer Center Ovarian Cancer Study
definition: A case-control study of epithelial ovarian cancer at the H. Lee Moffitt Cancer Center in Tampa, Florida, United States, drawing on Moffitt's Total Cancer Care protocol, that contributes genotyped cases and controls to the Ovarian Cancer Association Consortium.

label: Moffitt Prostate Cancer Study
other synonyms: Moffitt group|The Moffitt Group
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of prostate cancer at the Moffitt Cancer Center in Florida, United States, whose cases are patients of Moffitt Cancer Center clinics and whose controls come from a Moffitt-affiliated lifetime cancer screening centre, contributing genotyped men to prostate cancer genetic studies of the OncoArray project.

label: Mammography, Oestrogens and Growth Factors study
other synonyms: Mammography Oestrogens and Growth Factors Study|Mammography Oestrogens and Growth Factors study|Mammography Oestrogens and Growth factors study|Mammography, Oestrogens and Growth factor study|Mammography, Oestrogens and Growth factors study
definition: An observational study of mammographic density nested within the intervention arm of the Age Trial, a British trial of annual mammographic screening in young women, which from 2000 to 2003 invited cancer-free women of the intervention arm who were still attending screening to give a blood sample and complete a questionnaire on demographic, anthropometric, lifestyle and reproductive characteristics, and enrolled women from 17 screening centres in England and Wales.

label: Molecular Markers in Treatment of Endometrial Cancer
other synonyms: MoMaTEC study|Molecular Markers for Treatment of Endometrial Cancer|Molecular Markers in Treatment in Endometrial Cancer
definition: A prospective multicentre study of women treated for endometrial cancer (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT00598845), centred on Haukeland University Hospital in Bergen, Norway, that between May 2001 and February 2013 enrolled consenting patients at ten hospitals in Norway, Belgium and Sweden within the European Network for Individualized Treatment of Endometrial Cancer (ENITEC), collecting preoperative curettage or biopsy specimens, tumour tissue, blood and clinical follow-up to study molecular markers of lymph node metastasis and prognosis for preoperative risk stratification.

label: Monitoring National du Risque Artériel
other synonyms: MONA LISA Study|MONA LISA survey|MOnitoring NAtionaL du rISque Artériel|Monitoring National du risque Art_rie|National Monitoring of Arterial Risk
definition: A population-based cross-sectional survey of cardiovascular risk factors in France, in which women and men aged 35 to 74 years were randomly selected from electoral rolls between 2005 and 2007 in three areas: the Lille urban community in northern France, the Bas-Rhin department in eastern France and the Haute-Garonne department in southwestern France.

label: Montreal/Boston Collection
other synonyms: MonBos Collection|Montreal Boston Collection|Montreal/Boston (MonBos) Collection
definition: A collection of families of children with autism spectrum disorder, recruited in the Montreal and Quebec City regions of Canada and by investigators of the Autism Consortium of Boston in Massachusetts and surrounding states of the United States, including the Extreme Discordant Sib-Pair family sample. Funded in part by the Autism Consortium of Boston, its parent-offspring trios have been genotyped for autism genome-wide association studies, including those of the Psychiatric Genomics Consortium.

label: Systematic Investigation of the Molecular Causes of Major Mood Disorders and Schizophrenia
other synonyms: MooDS Consortium|MooDS consortium
definition: A German research consortium, the Integrated Genome Research Network MooDS of the National Genome Research Network plus (NGFNplus), funded by the German Federal Ministry of Education and Research, whose groups collected and genotyped case-control samples for genome-wide association studies of schizophrenia in Germany and of bipolar disorder in Germany and in partner centres in Poland, Russia, Spain, Canada and Australia.
diseases: patients with: bipolar disorder (MONDO:0004985)|patients with: schizophrenia (MONDO:0005090)

label: Mechanisms of Progression of Atopic Dermatitis to Asthma in Children
other synonyms: Mechanisms of Progression from Atopic Dermatitis to Asthma in Children|Mechanisms of Progression of Atopic Dermatitis to Asthma in CHildren
definition: A prospective early-life cohort of children with atopic dermatitis at Cincinnati Children's Hospital Medical Center, United States, recruited from late 2016 in the greater Cincinnati area (southwest Ohio and northern Kentucky) through public advertising or medical records, which enrols infants and toddlers with atopic dermatitis (at first aged 1–2 years, later from a few months of age) and follows them for five years with annual visits and extensive biospecimen collection from skin, blood and saliva, to define atopic dermatitis phenotypes and endotypes, the mechanisms of its progression to food allergy, asthma and other allergic disorders, and biomarkers of asthma risk.

label: Max Planck Institute of Psychiatry Study
other synonyms: MPIP/MARS|Munich Morphometry Sample
definition: A case-control sample for major depressive disorder at the Max Planck Institute of Psychiatry in Munich, Germany, whose cases were patients admitted to the institute's hospital for treatment of major depressive disorder and diagnosed by psychiatrists according to DSM-IV criteria, and whose controls were drawn at random from Munich community registries and screened for the absence of any lifetime axis I disorder; it contributed genotypes to the major depressive disorder analyses of the Psychiatric Genomics Consortium.

label: Malmö Preventive Project atrial fibrillation study
other synonyms: MPP AF|Malmö Preventive Project atrial fibillation study
definition: A nested case-control study of atrial fibrillation within the Malmö Preventive Project in Malmö, Sweden, in which participants with prevalent or incident atrial fibrillation identified from national registers, with DNA from the project's 2002-2006 re-examination, were matched one to one to controls from the same cohort by sex, age and date of baseline examination.

label: Malmö Preventive Project echo study
other synonyms: MPP Echo|MPP-Echo|Malmö Preventive Project-Re-examination Study UCG|Malmö Preventive Project-Re-examination echocardiography study
definition: An echocardiography study within the 2002-2006 re-examination of the Malmö Preventive Project in Malmö, Sweden, in which a subsample of re-examined participants, randomly selected from groups defined by glucometabolic status with impaired fasting glucose and diabetes oversampled, underwent echocardiography.
diseases: patients with: diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005015)|patients with: type 2 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005148)

label: MRC Asthma and United Kingdom Control panel
other synonyms: Medical Research Council-funded Collection of Nuclear Families with Asthma
definition: A United Kingdom case-control panel for asthma genome-wide association studies, combining childhood-onset asthma cases from the MRCA panel of British nuclear families ascertained through a child with asthma with United Kingdom control subjects.

label: Mount Sinai Health System COVID-19 Genomics Initiative
definition: A COVID-19 host genetics case–control study of the Mount Sinai Health System, contributed to the COVID-19 Host Genetics Initiative, that compares participants with reported SARS-CoV-2 infection with controls, under the review of the Mount Sinai Program for the Protection of Human Subjects; its participants, of European, African and admixed American ancestry, were genotyped on the Global Diversity Array or the Global Screening Array.

label: Memorial Sloan Kettering Bladder Cancer Study
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of bladder cancer at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center in New York, United States, whose cases and controls have been genotyped in bladder cancer susceptibility studies.

label: Memorial Sloan Kettering Lung Cancer GWAS
other synonyms: Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSKCC) study
definition: A hospital-based lung cancer genome-wide association study at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, whose participants were all never smokers, pooled with other lung cancer genome-wide association studies in analyses of the Transdisciplinary Research in Cancer of the Lung (TRICL) team and the International Lung Cancer Consortium (ILCCO).

label: Ms. OS (Hong Kong)
other synonyms: Ms. OS Hong Kong|MsOS (Hong Kong)|Osteoporotic Fractures in Women Study
definition: The women's arm of the Mr. Osteoporosis and Ms. Osteoporosis Study in Hong Kong: a prospective cohort of community-dwelling Chinese women aged 65 years or older in Hong Kong, recruited in 2001–2003 in a sample stratified by age group, whose osteoporotic hip, spine and vertebral fractures have been followed up for about two decades, with other outcomes of ageing such as diet, cognition and mortality studied in the same cohort.
diseases: population study of: Skeletal muscle atrophy (HP:0003202)|population study of: osteoporosis (MONDO:0005298)

label: Mammography Screening Project
other synonyms: Mammography Screening Project in Vasterbotten|Northern Sweden Mammography Screening Project
definition: A cohort of women who attended mammography screening in Västerbotten, Sweden, between 1995 and 2006 and gave blood samples and brief questionnaire data on reproductive factors at the mammography centre, many at repeated screening visits; one of the three sub-cohorts of the Northern Sweden Health and Disease Study.

label: Mid-South Tobacco Family
other synonyms: Mid-South Tobacco Family cohort|Mid-South Tobacco Family sample
definition: A family-based genetic study of nicotine dependence in which African American and European American smoker probands (aged at least 21, smoking at least 20 cigarettes a day for the preceding year and for at least five years) were recruited in the Mid-South states of the United States, primarily Tennessee, Mississippi and Arkansas, in 1999–2004, together with their biological parents and full siblings, with nicotine dependence assessed by smoking quantity, the Heaviness of Smoking Index and the Fagerström Test for Nicotine Dependence, for linkage and association studies of nicotine dependence.
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to smoking (ECTO:6000013)

label: Montreal Gene-Environment Breast Cancer Study
definition: A population-based case-control study of breast cancer in Montreal, Canada, whose cases were postmenopausal women aged 47 to 75 years living in Montreal with a first primary invasive breast cancer, identified from 2007 to 2010 in 15 of the 16 Montreal hospitals that treat breast cancer, and whose controls were a random sample of women living in Montreal from the provincial voter registration list, frequency-matched to cases on age; a member study of the Breast Cancer Association Consortium.

label: Minnesota Twin Family Registry
other synonyms: Minnesota Twin Registry
definition: A birth-record-based registry of twins born in Minnesota, United States, identified from Minnesota State birth certificates and enrolled by mailed questionnaires together with their parents, spouses, siblings and children, covering twins born 1904–1934, 1936–1955 and 1961–1964 who were assessed in middle and older adulthood, with subsets later assessed in person, as one of the studies of the Minnesota Center for Twin and Family Research.

label: Munich-MI study
other synonyms: Munich Myocardial Infarction Registry|Myocardial Infarction Genetics Exome Sequencing Consortium: German Heart Center in Munich
definition: A case-control study of early-onset myocardial infarction recruited at the German Heart Center in Munich, Germany, with cases who had a myocardial infarction before age 41 (men) or 56 (women) and controls from German population studies without myocardial infarction or coronary artery disease over age 65 (men) or 75 (women), exome-sequenced in the Myocardial Infarction Genetics Exome Sequencing Consortium to find genetic contributors to early myocardial infarction.

label: Myopia Genomics Study of Hong Kong
other synonyms: Myopia Genomics Study|Myopia Genomics Study (Hong Kong HTI)|The Myopia Genomics Study
definition: A genetic study of myopia at the Hong Kong Polytechnic University, which recruited unrelated adults of Chinese descent aged 18 to 45 years through the university's Optometry Clinic, excluding people with signs of ocular disorders or of inherited disorders associated with myopia, measured their refraction by cycloplegic autorefraction together with corneal curvature, lens thickness and axial length, and genotyped them genome-wide; it is a member study of the Consortium for Refractive Error and Myopia (CREAM).

label: Malaysian Ovarian Cancer Genetic Study
other synonyms: Malaysia Ovarian Cancer Genetic Study|Malaysia Ovarian Cancer Study
definition: A single-centre, hospital-based case cohort of women with ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer in Malaysia, recruited consecutively at a private hospital from October 2008 to February 2015 and tested for germline variants in BRCA1 and BRCA2; it takes part in the Ovarian Cancer Association Consortium under the study code MAS.
diseases: patients with: fallopian tube cancer (MONDO:0002158)|patients with: ovarian cancer (MONDO:0008170)|patients with: primary peritoneal carcinoma (MONDO:0015686)

label: Newcastle 85+ Study
other synonyms: Newcastle 85+ cohort study
definition: A prospective inception cohort study of health and ageing in the very old in North East England, funded by the UK Medical Research Council and the Biotechnology and Biological Sciences Research Council, which invited everyone born in 1921 (turning 85 in 2006) who was registered with a participating general practice in Newcastle upon Tyne or North Tyneside, whether living at home or in an institution and regardless of health, recruited them in 2006–2007, assessed them at home with a multidimensional health assessment, review of general practice records and fasting blood samples, with repeat assessments at 18 and 36 months and follow-up until death, to study health trajectories, their biological, medical and social determinants, and the biology of ageing.

label: Greek NAFLD study
other synonyms: NAFLD study
definition: A case-control study of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease run by Harokopio University of Athens in Greek adults without secondary liver disease or excessive alcohol intake, recruited between 2012 and 2015 at the outpatient clinics of the First Department of Propaedeutic and Internal Medicine, Laiko General Hospital, Athens, and classified as cases or controls by degree of hepatic steatosis.
diseases: patients with: metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MONDO:0013209)
exposures: designed to study: exposure to eating behavior (ECTO:6000021)

label: Nicotine Addiction Genetics
other synonyms: Nicotine Addiction Genetics Project|Nicotine Addiction Genetics consortium|Nicotine Addiction Genetics project
definition: A multisite consortium of Finland, Australia and the United States for the genetics of nicotine dependence, coordinated from Washington University School of Medicine: its Australian component, run with the Queensland Institute of Medical Research, recruited families with a sib pair concordant for heavy smoking, identified from surveys of Australian Twin Registry cohorts, and interviewed them by telephone in 2001–2006, and its Finnish component recruited twin pairs from the Finnish Twin Cohort concordant for ever-smoking, with their family members (mainly siblings), in 2001–2005; participants were assessed with a structured diagnostic interview and gave DNA for linkage and association studies of nicotine dependence and related substance use.
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to tobacco smoking (ECTO:6000029)

label: Nagano Breast Cancer Study
definition: A multicentre hospital-based case-control study of breast cancer in Nagano, Japan, enrolling a consecutive series of women aged 20-74 with newly diagnosed, histologically confirmed invasive breast cancer at four hospitals and cancer-free controls from medical check-up examinees matched by age and residential area, designed to study lifestyle and genetic risk factors and, with a parallel study in São Paulo, Brazil, to compare Japanese, Japanese Brazilian and non-Japanese Brazilian women.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to lifestyle (ECTO:6000015)

label: Norwegian Addison Registry
other synonyms: National Norwegian Addison Registry|Norwegian National Addison Registry
