definition: A multicentre prospective study in Australia and Belgium, enrolling since 2017, of atrial and ventricular remodelling and the prevalence and incidence of arrhythmias, especially atrial fibrillation, in endurance athletes aged 16 to 80 (young elite, retiring and retired athletes, including athletes referred with known or suspected arrhythmias) and in age- and sex-matched non-athletes.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to exercise (ECTO:6000002)

label: Progression in Cancer of the Prostate
other synonyms: PROCAP study|PROgression in CAncer of the Prostate|PROgression in Cancer of the Prostate
definition: A nationwide Swedish cohort of men with localized prostate cancer, drawn from the National Prostate Cancer Register of Sweden Follow-up Study (men registered in 1997-2002 with localized disease, PSA below 20 ng/mL and age 70 or younger at diagnosis), whose members still alive in 2007 answered a lifestyle questionnaire and gave a blood sample for genetic analysis in 2007-2008, to study genetic and lifestyle factors in prostate cancer progression and survival.

label: Prognostic Genetic factors in Multiple Sclerosis
other synonyms: PROGEMUS Consortium|PROGEMUS Group|PROGEMUS study|PROgnostic GEnetic factors in MUltiple Sclerosis
definition: A cross-sectional multicentre study of multiple sclerosis in continental Italy (excluding Sardinia), coordinated from Novara (the AOU Maggiore della Carità and the University of Piemonte Orientale), in which consecutive patients with multiple sclerosis of Italian ancestry, mostly from north-west Italy, were recruited through hospital-based clinics and gave DNA, to study genetic factors in multiple sclerosis, in particular prognostic ones.

label: Parkinson's Research: The Organized Genetics Initiative
other synonyms: PROGENI Study|PROGENI study|Parkinson's Research: The Organized GENetics Initiative|Parkinsons Research: The Organized Genetics Initiative
definition: A genetic study of familial Parkinson's disease, run through the Parkinson Study Group, that ascertains multiplex families through a pair of living siblings who both have Parkinson's disease and has the affected family members examined by movement disorder specialists at Parkinson Study Group clinical centres throughout North America, to identify genes contributing to susceptibility to Parkinson's disease.

label: PROGReSS study
other synonyms: Prostate Cancer Group, Santiago, Spain
definition: A hospital-based, prospective, observational case-control study of prostate cancer at the Hospital Clínico Universitario de Santiago de Compostela, Galicia, Spain, whose cases are men with prostate cancer from that hospital and whose controls are cancer-free men from the same population, funded by the Spanish Ministry of Health; it is one of the PRACTICAL consortium studies genotyped in the prostate cancer OncoArray project.

label: Progression Risk of Glaucoma: Relevant SNPs With Significant Association
other synonyms: PROGRESSA study|Progression Risk Of Glaucoma: RElevant SNPs with Significant Association|Progression Risk Of Glaucoma; RElevant SNPs with Significant Association|Progression Risk of Glaucoma: RElevant SNPs with Significant Association|Progression Risk of Glaucoma: Relevant SNPs with Significant Association
definition: A prospective, longitudinal, multicentre observational cohort study in Australia, led from Flinders University in South Australia and enrolling since 2012, of people with suspected glaucoma (an optic disc suspicious of glaucoma or ocular hypertension) or early manifest primary open-angle glaucoma, who are genotyped and examined every six months with optical coherence tomography and visual field testing, to identify clinical and genetic predictors of glaucoma progression.

label: Prospective Athletic Heart Study
other synonyms: PROspective ATHletic Heart study|Pro@Heart study|Prospective Athlete’s Heart study|Prospective Athletic Heart|Prospective Athletic Heart study
definition: An international multicentre prospective cohort study in Australia and Belgium of young competitive endurance athletes aged 14 to 23, recruited from elite endurance sports programmes, and of matched non-athletes, who undergo echocardiography, cardiac MRI, ECG, exercise testing and Holter monitoring repeated over 20 years, to assess how training load and genotype determine exercise-induced cardiac remodelling and its consequences for performance, health and heart disease.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to exercise (ECTO:6000002)

label: Sea Islands Genetic African American Registry
other synonyms: Project SuGAR registry|The Sea Islands Genetic African American Registry
definition: A registry of Gullah-speaking African American families from the Sea Islands and coastal low country of South Carolina, a population with little European admixture and high rates of type 2 diabetes, run from the Division of Endocrinology of the Medical University of South Carolina. Between 1995 and 2003 it enrolled families with several members affected by type 2 diabetes (affected sibling, half-sibling or parent-child pairs, with their affected and unaffected relatives), identified with the help of medical clinics, churches and community organisations on the Sea Islands, and assessed them for medical, anthropometric and metabolic traits for genetic studies such as genome-wide linkage scans of type 2 diabetes and lipoprotein subclasses.

label: Prostate Cancer: Mechanisms of Progression and Treatment
other synonyms: ProMPT study|Prostate Cancer: Mechanisms of Progression and Treatment collaborative|Prostate cancer : Mechanisms of progression and Treatment|Prostate cancer : Mechanisms of progression and Treatment (UK)
definition: A UK prostate cancer study run from Cambridge as a National Cancer Research Institute and Medical Research Council collaborative linked to the ProtecT trial, which collected biological samples (including tissue and urine) and data from men with and without prostate cancer attending hospital outpatient clinics, for a bio-repository used to study the mechanisms of prostate cancer progression and treatment.

label: Profiling Parkinson's disease
other synonyms: PROPARK study|PROfiling PARKinson's disease|Profiling Parkinson's disease study|SCOPA-PROPARK cohort
definition: A hospital-based longitudinal cohort of patients with idiopathic Parkinson's disease, recruited from neurology clinics of university and regional hospitals in the western Netherlands across strata of age at onset and disease duration and examined mainly at Leiden University Medical Center, who were assessed on a broad range of motor and non-motor features at baseline in 2003-2005 and annually for five years, to profile the clinical course of the disease.

label: Prostate testing for cancer and Treatment study
other synonyms: Prostate Testing for Cancer and Treatment study|Prostate testing for cancer and Treatment trial|prostate testing for cancer and treatment study
definition: A randomised phase 3 trial in the United Kingdom in which men aged 50–69 registered at primary care centres in nine UK cities were invited for PSA testing (a pilot from 1999, the main phase from 2001 to 2009), men with a raised PSA were offered prostate biopsy, and those with clinically localised prostate cancer were randomly assigned to active monitoring, radical prostatectomy or radiotherapy, to investigate the effectiveness of treatments for localised prostate cancer.

label: Prostate Cancer and Environment Study
other synonyms: Montreal PROtEuS Study|Prostate Cancer & Environment Study
definition: A population-based case-control study of prostate cancer in Montreal, Quebec, Canada, in which men aged 75 or under with histologically confirmed prostate cancer diagnosed in 2005–2009 were ascertained across Montreal's French-language hospitals and controls were randomly selected from the provincial electoral list of French-speaking men, frequency-matched on age, and interviewed in person on sociodemographic, lifestyle, environmental and medical factors, with a genetic component.
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)

label: Prevention of Ovarian Cancer in Quebec
other synonyms: PRevention of OVArian Cancer in Quebec|PRevention of OVArian cancer in Quebec|Prevention of OVArian Cancer in Québec
definition: A population-based case-control study of epithelial ovarian cancer conducted in Montreal, Canada, from 2011 to 2016, in which women aged 18–79 who were Canadian citizens living in the greater Montreal area, with incident borderline or invasive epithelial cancer of the ovary, fallopian tube or peritoneum identified at seven Montreal hospitals, and controls sampled from the Quebec electoral list and frequency-matched to them by age and region of Montreal, were interviewed in person.
diseases: patients with: fallopian tube cancer (MONDO:0002158)|patients with: ovarian carcinoma (MONDO:0005140)|patients with: peritoneum cancer (MONDO:0002087)

label: Pravastatin or Atorvastatin Evaluation and Infection Therapy-Thrombolysis In Myocardial Infarction 22
other synonyms: Pravastatin or Atorvastatin Evaluation and Infection Therapy
definition: A double-blind randomised trial in patients hospitalised for an acute coronary syndrome within the preceding 10 days that compared standard statin therapy (pravastatin 40 mg daily) with intensive statin therapy (atorvastatin 80 mg daily), and long-term treatment with the antibiotic gatifloxacin with placebo, for the prevention of death and major cardiovascular events.

label: Pharma SNP Consortium
other synonyms: Pharma SNP consortium
definition: A collection of DNA samples and Epstein-Barr virus-transformed cell lines from healthy Japanese volunteers, recruited through the Pharma SNP Consortium in Tokyo, whose health was checked through the consortium; the samples were used for a database of SNPs and haplotypes in drug-related genes and as controls in genetic association studies of the Japanese population.

label: Pumwani Sex Workers Cohort
other synonyms: Pumwani Sex Worker Cohort|Pumwani cohort|Pumwani sex worker Cohort|Pumwani sex worker cohort|Pumwani sex workers cohort
definition: An open cohort of female sex workers in Pumwani, Nairobi, Kenya, established in 1985 with follow-up visits twice a year and studied with the University of Nairobi and the University of Manitoba, in which a subgroup of women remain uninfected by HIV-1 despite heavy exposure through sex work; it is used to study natural resistance to HIV-1 infection, seroconversion and disease progression, including host genetic studies of HLA and other variants.
diseases: at risk of: HIV infectious disease (MONDO:0005109)
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to Human immunodeficiency virus (ECTO:3000289)

label: Prospective Urban Rural Epidemiology study
other synonyms: PURE Study|PURE study|Prospective Urban Rural Epidemiology|Prospective Urban and Rural Epidemiology|Prospective Urban and Rural Epidemiology Study
definition: A large international prospective epidemiological cohort study, funded by the Population Health Research Institute (Hamilton, Canada) with Canadian research funders, that has recruited since 2002 adults aged 35 to 70 years, with their household members, from representative samples of urban and rural communities in low-, middle- and high-income countries on five continents (17 countries at first, 27 later), to examine how societal influences and social, behavioural, genetic and environmental factors relate to lifestyle, cardiovascular risk factors and chronic non-communicable diseases, above all cardiovascular disease. Participants give medical history, lifestyle, anthropometric and electrocardiogram data and blood stored for biochemistry and genetic analysis, and are followed up for at least 10 years for events and death.

label: Puerto Rico Familial Colorectal Cancer Registry
other synonyms: Puerto Rico Familial Cancer Registry|The Puerto Rico Familial Colorectal Cancer Registry
definition: A familial cancer registry established in 2006 at the University of Puerto Rico Comprehensive Cancer Center, the first familial cancer registry in Puerto Rico, which enrols Hispanic individuals with a clinical or genetic diagnosis of a hereditary colorectal cancer or polyposis syndrome (familial adenomatous polyposis, attenuated FAP, hamartomatous polyposis syndromes or Lynch syndrome), referred with a personal or family history of possible familial colorectal cancer or polyposis by gastroenterologists, oncologists and colorectal surgeons. Consenting probands complete questionnaires on medical history, environmental exposures and cancer family history, their pedigrees are traced, and the registry offers affected families education, genetic testing and surveillance.
diseases: patients with: Lynch syndrome (MONDO:0005835)|patients with: attenuated familial adenomatous polyposis (MONDO:0016362)|patients with: classic or attenuated familial adenomatous polyposis (MONDO:0021057)

label: Quit2Live
other synonyms: Quit 2 Live|Quit-2-Live|Understanding Disparities in Quitting in African American and White Smokers
definition: A smoking-cessation clinical trial run by the University of Kansas Medical Center in Kansas City, United States, from 2013 to 2017, in which adult non-Hispanic African American and White smokers of 3–20 cigarettes a day who wanted to quit were treated with varenicline, to study racial differences in quitting smoking and their causes.
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to Cigarette Smoking (ECTO:6000038)

label: Queensland Familial Melanoma Project
other synonyms: Queensland familial melanoma project
definition: A population-based family and twin study of cutaneous melanoma in Queensland, Australia, begun in 1987, in which all Queensland residents with a first primary cutaneous melanoma diagnosed between 1982 and 1990, identified through the Queensland Cancer Registry, were sent a family-history questionnaire and familial cases, twins, a sample of non-familial cases and the cases' relatives were then studied, to investigate genetic susceptibility (skin type, pigmentation and naevi), solar ultraviolet exposure and their interaction in the aetiology of melanoma.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to ultraviolet radiation (ECTO:0000006)

label: Quebec Family Study
other synonyms: Québec Family Study
definition: An observational family study launched at Laval University in Quebec City, Canada, in 1978 to investigate the role of genetic factors in physical fitness, body composition, risk factors for common diseases and health-related behaviour, which in 1979–1982 recruited nuclear families of French descent living mostly near Quebec City (with biological or adopted offspring) irrespective of body weight. As the study turned to the genetics of obesity, families ascertained through obese members were added in 1989–1997 and 1998–2002, and it has been used to study the familial and genetic determinants of obesity, body fat distribution and energy balance.

label: SYNERGIQC
other synonyms: Quebec Lung Cancer Screening Program|Quebec lung cancer screening program|SYNERGIQC cohort
definition: A research cohort of ever-smokers aged 55–74 at high clinical risk of lung cancer (a PLCOm2012norace risk of 2% or more) enrolled in the provincial multicentre pilot lung cancer screening program of Quebec, Canada, launched in 2021, who gave blood samples to the AIRS biobank at the IUCPQ and CUSM sites at their first or second screening visit and are followed for incident lung cancer after low-dose CT screening managed with Lung-RADS.
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to tobacco smoking (ECTO:6000029)

label: Queensland Study
other synonyms: Retrospective Queensland Study
definition: A case-control study of prostate cancer in Queensland, Australia, contributed to the PRACTICAL consortium, whose cases were men with histopathologically confirmed prostate cancer recruited through urologists in Queensland from the Retrospective Queensland Study, the ProsCan (Prostate Cancer Supportive Care and Patient Outcomes Project) cohort of men newly diagnosed at 26 private practices and 10 public hospitals, and the Queensland node of the Australian Prostate Cancer BioResource. Its controls were healthy men with no personal history of prostate cancer, recruited through the Australian Red Cross Blood Service in Brisbane or, matched to the cases by age and postcode, through the Australian Electoral Commission.

label: QUASAR 2
other synonyms: Multicentre international study of capecitabine ± bevacizumab as adjuvant treatment of colorectal cancer|QUick And Simple And Reliable trial|Quick and Simple and Reliable trial
definition: An open-label randomised phase 3 trial in which patients aged 18 or older who had undergone potentially curative surgery for stage III or high-risk stage II colorectal cancer were recruited at 170 hospitals in seven countries, led from the United Kingdom, between 2005 and 2010 and randomly assigned to adjuvant capecitabine alone or capecitabine plus bevacizumab, to test whether bevacizumab improves disease-free survival.

label: RADIANT
other synonyms: RADIANT study|Radiant study
definition: A collection of clinically ascertained depression samples genotyped together for genome-wide association studies of major depressive disorder, made up of the Depression Network (DeNT) study of sibling pairs with recurrent unipolar depression recruited at clinical sites in Europe and one in the United States, the Depression Case Control (DeCC) study of unrelated patients with recurrent depression recruited at three UK sites, and the Genome-Based Therapeutic Drugs for Depression (GENDEP) pharmacogenetic study.

label: Radiogenomics: Assessment of Polymorphisms for Predicting the Effects of Radiotherapy
other synonyms: Radiogenomics: Assessment of Polymorphisms for Predicting the effects of radiotherapy|Radiogenomics: Assessment of polymorphisms for predicting the effects of radiotherapy
definition: A UK multicentre sample collection study, opened in 2005, that collects blood samples and prospectively recorded radiotherapy toxicity data from cancer patients, among them breast and prostate cancer patients, enrolled in radiotherapy clinical trials (such as RT01 and CHHiP) and other studies, to identify genetic variants that predict the adverse effects of radiotherapy on normal tissue.
diseases: patients with: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|patients with: head and neck cancer (MONDO:0005627)|patients with: prostate cancer (MONDO:0008315)

label: Rotterdam Breast Cancer Study
definition: A hospital-based breast cancer case-control study in the southwest of the Netherlands, whose cases are index patients from families with breast or breast and ovarian cancer counselled at the Clinical Genetics Centre of Erasmus University Medical Centre in Rotterdam from 1994, and whose geographically matched controls are women from cystic fibrosis families counselled at the same centre; it is one of the studies of the Breast Cancer Association Consortium.

label: Réseau Français de la Génétique de la Sclérose En Plaques
other synonyms: Centre de Ressources Biologiques du Réseau Français d'Etude Génétique de la Sclérose en Plaques|French MS Genetics group|French Network for MS Genetics|Multiple Sclerosis Genetics Study|Réseau Français d'Etude Génétique de la Sclérose en Plaques|Réseau français de la génétique de la sclérose en plaques
definition: A French national network for the genetic study of multiple sclerosis that since 1992 has recruited people with multiple sclerosis, with the parents and siblings of patients in trio and multiplex families, through physicians at hospital centres across France and through advertising campaigns run with patient associations, confirming each diagnosis by a network physician and collecting clinical information and a blood sample, and whose biological resource centre keeps DNA and cell lines for genetic studies of multiple sclerosis.

label: Girona Heart Registry
other synonyms: Girona Heart Register|REGICOR Study|REGICOR cohort|REGICOR study|REgistre GIroni del COr|Registre GIroní del COR|Registre Gironi del COR|Registre Gironi del Cor|Registre Gironí del Cor
definition: A population-based study of cardiovascular disease in the province of Girona, north-eastern Spain, run by the REGICOR study group of the Hospital del Mar Research Institute, Barcelona. It began as a registry of patients with myocardial infarction in Girona, with data from 1978, and its population cohort, established in 1995 to study the prevalence and control of cardiovascular risk factors, novel risk factors and biomarkers of cardiovascular disease and cardiovascular risk prediction, combines participants of four surveys (1995, 2000, 2005 and 2018) randomly sampled from towns of the province and the city of Girona. Participants were re-examined, followed up for cardiovascular and other events and death, including by linkage to electronic health records, and genotyped, with other omics measured in subsets.

label: Registry of Endometrial Cancer in Sweden
other synonyms: Registry of Endometrial Cancer in Stockholm
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of endometrial cancer in Sweden, whose patients underwent surgery for uterine cancer from 2008 at Karolinska University Hospital, Solna, in Stockholm, to which women of Stockholm County with newly diagnosed uterine cancer are referred, and gave blood and tumour samples, questionnaires on their own risk factors and on cancers in their families, and pedigrees in which cancers in relatives were verified from the Swedish Cancer Registry, medical records or death certificates where possible. Its cases were genotyped in the genome-wide association studies of the Endometrial Cancer Association Consortium.

label: Randomized Trial to Prevent Vascular Events in HIV
definition: A multicentre, international, phase 3, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial (ACTG A5332) of pitavastatin calcium for the primary prevention of major adverse cardiovascular events in adults with HIV on antiretroviral therapy and at low-to-moderate traditional cardiovascular risk, which enrolled participants from 2015 to 2019 at sites in 12 countries across five Global Burden of Disease regions.

label: REQUITE cohort
other synonyms: REQUITE cohort study|REQUITE study|Validating Predictive Models and Biomarkers of Radiotherapy Toxicity to Reduce Side-Effects and Improve Quality of Life in Cancer Survivors|validating pREdictive models and biomarkers of radiotherapy toxicity to reduce side effects and improve QUalITy of lifE in cancer survivors|validating pREdictive models and biomarkers of radiotherapy toxicity to reduce side-effects and improve QUalITy of lifE in cancer survivors
definition: An international, prospective, observational cohort study, funded by the European Union's Seventh Framework Programme, that between April 2014 and March 2017 recruited patients with breast, prostate or lung cancer planned for potentially curative radiotherapy at 26 hospitals in eight countries in Europe and the United States. With standardised data collection across centres, it gathered pre-treatment blood samples, treatment and dosimetry data and physician- and patient-reported outcomes during follow-up of at least 12 (lung) or 24 (breast, prostate) months, in a centralised database and biobank with genotype data, as a resource for validating models and biomarkers, including genetic ones, that predict toxicity after radiotherapy.
diseases: patients with: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|patients with: lung cancer (MONDO:0008903)|patients with: prostate cancer (MONDO:0008315)

label: Reykjavik Eye Study
definition: A population-based epidemiological study of eye disease, run by Icelandic and Japanese study groups, in which citizens of Reykjavik, Iceland, aged 50 years and older, randomly selected from the national population census, were given ophthalmological examinations to determine the prevalence of lens opacities, refractive error and visual acuity, and open-angle glaucoma.

label: The Resource for the Study of Lung Cancer Epidemiology in North Trent
definition: A case-control study of lung cancer epidemiology run from Sheffield, England, since 2006, which recruits pathologically confirmed lung cancer cases diagnosed at age 60 or younger (or older with a family history of lung cancer) and family-matched controls through several cancer treatment centres, mostly in North Trent, collecting a lifestyle, occupational-exposure and family-history questionnaire and blood for DNA.

label: Risk Evaluation of Viral Load Elevation and Associated Liver Disease/Cancer-Hepatitis B Virus
other synonyms: Risk Evaluation of Viral Load Elevation and Associated Liver Disease/Cancer-Hepatitis B Virus study
definition: A community-based prospective cohort in Taiwan made up of the participants of the REVEAL study who were seropositive for hepatitis B surface antigen: the REVEAL study enrolled residents aged 30 to 65 years from seven townships in Taiwan in 1991–1992, who gave blood samples, completed questionnaires and had health examinations at enrolment, and its HBsAg-seropositive participants were followed with blood collection and abdominal ultrasonography every 6–12 months and by linkage to the Taiwan National Cancer Registry and death certification, to study the risk factors for hepatocellular carcinoma in chronic hepatitis B virus carriers. Its sister cohort, REVEAL-HCV, followed the participants seropositive for antibodies to hepatitis C virus.

label: Risk Factors for Prostate Cancer Study
other synonyms: Risk Factors for Prostate Cancer Study of the Victoria Cancer Council
definition: A population-based case-control study of prostate cancer run by the Cancer Council Victoria, which in 1994-1997 recruited men resident in Melbourne and Perth, Australia, who were diagnosed with prostate cancer before age 70, through the state cancer registries, together with controls identified from government electoral rolls and frequency-matched to the cases by age.

label: RuiJin T2D Study
other synonyms: RJ Study|RJ study|RuiJin T2D study
definition: A case-control genome-wide association study of type 2 diabetes in Han Chinese at Ruijin Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine, in Shanghai, China, whose cases were patients with type 2 diabetes recruited from the hospital's outpatient departments and whose healthy controls were drawn from a glucose survey in Youyi community, Baoshan district, Shanghai; its genome-wide data were one of the Stage 1 studies of the 2015 meta-analysis of genome-wide association studies of adult height in East Asians.

label: Royal Marsden Hospital Breast Cancer Cases
Royal Marsden Hospital Ovarian Cancer Study
other synonyms: Royal Marsden Hospital Study|Royal Marsden Hospital study
definition: A hospital-based collection of women with invasive epithelial ovarian cancer ascertained at the Royal Marsden Hospital, London, United Kingdom, whose cases were genotyped in the UK stage of the first genome-wide association studies of ovarian cancer and in studies of the Ovarian Cancer Association Consortium.

label: Royal Marsden Hospital Trust/Institute of Cancer Research Family History and DNA Registry
other synonyms: Royal Marsden Hospital NHS Trust Family History and DNA Registry
definition: A collection of DNA samples from people with cancer, among them colorectal cancer patients, and from healthy people who were the spouses or unrelated friends of patients with malignancies, recruited from 1999 through the Institute of Cancer Research and the Royal Marsden Hospital NHS Trust in the United Kingdom for genetic epidemiological studies of cancer susceptibility.
diseases: patients with: cancer (MONDO:0004992)|patients with: colorectal cancer (MONDO:0005575)

label: Royal North Shore Hospital Twins Study
Research on Osteoarthritis/Osteoporosis Against Disability
other synonyms: ROAD study|Research on Osteoarthritis Against Disability|Research on Osteoarthritis Against Disability study|Research on Osteoarthritis/Osteoporosis Against Disability study
definition: A population-based cohort study of osteoarthritis and osteoporosis in Japan, established in 2005 to build epidemiological indices for skeletal diseases, whose participants were recruited from resident registration listings in three communities (urban Itabashi in Tokyo, and mountainous Hidakagawa and coastal Taiji in Wakayama Prefecture) for a baseline survey in 2005–2007 with radiographic examinations and questionnaires, and have been re-examined in follow-up surveys since.
diseases: population study of: osteoarthritis (MONDO:0005178)|population study of: osteoporosis (MONDO:0005298)

label: Partners/Roche Cohort
other synonyms: Partners/Roche|Partners/Roche cohort|Roche Study
definition: An observational study of patients with diabetes mellitus and of non-diabetic controls with no personal or first-degree family history of diabetes and with normal fasting glucose, recruited and evaluated by the Diabetes Center of Massachusetts General Hospital and the Division of Endocrinology and Metabolism of Brigham and Women's Hospital in Boston, United States, and assembled with support from Roche; its participants were genotyped for glycaemic-trait and type 2 diabetes association studies of the MAGIC consortium.

label: Rotterdam Ovarian Cancer Study
definition: An ovarian cancer study in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, listed among the study groups of the Ovarian Cancer Association Consortium under the study code EMC and funded by the Dutch Cancer Society.

label: Romanian Diabetic Nephropathy Study
definition: A cross-sectional study of diabetic kidney disease in patients with type 1 diabetes, begun in 2010 in Romania as the pilot study of the International Diabetic Nephropathy Consortium (InterDiane, built on the FinnDiane protocol), which examined patients at two centres in Bucharest and one in Craiova between 2010 and 2012, assessing renal status from urinary albumin excretion.
diseases: patients with: diabetic kidney disease (MONDO:0005016)|patients with: type 1 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005147)

label: Rotterdam-Clinic study
other synonyms: Rotterdam Eye Study
definition: A clinic-based series of patients with advanced age-related macular degeneration (choroidal neovascularisation, geographic atrophy, or one in each eye), recruited through ophthalmology clinics in Rotterdam, ascertained by fundus examination and optical coherence tomography and graded with a Wisconsin/modified International system, which contributed advanced-AMD cases, without intermediate-AMD cases or controls, to the genome-wide association study of the International AMD Genomics Consortium.

label: Roswell Park Cancer Institute Data Bank and BioRepository
other synonyms: Data Bank and BioRepository|RPCI Data Bank and Biorepository|RPCI DataBank and BioRepository|Roswell Park Cancer Institute
definition: A biobank at Roswell Park Cancer Institute in Buffalo, New York, that collects blood samples before treatment, clinical data and an epidemiological questionnaire from patients newly diagnosed with cancer at the institute and, as controls, from people with no personal history of cancer (family members and friends of patients and community members), and supplies them to cancer research studies.

label: Rugao Longevity and Ageing Study
other synonyms: Rugao Longevity and Aging Study|The Rugao Longevity and Ageing Study
definition: A population-based observational cohort study in Rugao, a city in Jiangsu province, China, with two arms: a longevity arm that in 2007–2008 recruited long-lived residents aged 95 years and over together with population controls drawn at random from the resident registry, and an ageing arm that in 2014 randomly recruited residents aged 70–84 years from rural communities of Jiang'an Township by age and sex strata and is followed up longitudinally, both examined with structured questionnaires, physical examinations and blood samples to study longevity and ageing.

label: Russian Multi-Cancer Case-Control Study
other synonyms: Russian Multi-Cancer-Case-Control Study
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of several cancer sites in Russia, whose lung cancer cases and controls have been genotyped for studies of inherited lung cancer susceptibility.

label: San Antonio Center of Biomarkers of Risk for Prostate Cancer
other synonyms: San Antonio Biomarkers of Risk|San Antonio Center for Biomarkers of Risk of Prostate Cancer
definition: A prospective population-based cohort of healthy male volunteers enrolled in San Antonio and South Texas since 2000 by the San Antonio Center of Biomarkers of Risk for Prostate Cancer of the National Cancer Institute's Early Detection Research Network, screened annually or biannually by digital rectal examination and serum prostate-specific antigen, with prostate biopsy recommended after an abnormal result, to study prostate cancer risk and its biomarkers.

label: San Antonio Family Diabetes/Gallbladder Study
other synonyms: San Antonio Family Diabetes Study|San Antonio Family Diabetes/Gallbladder study
definition: A family study of Mexican Americans in San Antonio, Texas, United States, begun in 1991 as the San Antonio Family Diabetes Study to identify susceptibility genes for type 2 diabetes, which recruited low-income Mexican Americans with type 2 diabetes identified in the San Antonio Heart Study and their extended families, examined them repeatedly, and at its second recall added a gallbladder disease component and further families; with the San Antonio Family Heart Study it makes up the San Antonio Family Studies.
diseases: at risk of: type 2 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005148)

label: San Antonio Family Heart Study
other synonyms: The San Antonio Family Heart Study
definition: A family study of Mexican Americans in San Antonio, Texas, begun in 1991, that recruited low-income Mexican Americans aged 40 to 60, selected at random without regard to disease from Mexican American census tracts, together with their extended families, and followed them with repeated examinations to study the genetic and environmental contributions to cardiovascular disease risk factors. With the San Antonio Family Diabetes/Gallbladder Study it makes up the San Antonio Family Studies.

label: Study of Asthma, Genes and the Environment
other synonyms: Canadian Childhood Cohorts: Study of Asthma Genes and Environment|Study of Asthma Genes and Environment|Study of Asthma Genes and Environment Study
definition: A population-based cohort of children born in the province of Manitoba, Canada, in 1995, whose families were surveyed in 2002 about the child's health and home environment, with linkage to the child's health care records, and from which children with asthma or allergy and a random sample of children with neither were invited to a nested case-control study of the early-life genetic and environmental origins of asthma. It is one of the Canadian cohorts of the ALLERGEN consortium.
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)

label: Stanford Aging and Memory Study
other synonyms: Stanford Aging & Memory Study|Stanford Aging Memory Study
definition: A longitudinal study of healthy ageing at Stanford University in which cognitively unimpaired older adults, recruited through advertisements in the Bay Area, undergo neuropsychological assessment, brain imaging and fluid biomarker sampling, with a focus on medial temporal lobe function and episodic memory.

label: Santiago Bladder Cancer Study
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of bladder cancer in Santiago, Spain, whose cases and controls were genotyped with TaqMan assays in a 2016 follow-up of genome-wide association studies of bladder cancer risk in individuals of European ancestry.

label: Salzburg Atherosclerosis Prevention Program in subjects at High Individual Risk
other synonyms: SAPHIR cohort|SAPHIR study|Salzburg Atherosclerosis Prevention Program in Subjects at High Individual Risk
definition: A prospective study begun in 1999 in Salzburg, Austria, to investigate genetic and environmental factors contributing to atherosclerotic vascular diseases, whose participants, healthy unrelated adults aged 39–67 years, were recruited through health screening programmes in large companies in and around the city of Salzburg and examined with carotid ultrasonography and laboratory measurements.
diseases: population study of: atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (MONDO:1060134)

label: Swedish Addison Registry
definition: A nationwide multicentre research registry of patients with autoimmune Addison's disease in Sweden, with enrolment from 2008, whose patients are clinically and immunologically characterised and give samples for clinical, immunological and genetic studies of the disease.
diseases: patients with: autoimmune primary adrenal insufficiency (MONDO:0100480)

label: Saxagliptin Assessment of Vascular Outcomes Recorded in Patients with Diabetes Mellitus-Thrombolysis in Myocardial Infarction 53
other synonyms: Saxagliptin Assessment of Vascular Outcomes Recorded in Patients with Diabetes Mellitus|The Saxagliptin Assessment of Vascular Outcomes Recorded in Patients with Diabetes Mellitus
definition: A phase 4, multinational, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of the TIMI Study Group, conducted in 25 countries, that enrolled people aged 40 and older with type 2 diabetes mellitus and either established cardiovascular disease or multiple cardiovascular risk factors and randomised them to the DPP-4 inhibitor saxagliptin or matching placebo, to evaluate the drug's cardiovascular safety and efficacy with a primary endpoint of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction or ischaemic stroke.

label: South African Zulu
other synonyms: Durban Diabetes Study (DDS) and the Durban Diabetes Case Control study (DCC)|South African Zulu cohort
definition: A combined sample of South African Zulu type 2 diabetes cases and controls from Durban, South Africa, formed for genetic studies by aggregating the Durban Diabetes Study, a population-based cross-sectional study of urban Black African adults of Zulu descent, with the Durban Diabetes Case Control study, which added cases of the same ethnic group and locality who had type 2 diabetes and attended a diabetes clinic.

label: Sheffield Breast Cancer Study
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of breast cancer in Sheffield, United Kingdom, that recruited women with histologically confirmed breast cancer from the surgical outpatient clinics of the Royal Hallamshire Hospital, Sheffield, and Rotherham District Hospital from 1998 to 2005, and as controls women aged 50 to 60 attending the Sheffield mammography screening service in 2000–2004 whose mammograms showed no breast lesions, all resident in the Sheffield area and of northern European ancestry, for studies of genetic susceptibility to and survival from breast cancer.

label: Shanghai Breast Cancer Survival Study
definition: A population-based cohort study of breast cancer survivors in urban Shanghai, China, which enrolled women aged 20 to 75 years with newly diagnosed breast cancer identified through the Shanghai Cancer Registry between March 2002 and April 2006, about six months after diagnosis, and followed them in person at 18 months and 3, 5 and 10 years after diagnosis for cancer outcomes, health status, lifestyle and medication use.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to legume food product via ingestion (ECTO:0070183)

label: Spanish Cervical Artery Dissection Collection
other synonyms: Spanish cervical artery dissection collection
definition: A collection of patients with cervical artery dissection in Barcelona, Spain, which contributed patients of European origin, meeting the inclusion criteria of the CADISP study, to the second sample (CADISP-2) of the 2015 genome-wide association study of cervical artery dissection and, from Hospital Vall d'Hebron, patients and controls to its follow-up sample.

label: SCARFSHEEP
definition: A combined sample of two Swedish population-based case-control studies of myocardial infarction from Stockholm, the Stockholm Coronary Atherosclerosis Risk Factor (SCARF) study and the Stockholm Heart Epidemiology Program (SHEEP), whose cases had a first confirmed myocardial infarction and whose controls had no history of myocardial infarction, analysed together in genetic studies of coronary artery disease and cardiometabolic traits.

label: Subjective Cognitive Impairment Cohort
other synonyms: SCIENCe project
definition: A prospective cohort study, with inclusion from June 2014, of consecutive patients with subjective cognitive decline, without major psychiatric or neurological disorders, who presented at the memory clinic of the Alzheimer Center of VU University Medical Center Amsterdam, the Netherlands. After the clinic's standardised dementia screening they are followed annually, with repeated blood and cerebrospinal fluid collection for biobanking and optional amyloid PET, to study clinical progression and the factors contributing to subjective cognitive decline.
diseases: at risk of: cognitive disorder (MONDO:0002039)|at risk of: dementia (MONDO:0001627)

label: Skin Cancer Nested Case-Control Study
other synonyms: Skin Cancer Nested Case-Control Study within the NHS|skin cancer nested case-control study
definition: A case-control study of skin cancer nested within the Nurses' Health Study in the United States, in which women of the cohort's blood subcohort (blood given in 1989-1990) with incident melanoma, squamous cell carcinoma or basal cell carcinoma diagnosed after blood collection, and no earlier skin cancer, were compared with a common series of controls randomly selected from blood donors free of diagnosed skin cancer and matched by year of birth, with pigmentation and sun exposure information collected by a retrospective supplementary questionnaire.
diseases: patients with: basal cell carcinoma (MONDO:0020804)|patients with: melanoma (MONDO:0005105)|patients with: squamous cell carcinoma (MONDO:0005096)
exposures: designed to study: exposure to Solar radiation (ECTO:8000061)

label: Singapore Cohort Study of the Risk Factors for Myopia
other synonyms: SCORM study|Singapore Cohort Of the Risk factors for Myopia|Singapore Cohort Study of Risk Factors for Myopia|Singapore Cohort Study of the Risk factors for Myopia study|Singapore Cohort of Risk Factors for Myopia|Singapore Cohort study Of the Risk factors for Myopia|Singapore Cohort study Of the Risk factors for Myopia study
definition: A school-based cohort study of myopia in Singapore children, begun in three Singapore schools in 1999–2001, which recruited children aged 7 to 9 years and examined them yearly in their schools, with cycloplegic autorefraction and ocular biometry, to study the risk factors for the onset and progression of myopia.

label: South Carolina Prostate Cancer Study
definition: A population-based case-control study of prostate cancer in older African American and white men in South Carolina, United States, funded by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Men aged 65–79 with incident, histologically confirmed prostate cancer diagnosed from October 1999 to September 2001 were identified through the South Carolina Central Cancer Registry, and controls of the same ages, frequency-matched on age, race and region, were sampled from the Medicare beneficiary file; both were interviewed by telephone by the University of South Carolina Survey Research Laboratory about lifestyle, diet, medical and family history and farm work.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to lifestyle (ECTO:6000015)

label: Shanghai Diabetes Genetic Study
other synonyms: Shanghai Diabetes GWAS|Shanghai Diabetes Genetics Study|Shanghai Diabetes Genome-Wide Association Study
definition: A genome-wide association study of type 2 diabetes in Chinese women in Shanghai, contributed by Vanderbilt University and the Shanghai Cancer Institute, whose cases were incident type 2 diabetes cases from the Shanghai Women's Health Study and prevalent cases found among the controls of the Shanghai Breast Cancer Study, and whose controls were women from the general population free of cancer and diabetes, shared with the Shanghai Breast Cancer Genetics Study. Genotyped on the Affymetrix Genome-Wide Human SNP Array 6.0, it has also been pooled with the Shanghai breast and endometrial cancer genetics studies for genetic analyses of other traits in women.

label: Study of Digestive Health
definition: A population-based case-control study of Barrett's oesophagus and reflux-related conditions in Brisbane, Australia, whose cases were residents of metropolitan Brisbane aged 18 to 79 with a new histologically confirmed diagnosis of Barrett's oesophagus, with or without dysplasia, between February 2003 and June 2006, identified through the pathology laboratories serving the city, and whose controls were people randomly selected from the Australian electoral roll and matched to the cases by age and sex, together with endoscopy patients whose biopsies showed only oesophageal inflammation consistent with reflux and no Barrett's oesophagus.

label: Shanghai Diabetes Institute Inpatient Database
other synonyms: Shanghai DIabetes Inpatient Database|Shanghai Diabetes Inpatient Database|Shanghai Diabetes Institute inpatient database
definition: The inpatient database of the Shanghai Diabetes Institute at Shanghai Jiao Tong University Affiliated Sixth People's Hospital, Shanghai, China: Han Chinese inpatients of the hospital's Department of Endocrinology and Metabolism, recruited from 2001, with type 2 diabetes, type 1 diabetes or genetic syndromes related to diabetes, for whom detailed phenotypes of glucose and lipid metabolism, blood pressure, liver and kidney function and diabetic complications were collected. Its type 2 diabetes patients have served as cases, with controls from the community-based Shanghai Diabetes Studies, in genetic association studies of type 2 diabetes and its complications.
diseases: patients with: type 1 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005147)|patients with: type 2 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005148)

label: Stockholm Diabetes Prevention Program
other synonyms: Stockholm Diabetes Prevention Programme
definition: A population-based prospective cohort of men and women aged 35–56 without previously diagnosed diabetes from five municipalities of Stockholm County, Sweden, surveyed at baseline in 1992–1994 (men) and 1996–1998 (women) with the sample enriched to about half with a family history of diabetes, and re-examined after 8–10 years and again in 2014–2017 with health examinations, oral glucose tolerance tests and questionnaires, set up at the Karolinska Institute to study the determinants of prediabetes and type 2 diabetes.
diseases: population study of: type 2 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005148)

label: Study of the Effectiveness of Additional Reductions in Cholesterol and Homocysteine
other synonyms: SEARCH trial|Study Evaluating Additional Reduction in Cholesterol and Homocysteine|Study of the effectiveness of additional reductions in cholesterol and homocysteine
definition: A randomised trial cohort of men and women aged 18–80 years with a history of myocardial infarction, recruited from 1998 through special clinics at 88 UK hospitals and coordinated by the Clinical Trial Service Unit in Oxford, which compared 80 mg with 20 mg simvastatin daily and, in a two-by-two factorial design, folic acid plus vitamin B12 with placebo, and whose participants also served for the identification of an SLCO1B1 variant associated with simvastatin-induced myopathy.

label: UK SEARCH Ovarian Cancer Study
other synonyms: SEARCH (Studies of Epidemiology and Risk Factors in Cancer Heredity Ovarian Cancer Study)|Studies of Epidemiology and Risk Factors in Cancer Heredity Ovarian Cancer Study|Studies of Epidemiology and Risk Factors in Cancer Heredity-Ovarian Cancer
definition: The ovarian cancer arm of the SEARCH population-based case-control study in England, whose cases are women with ovarian cancer from the East Anglian, West Midlands and Trent regions identified through the regional cancer registries (prevalent cases diagnosed 1991-1998 and incident cases from 1998 onwards) and whose controls were drawn from the EPIC-Norfolk cohort, set up to study genetic susceptibility to ovarian cancer.

label: Shanghai Endometrial Cancer Study
other synonyms: Shanghai endometrial cancer study
definition: A population-based case-control study of endometrial cancer among Chinese women in urban Shanghai, China, conducted from 1997 to 2003, in which women aged 30-69 with newly diagnosed endometrial cancer, identified through the Shanghai Cancer Registry, and age frequency-matched controls randomly selected from the general population through the Shanghai Resident Registry were interviewed in person and gave blood or buccal cell samples, to study risk factors for endometrial cancer.

label: Severe Asthma Cohorts
other synonyms: Severe asthma study
definition: A collection of children and adults with severe or refractory asthma recruited through three specialist severe asthma clinics in England, the adult and paediatric clinics of the Royal Brompton Hospital, London, and the adult clinic of the Glenfield Hospital, Leicester, where they were characterised under the clinics' severe asthma protocols, assembled as the severe asthma group of the GABRIEL consortium's genome-wide association study of asthma.

label: Seattle Familial Colorectal Cancer Registry
other synonyms: Seattle Colon Cancer Family Registry|Seattle Colorectal Cancer Family Registry|Seattle Familial Colon Cancer Registry
definition: A population-based colorectal cancer family registry in western Washington State, United States, one of the sites of the Colon Cancer Family Registry, which enrolled people aged 20 to 74 with incident colorectal cancer in three Washington State counties, identified through the Puget Sound SEER cancer registry, together with their first-degree relatives, and age- and sex-matched population controls recruited from driver's licence lists (under 65) and health care finance files (65 to 74), all of whom completed epidemiology and family-history questionnaires by telephone.

label: San Francisco Prostate Cancer Study
definition: A population-based case-control study of advanced prostate cancer among non-Hispanic White and African American men aged 40-79 in the San Francisco Bay Area, California, United States, whose cases were diagnosed from 1997 to 2000 and identified through the Greater Bay Area Cancer Registry and whose controls, men without a history of prostate cancer, were found by random-digit dialling and from Health Care Financing Administration rosters and frequency matched to cases on race and age; participants were interviewed about lifetime sun exposure and other risk factors and gave biospecimens.

label: Singapore Breast Cancer Cohort
definition: An ongoing multi-ethnic cohort of breast cancer patients aged 21 years and over who are citizens or permanent residents of Singapore, recruited from April 2010 at the National University Hospital and later at five other public tertiary hospitals in Singapore, with retrospective and prospective components, questionnaire, medical record and biospecimen data and follow-up through linkage with the Registry of Births and Deaths, established to identify genetic markers of breast cancer risk, prognosis and treatment response and to study ethnic differences in breast cancer risk and outcome in Asia.
diseases: patients with: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|patients with: breast carcinoma in situ (MONDO:0004658)

label: NIMH Schizophrenia Genetics Initiative
other synonyms: NIMH Genetics Initiative on Schizophrenia|National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH) Schizophrenia Genetics Initiative|National Institute of Mental Health Schizophrenia Genetics Initiative|Schizophrenia Genetics Initiative
definition: A family collection of the US National Institute of Mental Health Genetics Initiative, a multisite study set up as a national resource with a centralised clinical database and cell repository, in which Washington University, Harvard University and Columbia University ascertained, from 1991 to 1997, nuclear families of European and African ancestry with siblings affected by schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder, for genetic linkage and association studies of schizophrenia; its cases later formed one of the three collections of the Molecular Genetics of Schizophrenia genome-wide association study.

label: Shanghai Genome-Wide Association Studies
other synonyms: Shanghai Genome Wide Associations Studies|Shanghai Genome-wide Association Studies|Shanghai genome-wide association studies
definition: A collection of the genome-wide genotyping of Chinese participants of population-based studies in Shanghai, China, run by Vanderbilt University with the Shanghai Cancer Institute and the Shanghai Institute of Preventive Medicine, that pools the scans of the Shanghai Breast Cancer Study, the Shanghai Breast Cancer Survival Study, the Shanghai Endometrial Cancer Study, the Shanghai Women's Health Study and the Shanghai Men's Health Study for genetic association studies of breast cancer and other traits such as body mass index.
diseases: patients with: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|patients with: endometrial cancer (MONDO:0011962)|patients with: type 2 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005148)

label: SNP Health Association Asthma Resource Project
other synonyms: NHLBI SNP Health Association Resource (SHARe) Asthma Resource project|SHARe Asthma Resource project|SNP Health Associated Resource|SNP Health Association Resource (SHARe) Asthma Resource project
definition: A genome-wide genotyping project of the NHLBI SNP Health Association Resource (SHARe) that collects children and adults with asthma who took part in NHLBI asthma clinical trials: children of the Childhood Asthma Management Program and of trials of the Childhood Asthma Research and Education (CARE) network, most of them with their parents as parent-child trios, and adults of trials of the Asthma Clinical Research Network (ACRN), for genetic studies of asthma and of response to asthma treatment.

label: Stockholm Heart Epidemiology Program
other synonyms: SHEEP study|Stockholm Heart epidemiology Program
definition: A population-based case-control study of risk factors for a first myocardial infarction, whose study base was all Swedish citizens aged 45–70 years without a previous myocardial infarction living in Stockholm County, Sweden, in 1992–1994: cases were identified through the coronary and intensive care units of the catchment-area hospitals, hospital discharge records and death certificates, controls were drawn at random from the study base matched on age, sex and hospital catchment area, and the patients were followed for recurrent cardiovascular events and mortality.

label: Sleep Heart Health Study
definition: A multicentre prospective cohort study of the US National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute that enrolled adults aged 40 years or older in 1995–1998 from existing epidemiological cohorts (sites of the Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities Study and the Cardiovascular Health Study, the Framingham Offspring Cohort, the Strong Heart Study, the New York Hypertension Cohorts and two Tucson studies) and added an in-home polysomnogram at baseline and again in 2001–2003 to their data, to study obstructive sleep apnoea and other sleep-disordered breathing as risk factors for cardiovascular disease, hypertension and death.

label: Singapore Indian Chinese Cohort
other synonyms: Singapore Indian Chinese Cohort (SICC) Eye Study|Singapore Indian Chinese Cohort Eye Study|Singapore Indian Chinese cohort eye study
definition: A population-based eye study of ethnic Indian and ethnic Chinese adults aged 40 years and older living in south-western Singapore, sampled by age-stratified random sampling from name lists provided by the Ministry of Home Affairs and examined with standardised interviews, eye examinations and laboratory investigations, with blood, tear and urine samples stored for genetic and proteomic studies, to quantify ethnic differences in the prevalence, risk factors and impact of major eye diseases; its Indian component is the Singapore Indian Eye Study, and together with the Singapore Malay Eye Study it covers Singapore's three main ethnic groups.

label: Shanghai Institute of Hypertension GWAS
definition: A hospital-based case-control genome-wide association study of hypertension among Han Chinese adults aged 37–84 living in the Shanghai metropolitan area, approved by the ethics committee of Ruijin Hospital. Its cases had hypertension diagnosed after age 30 and at least two family members with hypertension, and its controls were normotensive adults over 40; both groups had a BMI under 27 kg/m2 and cases had no diabetes.

label: Silk Road
other synonyms: SR cohort|Silk Road cohort
definition: A collection of genetic and phenotypic data, gathered in 2010 by the scientific expedition Marco Polo (Marcopolo 2010), from healthy people in communities of the Terra Madre network along the Silk Road in Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan and Tajikistan (rural communities, and also cities in Uzbekistan and Kazakhstan), with ethics approval from the IRCCS Burlo Garofolo hospital in Trieste, Italy. It was used to study the genetics of the senses, such as taste, food preferences, hearing and vision, in these isolated populations.

label: Shanghai Jiao Tong University Diabetes Study
definition: A study of type 2 diabetes and glucose metabolism in Han Chinese run from the Shanghai Diabetes Institute of Shanghai Jiao Tong University. Its participants, probands of type 2 diabetes pedigrees diagnosed before age 40 with normoglycaemic controls over 50 without a family history of diabetes recruited at the institute, and people with normal glucose tolerance drawn from the community-based Shanghai Diabetes Study I and II, were genotyped for East Asian genome-wide association studies of type 2 diabetes and fasting glucose.

label: Städtisches Klinikum Karlsruhe Deutsches Krebsforschungszentrum Study
other synonyms: St_dtisches Klinikum Karlsruhe Deutsches Krebsforschungszentrum Study
definition: A hospital-based breast cancer study, supported by the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ), of women diagnosed with primary in situ or invasive breast cancer at the Städtisches Klinikum Karlsruhe, Germany, from March 1993 to July 2005, with controls selected from the German Consortium for Hereditary Breast and Ovarian Cancer (GC-HBOC); it contributes to the Breast Cancer Association Consortium.

label: South Korea Multi-Center Lung Cancer Study
definition: A South Korean multi-centre lung cancer study that brings together three previously described case-control studies of ethnic Koreans, the Seoul National University study, the Korea University Medical Center study and the Kyungpook National University Hospital study, which recruited lung cancer patients at university hospitals and a lung cancer research centre and controls from hospital health check-up programmes; it takes part in the Female Lung Cancer Consortium in Asia as one study.

label: Småbørns Kost Og Trivsel
other synonyms: Diet and Thriving in Young Children|SKOT cohort|Småbørns Kost Og Trivsel study|Småbørns Kost og Trivsel
definition: An observational cohort of healthy, singleton, term-born young children from the greater Copenhagen area, Denmark, run by the Department of Nutrition, Exercise and Sports at the University of Copenhagen, which followed them from 9 to 36 months of age: SKOT I enrolled infants selected at random from the Danish Civil Registry in 2007–2008 and examined them at 9, 18 and 36 months, and SKOT II enrolled, under the same protocol, infants of obese mothers from a trial of obese pregnant women at Hvidovre Hospital, to study diet, growth, body composition, development and early determinants of overweight.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to eating behavior (ECTO:6000021)

label: Shenyang Lung Cancer Study
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of lung cancer in never-smoking ethnic Chinese women in Shenyang, Liaoning Province, northeast China, whose cases had histologically confirmed lung cancer and whose controls were non-smoking women with other lung diseases but free of cancer, frequency-matched to the cases on age; it is one of the studies pooled in the Female Lung Cancer Consortium in Asia.

label: Sri Lankan Diabetes Study
other synonyms: Sri Lankan Diabetes Studies
definition: A Sri Lankan type 2 diabetes case-control study whose cases came mostly from the Sri Lankan Young Diabetes Study of patients with early-onset diabetes recruited from the three largest hospitals in Sri Lanka, augmented with diabetes cases from the Sri Lankan Diabetes Cardiovascular Study, and whose controls were participants in the Sri Lankan Diabetes Cardiovascular Study, a cross-sectional nationally representative epidemiological investigation.

label: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus in Gullah Health Study
other synonyms: SLE in Gullah Health|SLE in Gullah Health Study|SLE in Gullah Health study|The Systemic Lupus Erythematosus in Gullah Health study
definition: A longitudinal observational cohort study of systemic lupus erythematosus among the Gullah African Americans of the Sea Island region of South Carolina, United States, run from the Medical University of South Carolina, which enrols self-identified Gullah patients with lupus meeting the American College of Rheumatology classification criteria, their relatives, and unrelated unaffected Gullah controls, to study the genetic and environmental factors that contribute to lupus in this population. It is one of the community-engaged Sea Island Families Project studies.

label: Prevalence of osteoporosis in Slovenia
definition: A cross-sectional, population-based study of osteoporosis in Ljubljana, Slovenia, created within projects funded by the Slovenian Research Agency, that included premenopausal women aged 35 to 50 years and postmenopausal women and men aged over 50 years in order to carry out genotype-phenotype association studies; it was one of the studies de novo genotyped for the replication stage of the 2012 GEFOS genome-wide meta-analysis of bone mineral density and fracture.

label: Study of Myocardial Infarctions Leiden
other synonyms: Study of Myocardial Infarction in LEiden
definition: A population-based case-control study from Leiden, the Netherlands, of men born in the Netherlands, comparing men younger than 70 years who had a first myocardial infarction between 1990 and 1996 with control men without a history of myocardial infarction, frequency-matched on 10-year age groups, used to study coagulation and fibrinolytic factors, their genetic variants and cardiovascular risk factors as risk factors for myocardial infarction.

label: Scotland and Newcastle Lymphoma Group
other synonyms: Scotland and Newcastle Lymphoma Group series
definition: A population-based series of patients with Hodgkin lymphoma in Scotland and northern England, collected through the Scotland and Newcastle Lymphoma Group, a clinical collaborative group that registered lymphoma patients in these regions prospectively on a shared database from 1979; the genetic series comprises the Scotland and Newcastle Epidemiological Study of Hodgkin's Disease, a case–control study conducted in 1993–1997, and a local case series collected prospectively in 1992–2008, and its cases were genotyped in European genome-wide association studies of classical Hodgkin lymphoma.

label: SNP Prostate Ghent
other synonyms: RGC-UGhent cohort|SNP Prostate Ghent (Belgium)
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of prostate cancer at Ghent University Hospital, Belgium, whose cases are men treated with intensity-modulated radiotherapy as primary or postoperative treatment for prostate cancer at the hospital between 2000 and 2010, first genotyped to study genetic markers of radiation toxicity, and whose controls are employees of the hospital and members of social activity clubs without a history of any cancer.

label: Southern Ostrobothnia isolate GWAS
other synonyms: Southern Ostrobothnia (SO) isolate GWAS
definition: A Finnish case-control sample of multiple sclerosis patients with both parents, or one parent and a family history of multiple sclerosis, from Southern Ostrobothnia, the internal isolate on the western coast of Finland with an increased prevalence and familial clustering of multiple sclerosis, and population-based controls, drawn from the Health 2000 project, matched to them by genome-wide identity-by-state sharing and parental birthplace, that formed the genome-wide association stage of a 2010 study of multiple sclerosis in that isolate.

label: Southampton Ovarian Cancer Study
definition: A hospital-based, case-only series of women with epithelial ovarian cancer in the Wessex region of southern England, made up of consecutive patients who underwent primary surgery at hospitals in the region between 1993 and 1998, that takes part in the Ovarian Cancer Association Consortium under the study code SOC.

label: Study of Irish Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
other synonyms: Study of Irish Amyotrophic|study of Irish Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
definition: A case–control collection of Irish patients with sporadic amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, diagnosed by consultant neurologists by the El Escorial criteria and drawn from across the island of Ireland, and unrelated neurologically normal controls, all reporting Irish ancestry for at least three generations, assembled in Dublin (Beaumont Hospital, Trinity College and University College Dublin) for a genome-wide association study of susceptibility to sporadic ALS in the Irish population, and later used for whole-genome sequencing of an Irish control.
diseases: patients with: sporadic amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (MONDO:0005145)

label: Stabilization of pLaques usIng Darapladib-Thrombolysis in Myocardial Infarction
other synonyms: Stabilization of Plaques Using Darapladib|Stabilization of Plaques Using Darapladib-Thrombolysis in Myocardial Infarction 52|The Stabilization of PLaques UsIng Darapladib-Thrombolysis in Myocardial Infarction 52 Trial|The Stabilization of pLaques usIng Darapladib-Thrombolysis in Myocardial Infarction
definition: A randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicentre trial that enrolled patients with an acute coronary syndrome in 36 countries between 2009 and 2011, to determine the clinical benefit of direct inhibition of lipoprotein-associated phospholipase A2 with darapladib versus placebo.

label: Southern Ontario Ovarian Cancer Study
other synonyms: Southern Ontario Study of Reproduction, Diet and Health
definition: A population-based case–control study of epithelial ovarian cancer in metropolitan Toronto and nearby areas of southern Ontario, Canada, which from 1989 to 1992 interviewed women aged 35–79 with newly diagnosed, histologically confirmed malignant or borderline epithelial ovarian tumours, identified through the Ontario Cancer Registry, and randomly selected population controls frequency-matched to them on age, about their reproductive history and diet. It is one of the case–control studies of the Ovarian Cancer Association Consortium.
diseases: patients with: borderline epithelial tumor of ovary (MONDO:0016093)|patients with: ovarian carcinoma (MONDO:0005140)
exposures: designed to study: exposure to eating behavior (ECTO:6000021)

label: Swedish Obese Subjects Study
other synonyms: Swedish Obese Subjects study
definition: A prospective, controlled intervention study in Sweden in which severely obese adults aged 37 to 60, recruited between 1987 and 2001, either underwent bariatric surgery or received usual obesity care as a matched control group, and were followed long term for the effects of surgically induced weight loss.

label: Serum Proteomic analysis for biomarkers of Aggressive prostate disease in the Guernsey population
definition: A hospital-based, retrospective, observational case-control study of men from Guernsey, with prostate cancer cases and controls drawn from the island's population and the study run from Manchester and Southampton, UK, to look for serum proteomic biomarkers of aggressive prostate cancer.

label: Determining the Molecular Pathways and Genetic Predisposition of the Acute Inflammatory Process Caused by SARS-CoV-2
other synonyms: SPGRX cohort|SPGRX study
definition: A Spanish study of the molecular pathways and genetic predisposition behind the acute inflammatory response to SARS-CoV-2, run from the GENYO Centre for Genomics and Oncological Research in Granada, whose participants, patients with laboratory-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection whose blood was sampled on arrival at the emergency ward of the Hospital Clínico Universitario de Valladolid (from March 2020) or the Hospital Regional Universitario de Málaga (from August 2020), together with SARS-CoV-2 PCR-negative individuals, were genotyped on the Illumina Infinium Global Screening Array and profiled for whole-blood DNA methylation; it contributed to the COVID-19 Host Genetics Initiative.

label: Secondary Prevention of Small Subcortical Strokes
other synonyms: Secondary Prevention of Small Subcortical Strokes trial
definition: A randomised, multicentre phase III secondary-prevention trial in patients with recent, MRI-confirmed symptomatic lacunar (small subcortical) stroke, recruited between 2003 and 2011 at clinical centres in North America, Latin America and Spain, which tested in a two-by-two factorial design aspirin plus clopidogrel against aspirin alone and a lower against a higher systolic blood-pressure target for preventing recurrent stroke.

label: Scottish Randomised Trial in Ovarian Cancer
other synonyms: Scottish Randomised Trial in Ovarian Cancer I|Scottish Randomised Trial in Ovarian Cancer study
definition: An international multicentre phase III randomised trial (SCOTROC1) of first-line docetaxel-carboplatin versus paclitaxel-carboplatin chemotherapy for stage Ic–IV epithelial ovarian or primary peritoneal cancer, coordinated through a clinical trials unit in Glasgow and recruiting patients in the United Kingdom, elsewhere in Europe, the United States and Australasia, whose patients were followed for progression-free and overall survival and whose DNA has been used in pharmacogenetic studies and in the Ovarian Cancer Association Consortium's studies of ovarian cancer outcome.
diseases: patients with: ovarian carcinoma (MONDO:0005140)|patients with: primary peritoneal carcinoma (MONDO:0015686)

label: South Stockholm Ischemic Stroke Study
definition: A case-control study of ischaemic cerebrovascular disease in southern Stockholm, Sweden, whose stroke patients underwent clinical investigation and standardised blood tests and whose patients and controls were genotyped for 100 polymorphisms in 47 candidate susceptibility genes to study the genetic profile of ischaemic stroke and its subtypes.

label: Genomic epidemiology of SARS-Cov-2 and host genetics in Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19)
definition: A COVID-19 pandemic-tracking study at Stanford Health Care in northern California that, from March to July 2020, collected the residual nasopharyngeal swab media of clinical SARS-CoV-2 tests from approximately consecutive SARS-CoV-2-positive and -negative patients, linked them to electronic health record data, and sequenced the patients' genomes at low coverage together with viral genomes and transcriptomes, to study host genetic, viral and clinical correlates of COVID-19 severity; it contributed its host genetic data to the COVID-19 Host Genetics Initiative.

label: Strabismus, Amblyopia and Refractive Error Study in Singaporean Chinese Preschoolers
other synonyms: STARS study|Strabismus, Amblyopia and Refractive Error Study|Strabismus, Amblyopia and Refractive Error in Singaporean Children|Strabismus, Amblyopia, and Refractive Error Study|Strabismus, Amblyopia, and Refractive Error Study in Singaporean Chinese Preschoolers|Strabismus, Amblyopia, and Refractive Error Study of Preschool Children|Strabismus, Amblyopia, and Refractive Error in Singapore children Study|Strabismus, Amblyopia, and Refractive Error in Young Singaporean Children Study
definition: A population-based study of Chinese children aged 6 to 72 months living in south-western and western Singapore, recruited door to door from 2006 to 2008 with disproportionate random sampling in 6-month age bands, who had parental questionnaires and eye examinations including visual acuity, cycloplegic autorefraction, ocular biometry and retinal photography, to study strabismus, amblyopia and refractive error in preschool children; a family study in 2008-2010 added parents and siblings.
diseases: population study of: amblyopia (MONDO:0001020)|population study of: refractive error (MONDO:0004892)|population study of: strabismus (MONDO:0003432)

label: Singapore Translational and Clinical Research in Psychosis
other synonyms: Singapore Translational & Clinical Research in Psychosis|Singapore Translational and Clinical Research Psychosis|The Singapore Translational and Clinical Research in Psychosis
definition: A five-year national flagship research programme on psychosis in Singapore, based at the Institute of Mental Health, made up of three linked studies: a genome-wide association and copy-number study of schizophrenia and its cognitive phenotypes, a prospective study of people at ultra-high risk of psychosis, and a randomized controlled trial to improve neurocognition in schizophrenia. Its schizophrenia study recruited outpatients and inpatients of Chinese ethnicity aged 21 to 55 with DSM-IV schizophrenia at the Institute of Mental Health from 2008 to 2011.
diseases: patients with: psychotic disorder (MONDO:0005485)|patients with: schizophrenia (MONDO:0005090)

label: Stockholm 2
other synonyms: STHM1, STHM2, Stockholm-1, Stockholm-2, STHLM, STHLM2|The Stockholm Study
definition: A population-based cohort of men referred for prostate-specific antigen testing in laboratories in Stockholm County, Sweden, who were invited at the blood-sampling visit between 2010 and 2012, with prostate cancer diagnoses and biopsy results taken from the National Prostate Cancer Register and regional records; it supplied prostate cancer cases and controls to international genetic studies.

label: Special Turku Coronary Risk Factor Intervention Project
other synonyms: STRIP study|Special Turku coronary Risk factor Intervention Project for babies
definition: A randomised controlled trial in Turku, Finland, that enrolled infants and their parents at well-baby clinics between 1989 and 1992 and gave the intervention group individualised dietary counselling from age 7 months to 20 years, aimed at improving dietary fat quality to prevent cardiovascular disease, while the control group received routine care; participants have been followed into adulthood.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to eating behavior (ECTO:6000021)

label: Simultaneous Study of Gemcitabine-Docetaxel Combination adjuvant treatment, as well as Biological Targeted Treatment
other synonyms: SUCCESS B study|SUCCESS B trial|Simultaneous Study of Gemcitabine-Docetaxel Combination adjuvant treatment
definition: An open-label, multicentre, randomised phase III trial in Germany that enrolled patients with HER2-positive, intermediate-to-high-risk early breast cancer between 2008 and 2011 and compared adjuvant chemotherapy of three cycles of fluorouracil, epirubicin and cyclophosphamide followed by three cycles of docetaxel with the same followed by three cycles of gemcitabine and docetaxel, all patients then receiving trastuzumab for a year.
diseases: patients with: HER2 positive breast carcinoma (MONDO:0006244)

label: Simultaneous Study of Docetaxel Based Anthracycline Free Adjuvant Treatment Evaluation, as well as Life Style Intervention Strategies
other synonyms: SUCCESS C study|SUCCESS C trial|Simultaneous Study of Docetaxel Based Anthracycline Free Adjuvant Treatment Evaluation
definition: An open-label, multicentre, randomised phase III trial at study sites in Germany that enrolled patients with HER2-negative early breast cancer between 2009 and 2011 and compared anthracycline-containing with anthracycline-free (docetaxel and cyclophosphamide) adjuvant chemotherapy, with a second randomisation of patients with a body mass index of 24 to 40 kg/m2 to an individualised two-year telephone lifestyle intervention aiming at moderate weight loss or to general lifestyle recommendations.
diseases: patients with: Her2-receptor negative breast cancer (MONDO:0000618)
exposures: designed to study: exposure to Physical Activity (ECTO:6000039)|designed to study: exposure to dietary intervention (ECTO:2000068)

label: Suita Study
other synonyms: suita study
definition: A population-based prospective cohort of residents of Suita, an urban city in Osaka, Japan, made up of two groups randomly selected from the general population by sex and 10-year age group (recruited in 1989 and 1998) and a volunteer group (recruited 1992-2006), who had a baseline health examination with questionnaire, clinical examination, blood and urine analysis and electrocardiogram at the National Cerebral and Cardiovascular Center and return there every two years for follow-up, to investigate risk factors for cardiovascular disease.

label: SUpplementation en VItamines et Minéraux AntioXydants
other synonyms: SU.VI.MAX study|SUVIMAX study|SUpplémentation en VItamines et Minéraux AntioXydants|Supplementation en Vitamines et Mineraux Antioxydants|Supplementation en Vitamines et Mineraux Antioxydants Study
definition: A randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled primary-prevention trial in the general adult population of France, which in 1994 enrolled women aged 35 to 60 and men aged 45 to 60 and followed them for eight years to test whether daily supplementation with antioxidant vitamins (vitamin C, vitamin E and beta-carotene) and minerals (selenium and zinc) at nutritional doses reduces cancers and cardiovascular diseases.

label: Suzhou study on hypertension
other synonyms: Suzhou Study|Suzhou study
definition: A cross-sectional survey of hypertension carried out in 2010 in four urban communities and four rural villages of the Jinchang district of Suzhou, Jiangsu province, China, whose 3,061 participants were Han Chinese adults aged 30 years or older without end-organ damage, chronic renal disease, tumours or urinary tract infections, with questionnaire, anthropometric and blood pressure data. All its participants were genotyped as a de novo replication sample of the Asian Genetic Epidemiology Network's genome-wide association meta-analysis of mean arterial and pulse pressure.

label: Shanghai-Vanderbilt Colorectal Cancer Genetic Project
other synonyms: Shanghai-Vanderbilt Colorectal Cancer Genetics Project
definition: A colorectal cancer case-control study nested in two population-based cohorts in urban Shanghai, China, the Shanghai Women's Health Study and the Shanghai Men's Health Study, whose cases were colorectal cancer patients identified among the cohorts' participants and whose controls were cancer-free participants of the same cohorts frequency-matched to the cases by age and sex. Its samples, with additional community controls from the Shanghai Breast Cancer Study, were genotyped as the Shanghai-1 and Shanghai-2 sets of the discovery stage of the Asia Colorectal Cancer Consortium's genome-wide association study.

label: Sweden Western Region Ovarian Cancer Study
