definition: An ovarian cancer study in the western region of Sweden, a member study of the Ovarian Cancer Association Consortium, that contributed ovarian cancer cases and controls to the consortium's OncoArray genotyping project; it is funded by the Swedish Cancer Foundation, WeCanCureCancer and the årKampMotCancer foundation.

label: Swedish Breast Cancer Study
other synonyms: Swedish BRCA1 and BRCA2 study
definition: A cancer clinic-based study of carriers of pathogenic BRCA1 and BRCA2 variants in Sweden, run by collaborators at the university hospitals of Lund, Gothenburg (Sahlgrenska), Stockholm (Karolinska), Umeå, Uppsala and Linköping and supported by the Swedish Cancer Society, that contributes its carriers to the Consortium of Investigators of Modifiers of BRCA1/2 (CIMBA).
diseases: at risk of: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|at risk of: ovarian cancer (MONDO:0008170)

label: Swiss Memory Genetics Study
definition: A genetic study of memory performance in healthy young Swiss adults aged 18 to 45 years, university students or age-matched employees and trainees recruited at the University of Zürich and the University of Basel, whose verbal episodic memory is measured by an unexpected delayed free recall of visually presented words and who are genotyped at the Biozentrum of the University of Basel.

label: Southampton Women's Survey
other synonyms: Southampton Womens Survey
definition: A prospective mother-offspring cohort of non-pregnant women aged 20 to 34 years from the general population of Southampton, UK, recruited through their general practitioners between 1998 and 2002 and characterised before pregnancy; the women who later became pregnant were followed through pregnancy, and their children through infancy and childhood, to study how maternal characteristics and the children's prenatal and postnatal growth affect their development and their risk factors for chronic diseases.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to eating behavior (ECTO:6000021)

label: IHCC-Szczecin Breast Cancer Study
definition: A breast cancer case-control study in Szczecin, West Pomerania, Poland, run from the International Hereditary Cancer Center of the Pomeranian Medical University and a member study of the Breast Cancer Association Consortium, whose cases are prospectively ascertained patients with invasive breast cancer diagnosed at the Regional Oncology Hospital or the University Hospital in Szczecin in 2002–2007, and whose controls were drawn from a population-based study of the inhabitants of West Pomerania in 2003–2004, matched to cases for year of birth, sex and region.

label: Tulsa 1000 study
other synonyms: Tulsa 1000|Tulsa-1000 study
definition: A naturalistic, longitudinal observational study run by the Laureate Institute for Brain Research in Tulsa, Oklahoma, United States, that recruited healthy controls and treatment-seeking individuals with mood, anxiety, substance use and eating disorders from the Tulsa metropolitan area from 2015 to 2018 and assessed them at levels from self-report, behaviour and physiology to neuroimaging, cells, molecules and genes, following the NIMH Research Domain Criteria, to predict symptom severity, treatment outcome and prognosis.
diseases: patients with: anxiety disorder (MONDO:0005618)|patients with: eating disorder (MONDO:0005451)|patients with: mood disorder (MONDO:0005371)|patients with: substance-related disorder (MONDO:0002494)

label: Type 2 Diabetes Global Genomics Initiative
definition: An international initiative that assembled genome-wide association studies of type 2 diabetes from studies in six ancestry groups (African American, East Asian, European, Hispanic, South African and South Asian), among them the DIAMANTE Consortium and the Million Veteran Program, and meta-analysed them to characterise the genetic contribution to type 2 diabetes and its aetiological heterogeneity across populations.

label: Tromso-6 Migraine
definition: A genotyped case-control sample from the sixth wave of the Tromsø Study, the population-based health study of the municipality of Tromsø in Northern Norway, in which participants who reported headache in the past year meeting modified ICHD criteria for migraine, or who reported previous or current migraine, were taken as migraine cases and the other participants genotyped as controls, first used in the International Headache Genetics Consortium's genome-wide meta-analysis of migraine.

label: TAiwan Coronary and Transcatheter intervention
definition: A hospital-based cohort of patients with angina pectoris and objective documentation of myocardial ischaemia who underwent diagnostic coronary angiography or revascularisation at National Taiwan University Hospital at any time after October 2000, with questionnaire data including cardiovascular medication, electronic medical records and fasting blood samples taken before cardiac catheterisation. Collected independently of the similar TCAGEN study at the same hospital, it is one of the seven Taiwan-based cohorts of the TAICHI consortium.

label: Tampa Lung Cancer Study
other synonyms: The Washington State University Lung Cancer Study
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of lung cancer run from Washington State University at the H. Lee Moffitt Cancer Center in Tampa, Florida, United States, whose cases were patients with histologically confirmed primary lung cancer identified at the centre in 1999–2002 and recruited within a year of diagnosis, and whose cancer-free controls, matched to cases on age, race and sex, were recruited at the centre's affiliated Lifetime Cancer Screening Center.

label: Finnish Genetic Predisposition to Prostate Cancer Study
other synonyms: Tampere University Hospital|Tampere study
definition: A population-based prostate cancer case–control study in Finland, run from Tampere, whose cases were identified through linkage to the Finnish Cancer Registry, patient records and the Finnish arm of the European Randomized Study of Screening for Prostate Cancer (ERSPC), and whose controls are ERSPC cohort participants without a cancer diagnosis; it contributes to the PRACTICAL consortium.

label: The Admixture and Neurodegeneration Genomic Landscape
other synonyms: The Admixture and Neurodegeneration Genomic Landscape Study
definition: A genome sequencing study of Colombians with neurodegenerative disease, chiefly early-onset or autosomal dominant Alzheimer's disease, the frontotemporal lobar degeneration–motor neuron disease spectrum and other early-onset dementias, together with affected and healthy relatives and unrelated healthy participants, recruited or referred to the Grupo de Neurociencias de Antioquia of the University of Antioquia, Medellín, Colombia, with recruitment targeting early-onset dementia and families with several affected first-degree relatives, to study the admixture and rare disease-causing variants underlying neurodegeneration in Colombia.
diseases: patients with: Alzheimer disease (MONDO:0004975)|patients with: dementia (MONDO:0001627)|patients with: neurodegenerative disease (MONDO:0005559)

label: Comparative Evaluation of Novel Screening Strategies for Colorectal Cancer Screening
other synonyms: TARGET-C colorectal cancer screening trial (China)|TARGET-C study|TARGET-C trial
definition: A multicentre randomised controlled trial of colorectal cancer screening at six study centres in five Chinese provinces (Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui, Hunan and Yunnan), which from May 2018 recruited adults aged 50–74 years from community-based screening programmes and randomised them to one-time colonoscopy, annual faecal immunochemical testing or a risk-adapted strategy (colonoscopy for high-risk and faecal immunochemical testing for low-risk participants), over four annual screening rounds completed in 2023.

label: Tasmanian Study of Cognition and Gait
other synonyms: Tasmanian study of cognition and gait
definition: A population-based longitudinal cohort of community-dwelling people aged 60 to 85 randomly selected from the Southern Tasmanian electoral roll in Australia, examined in three phases between 2005 and 2012 with questionnaires, objective gait, cognitive and sensorimotor testing and brain magnetic resonance imaging, to study gait, cognition and brain structure in older people.

label: TASPRAC Study
other synonyms: Tasprac study|University of Tasmania Prostate Cancer Study
definition: The prostate cancer resource of the Menzies Institute for Medical Research, University of Tasmania, in Hobart, made up of the Tasmanian Familial Prostate Cancer Study, begun in the late 1990s, of prostate cancer families of Northern European descent identified through the Menzies Genealogical database, the Tasmanian Cancer Registry and local clinicians, and the population-based Tasmanian Prostate Cancer Case-Control Study, whose cases were ascertained through the Tasmanian Cancer Registry and whose male controls were selected at random from the Tasmanian electoral roll; it contributes to the PRACTICAL consortium.

label: Torino Bladder Cancer Study
other synonyms: Torino Bladder Cancer Case Control Study|Torino bladder cancer study
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of bladder cancer in Torino (Turin), Italy, whose cases were men living in the Torino metropolitan area newly diagnosed with bladder cancer between 1994 and 2006 in the urology departments of the San Giovanni Battista Hospital, and whose controls were men from the same area treated in the same hospital for benign diseases.

label: Tampa Bay Ovarian Cancer Study
definition: A population-based case-control study of epithelial ovarian cancer run by the Moffitt Cancer Center in Tampa, Florida, United States, which since 2000 has recruited women newly diagnosed with ovarian cancer, through rapid case ascertainment in the two most populous counties of the Tampa Bay region, and control women, with data collected by interview.

label: Taichung CAD study
other synonyms: Taichung CAD Study
definition: A hospital-based study of patients with cardiovascular disease receiving care at Taichung Veterans General Hospital in Taichung, Taiwan, chiefly people hospitalised for diagnostic and interventional coronary angiography and treatment, together with patients with a history of myocardial infarction or coronary revascularisation, whose angiographic and clinical records are used to study the severity and outcomes of stable coronary artery disease and whose DNA contributes to the TAICHI Consortium's genetic studies.
diseases: patients with: cardiovascular disorder (MONDO:0004995)|patients with: coronary artery disorder (MONDO:0005010)

label: Taiwan Coronary Artery Disease GENetic study
definition: An ongoing hospital-based cohort of patients undergoing coronary angiography or percutaneous coronary intervention for stable angina pectoris or prior myocardial infarction at National Taiwan University Hospital, enrolling patients both in the north of Taiwan, where the main hospital is, and at a branch of the hospital in south-central Taiwan, with electronic medical records, fasting blood samples taken before cardiac catheterisation and blood collected in the catheter laboratory for DNA. It is one of the seven Taiwan-based cohorts of the TAICHI consortium.
diseases: patients with: Angina pectoris (HP:0001681)|patients with: myocardial infarction (MONDO:0005068)

label: Tehran Cardiometabolic Genetic Study
other synonyms: Tehran cardiometabolic genetic study
definition: A family-based, population-based genetic cohort in Tehran, Iran, designed by the Research Institute for Endocrine Sciences in collaboration with deCODE genetics, that genotyped participants of the Tehran Lipid and Glucose Study genome-wide and links their genotypes to the behavioural, biochemical and clinical data collected since 1999, later extended to participants of four ongoing studies with periodic follow-up, to identify genetic factors in cardiometabolic risk factors, cancers and other non-communicable diseases.

label: Transcontinental COPD Genetics Study
definition: A case-control genetic study of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease made up of two case-control studies, one in Poland, enrolled through the Institute of Tuberculosis and Lung Diseases in Warsaw, and one in Korea, at four university hospitals, which recruited smokers aged 40 to 80 with at least 10 pack-years of smoking: cases with severe to very severe airflow obstruction and controls with normal lung function.
diseases: patients with: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (MONDO:0005002)
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to Cigarette Smoking (ECTO:6000038)

label: Tennessee Colorectal Polyp Study
definition: A colonoscopy-based case-control study of colorectal polyps conducted by Vanderbilt University Medical Center in Nashville, Tennessee, from 2003 to 2010, which enrolled patients undergoing colonoscopy at the Vanderbilt gastroenterology clinic and the Nashville Veterans Affairs medical centre, taking those found to have adenomatous or hyperplastic polyps as cases and polyp-free patients as controls, to study dietary, lifestyle and genetic risk factors for colorectal polyps.
diseases: patients with: colorectal adenoma (MONDO:0005484)|patients with: hyperplastic polyp (MONDO:0006249)

label: The Environmental Determinants of Diabetes in the Young Study
other synonyms: The Environmental Determinants of Diabetes in the Young|The Environmental Determinants of Diabetes in the Young (TEDDY) Study|The Environmental Determinants of Diabetes in the Young (TEDDY) study
definition: A multicentre, multinational prospective birth cohort study, run from six clinical centres in the United States, Finland, Germany and Sweden, that screened newborns from the general population and first-degree relatives of people with type 1 diabetes for high-risk HLA genotypes, enrolled eligible children before four months of age and follows them to age 15, to identify infectious, dietary and other environmental exposures associated with islet autoimmunity and type 1 diabetes.
diseases: at risk of: type 1 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005147)
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)|designed to study: exposure to eating behavior (ECTO:6000021)|designed to study: exposure to organism (ECTO:3000000)

label: The Epidemiology and Natural History of Asthma: Outcomes and Treatment Regimens
other synonyms: Epidemiology and Natural History of Asthma: Outcomes and Treatment Regimens|TENOR I study|TENOR study|The Epidemiology and Natural History of Asthma: Outcomes and Treatment Regimens (TENOR) study
definition: A 3-year multicentre observational cohort study of patients aged 6 years or older with severe or difficult-to-treat asthma, enrolled from January to October 2001 by more than 400 pulmonologists and allergists in the United States and sponsored by Genentech and Novartis, with data on demographics, medical history, comorbidities, asthma control, health care use, medication use, lung function, IgE levels, asthma triggers and quality of life collected semiannually and annually to characterise the natural history of the disease.

label: Twins Eye Study in Tasmania
other synonyms: Twin Eye Study in Tasmania|Twins Eye Study Tasmania|Twins eye study in Tasmania
definition: A study of the eyes of twins, begun in 2000 by the University of Tasmania and the Centre for Eye Research Australia, that recruited twins aged five years and over and some of their siblings, mostly in Tasmania, Australia, through earlier Tasmanian cohort studies, the Australian Twin Registry, schools and local publicity, and gave them ophthalmic examinations, to find genes for blinding eye diseases and quantitative eye traits.

label: Han Chinese Cell and Genome Bank in Taiwan
other synonyms: Han Chinese cell and genome bank in Taiwan|Han-Chinese Cell and Genome Bank in Taiwan|Taiwan Han Chinese Cell and Genome Bank
definition: A biobank of healthy Han Chinese people in Taiwan, recruited between October 2002 and January 2004 by stratified three-stage probability cluster sampling through the registries of the non-aboriginal townships and city districts of Taiwan, whose DNA has served as population controls for genetic association studies, among them the Taiwan Super Control Study.

label: Tianjin Study
other synonyms: Tianjin study
definition: A hospital-based case–control study of breast cancer in Tianjin, China, whose cases were women with histopathologically diagnosed primary breast cancer recruited consecutively from the Department of Breast Surgery of Tianjin Cancer Institute and Hospital, Tianjin Medical University, and whose controls were women without evidence of cancer who attended health screening at the same hospital, frequency-matched to the cases on age; all participants were unrelated ethnic Han Chinese women who were permanent residents of urban Tianjin. Its study period was 2004 to 2008, and it is one of the participating studies of the Asia Breast Cancer Consortium.

label: Trial of Intensified versus standard Medical therapy in Elderly patients with Congestive Heart Failure
other synonyms: Trial of Intensified Versus Standard Medical Therapy in Elderly Patients with Congestive Heart Failure|Trial of Intensified versus Standard Medical Therapy in Elderly Patients with Congestive Heart Failure|Trial of Intensified vs Standard Medical Therapy in Elderly Patients With Congestive Heart Failure
definition: A prospective, single-blinded, multicentre randomised trial, run at centres in Switzerland and Germany from 2003 to 2008, in which patients aged 60 years or over with symptomatic congestive heart failure, a heart-failure hospitalisation within the previous year and raised NT-proBNP were randomised to NT-proBNP-guided (intensified) or symptom-guided (standard) medical therapy, to compare the two strategies in patients aged 75 or over and aged 60 to 74, with reduced or preserved ejection fraction.

label: Total Lung Cancer Study
other synonyms: Total Lung Cancer (TLC) Study|Total Lung Cancer: Molecular Epidemiology of Lung Cancer Survival
definition: A hospital-based, case-only study of the molecular epidemiology of lung cancer survival at the H. Lee Moffitt Cancer Center in Tampa, Florida, United States, whose participants are lung cancer patients recruited from Moffitt's Thoracic Oncology Clinic between April 2006 and August 2010 under the centre's Total Cancer Care protocol, which collects self-reported, medical record and cancer registry data and blood samples.

label: Tianjin Lung Cancer Study
definition: A case–control study of lung cancer in Tianjin, China, whose cases were patients with newly diagnosed, histologically confirmed primary non-small cell lung cancer at Tianjin Medical University Cancer Hospital, excluding those with a previous cancer or earlier radiotherapy or chemotherapy, and whose controls were people attending regular health check-ups in the same period who lived in the same or nearby neighbourhoods, frequency-matched to the cases on sex and age; all participants were ethnic Chinese. Its never-smoking women were genotyped genome-wide as one of the studies of the Female Lung Cancer Consortium in Asia.
diseases: patients with: non-small cell lung carcinoma (MONDO:0005233)

label: Tehran Lipid and Glucose Study
other synonyms: Tehran lipid and glucose study
definition: A community-based prospective study of a representative sample of residents of district 13 of Tehran, Iran, aged 3 years and over and selected by multistage stratified cluster random sampling, designed in 1997 and begun in 1999 as a cross-sectional survey of non-communicable disease risk factors; from 2002 it became a long-term longitudinal study, including a controlled community lifestyle intervention, with follow-up examinations about every three years.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to Physical Activity (ECTO:6000039)|designed to study: exposure to eating behavior (ECTO:6000021)|designed to study: exposure to smoking (ECTO:6000013)

label: Tasmanian Longitudinal Health Study
other synonyms: Tasmanian Longitudinal Health STUDY
definition: A population-based cohort study of respiratory health that began in 1968 with a survey of the children born in 1961 who were attending school in Tasmania, Australia, and has followed these probands with repeated surveys and lung function testing from age 7 into their sixth decade, with their parents also surveyed.
diseases: population study of: respiratory system disorder (MONDO:0005087)

label: Triple Negative Breast Cancer Consortium
other synonyms: Triple Negative Breast Cancer Consortium Study|Triple-negative Breast Cancer Consortium
definition: An international consortium of case-control, cohort, case-only and tumour-collection studies of breast cancer in the United States, Australia and Europe that pools women with triple-negative (estrogen receptor-, progesterone receptor- and HER2-negative) breast cancer and controls to study inherited susceptibility to triple-negative breast cancer, and that contributes its case series to the Breast Cancer Association Consortium.

label: Tasmanian Older Adult Cohort Study
other synonyms: Tasmania Older Adult Cohort|Tasmanian Older Adult Cohort|Tasmanian older adult cohort study
definition: A prospective population-based cohort of community-dwelling men and women aged 50 to 79, selected at random in equal numbers by sex from the electoral roll of southern Tasmania, Australia, and enrolled between March 2002 and September 2004, with follow-up assessments, to identify environmental, genetic and biochemical factors in the development and progression of osteoarthritis at multiple sites.

label: Tomsk Study
definition: A family study of asthma conducted from 1998 onwards by the Research Institute of Medical Genetics and Siberian State Medical University in Tomsk, Russia, which recruited nuclear families and extended pedigrees of Russian or mixed East Slavonic origin through probands with atopic bronchial asthma at hospitals in Tomsk and Irkutsk, with probands and relatives clinically examined for asthma and atopy.

label: Thematically Organized Psychosis Research Study
other synonyms: TOP Study|Thematically Organized Psychoses Research Study|Thematically Organized Psychoses Study|Thematically Organized Psychosis Study
definition: An ongoing study of schizophrenia and bipolar disorder based in Oslo, Norway, that since 2003 has recruited patients from in-patient and out-patient psychiatric units, diagnosed by structured clinical interview, together with healthy controls randomly selected from the population records of the same catchment areas.
diseases: patients with: bipolar disorder (MONDO:0004985)|patients with: schizophrenia (MONDO:0005090)

label: Tampere Sudden Death Study
definition: A collection of medico-legal autopsies performed at the Department of Forensic Medicine of the University of Tampere, Finland, on unselected individuals from Tampere and the surrounding regions who died out of hospital from any cause, used to study coronary atherosclerosis, brain pathology such as Lewy-related pathology, and other post-mortem tissue, with risk-factor data gathered by interviewing relatives of the deceased.

label: Tampere Vascular Study
definition: A study of atherosclerosis at Tampere University Hospital, Finland, that collected arterial tissue from patients undergoing open vascular surgery (carotid or femoral endarterectomy, or aortic bypass, for occlusive atherosclerosis), with internal thoracic artery samples from coronary bypass patients as controls, and, in a second arm collected in 2008, whole blood and monocyte samples from patients with angiographically verified coronary artery disease and angiographically normal controls drawn from the patients given an exercise test at the hospital, for gene-expression and genetic studies.

label: Taiwanese Breast Cancer Study
other synonyms: Breast Cancer Study in Taiwan|Breast Cancer Study of Taiwan
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of breast cancer in Taiwan, conducted by the Institute of Biomedical Sciences, Academia Sinica, with the Tri-Service General Hospital in Taipei and supported by the Taiwan Biobank project, that recruited incident breast cancer cases diagnosed and treated at two major teaching hospitals and, as controls, women randomly selected from those attending health examinations at the same hospitals.

label: Utah Cervical Artery Dissection Collection
other synonyms: Utah cervical artery dissection collection
definition: A collection of patients with cervical artery dissection at University Hospital, Salt Lake City, Utah, United States, one of the centres collaborating with the CADISP consortium that recruited patients of European origin, applying the inclusion criteria of the CADISP study, for the second sample (CADISP-2) of the 2015 genome-wide association study of cervical artery dissection.

label: Utrecht Cannabis Cohort
other synonyms: CannabisQuest|Utrecht cannabis cohort
definition: A cohort of young Dutch adults recruited online through a project website launched in 2006, who reported their cannabis use and psychotic-like experiences in a web-based survey; to increase power for gene-environment interaction, a genotyped subset combines participants from the general population with participants selected from the top or bottom quintile of psychotic-like experience scores who were either cannabis non-users or heavy users.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to cannabis (ECTO:0100005)

label: University of California, Irvine Ovarian Cancer Study
other synonyms: UC Irvine Ovarian Cancer Study|UC Irvine Ovarian Cancer Study, California|University of California Irvine Ovarian Cancer Study|University of California Irvine Ovarian Study
definition: A population-based case-control study of epithelial ovarian cancer run by the University of California, Irvine, that recruited women in Southern California (Orange, San Diego and Imperial Counties), United States, and contributed to the Ovarian Cancer Association Consortium.

label: Dutch Bipolar Cohort
other synonyms: DB Cohort|Dutch Bipolar (DB) Cohort|Dutch Bipolar cohort
definition: A multicentre case-control study in the Netherlands, started in 2011 as a collaboration between the University of California Los Angeles and University Medical Center Utrecht with other Dutch mental health care institutes, that collects genetic and phenotypic information on patients with bipolar I disorder, their first-degree relatives and controls, recruited through clinicians, the Dutch bipolar disorder patients' association, pharmacies, advertisements and earlier research studies.

label: London and the South East Region Alzheimer's Disease Study
other synonyms: LASER-AD study|London and South-East Region Alzheimer's Disease Study|London and the South East Region AD project|London and the South East Region Alzheimer's disease project
definition: A naturalistic, prospective cohort of people with Alzheimer's disease and their carers in London and the South East Region of the UK, run from University College London, recruited in 2002-2003 through community mental health teams, memory clinics, care homes, day hospitals and the voluntary sector to be representative of people with Alzheimer's disease in the community by sex, living setting and severity, and followed for up to 54 months to study the progression, characteristics and costs of the disease and the problems of carers.

label: MRC Prion Unit/UCL Department of Neurodegenerative Disease collection
other synonyms: MRC Prion Unit/University College London Department of Neurodegenerative Disease collection
definition: A collection of patients recruited by the MRC Prion Unit and the Department of Neurodegenerative Disease at University College London, UK, with support from the UCLH/UCL Biomedical Centre, from which patients with Alzheimer's disease were contributed as cases to the GERAD genome-wide association studies of Alzheimer's disease.

label: University of California San Francisco Atrial Fibrillation Study
other synonyms: The University of California San Francisco Atrial Fibrillation Study|UCSF Atrial Fibrillation Study
definition: A case set of patients with atrial fibrillation, drawn from the roughly 1,000 patients who came to the University of California San Francisco electrophysiology laboratory for electrophysiology procedures and are held within the UCSF Cardiovascular Research Institute Resource in Arteriosclerosis and Metabolic Disease, San Francisco, United States. Participants were densely phenotyped for electrophysiological characteristics, by interview and review of medical records, with biospecimens collected from intra- and extra-cardiac chambers, for genetic studies of atrial fibrillation; its early-onset cases were whole-genome sequenced in the NHLBI TOPMed programme.

label: UCSD study
definition: A clinic-based case-control collection for genetic studies of age-related macular degeneration, run by the Department of Ophthalmology of the University of California, San Diego, of white patients with age-related macular degeneration and controls aged 60 or over without drusen, enrolled at the Shiley Eye Center, University of California, San Diego, and the Moran Eye Center, University of Utah, examined by visual acuity, slit-lamp biomicroscopy, fundus photography and optical coherence tomography and graded by the Age-Related Eye Disease Study criteria.

label: UFA Study
other synonyms: UFA region study
definition: A case-control study of asthma in the Volga-Ural region of Russia, in which patients with physician-diagnosed asthma and healthy controls matched on age and sex, of Russian, Tatar and Bashkir origin, were recruited at the Hospital of the Bashkir Medical State University and Ufa Municipal Hospital No. 21 between 1999 and 2007.

label: University of Florida Diabetes Institute Study Bank
other synonyms: UFDI Study Bank|UFDI cohort|University of Florida Diabetes Institute|University of Florida Diabetes Institute cohort
definition: A cross-sectional collection of serum and genomic DNA from people with type 1 diabetes, their first- and second-degree relatives, islet autoantibody-positive at-risk individuals and unaffected controls, recruited from the general population and from outpatient clinics at the University of Florida in Gainesville, Nemours Children's Hospital in Orlando and Emory University in Atlanta, United States, and banked by the University of Florida Diabetes Institute for studies of type 1 diabetes genetic risk and biomarkers.

label: Utrecht Health Project
other synonyms: Leidsche Rijn Gezondheids Project|Leidsche Rijn Gezondheidsproject
definition: A community-based prospective cohort study in Leidsche Rijn, a newly developed residential area of the city of Utrecht, the Netherlands, in which all new inhabitants are invited by their general practitioner to take part, receive a baseline individual health profile from research nurses, and are followed up through continuous linkage with the general practitioners' electronic medical records.

label: UNAM/INCMNSZ Diabetes Study
other synonyms: UNAM/INCMNSZ diabetes study|Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México/Instituto Nacional de Ciencias Médicas y Nutrición Salvador Zubirán diabetes study
definition: A type 2 diabetes case-control study of Mexican-mestizo adults in Mexico City, whose cases were recruited at the outpatient diabetes clinic of the Department of Endocrinology and Metabolism of the Instituto Nacional de Ciencias Médicas y Nutrición Salvador Zubirán (INCMNSZ) and whose normoglycaemic controls were recruited from a cohort of adults aged 45 years or older among government employees, blue-collar workers and people seeking attention in medical units.

label: United Kingdom Asian Diabetes Study
other synonyms: U.K. Asian Diabetes study|UK Asian Diabetes Study
definition: A study of patients with type 2 diabetes in general practices in Birmingham and Coventry, United Kingdom, carried out in 2004-2007, made up of a community-based cluster randomised controlled trial of a culturally sensitive enhanced care package for patients of south Asian origin and a parallel cohort study of cardiovascular risk factors in south Asian and white European patients; its south Asian participants have also contributed to genetic association studies of type 2 diabetes.

label: Breast Cancer Now Male Breast Cancer Study
other synonyms: BCN Male Breast Cancer Study|UK Breast Cancer Now Male Breast Cancer Study
definition: A national population-based case-control study of male breast cancer in England and Wales, set up at the Institute of Cancer Research, London, in 2007 to investigate the aetiology of breast cancer in men, whose cases are men resident in England and Wales diagnosed with invasive or in situ breast cancer at ages 18–79 from 2005 onwards, found through regional cancer registries and consultants, and whose controls are male non-blood relatives of cases and male spouses of women in the Generations Study.

label: UK Biobank Lung Exome Variant Evaluation
other synonyms: UK BiLEVE Cohort Information|UK BiLEVE study
definition: A sub-cohort of UK Biobank participants of European ancestry chosen from the middle and the extremes of the distribution of forced expiratory volume in 1 second among heavy smokers and among never smokers, sampled equally by sex, for nested case-control studies of the genetics of lung function, smoking behaviour and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, and genotyped on the custom UK BiLEVE Axiom array.
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to tobacco smoking (ECTO:6000029)

label: UK Barrett's Oesophagus Gene Study
other synonyms: UK Barrett's Esophagus Gene Study|UK Barrett's oesophagus gene study|UK Barretts Oesophagus Gene Study|UK Gene Study
definition: A United Kingdom study, funded by a Medical Research Council programme grant, of people with Barrett's oesophagus identified at endoscopy with a histopathologically confirmed diagnosis of intestinal metaplasia and recruited across the UK excluding Northern Ireland, whose cases have been used in genetic association studies of Barrett's oesophagus and oesophageal adenocarcinoma.

label: United Kingdom Colorectal Adenoma Prevention trial
other synonyms: UKCAP trial|United Kingdom Colorectal Adenoma Prevention|ukCAP trial
definition: A multicentre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in the United Kingdom and Denmark of aspirin (300 mg/day) and folic acid (0.5 mg/day) in a 2 x 2 factorial design for the prevention of colorectal adenoma recurrence, in patients who had had a colorectal adenoma removed in the six months before recruitment and who were followed up with a second colonoscopy after about three years; DNA from its participants has been used in genetic studies of adenoma risk and recurrence.

label: UK-CLL
other synonyms: CLL-UK1|CLL-UK2|UK-CLL-1|UK-CLL-2|UK-CLL1|UK-CLL2
definition: The two UK case-control genome-wide association studies of chronic lymphocytic leukaemia led by the Institute of Cancer Research: UK-CLL-1, whose cases came from the International CLL Linkage Consortium and the Leukaemia Research Fund CLL4 trial, and UK-CLL-2, whose cases came from a UK national study of CLL genetics coordinated by the Institute of Cancer Research and from the Newcastle CLL Consortium; both used publicly available genotypes of UK controls from the Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium, the 1958 Birth Cohort and the UK Blood Service.
diseases: patients with: B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia (MONDO:0004948)

label: UK Colorectal control
definition: A set of population-based controls from the United Kingdom, taken from a national colorectal cancer genetics study and genotyped on the Illumina HumanHap550 array for a colorectal cancer genome-wide association study, whose existing genotypes were reused as controls in the first stage of an ovarian cancer genome-wide association study.

label: UKCVD
definition: A pooled sample of four European cardiovascular studies with leukocyte telomere length measures: the HIFMECH study (male survivors of a first myocardial infarction and population controls from four centres in Sweden, England, France and Italy), the Simon Broome study (patients with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolaemia from six UK lipid clinics), the University College London Diabetes and Cardiovascular disease Study (UDACS, patients of the diabetes clinic at UCL Hospitals) and the European Atherosclerosis Research Study II (young men whose fathers had a myocardial infarction before the age of 55, and age-matched controls). Under this name its 2,952 myocardial infarction patients and healthy controls of European ancestry were the Stage 2 replication sample of a 2014 genome-wide association study of leukocyte telomere length in Punjabi Sikhs.

label: UK Familial Ovarian Cancer Register
other synonyms: Cancer Research UK familial ovarian Cancer Register|UK Familial Ovarian Cancer Registry|UKCCCR study of familial ovarian cancer|United Kingdom Familial Ovarian Cancer Registries|familial ovarian cancer register
definition: A register of families in the United Kingdom in which at least two people have been diagnosed with ovarian cancer, begun in 1991 as the UKCCCR study of familial ovarian cancer and supported by Cancer Research UK and the University of Cambridge, which recruited until 2009 and collected medical information, family histories and, from some members, blood and tissue samples to study familial risk factors for ovarian cancer.
diseases: at risk of: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|at risk of: ovarian cancer (MONDO:0008170)

label: United Kingdom Graves' disease cohort
other synonyms: UK Graves' disease cohort|United Kingdom Graves disease cohort
definition: The patients with Graves' disease of the United Kingdom's national DNA collection for autoimmune thyroid disease (the AITD National Collection), a multicentre collection of Caucasian patients with Graves' disease or Hashimoto's thyroiditis and their family members, recruited at hospitals across the United Kingdom with clinical and biochemical data collected prospectively under a common protocol and funded by the Wellcome Trust. Its Graves' disease patients have served as cases in genetic association studies of Graves' disease, analysed against British 1958 Birth Cohort controls.

label: UK Genetic Prostate Cancer Study
other synonyms: Uk genetic prostate cancer study
definition: A multi-institutional, longitudinal observational study of prostate cancer in the United Kingdom, conducted through the Royal Marsden NHS Foundation Trust, that since 1992 has recruited men with histologically confirmed prostate cancer in a population-based arm and in arms enriched for young age at onset or a family history of the disease, together with cancer-free men from its clinics as controls, collecting baseline and follow-up clinical data to study inherited susceptibility to prostate cancer and its outcomes.

label: UK and Gilda Radner Familial Ovarian Cancer Registries
definition: The combined contribution to the Consortium of Investigators of Modifiers of BRCA1/2 (CIMBA) of two registries of families with ovarian cancer, the UK Familial Ovarian Cancer Register and the Gilda Radner Familial Ovarian Cancer Registry of Buffalo, New York, providing women carrying BRCA1 or BRCA2 mutations from registered families in the United Kingdom and the United States.
diseases: at risk of: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|at risk of: ovarian cancer (MONDO:0008170)

label: UK HumanCoreExome genotyped IBD study
definition: A genome-wide association study sample of the UK IBD Genetics Consortium, analysed in a 2017 genome-wide association study of inflammatory bowel disease: British patients with Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis or unclassified inflammatory bowel disease, diagnosed by accepted endoscopic, histopathological and radiological criteria and genotyped on the Human Core Exome v12.1, with population controls from the Understanding Society project (the UK Household Longitudinal Study) genotyped on the Human Core Exome v12.0.
diseases: patients with: Crohn disease (MONDO:0005011)|patients with: inflammatory bowel disease (MONDO:0005265)|patients with: ulcerative colitis (MONDO:0005101)

label: UK Ovarian Cancer Population Study
other synonyms: United Kingdom Ovarian Cancer Population Study
definition: A population-based case-control study of ovarian cancer run from University College London at hospitals in England, Wales and Northern Ireland, whose cases are women with an adnexal mass suspicious of ovarian cancer about to undergo surgery or with a confirmed or probable diagnosis of primary invasive or borderline ovarian cancer, and whose controls are women with a possibly benign or borderline adnexal mass and apparently healthy women from the multimodal screening arm of UKCTOCS, set up to find genetic risk factors, markers to add to CA125 and early symptoms of ovarian cancer.

label: UK Prospective Diabetes Study
other synonyms: United Kingdom Prospective Diabetes Study
definition: A multicentre randomised intervention trial in the United Kingdom, begun in 1977 and expanded to 23 centres by 1987, of patients aged 25–65 years with newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes, who after initial diet treatment were randomly allocated to intensive blood-glucose control (with a sulphonylurea or insulin, or metformin for overweight patients) or to conventional diet-based treatment, with the Hypertension in Diabetes Study nested in a factorial design comparing tight with less tight blood-pressure control; its participants were followed for diabetic complications and death for decades after the intervention ended.

label: United Kingdom Rheumatoid Arthritis Genetics
other synonyms: UK Rheumatoid Arthritis Genetics|UK Rheumatoid Arthritis Genetics Consortium|UK Rheumatoid Arthritis Genetics Group
definition: A collection of adult patients with rheumatoid arthritis fulfilling the 1987 American College of Rheumatology criteria, and of healthy controls, assembled for genetic studies by the UK Rheumatoid Arthritis Genetics consortium, a collaboration of six UK rheumatology research groups. Cases were recruited in Manchester, Aberdeen, Leeds, Sheffield, London and Oxford, mostly from NHS rheumatology clinics but also from the Arthritis Research Campaign National Repository of Family Material and the Norfolk Arthritis Register, and controls in five of these centres; its samples were used to replicate and extend rheumatoid arthritis susceptibility loci from genome-wide association studies.

label: UK Small Aneurysm Trial
other synonyms: U.K. Small Aneurysm Trial|United Kingdom Small Aneurysm Trial
definition: A multicentre, open, randomised trial at university and general hospitals across the United Kingdom that allocated patients aged 60–76 years with symptomless abdominal aortic aneurysms 4.0–5.5 cm in diameter to early elective open surgical repair or to ultrasonographic surveillance, comparing mortality, health service costs and quality of life, and following the natural history of small aneurysms in the surveillance group.

label: UK Testicular Cancer Collaboration
definition: The testicular germ cell tumour case series coordinated at the Institute of Cancer Research in the United Kingdom, drawn from a UK study of familial testicular cancer and a national collection of testicular germ cell tumour cases treated in the UK, whose cases were recruited over about 20 years through the UK Testicular Cancer Collaboration, a group of oncologists and surgeons treating the disease across the UK, and used in genome-wide association studies of testicular cancer susceptibility.
diseases: patients with: testicular germ cell tumor (MONDO:0010108)

label: Familial Prostate Cancer Study Ulm
other synonyms: Familial Prostate Cancer Study, University Hopsital of Ulm, Germany|Prostate Cancer Genetics Project of Ulm
definition: A prostate cancer case-control study run by the Institute of Human Genetics and the Department of Urology of Ulm University Hospital, Germany. Familial cases were identified through family-history questionnaires sent by collaborating urologists throughout Germany, sporadic cases came from radical prostatectomy series at the Ulm urology clinic, and controls were men from Ulm without prostate cancer. It is used for linkage and association studies of inherited prostate cancer susceptibility and contributes to the PRACTICAL consortium.

label: University of Miami/Vanderbilt University/Mt. Sinai School of Medicine
other synonyms: University of Miami Hussman Institute for Human Genomics/Vanderbilt University Center for Human Genetics Research/Mount Sinai School of Medicine
definition: A case-control collection of late-onset Alzheimer's disease, whose cases met NINCDS-ADRDA criteria for probable or definite Alzheimer's disease with onset after age 60 and whose controls are cognitively healthy, unrelated people from the same catchment areas frequency-matched by age and sex, ascertained at the University of Miami, Vanderbilt University (later Case Western Reserve University) and Mount Sinai School of Medicine, including autopsy-confirmed cases and controls mainly from Mount Sinai; it is one of the datasets of the Alzheimer's Disease Genetics Consortium.

label: University of North Carolina CanCORS study
definition: The North Carolina site of the Cancer Care Outcomes Research and Surveillance (CanCORS) Consortium, run by the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill: a prospective population-based cohort of patients with colorectal cancer diagnosed between April 2003 and January 2005 in counties of central and eastern North Carolina, United States, identified by rapid case ascertainment through the North Carolina Central Cancer Registry.

label: Prognostic Modelling in Ischaemic Stroke study
other synonyms: PROMISe Study|PROMISe study|Utrecht ImmunoChip Study|Utrecht, The Netherlands ImmunoChip Study Samples
definition: A cohort study of patients with non-disabling cerebral ischaemia of arterial origin referred to the University Medical Center Utrecht, the Netherlands, and included between 1994 and 2009 in the SMART study or the Utrecht Stroke Database, whose patients were genotyped with the Illumina Immunochip and followed up for new vascular events in order to test whether genetic information improves prognostic models for new ischaemic and haemorrhagic events. Its genotyped patients were also the Utrecht Immunochip case sample of genetic association studies of ischaemic stroke.

label: Uppsala Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Cohort Study
definition: A prospective population-based case-control study of abdominal aortic aneurysm in Uppsala, Sweden, in which all 65-year-old men identified through the National Population Registry were invited to an ultrasound examination; it aims to find biomarkers for the cause and progression of abdominal aortic aneurysm and to investigate how people with and without an aneurysm experience their health.

label: URWCI study
other synonyms: RGC-URWCI cohort
definition: A prospective, multicentre observational study of late radiotherapy toxicity that recruited men with prostate cancer without distant metastases who were scheduled for curative-intent radiotherapy (external beam radiotherapy with or without a brachytherapy boost, or brachytherapy alone) between April 2016 and March 2019 at two hospitals in the United States, the University of Rochester Wilmot Cancer Institute and the Medical College of Wisconsin; participants were enrolled before or in the first week of radiotherapy, followed with patient-reported outcomes (the Expanded Prostate Index Composite with added radiation-related questions) at the end of radiotherapy, at 6 months and yearly for up to four years, and genotyped genome-wide, to validate predictive models and biomarkers of toxicity such as hematuria.

label: US Military HIV Natural History Study
other synonyms: Department of Defense Human Immunodeficiency Virus Natural History Study|U.S. Military HIV Natural History Study|US military HIV Natural History Study
definition: A prospective observational cohort, enrolling since 1986, of consenting United States military members, retirees and beneficiaries aged 18 years or older with HIV, who are seen about every six months at participating US military treatment facilities, with systematic collection of demographic characteristics, medication use, laboratory data and medically confirmed clinical events.

label: US Kidney Cancer Study
other synonyms: National Cancer Institue U.S. Kidney Cancer Study|National Cancer Institute United States Kidney Cancer Study|United States Kidney Cancer
definition: A population-based case-control study of renal cell carcinoma run by the US National Cancer Institute in the Chicago (Cook County) and Detroit (Wayne, Macomb and Oakland counties) metropolitan areas, chosen for their high proportion of African American residents. Cases were residents aged 20 to 79 newly diagnosed with histologically confirmed renal cell carcinoma between 2002 and 2007; controls were drawn from motor vehicle and Medicare records and frequency-matched to the cases by age, race and sex, and participants were interviewed about their medical history, tobacco use, occupation, diet, family history of cancer and other factors.

label: Utah Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia Study
other synonyms: Utah Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia GWAS
definition: A case-control study of chronic lymphocytic leukaemia in Utah, United States, whose prevalent cases came from the Huntsman Cancer Hospital's haematology clinics or were identified in the Utah Cancer Registry and verified by medical records and pathology reports, and whose controls, from the same area, were frequency-matched to the cases by sex and birth cohort using the Utah Population Database; it was genotyped genome-wide for studies of genetic susceptibility to the disease.
diseases: patients with: B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia (MONDO:0004948)

label: Utah/Sheffield Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia Collaborative Study
other synonyms: Utah/Sheffield Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia study
definition: A collaborative case-control study of chronic lymphocytic leukemia with sites in Utah, USA, and Sheffield, UK, whose prevalent cases came from the hematology clinics of the Huntsman Cancer Hospital and the Utah Cancer Registry, verified by medical records and pathology reports, and from National Health Service hospitals in the North Trent region of the UK, and whose controls were ascertained from the Utah Population Database; its cases and controls, genotyped at the University of Utah, were a replication series of the genome-wide association studies of chronic lymphocytic leukemia published in 2013 and 2016.
diseases: patients with: B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia (MONDO:0004948)

label: UTAH Study
other synonyms: The Utah Study
definition: A prostate cancer case-control study from Utah, United States, and part of the PRACTICAL consortium. Its cases are prostate cancer cases sampled from extended Utah high-risk pedigrees, chosen so that no two are closely related. Its controls come from other high-risk pedigree studies and have no cancer, no link to a prostate cancer kindred and no first-degree relative with prostate cancer.

label: UWA, LEI & Flinders
definition: A combined age-related macular degeneration case-control sample contributed by the UWA, LEI & Flinders study group to the International AMD Genomics Consortium. Its participants were recruited from the population (UWA) and from ophthalmology clinics (LEI and Flinders), and AMD was graded with the international classification system.

label: University of Wisconsin Transdisciplinary Tobacco Use Research Center Trial
other synonyms: TTURC study|Transdisciplinary Tobacco Use Research Centers Study|UW-TTURC trial|University of Wisconsin Transdisciplinary Tobacco Use Research Center|University of Wisconsin-Transdisciplinary Tobacco Use Research Cente|University of Wisconsin-Transdisciplinary Tobacco Use Research Center|Wisconsin TTURC Cessation Trial
definition: A randomized, placebo-controlled smoking cessation trial of the University of Wisconsin Transdisciplinary Tobacco Use Research Center, run at the University of Wisconsin Center for Tobacco Research and Intervention with participants recruited in Madison and Milwaukee, Wisconsin, United States, in which adults who smoked 10 or more cigarettes a day and were motivated to quit were randomly assigned to placebo, nicotine patch, nicotine lozenge, sustained-release bupropion or a combination, and whose genotyped participants are used in genetic studies of nicotine dependence and smoking cessation.
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to Cigarette Smoking (ECTO:6000038)

label: Val Gardena COVID-19 study
other synonyms: Val Gardena|Val Gardena cohort|Val Gardena/Gröden study
definition: A population-based SARS-CoV-2 study in the Gardena valley (Val Gardena/Gröden) of South Tyrol, Italy, one of the areas most afflicted early in the COVID-19 pandemic, that invited a random sample of the inhabitants of its main municipalities (Ortisei, Santa Cristina and Selva), stratified by municipality, sex and age group, to answer a questionnaire and undergo a nasopharyngeal swab test and a serological antibody test between 26 May and 8 June 2020, towards the end of the first wave, and stored their biological samples at the Eurac Research Biobank; funded by the Healthcare System of the Autonomous Province of Bolzano/Bozen, it later contributed genotyped participants to the COVID-19 Host Genetics Initiative and participants with confirmed infection to a whole-genome sequencing study of COVID-19 host genetics built on the German COVID-19 Omics Initiative.
diseases: population study of: COVID-19 (MONDO:0100096)|population study of: COVID-19 (MONDO:0100096)

label: Vantaa 85+ Study
other synonyms: Vantaa 85+|Vantaa 85+ study|Vantaa85+ study
definition: A population-based study of the oldest old in Finland that includes all people aged 85 years or over who were living in the city of Vantaa, in southern Finland, on 1 April 1991, whose dementia status was assessed at baseline and at three follow-ups in 1994–99 and who underwent general and neuropathological autopsy whenever possible; its genotyped participants have been used in genetic studies of Alzheimer disease and other neuropathology of very old age and as Finnish controls in genome-wide association studies.

label: Viborg Aneurysm Screening Study
other synonyms: Viborg Country AAA screening program|Viborg Study|Viborg study
definition: A single-centre randomised controlled trial of screening for abdominal aortic aneurysm in Viborg County, Denmark, which randomised all men born in 1921–29 who lived in the county in 1994, and those who turned 65 in 1995–98, either to an invitation to abdominal ultrasound screening or to a control group; men found to have an aneurysm of 30–49 mm were offered annual surveillance.
diseases: population study of: abdominal aortic aneurysm (MONDO:0005350)

label: Virginia Cervical Artery Dissection Collection
other synonyms: Virginia Cervical Artery Dissection|Virginia cervical artery dissection collection
definition: A collection of patients with cervical artery dissection at the University of Virginia, Charlottesville, United States, which contributed patients of European origin, meeting the inclusion criteria of the CADISP study, to the second sample (CADISP-2) of the 2015 genome-wide association study of cervical artery dissection and, with controls from the Ischemic Stroke Genetics Study and the Siblings with Ischemic Stroke Study, to its follow-up sample.

label: Vejle Diabetes Biobank
other synonyms: Vejle Biobank
definition: A regional diabetes case-control biobank in Vejle, Denmark, established from 2007 to 2010, holding blood, DNA and urine samples and examination, questionnaire and interview data from patients with diabetes and an age- and sex-matched control population aged 25 to 75, linked to the Danish Civil Registration System, National Patient Registry and National Prescription Registry, for studies of the causes of diabetes and its comorbidities.
diseases: patients with: type 1 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005147)|patients with: type 2 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005148)

label: Verlauf der diagnostischen Abklärung
other synonyms: VERDI study|Verlauf der diagnotischen Abklärung bei Krebspatienten|Verlauf der diagnotischen Abklärung bei Krebspatienten
definition: A population-based, statewide study of patients with newly diagnosed cancers of various sites in Saarland, Germany, identified in the late 1990s by their treating physicians at the hospitals of Saarland and adjacent counties and interviewed about the diagnostic process, to study diagnostic delay and late-stage diagnosis; conducted by epidemiologists of the University of Ulm and the German Centre for Research on Ageing with the Saarland Cancer Registry. It is distinct from the ESTHER cohort, with which consortia pool it as ESTHER/VERDI.
diseases: patients with: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|patients with: colorectal cancer (MONDO:0005575)|patients with: gastric cancer (MONDO:0001056)

label: Victorian Familial Cancer Trials Group
other synonyms: VFCTG study
definition: A cancer clinic-based study of carriers of pathogenic BRCA1 and BRCA2 variants in Victoria, Australia, assembled by the Victorian Familial Cancer Trials Group under the ethics approval of the Peter MacCallum Cancer Centre, which contributes carriers to the Consortium of Investigators of Modifiers of BRCA1/2 (CIMBA) for studies of genetic modifiers of breast and ovarian cancer risk.
diseases: at risk of: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|at risk of: ovarian cancer (MONDO:0008170)

label: Verona Heart Study
other synonyms: Verona Heart Project
definition: An ongoing regional study at the university hospital of Verona, Italy, of adults from the Verona district who underwent coronary angiography, comprising patients with angiographically documented coronary artery disease and coronary artery disease-free subjects angiographed for other reasons (mainly valvular heart disease), with cross-sectional and prospective designs, to search for new risk factors for coronary artery disease and myocardial infarction.

label: Vioxx in Colorectal Cancer Therapy: Definition of Optimal Regime
other synonyms: VICTOR trial
definition: A phase III, placebo-controlled randomized trial of the COX-2 inhibitor rofecoxib (Vioxx) in patients from throughout the United Kingdom who had undergone potentially curative surgery and completed adjuvant therapy for stage II or III colorectal cancer, testing whether rofecoxib reduced recurrence and improved survival; it was terminated early by the worldwide withdrawal of rofecoxib. Its patients, together with those of the QUASAR2 trial, form the VQ58 case series of colorectal cancer genome-wide association studies.

label: Västerbotten Intervention Project
other synonyms: VIP study|Västerbotten Intervention Program
definition: An ongoing population-based cohort study initiated in 1985 in which all residents of Västerbotten County, Sweden, are invited to a health examination at ages 40, 50 and 60, with blood drawn for cryopreservation; one of the three sub-surveys of the Northern Sweden Health and Disease Study, used for nested case–control studies of cancer and cardiovascular disease and for evaluating polygenic risk scores.

label: Variation in Recovery: Role of Gender on Outcomes of Young AMI Patients
other synonyms: Infarto de miocardio en la Mujer Joven
definition: An observational, multiethnic cohort study of young adults with acute myocardial infarction, aged 18 to 55, enrolled with more women than men at hospitals across the United States and Spain from 2008, to study sex differences in the presentation, treatment and outcomes of AMI.

label: Vobarno Study
definition: A population-based observational study of middle-aged residents of Vobarno, a small town between Brescia and Lake Garda in northern Italy, randomly selected from the electoral rolls and examined with clinic and 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure measurement, cardiac and carotid ultrasound, aortic stiffness and blood sampling for biochemistry and DNA extraction, to relate cardiac and vascular structure and function to blood pressure; participants were followed for about 25 years for cardiovascular morbidity and mortality.

label: Vlagtwedde/Vlaardingen study
other synonyms: Vlagtwedde-Vlaardingen cohort|Vlagtwedde-Vlaardingen cohort study|Vlagtwedde-Vlaardingen study|Vlagtwedde/Vlaardingen Cohort study|Vlagtwedde/Vlaardingen cohort study
definition: A population-based cohort study of the epidemiology of pulmonary diseases in adults of Dutch descent from the general population of Vlagtwedde and Vlaardingen, the Netherlands, who from 1965 until the last survey in 1989/1990 had medical examinations with a respiratory questionnaire and spirometry every three years, and whose vital status was later updated; its genotyped participants have been used in genetic studies of lung function, airflow obstruction and respiratory symptoms.

label: Diabetes UK Warren 2 Repository
other synonyms: Diabetes UK Warren 2 repository|WARREN 2|Warren 2|Warren 2 Cases|Warren 2 Cohort|Warren 2 Consortium
definition: A collection, funded by Diabetes UK, of people with type 2 diabetes and their relatives recruited from across the United Kingdom for genetic studies of type 2 diabetes, comprising probands of affected sibships (sib pairs), parent-offspring trios and duos, and a later collection of cases diagnosed at 35 to 65 years who were not selected for a family history of diabetes.

label: Women's Antioxidant Cardiovascular Study
other synonyms: Womens Antioxidant Cardiovascular Study
definition: A randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled 2x2x2 factorial trial of vitamin C, vitamin E and beta carotene for the prevention of cardiovascular events among female health professionals in the United States aged 40 or older with a history of cardiovascular disease or at least three cardiovascular risk factors, randomised from June 1995 to October 1996, to which a folic acid, vitamin B6 and vitamin B12 component was added in 1998; participants were followed up by questionnaire to 2005.

label: Western Australian HIV Cohort Study
other synonyms: West Australian HIV cohort Study|Western Australia HIV Cohort Study|Western Australian HIV Cohort study|Western Australian HIV Study Cohort|Western Australian HIV cohort study
definition: A prospective, single-centre, population-based observational study of the natural history of HIV disease among people with HIV attending the tertiary HIV service in Perth, Western Australia, whose clinical data, HIV sequences and host HLA and genome-wide genotypes have been used to study HIV immune escape, host genetic control of the virus, and prospective HLA-B*5701 screening to prevent abacavir hypersensitivity.

label: Women's Circle of Health Study
other synonyms: Womens Circle of Health Study
definition: A multi-site case-control study of breast cancer in African American and European American women in metropolitan New York City and New Jersey, with cases ascertained through hospitals and the New Jersey State Cancer Registry and controls identified first through random digit dialing and later also through community-based recruitment, recruited from bases at Mount Sinai School of Medicine and the Cancer Institute of New Jersey with data and biospecimens processed at Roswell Park Cancer Institute, to investigate genetic and lifestyle risk factors for aggressive (high-grade, estrogen receptor-negative) breast cancer and its earlier onset in African American women.

label: Wuhan Diabetes Study
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of type 2 diabetes in Han Chinese in Wuhan, China, whose cases were men and women aged 30 or older with newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes (by American Diabetes Association and World Health Organization criteria, using fasting and 2-hour oral glucose tolerance test glucose), recruited consecutively from the endocrinology outpatient clinics of Tongji Medical College Hospital, and whose controls were people with normal glucose tolerance from an unselected population attending routine health check-ups at the same hospital between December 2004 and November 2007. It has been used for replication genotyping in genetic association studies of type 2 diabetes and obesity.

label: Westlake Precision Birth Cohort
other synonyms: WeBirth cohort|WeBirth study|Westlake Precision Birth Cohort study
definition: An ongoing prospective cohort that since August 2019 has recruited pregnant women aged 18 years or older with gestational diabetes at 24–28 weeks' gestation from the Hangzhou Maternity and Child Health Care Hospital in Hangzhou, China, who intend to deliver there and to stay in Hangzhou with their children for at least four years; it was approved by the institutional review board of Westlake University and integrates multi-omics with precision nutrition research on gestational diabetes.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to eating behavior (ECTO:6000021)

label: Wellcome Genetics study
other synonyms: WellGen cohort|WellGen study|Wellcome Genetic collection|Wellcome Trust Genetic Study
definition: A genetic study of type 2 diabetes in India, funded in part by the Wellcome Trust, whose participants are people with type 2 diabetes treated at the Diabetes Unit of the King Edward Memorial (KEM) Hospital and Research Centre in Pune and associated clinics, with clinical, anthropometric and biochemical measurements made in that unit and genome-wide genotyping performed at the Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology, Hyderabad.

label: Wessex family study
other synonyms: Wessex Family Cohort|Wessex Family-Based Study
definition: A UK family-based collection of white families recruited from the Southampton area, each with at least two biological siblings aged 5 to 21 years with a current physician's diagnosis of asthma who were taking asthma medication regularly, originally recruited in collaboration with Genome Therapeutics Corporation and Schering-Plough for the study that identified ADAM33 as an asthma gene, and later used to test asthma genetic associations by transmission disequilibrium tests.

label: Wake Forest University Breast Cancer Study
definition: A hospital-based breast cancer case-control study at Wake Forest University Health Sciences (Winston-Salem, North Carolina, United States) that from November 1998 enrolled women newly diagnosed with breast cancer, before any therapy, at the Wake Forest University Breast Care Center, and as controls, frequency-matched to cases on age and race, women with normal mammograms and no history of cancer from those attending routine mammography at its Breast Screening and Diagnostic Center; its African-American participants, recruited up to December 2008, were contributed to the African American Breast Cancer Consortium.

label: Wake Forest University Prostate Cancer Study
other synonyms: MIAMI (WFPCS)|Miami-Wake Forest Prostate Cancer Study|Wake Forest Prostate Cancer Study
definition: A hospital-based case-control study of prostate cancer at Wake Forest University School of Medicine in North Carolina, United States, whose cases and controls (men with normal PSA and digital rectal examination, or with abnormal findings but a negative biopsy) were recruited with blood samples from its Departments of Urology and Internal Medicine between 1998 and 2005; prostate cancer genetics consortia also list it as the Miami-Wake Forest Prostate Cancer Study (MIAMI-WFPCS).

label: Wuhan-Beijing GWA study
other synonyms: Wuhan-beijing GWA study
definition: A case-control genome-wide association study sample of Chinese adults that combines participants of the Dongfeng-Tongji cohort study, a cohort of retired employees of a state-owned automobile enterprise in China, with patients with oesophageal squamous-cell carcinoma recruited at the Cancer Hospital of the Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences in Beijing; it was one of the Stage 1 studies of the 2015 meta-analysis of genome-wide association studies of adult height in East Asians.
diseases: patients with: esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (MONDO:0005580)

label: Women's Health Initiative Clinical Trial
other synonyms: WHI Clinical Trial|Women's Health Initiative Clinical Trials|Womens Health Initiative - randomized clinical trial
definition: The randomised clinical trial component of the Women's Health Initiative, in which postmenopausal women aged 50 to 79 enrolled from 1993 to 1998 at the 40 WHI clinical centres in the United States were randomised in three distinct interventions: menopausal hormone therapy versus placebo, calcium and vitamin D supplementation versus placebo, and a low-fat eating pattern versus usual diet, tested for the prevention of coronary heart disease, breast and colorectal cancer, and fractures.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to low fat diet intake (ECTO:2000121)

label: Women's Health Initiative Genetic Components of HIP Fracture Consortium
other synonyms: Genetic Components of HIP Fracture|Genetic Components of Hip Fracture|Women's Health Initiative Genetic Components of HIP Fracture (GeCHIP) Consortium|Womens Health Initiative GeCHIP
definition: A genetic study of hip fracture and bone mineral density within the Women's Health Initiative in the United States, made up of a case-control sample in which all hip fractures in the WHI Clinical Trial and Observational Study up to August 2007 were matched to controls, and a subsample of the WHI bone mineral density cohort, measured at three of the 40 WHI clinical centres, in which women with the best or worst hip bone density Z-scores and physical functioning scores were selected.

label: Women's Health Initiative Hormone Therapy Trials
other synonyms: WHI Hormone Therapy Trials|WHI-HT trials|Womens Health Initiative Hormone Therapy Trial
definition: The hormone therapy component of the Women's Health Initiative: two randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trials in which postmenopausal women aged 50 to 79 years were enrolled between 1993 and 1998 at 40 clinical centers across the United States and randomized to estrogen alone (women without a uterus) or estrogen plus progestin versus placebo; the estrogen plus progestin and estrogen-alone trials were stopped early in 2002 and 2004, and participants were then followed without intervention.

label: Women's Health Initiative Long Life Study
other synonyms: Long Life Study|WHI Long Life Study|Womens Health Initiative Long Life Study
definition: An ancillary study of the Women's Health Initiative that between March 2012 and May 2013 made a one-time in-person home visit to women of the WHI Extension Study, then aged 63 to 99, to collect a blood sample, a brief clinical assessment, blood pressure, anthropometry and objective physical-function measures; the women added when its study population was expanded in 2012 were genotyped genome-wide as the WHI-LLS GWAS sub-study.

label: Wheezing Illnesses Study Leidsche Rijn
other synonyms: WHeezing-Illnesses-STudy-LEidsche-Rijn|Wheezing-Illnesses-Study-Leidsche-Rijn
definition: A population-based prospective birth cohort of healthy newborns from Leidsche Rijn, a residential area near Utrecht in the Netherlands, begun in December 2001 from the University Medical Center Utrecht and embedded in the Utrecht Health Project, with infant and parental lung function, DNA, questionnaires and primary-care records collected to study the determinants of wheezing illnesses; in 2007 it was extended with vascular measurements (WHISTLER-Cardio).
exposures: designed to study: exposure to lipopolysaccharide (ECTO:9000215)

label: Whitehall II Study
other synonyms: Whitehall II|Whitehall II study|Whitehall Study
definition: A prospective occupational cohort of British civil servants, men and women aged 35 to 55 working in 20 London-based civil service departments, recruited in 1985–1988 with a clinical examination and questionnaire and re-examined in repeated phases since, set up to investigate the mechanisms, notably psychosocial stress, underlying socioeconomic inequalities in disease.

label: Wuhan-Zhuhai Cohort
other synonyms: Wuhan Zhuhai cohort|Wuhan-Zhuhai Cohort Study|Wuhan-Zhuhai cohort|Wuhan-Zhuhai cohort study
definition: A community-based prospective cohort of residents aged 18 to 80 of sampled communities in Wuhan (Hubei province) and Zhuhai (Guangdong province), China, who had lived there for more than five years, recruited in April–May 2011 in Wuhan and May 2012 in Zhuhai with questionnaires, physical examination, spirometry and blood and urine samples, and followed up every three years to study how exposure to air particulate matter and other environmental pollutants affects the respiratory and cardiovascular systems.
diseases: population study of: Abnormal circulating lipid concentration (HP:0003119)|population study of: asthma (MONDO:0004979)|population study of: cardiovascular disorder (MONDO:0004995)|population study of: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (MONDO:0005002)|population study of: hypertensive disorder (MONDO:0005044)
exposures: designed to study: exposure to particulate matter (ECTO:7000068)

label: Women's Insights and Shared Experiences Study
other synonyms: Women's Insights and Shared Experiences|Women's Insights and Shared Experiences study|Womens Insights and Shared Experiences study
definition: A population-based pair of case-control studies, one of endometrial cancer and one of breast cancer, among white and African American women aged 50 to 79 in the Philadelphia area of Pennsylvania and New Jersey, United States, examining exogenous hormone use, parity and estrogen-related genes: cases diagnosed between July 1999 and June 2002 were identified through hospitals and the Pennsylvania Cancer Registry, and controls from the same area by random-digit dialling. Its endometrial cancer study is one of the studies of the Epidemiology of Endometrial Cancer Consortium.
diseases: patients with: breast cancer (MONDO:0007254)|patients with: endometrial cancer (MONDO:0011962)

label: Weiss Laboratory Autism Collection
other synonyms: Weiss Laboratory Autism Collections
definition: A combination of Californian autism spectrum disorder collections, namely the UCSF/Weiss trios and cases, the UCSF/Hendren cases, the USC/Levitt cases and controls, trios, cases and controls from the CHARGE study at UC Davis and cases and controls of the Autism Phenome Project of the UC Davis MIND Institute, whose samples were genotyped by the laboratory of L. A. Weiss at the University of California, San Francisco, on Affymetrix Axiom EUR arrays, and which contributed its European-American participants to the Psychiatric Genomics Consortium autism GWAS.

label: Wuhan Lung Cancer Study
other synonyms: Wuhan lung cancer study
definition: A hospital-based case–control study of lung cancer in Wuhan, China, whose cases were consecutive patients with lung cancer at Wuhan Zhongnan Hospital, without restriction on age, sex or histology but excluding those with a previous cancer or an unknown history of radiotherapy or chemotherapy, and whose controls were cancer-free outpatients of other clinics of the same hospital in the same period, frequency-matched to the cases on age, sex and urban or rural residence; all participants were ethnic Chinese. Its never-smoking women were genotyped genome-wide as one of the studies of the Female Lung Cancer Consortium in Asia.

label: Wenzhou Medical University Biobank - Tibetans
definition: A collection of Tibetans recruited at two sites about 4,100 m above sea level on the Tibetan Plateau in Sichuan, western China: at Seda, among people studying or working at the Seda Larong Wuming Buddhist Institute who came from diverse regions of the plateau, and at Litang, among nomadic people who had lived in the area for generations; their blood DNA was genotyped on the Illumina CoreExome array for a study of high-altitude adaptation, and the genotype and phenotype data are held by the Wenzhou Medical University biobank.

label: Warsaw Ovarian Cancer Study
definition: A clinic-based case–control study of ovarian cancer in Warsaw and central Poland, supported by the Maria Sklodowska-Curie Memorial Cancer Center and Institute of Oncology in Warsaw, whose cases and controls contribute to the genome-wide association studies of the Ovarian Cancer Association Consortium.

label: West of Scotland Coronary Prevention Study
definition: A primary-prevention trial of men aged 45 to 64 with raised plasma cholesterol, recruited in Scotland and randomised to pravastatin or placebo to test whether lowering serum cholesterol reduces fatal and non-fatal myocardial infarction.

label: Warfarin Pharmacogenomics Cohort
other synonyms: Warfarin Pharmacogenetics Cohort
definition: A prospective inception cohort of adults starting chronic warfarin therapy with a target INR of 2–3 for venous thromboembolism, stroke or transient ischaemic attack, atrial fibrillation, myocardial infarction or peripheral arterial disease, enrolled at anticoagulation clinics by the University of Alabama at Birmingham and followed at monthly clinic visits for warfarin dose, INR, medications and outcomes, to study genetic and clinical determinants of warfarin response in African American and European American patients.
diseases: patients with: atrial fibrillation (MONDO:0004981)|patients with: myocardial infarction (MONDO:0005068)|patients with: peripheral arterial disease (MONDO:0005386)|patients with: stroke disorder (MONDO:0005098)|patients with: transient ischemic attack (MONDO:0005264)|patients with: venous thromboembolism (MONDO:0005399)

label: Westphalian Stroke Register
definition: A regional hospital-based register of patients admitted with acute stroke to cooperating hospitals in Westphalia, north-west Germany, with departments of neurology, internal medicine and geriatric medicine taking part, which records a standardised data set of sociodemographic and clinical characteristics, diagnostic and treatment procedures, complications and status at discharge; its case ascertainment was part of the German Competence Net Stroke, and consecutive consenting ischaemic stroke patients recruited through it have been used in genetic studies of stroke.

label: Washington University Genetics Study
definition: A hospital-based case series of men diagnosed with and managed for prostate cancer, identified through the university clinics of Washington University in St. Louis, Missouri, United States, and recruited from 2004 to 2011, which contributes genotyped cases to the prostate cancer genetic studies of the PRACTICAL consortium.

label: Wuxi Non-Communicable Diseases cohort
other synonyms: Wuxi NCDs cohort|Wuxi Non-Communicable Disease cohort
definition: A population-based cohort of adults aged 30 or older established in Wuxi city, Jiangsu Province, China, in April to June 2007 through random cluster sampling of residents of two communities, with a baseline questionnaire, physical measurements and blood sampling for DNA extraction, followed prospectively to study risk factors for non-communicable diseases such as type 2 diabetes.

label: Wisconsin Women's Health Study
other synonyms: Wisconsin Womens Health Study|Wisconsin women's health study
