definition: A series of population-based case–control studies of breast cancer run at the University of Wisconsin, whose cases are Wisconsin women with incident breast cancer reported to the statewide cancer registry and whose controls are women without breast cancer randomly selected from lists of licensed drivers and, for women aged 65 or over until 2003, of Medicare beneficiaries, all interviewed by telephone about reproductive history, family cancer history and lifestyle, to study lifestyle and genetic risk factors for breast cancer; it is the Wisconsin part of the Collaborative Breast Cancer Study, which recruited Wisconsin cases from 1988 to 2008.

label: Yonsei Avellino Corneal Dystrophy Study
definition: A Korean genetic study of Avellino corneal dystrophy (granular corneal dystrophy type 2) at the Corneal Dystrophy Research Institute of Yonsei University College of Medicine, Seoul, whose genome-wide genotyped participants have contributed to multi-ancestry meta-analyses of blood lipid levels and body mass index.
diseases: patients with: granular corneal dystrophy type II (MONDO:0011855)

label: Young Adult Hodgkin's Disease Case-Control Study
other synonyms: Young Adult Hodgkin Case-Control Study|Young Adult Hodgkin Disease Case-Control Study|Young Adult Hodgkins Disease Case_Control Study|Young adult Hodgkin Case-Control Study
definition: A UK population-based case-control study of Hodgkin's disease in young adults aged 16 to 24 years, whose cases were those newly diagnosed between October 1991 and May 1995 in the Yorkshire, Wessex and South West Family Health Service Authority areas and parts of Cumbria and Lancashire, ascertained by the methods of the Leukaemia Research Fund Data Collection Study, and whose controls, two per case, were randomly selected from people registered with general practitioners in the study area and matched on sex, year of birth and area of residence. It was set up to test the late host response model of young adult Hodgkin's disease and whether it differs between Epstein-Barr virus-positive and -negative disease, and its cases were later genotyped for genome-wide association studies of classical Hodgkin lymphoma, among them the European Collaborative Study.

label: Yunnan Lung Cancer Study
definition: A case-control study of lung cancer in never-smoking ethnic Chinese women in Yunnan Province, China, that enrolled incident lung cancer cases and controls without a history of cancer, all aged at least 18; it is one of the studies pooled in the Female Lung Cancer Consortium in Asia.

label: Academia Sinica Multicentered Young-Onset Hypertension Genetic Study
other synonyms: Academia Sinica Multi-Center YOH Genetic Study|Academia Sinica Multi-Center Young-Onset Hypertension Genetic Study|Academia Sinica young-onset hypertension multi-center study
definition: A multicentre study run from Academia Sinica, Taiwan, of Han Chinese patients with young-onset essential hypertension, first diagnosed between the ages of 20 and 51, with secondary hypertension, diabetes and a body mass index of 35 kg/m2 or more excluded. Lymphoblastoid cell lines were established for its patients, who, with normotensive controls from other Taiwanese studies, have been used in genome-wide association, gene-expression and candidate-gene studies of hypertension, blood pressure, adiponectin and ACE activity.

label: Zaragoza Bladder Cancer Study
definition: A hospital-based case–control study of urinary bladder cancer in Zaragoza, Spain, whose cases were patients with histologically proven urothelial cell carcinoma of the bladder recruited from the urology and oncology departments of Zaragoza Hospital from 2007 to 2009 and whose controls were individuals who had attended the University Hospital in Zaragoza for diseases other than cancer from 2001 to 2007.

label: Zhejiang colorectal cancer set
other synonyms: Zhejiang Colorectal Cancer set
definition: A Chinese genetic sample for colorectal neoplasia drawn from the population-based colorectal cancer screening programme of Jiashan County, Zhejiang Province, made up of a one-to-one matched case-control study conducted from 2015 to 2022 and a cross-sectional colonoscopy screening study performed in 2014, whose participants were genotyped on the Illumina Asian Screening Array.

label: Nurses' Health Studies
definition: An umbrella of three prospective cohorts of nurses: the original Nurses' Health Study established in 1976, Nurses' Health Study II, and Nurses' Health Study 3, which is still enrolling nurses and nursing students in the United States or Canada; together they count more than 275,000 participants and are among the largest prospective investigations into the risk factors for major chronic diseases in women.

label: International Consortium on the Genetics of Heroin Dependence
definition: A collaboration of Australian and American investigators to identify genes associated with liability for heroin dependence, using a case–control design in which cases met lifetime DSM-IV criteria for heroin dependence and controls were assessed individuals without heroin dependence or unassessed general population controls, with cases and controls drawn from several investigations including the Comorbidity and Trauma Study, Heroin Dependence in Western Australia, the OZ-ALC Study, a twin study of mole development in adolescence and genetic studies of substance dependence at Yale; its data, collected from 2004 to 2009, are held in dbGaP as phs000277.

label: Cardiovascular Effects of Air Pollution and Noise in Stockholm
other synonyms: Cardiovascular Effects of Air Pollution and Noise Study|Cardiovascular Effects of Air Pollution and Noise in Stockholm study|Cardiovascular Effects of Air pollution and Noise Study
definition: A pooling of four population-based cohorts from Stockholm County, Sweden (the Stockholm Diabetes Prevention Programme, a random sample of 60-year-olds known as SIXTY, the Stockholm-resident participants of the Screening Across the Lifespan Twin study, and the Swedish National Study on Aging and Care in Kungsholmen), recruited between 1992 and 2004 and analysed together to study long-term exposure to ambient air pollution and noise as risk factors for cardiovascular disease.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to air pollution (ECTO:8000036)|designed to study: exposure to sound radiation (ECTO:8000044)

label: My Purchases cohort
other synonyms: Mine Indkøb|Mine indkøb kohorten|My Purchases|My purchases cohort
definition: A cohort of adult Danish residents who, since June 2021, have consented through a web application run by Statens Serum Institut to donate the digital receipts of their consumer purchases, linked through their personal identification number to national health registers, to study how purchases, diet and household lifestyle exposures affect health.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to chemical (ECTO:0000231)|designed to study: exposure to eating behavior (ECTO:6000021)|designed to study: exposure to lifestyle (ECTO:6000015)

label: Study on Transitions in Employment, Ability and Motivation
other synonyms: Study on TRansitions in Employment, Ability and Motivation
definition: A prospective cohort of persons aged 45 to 64 years in the Netherlands, stratified by age and employment status, followed from 2010 by the Netherlands Organisation for Applied Scientific Research TNO through online questionnaires on work characteristics, health, employment transitions, work ability and productivity, to study sustainable work participation of older workers; a second group was recruited in 2015.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to occupation (ECTO:0001591)

label: Swedish Cervical Screening Cohort
other synonyms: Cervical Screening Cohort|Cervical screening cohort|Swedish cervical screening cohort
definition: A cohort of women screened for human papillomavirus and cervical abnormalities in the capital region of Sweden, in the organised screening programme and in non-organised testing, enrolled from 2011 by the Center for Cervical Cancer Elimination at Karolinska Institutet and Karolinska University Hospital, with biobanked cervical samples and individual screening data updated from the Swedish National Cervical Screening Registry (NKCx), for long-term follow-up studies of cervical cancer and other diseases.

label: Dutch Famine Birth Cohort
other synonyms: Dutch Famine Birth Cohort study|Dutch famine birth cohort|Dutch famine birth cohort study|Hongerwinter Onderzoek
definition: A historical birth cohort of singletons born alive and at term in the Wilhelmina Gasthuis in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, around the time of the 1944–1945 Dutch famine (1943–1947), traced and studied by Amsterdam UMC since 1994 through repeated interviews, examinations, biological samples, imaging and registry linkage, to investigate the effects of acute maternal undernutrition during specific stages of gestation on later health, particularly cardiovascular and metabolic disease, ageing and mental health.
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to famine via maternal (ECTO:0800003)

label: Diabetes Prediction in Skåne
other synonyms: DiPiS study|Diabetes Prediction in Skåne study
definition: A prospective, population-based cohort of children born in Skåne, Sweden, between September 2000 and August 2004 who were screened as newborns for risk of type 1 diabetes, with children at increased risk followed with yearly capillary blood samples for islet autoantibodies from two to 15 years of age or until diabetes onset, to investigate the genetic and environmental factors contributing to or triggering type 1 diabetes.
diseases: at risk of: type 1 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005147)

label: Étude Longitudinale Française depuis l'Enfance
other synonyms: ELFE cohort|Etude Longitudinale Française depuis l'Enfance|Etude Longitudinale Française depuis l'Enfance"  (French longitudinal study of children)|French Longitudinal Study of Children|French Longitudinal Study since Childhood|French longitudinal study of children|French national cohort of children
definition: The first French national birth cohort, of children recruited at birth in 2011 in a random sample of maternity units in metropolitan France during 25 selected days spread over the year and followed by the French Institute for Demographic Studies (Ined), Inserm and the French Blood Agency, to study the determinants of development, health and socialisation of children from birth to adulthood through a multidisciplinary approach.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to environmental contaminant (ECTO:0000931)

label: ENVIRonmental influence ON early AGEing
other synonyms: Environmental Influence on Ageing in Early Life|Environmental Influence on Early Aging|Limburgs Geboortecohort
definition: A prospective, population-based birth cohort of mother–newborn pairs recruited at delivery since February 2010 at East-Limburg Hospital (Ziekenhuis Oost-Limburg) in Genk, in the province of Limburg, Belgium, with umbilical cord blood collected at birth and follow-up of the children at 4 to 6 years of age at Hasselt University, to study how environmental exposures in early life influence the biology of human ageing.
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)|designed to study: exposure to air pollution (ECTO:8000036)

label: Finnish HPV vaccination cohort
other synonyms: HPV vaccination cohort|HPV-Rokotiitus|NCT00534638
definition: The participants of a community-randomised phase IV trial in which early adolescents born 1992–1995 and resident in 33 Finnish communities were invited in 2007–2009 and assigned by community to gender-neutral HPV16/18 vaccination, HPV16/18 vaccination of girls with hepatitis B vaccination of boys, or gender-neutral hepatitis B vaccination, and followed up with cervicovaginal sampling from 18.5 years of age, to compare the overall and herd effects of gender-neutral and girls-only HPV vaccination.
diseases: population study of: human papilloma virus infection (MONDO:0005161)

label: Nascita e INFanzia: gli Effetti dell'Ambiente
other synonyms: NINFEA birth cohort|NINFEA cohort|NINFEA project|NINFEA study|Nascita e INFanzia gli Effetti dell’Ambiente|Nascita e Infanzia: gli Effetti dell’Ambiente|Nascita ed INFanzia: gli Effetti dell'Ambiente|Progetto NINFEA
definition: An Italian internet-based birth cohort of children born to pregnant women who volunteered through the study website, started as a pilot in Turin in July 2005 and extended to the rest of Italy, with recruitment until 2016 and online questionnaires completed by the mothers during pregnancy and repeatedly through the child's childhood and adolescence, set up to investigate the effects of pre-natal and early post-natal exposures on infant, child and adult health.
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)

label: Rhea Study
other synonyms: Mother-Child Cohort in Crete, Greece|RHEA - Mother Child Cohort in Crete, Greece|Rhea cohort|Rhea mother-child cohort|Rhea pregnancy cohort|Rhea project
definition: A population-based mother-child cohort of pregnant women living in the prefecture of Heraklion, Crete, Greece, recruited at their first major ultrasound examination around week 12 of gestation at four prenatal clinics in Heraklion from February 2007 to February 2008, and of their children, followed from early pregnancy towards young adulthood to study how environmental, dietary and other early-life exposures affect the health of mothers and children, with a focus on childhood obesity.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to mediterranean diet (ECTO:0050001)

label: Rotterdam Study III
other synonyms: Rotterdam Study, third cohort|third cohort of the Rotterdam Study
definition: The third cohort of the Rotterdam Study, a prospective population-based cohort of inhabitants of Ommoord, a suburb of Rotterdam in the Netherlands, aged 45 and over who had not already been examined in the study (mainly people aged 45 to 54), enrolled from 2006 to 2008 and re-examined periodically to study the causes and course of chronic diseases in mid-life and late life.

label: Suivi de l'Exposition à la Pollution Atmosphérique durant la Grossesse et Effets sur la Santé
other synonyms: Assessment of air pollution exposure during pregnancy and effect on health|SEPAGES cohort|SEPAGES couple-child cohort|SEPAGES mother-child cohort|Suivi de l'Exposition à la Pollution Atmosphérique et Effet sur la santé|Suivi de l’Exposition à la Pollution Atmosphérique durant la Grossesse et Effets sur la Santé
definition: A French couple-child cohort of pregnant women, their partners and their children, recruited between July 2014 and July 2017 at eight obstetric ultrasonography practices in the Grenoble area, set up by Inserm, CNRS and University Grenoble Alpes as a research platform with repeated personal exposure measurements and biological sampling during pregnancy and early life, to study the effects of air pollutants, non-persistent endocrine disruptors and other exposures on child growth, respiratory health and neurodevelopment and the biological pathways involved.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to air pollution via maternal (ECTO:0800002)|designed to study: exposure to endocrine disruptor (ECTO:9001630)|designed to study: exposure to phthalate ester (ECTO:9000906)

label: Sysdimet study
other synonyms: Dietary Modulation of Gene Expression and Metabolic Pathways in Glucose Metabolism|Health Grain intervention|Sysdimet Study|Systems Biology Approach to Understand Dietary Modulation of Gene Expression and Metabolic Pathways in Subjects With Abnormal Glucose Metabolism
definition: A 12-week randomised controlled dietary intervention trial of men and women aged 40 to 70 with impaired glucose metabolism and other features of the metabolic syndrome, recruited in 2007–2008 in the Kuopio area of Finland and run by the Department of Clinical Nutrition of the University of Eastern Finland, comparing a healthy Nordic-type diet rich in whole grain products, fatty fish and bilberries and a whole-grain-enriched diet with a control diet for effects on glucose and lipid metabolism, inflammation and endothelial function.
diseases: at risk of: cardiovascular disorder (MONDO:0004995)|at risk of: type 2 diabetes mellitus (MONDO:0005148)
exposures: designed to study: exposure to dietary intervention (ECTO:2000068)

label: Finnish Maternity Cohort
other synonyms: Maternity cohort
definition: A nationwide population-based biobank cohort of the women in Finland who have been pregnant since 1983, made up of the first-trimester serum samples left over from the screening for congenital infections offered to all pregnant women, now held by the Northern Finland Biobank Borealis and linkable to national health registers such as the Finnish Cancer Registry and the Medical Birth Register, as a resource for epidemiological, biomarker and surveillance studies of cancer and other diseases.

label: Polish-Norwegian Study
other synonyms: PONS cohort|PONS study|Polish Norwegian Study
definition: A prospective community-based cohort of volunteer men and women aged 45–64 years recruited in 2010–2011 from the city of Kielce and its surrounding rural area in south-eastern Poland, with questionnaires and stored blood and urine samples, set up with support from the Polish-Norwegian Research Fund to study health, health-related behaviours and risk factors for chronic diseases and premature mortality.

label: Monitoring Project on Risk Factors for Chronic Diseases
other synonyms: MORGEN Study|MORGEN-cohort|MORGEN-project|MORGEN-study|Monitoring Project on Chronic Disease Risk Factors|Monitoring Project on Risk Factors and Chronic Diseases in the Netherlands
definition: A population-based study of men and women aged 20–65 years drawn as random samples of the populations of Amsterdam, Maastricht and Doetinchem in the Netherlands, whose cardiovascular and other chronic disease risk factors were measured by the Municipal Health Services in 1993–1997 in a project supported by the Dutch Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and the National Institute for Public Health and the Environment, and who were followed for disease through linkage with national registers.

label: Generation R Next Study
other synonyms: Generation R Next|Generation R Next - Optimaal Opgroeien
definition: A population-based prospective cohort in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, of women enrolled from August 2017 before conception or during pregnancy, with their partners and children, followed from preconception and fetal life onwards by the Generation R group at Erasmus MC to study the growth, development and health of a new generation of children and their parents.

label: Nordic Children and Adults Born Preterm
other synonyms: Keskosina syntyneet lapset ja aikuiset - yhteispohjoismainen tutkimushanke|NORDCAP project|NORDCAP study|Nordic Children and Adolescents Born Preterm
definition: A register-based cohort of all children born in Finland from 1987 onwards, identified from the Finnish Medical Birth Register and linked with other national health, social and population registers and with data on their parents, held by the University of Oulu (earlier by the Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare) to study how preterm birth, pregnancy disorders and other early-life factors predict health, well-being and societal outcomes from childhood to adulthood, and the intergenerational transmission of health.

label: Wearable data collection study
other synonyms: HEAP wearable sensor cohort|Monitoring exposures during pregnancy with a wearable device
definition: A longitudinal cohort of healthy pregnant and non-pregnant women in Finland, enrolled by the University of Oulu from 2022 within the EU Human Exposome Assessment Platform (HEAP) project and followed for at least four months with wearable personal exposome monitors and repeated biological sampling (blood, saliva, sweat, urine), to pilot personal profiling of chemical and biological exposures.
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)

label: Kardiovize Brno 2030
other synonyms: Kardiovize|Kardiovize Brno 2030 Project|Kardiovize Brno 2030 study|Kardiovize Brno cohort|Kardiovize study
definition: A prospective population-based cohort of a random, sex- and age-stratified 1% sample of residents of Brno, Czech Republic, aged 25–64 years, drawn from health insurance registries in 2013 and examined at St Anne's University Hospital in Brno, to study how biological, psychosocial, environmental, behavioural and economic factors relate to cardiovascular disease and its outcomes in a Central European urban population.

label: 1970 British Cohort Study
other synonyms: 1970 British birth cohort|British Births Survey
definition: A longitudinal birth cohort of the people born in England, Scotland and Wales in a single week of 1970, which began as the British Births Survey and has followed its members' health, physical, educational and social development and economic circumstances through childhood and adult life; it is managed by the Centre for Longitudinal Studies at University College London and core funded by the Economic and Social Research Council.

label: Study on the influence of Air pollution on Lung function, Inflammation and Ageing
other synonyms: Study on Air pollution, Lung function, Inflammation, and Aging|Study on the influence of Air pollution on Lung function, Inflammation and Aging|Study on the influence of Air pollution on lung function inflammation and ageing|Study on the influence of air pollution on lung function, inflammation and ageing
definition: A population-based longitudinal cohort of women aged 55 years at recruitment from the industrialised Ruhr Area and rural areas north of it (Borken, Dülmen) in North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany, examined at baseline between 1985 and 1994 and followed up from 2006 onwards; initiated by the State Government of North Rhine-Westphalia to study the health effects of air pollution in women, and run by the IUF – Leibniz Research Institute for Environmental Medicine, Düsseldorf.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to air pollution (ECTO:8000036)|designed to study: exposure to particulate matter (ECTO:7000068)

label: NoMa study
other synonyms: Effect of fat quality on blood lipids and immune response|Fat quality on blood lipids and immune response|NOMA study
definition: The participants of an 8-week double-blind randomised controlled dietary intervention trial run from 2012 to 2014 by the University of Oslo and the Oslo and Akershus University College of Applied Sciences, Norway, in which adults with moderately elevated cholesterol ate commercial food items in which saturated fat had been replaced by polyunsaturated fat, or control items, to study effects on blood lipids, immune-cell gene expression and blood metabolites.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to polyunsaturated fatty acid via ingestion (ECTO:0900053)

label: National Health and Nutrition Survey – HYDRIA
other synonyms: Greek HYDRIA survey|HYDRIA 2013–2014 National Health and Nutrition study|HYDRIA survey|National Health and Nutrition Survey -HYDRIA
definition: A cross-sectional national health examination and nutrition survey of a representative sample of adults aged 18 years and over in Greece, drawn by two-stage stratified random sampling across all prefectures and examined between June 2013 and December 2014 by the Hellenic Health Foundation, following European Health Examination Survey and EFSA methodology, to describe the population's dietary intake, nutritional status and health.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to eating behavior (ECTO:6000021)|designed to study: exposure to mediterranean diet (ECTO:0050001)

label: Grain Fibre Modification for Gut-mediated Health Effects
other synonyms: Fibrefects - Grain fibre modification for gut-mediated health effects|Grain Fibre Modification for Gut-Mediated Health Effects|Grain Fibre and Gut Health|Grain fiber modification for gut mediated health effects|Grain fibre modification for gut-mediated health effects
definition: The participants of a randomised crossover dietary intervention trial started in 2011 by the University of Eastern Finland with VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland, within the FIBREFECTS project, in which adults with self-reported gastrointestinal symptoms after eating grain products ate white wheat bread during a run-in and then wholegrain rye bread and wheat bread enriched with bioprocessed rye bran, to study the effects of modified cereal fibre on glucose metabolism, gut fermentation and gut-mediated health.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to dietary intervention (ECTO:2000068)|designed to study: exposure to rye bread via ingestion (ECTO:0070112)

label: Piccolipiù birth cohort
other synonyms: Piccolipiù Italian birth cohort|Piccolipiù cohort|Piccolipiù study|Progetto Piccolipiù
definition: An Italian multicentre prospective birth cohort of newborns recruited from October 2011 to March 2015 in six maternity units in Florence, Rome, Trieste, Turin and Viareggio, with maternal blood, cord blood and other samples stored in a biobank at the Istituto Superiore di Sanità and follow-up by questionnaires through childhood, set up to study the effects of environmental exposures, parental conditions and social factors in pre- and early post-natal life on child health and development.

label: Foods for weight management
other synonyms: Elintarvikkeita Painonhallintaan|Elintarvikkeita painonhallintaan|Foods for Weight Maintenance|Foods for weight management (Elintarvikkeita painonhallintaan)|Foods for weight management: a randomized controlled trial
definition: The participants of a randomised controlled weight-management trial run from 2008 to 2010 by the Institute of Public Health and Clinical Nutrition, University of Kuopio (now University of Eastern Finland), Finland, in which adults aged 30–65 with obesity followed a very-low-energy diet and were then randomised to weight-maintenance diets containing foods of higher or lower predetermined satiety value, to study whether food satiety value affects self-regulation of food intake and weight management.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to calorie restrictive diet intake (ECTO:2000065)|designed to study: exposure to dietary intervention (ECTO:2000068)

label: Constances
other synonyms: CONSTANCES cohort|Cohorte des Consultants des Centres d’Examens de Santé|French CONSTANCES population-based cohort
definition: A French general-purpose population-based cohort of adults aged 18–69 years at inclusion, randomly sampled from people covered by the national health insurance fund (CNAMTS) and included from the end of 2012 through health examinations at selected Health Screening Centres across France, with yearly questionnaires, periodic examinations, a biobank and linkage to national social and health databases; run by Inserm as a research infrastructure with a focus on occupational and social factors, chronic diseases and ageing.

label: Gene and Environment: Prospective Study on Infancy in Italy
other synonyms: GASPII birth cohort|gene and environment prospective study on infancy in Italy
definition: A prospective birth cohort of children born between June 2003 and October 2004 in two hospitals in Rome, Italy, to mothers resident in the district of the Local Health Unit RME, followed up through childhood as a pilot for a national Italian birth cohort, to study genetic and environmental influences on child health.

label: Kaunas cohort
other synonyms: HiWATE cohort study|KANC cohort|KANC newborns cohort study
definition: A prospective birth cohort of pregnant women living in Kaunas municipality, Lithuania, recruited in the first trimester at four prenatal care clinics of the Kaunas University of Medicine hospitals from 2007, first as the Kaunas cohort of the EU HiWATE project on drinking-water contaminants and pregnancy outcomes, and their children, later followed up in childhood and within the HELIX exposome project.
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)|designed to study: exposure to drinking water (ECTO:7000125)

label: Central European Longitudinal Studies of Parents and Children: Young Adults
definition: A follow-up study, begun in 2019 at Masaryk University in Brno, Czech Republic, of the young adults born in 1991 and 1992 who took part in the Czech arm of the European Longitudinal Study of Pregnancy and Childhood, joined by their siblings and partners and by others born in those years, who are examined clinically, give blood, urine and buccal samples and answer questionnaires, to study how lifestyle, social and environmental factors relate to early signs of chronic disease.

label: European Longitudinal Study of Pregnancy and Childhood
other synonyms: Czech ELSPAC study|European Longitudinal Cohort Study of Pregnancy and Childhood
definition: The Czech arm of the European Longitudinal Study of Pregnancy and Childhood initiated by the WHO Regional Office for Europe: a population-based prospective birth cohort of children born in 1991 and 1992 in the Brno and Znojmo regions of South Moravia, Czech Republic, and their parents, followed from pregnancy into early adulthood by questionnaires, medical records and examinations to study biological, psychosocial, economic and environmental influences on pregnancy, delivery, child development and health, and now held by RECETOX at Masaryk University.

label: Perturbateurs Endocriniens: Étude Longitudinale sur les Anomalies de la Grossesse, l’Infertilité et l’Enfance
other synonyms: PELAGIE birth cohort|PELAGIE mother-child cohort|Perturbateurs endocriniens: Étude Longitudinale sur les Anomalies de la Grossesse, l’Infertilité et l’Enfance
definition: A mother-child cohort set up by INSERM in Rennes of pregnant women enrolled before the 19th week of gestation by gynaecologists, obstetricians and ultrasonographers in three départements of Brittany, France, between 2002 and 2006, whose children are followed from birth through childhood into young adulthood, to study the effects of prenatal and childhood exposure to environmental and occupational chemicals such as pesticides on pregnancy, fertility and child development.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to chemical (ECTO:0000231)|designed to study: exposure to endocrine disruptor (ECTO:9001630)|designed to study: exposure to herbicide (ECTO:0000515)

label: Generation XXI
other synonyms: Generation 21|Generation XXI birth cohort|Geração 21|Geração XXI
definition: A prospective population-based birth cohort of infants born between April 2005 and August 2006 in all the public maternity units of the Porto Metropolitan Area, Portugal, and their families, set up at the University of Porto and followed through childhood and adolescence to study how pregnancy and early-life characteristics relate to later growth, health and risk of chronic disease.

label: Moli-sani Study
other synonyms: MOLI-SANI Study|Moli-sani Project|Moli-sani cohort study|Progetto Moli-sani
definition: A population-based cohort of men and women aged 35 years or more living in the Molise region of southern Italy, randomly sampled with their family members from the city registries of Molise towns and recruited between 2005 and 2010, examined at baseline with a biobank of their samples and followed by linkage to regional health and mortality registries and a recall examination, to study genetic and environmental risk factors for cardiovascular, cancer and neurodegenerative diseases.

label: Central European Longitudinal Studies of Parents and Children: The Next Generation
other synonyms: Central European Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children: The Next Generation|The Next Generation
definition: A prospective birth cohort run by RECETOX at Masaryk University with University Hospital Brno, Czech Republic, which enrolled pregnant women from 2017 (after a 2015-2016 pilot) and follows them and their children from pregnancy through early childhood, collecting biological samples and questionnaires, to study exposome factors such as environment, lifestyle, nutrition, genetics and the gut microbiome behind chronic diseases and developmental disorders in children.
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)

label: Cypriot Children's Health and Environment Observatory
other synonyms: CHILDREN HEALTH AND ENVIRONMENT OBSERVATORY|Κυπριακό Παρατηρητήριο Υγείας και Περιβάλλοντος Παιδιών
definition: The Cypriot site of the CHILDREN_FIRST multi-country prospective exposome cohort: children in the first grade of randomly selected public primary schools in Cyprus, recruited from October 2023 by the Cyprus University of Technology with the biobank of the University of Cyprus and assessed every year until the end of primary school with questionnaires, urine and saliva samples and home and school environmental measurements, to study how the exposome shapes early risk of cardiometabolic, neurodevelopmental and respiratory disease.
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)

label: Observation of Cardiovascular Risks and Health in Luxembourg
other synonyms: Observation des Risques et de la Santé Cardio-Vasculaire au Luxembourg|Observation of Cardiovascular Risk Factors in Luxembourg|Observation of cardiovascular risk factors in Luxembourg
definition: A nationwide population-based study of adults living in the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, run by the Luxembourg Institute of Health, whose first wave (2007-2009) examined a random sample of residents and whose second wave (2016-2018) re-examined them together with new participants from the civil registry, another national health examination survey and volunteers, with questionnaires, clinical measurements and blood, urine and hair samples, to describe the prevalence and evolution of cardiovascular risk factors.

label: Barcelona Life Study Cohort
other synonyms: BiSC Project
definition: An exposome birth cohort of pregnant women enrolled between October 2018 and April 2021 at three tertiary university hospitals in Barcelona, Spain (Hospital Sant Joan de Déu, Hospital de la Santa Creu i Sant Pau and Hospital Clínic de Barcelona) and their primary healthcare centres, and of their children, followed from the first trimester of pregnancy through delivery into childhood to study the socio-environmental and genetic determinants of foetal and child health, growth and development and of maternal mental and physical health during and after pregnancy.
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)

label: Puberty and metabolic risk in obese children. Epigenetic alterations and pathophysiological and diagnostic implications
other synonyms: PUBMEP study
definition: A multicentre longitudinal follow-up in Spain (Santiago de Compostela, Córdoba, Zaragoza and Granada) of children who had taken part in the GENOBOX study before puberty and were re-examined after reaching puberty, grouped by obesity and insulin resistance status, to study the progression of metabolic syndrome and cardiometabolic risk factors from prepuberty to puberty and to find biomarkers and epigenetic marks of metabolic complications during puberty.
diseases: patients with: metabolic syndrome X (MONDO:0011565)|patients with: obesity disorder (MONDO:0011122)

label: Study of Secondary Exposure to Pesticides among Children, Adolescents, and Adults
other synonyms: ESPINA Study|ESPINA study|Secondary Exposure to Pesticides Among Children, Adolescents, and Adults (ESPINA) study|Study of Secondary Exposures to Pesticides Across Childhood, Adolescence and Adulthood|Study of secondary exposure to pesticides among children, adolescents, and adults
definition: A prospective cohort set up in 2008 of children living in the agricultural (floricultural) community of Pedro Moncayo County, Pichincha, Ecuador, recruited to include a balanced mix of children who did and did not live with a floricultural or agricultural worker and followed with repeated examinations into adolescence and adulthood, run by the University of California San Diego with Fundación Cimas del Ecuador to study the health effects of pesticide and other agrochemical exposures from childhood to adulthood.
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to agrochemical (ECTO:9001696)|participants with exposure: exposure to persistent organic pollutant (ECTO:9002053)|participants with exposure: exposure to pesticide (ECTO:0000530)

label: Rome Longitudinal Study
other synonyms: Rome longitudinal study
definition: An administrative cohort of the residents of Rome, Italy, enrolled from population census returns (the 2001 census and the census of 9 October 2011) linked to the municipal population registry, and followed by record linkage with administrative health databases, with baseline residential addresses linked to environmental exposures such as air pollution, temperature and greenness. It is run by the Department of Epidemiology of the Lazio Regional Health Service (ASL Roma 1) to study social, occupational and environmental determinants of health.

label: Prevention Cube
other synonyms: Prevention Cube: data warehouse for detection and evaluation of trends of occupational diseases|Prevention Cube: data warehouse for detection and evaluation of trends of occupational diseases (Precube)
definition: An occupational cohort of the employees of employers in Belgium that chose IDEWE as their External Service for Prevention and Protection at Work, followed from 1993 through the records of their legally required occupational health surveillance. IDEWE pools the records in a data warehouse for research on work-related diseases and sector-specific health problems.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to occupation (ECTO:0001591)

label: Czech Health, Alcohol and Psychosocial factors In Eastern Europe study
other synonyms: Czech HAPIEE cohort|Czech HAPIEE study|Health, Alcohol and Psychosocial factors In Eastern Europe
definition: The Czech Republic cohort of the HAPIEE study: a random sample of men and women aged 45-69 years, stratified by sex and age and selected from population registers in six Czech towns (Havířov/Karviná, Hradec Králové, Jihlava, Kroměříž, Liberec and Ústí nad Labem), examined at baseline in 2002-2005 and followed through re-examinations (most recently in 2023-2024) and linkage to national health registers, with geocoded addresses linked to exposome and census data. The aim is to study psychosocial, behavioural and environmental risk factors for cardiovascular and other chronic diseases and for ageing outcomes.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to alcohol (ECTO:9000026)|designed to study: exposure to nutrient (ECTO:9001695)

label: International Lipid-Based Nutrient Supplements Project-DYAD-Malawi
other synonyms: International Lipid‑Based Nutrient Supplements Project|iLiNS-DYAD-Malawi
definition: The participants of a randomised, single-blind controlled trial in rural Malawi (Mangochi, University of Malawi College of Medicine with Tampere University), part of the International Lipid-Based Nutrient Supplements (iLiNS) Project: pregnant women enrolled from 2011, and later their infants. The women received small-quantity lipid-based nutrient supplements, multiple micronutrients or iron-folic acid during pregnancy and lactation, and the infants were followed to test effects on birth size, child growth and development, with a later follow-up of the children at 9 years.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to dietary supplement, vitamin(s) and fatty acids via ingestion (ECTO:0070245)|designed to study: exposure to iron supplementation (ECTO:2000097)|designed to study: exposure to micronutrient via ingestion (ECTO:0900369)

label: New Hampshire Birth Cohort Study
other synonyms: NH Birth Cohort Study|New Hampshire birth cohort study
definition: A prospective longitudinal cohort of pregnant women enrolled since 2009 at prenatal clinics in the Concord and Lebanon regions of New Hampshire, USA, by the Geisel School of Medicine at Dartmouth, and of their children, followed from early pregnancy into childhood to study how environmental contaminants, such as arsenic from private well water, affect the health of pregnant women and their children.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to arsenic in water via ingestion (ECTO:0080000)|designed to study: exposure to environmental contaminant (ECTO:0000931)

label: Shanghai Dapuqiao Aging and Cognition Study
definition: A community-based open cohort of residents aged 65 and older of the Dapu (Dapuqiao) neighbourhood of Huangpu District in central Shanghai, China, recruited through the Shanghai Municipal Annual Physical Examination Program for older residents and examined in three waves in 2019, 2022 and 2024, mostly as repeated cross-sectional samples with a small longitudinal subset, to study health, lifestyle and cognition in an ageing urban population.

label: Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe
definition: A multidisciplinary, cross-nationally harmonised longitudinal panel survey of people aged 50 and older, begun in 2004 in eleven European countries and Israel and extended to all EU member states and Switzerland, run as a European Research Infrastructure Consortium (SHARE-ERIC, coordinated from Munich and later Berlin), that collects data on health, biomarkers, cognition, employment, socio-economic status and social and family networks to study the effects of health, social, economic and environmental policies over the life course.

label: Harmonized Diagnostic Assessment of Dementia for the Longitudinal Aging Study in India
other synonyms: Diagnostic Assessment of Dementia for the Longitudinal Aging Study in India|Harmonized Diagnostic Assessment for the Longitudinal Aging Study in India|Harmonized Diagnostic Assessment of Dementia for the Longitudinal Aging study in India|Longitudinal Aging Study in India-Diagnostic Assessment of Dementia
definition: A nationally representative in-depth study of late-life cognition and dementia in India, led from the University of Southern California with Indian partners, that recruited a sub-sample of Longitudinal Aging Study in India (LASI) respondents aged 60 and older, oversampling those at high risk of cognitive impairment, from 18 states and union territories in 2017–2019 and 22 in 2022–2024, and assessed them with the Harmonized Cognitive Assessment Protocol, informant interviews, geriatric assessments, blood biomarkers, neuroimaging, genomics and environmental exposure measures.

label: Hokkaido Study on Environment and Children's Health
other synonyms: Hokkaido Birth Cohort Study on Environment and Children's Health|Hokkaido Study on Environment and Children’s Health|Hokkaido Study on Environment and Children’s Health: Malformation, Development, and Allergy|Hokkaido birth cohort study on environment and children’s health
definition: An ongoing prospective birth cohort study run by the Center for Environmental and Health Sciences of Hokkaido University, Japan, made up of the Sapporo cohort, recruited in pregnancy at one Sapporo hospital in 2002–2005, and the Hokkaido cohort, recruited in the first trimester at clinics and hospitals across Hokkaido Prefecture in 2003–2012, that follows the children to study the effects of prenatal and postnatal exposure to environmental chemicals on birth outcomes, birth defects, growth, allergies, infections and neurodevelopment, and genetic susceptibility to them.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to environmental contaminant (ECTO:0000931)|designed to study: exposure to perfluoroalkyl substance (ECTO:9002160)|designed to study: exposure to smoke (ECTO:7000059)

label: GINIplus/LISA North
other synonyms: GINIplus (German Infant Nutritional Intervention plus environmental and genetic influences on allergy development)/LISA (Influence of Lifestyle factors on the development of the Immune System and Allergies) North
definition: The children of the German birth cohorts GINIplus (born 1995–1998) and LISAplus (born 1997–1999) recruited in the rural study area of Wesel, near the industrial Ruhr area in western Germany, whose data are pooled because the two cohorts have nearly identical designs and analysed as one study population, as in the ESCAPE and EXPANSE air pollution and exposome consortia, separately from the urban Munich participants (GINI/LISA South).
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)|designed to study: exposure to dietary intervention (ECTO:2000068)

label: Walnuts Smart Snack Dietary Intervention Trial
other synonyms: WALNUTs study|Walnuts, Long-Chain Polyunsaturated Fatty Acids, and Adolescent Brain Development
definition: A multi-school, population-based, parallel-group randomised controlled trial of healthy adolescents aged 11 to 16 attending schools in Barcelona, Spain, run by researchers of ISGlobal in 2016–2017, that tested whether eating 30 g of walnuts a day for six months improves neuropsychological and socio-emotional development, with cognitive, behavioural, lifestyle and environmental assessments and blood and urine samples from part of the participants.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to walnuts via ingestion (ECTO:0070155)

label: GENOBOX study
other synonyms: GENOBOX clinic cohort|GENOBOX cohort|Genobox cohort
definition: A multicentre hospital-based case–control study of children and adolescents in Spain, recruited at the university hospitals of Santiago de Compostela (Hospital Clínico Universitario de Santiago), Zaragoza (Hospital Clínico Universitario Lozano Blesa) and Córdoba (Hospital Universitario Reina Sofía): cases attending hospital with suspected overweight or obesity, and controls attending for minor disorders or common infections that were not confirmed, studied to understand the pathophysiology and cardiometabolic, inflammatory and oxidative-stress risk factors of childhood obesity.

label: Rio Birth Cohort Study on Environmental Exposure and Childhood Development
other synonyms: Birth Cohort Study of Environmental Exposure  and Childhood Development – PIPAUFRJ Project|Birth Cohort Study of Environmental Exposure and Childhood Development – PIPAUFRJ Project|PIPA Project|PIPA Study|PIPA project|PIPA study|Projeto Infância e Poluentes Ambientais|Rio Birth Cohort|Rio Birth Cohort Study|Rio Birth Cohort Study of Environmental Exposure and Childhood Development|Rio Birth Cohort Study on Environmental Exposure and Child Development|Rio birth cohort
definition: A hospital-based prospective birth cohort of pregnant women aged 16 or over living in the city of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, and their children born at the Maternity School of the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro, coordinated by the university's Institute for Studies in Collective Health with Fiocruz, in which mothers and children are followed with interviews, examinations and biological samples from pregnancy to age four to study the effects of prenatal and early-life exposure to metals, pesticides and plasticisers on child health and development; a pilot phase ran from September 2017 to August 2018.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to environmental contaminant (ECTO:0000931)|designed to study: exposure to metal cation (ECTO:9000175)|designed to study: exposure to pesticide (ECTO:0000530)|designed to study: exposure to plasticiser (ECTO:9002071)

label: Programming Research in Obesity, Growth, Environment and Social Stressors
other synonyms: PROGRESS cohort|PROGRESS study|Programming Research in Obesity, Growth, Environment, and Social Stressors
definition: A prospective birth cohort of pregnant women receiving prenatal care through the Mexican Social Security Institute (IMSS) in Mexico City, recruited from July 2007 to February 2010, and their children, run by the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai, Harvard University and Mexico's National Institute of Public Health, and followed to study how prenatal and early-life exposure to metals, air pollution and phthalates, together with chronic psychosocial stress, affects child neurodevelopment, growth and metabolic health.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to air pollution (ECTO:8000036)|designed to study: exposure to metal cation (ECTO:9000175)|designed to study: exposure to phthalate ester (ECTO:9000906)

label: Infants' Environmental Health Study
other synonyms: ISA birth cohort study|ISA cohort|ISA study|Infantes y Salud Ambiental|Infants' Environmental Health (ISA) Study|Infants’ Environmental Health Study
definition: A prospective community-based birth cohort of pregnant women aged 15 or over living in 40 villages of Matina County, Limón, Costa Rica, within 5 km of large-scale banana plantations where the fungicide mancozeb is sprayed from the air, enrolled from March 2010 to June 2011 by the Central American Institute for Studies on Toxic Substances (IRET) of the Universidad Nacional, and their children, followed to study the effects of prenatal pesticide and manganese exposure on children's growth, neurodevelopment and respiratory health and on the mothers' health.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to manganese (ECTO:9000946)|designed to study: exposure to pesticide (ECTO:0000530)

label: Multi-Partner Consortium to Expand Dementia Research in Latin America
other synonyms: Multi-partner consortium to expand dementia research in Latin America|Multi‐Partner Consortium to Expand Dementia Research in Latin America|ReDLat Study|ReDLat cohort|ReDLat consortium|ReDLat project
definition: A multicentre cohort of people with Alzheimer's disease or frontotemporal dementia and cognitively unimpaired controls, recruited at memory clinics and other clinical and community sites in Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico and Peru by the Multi-Partner Consortium to Expand Dementia Research in Latin America with the University of California San Francisco Memory and Aging Center, and assessed under a harmonised protocol (clinical, cognitive, genetic, neuroimaging and EEG data, and a questionnaire on lifelong social exposures) to study how genetic, social and environmental factors shape dementia and brain health in Latin America compared with the United States.
diseases: patients with: Alzheimer disease (MONDO:0004975)|patients with: frontotemporal dementia (MONDO:0017276)

label: Sustainable plant protection transition: a global health approach
other synonyms: SPRINT project|Sustainable Plant Protection Transition|Sustainable Plant-Protection Transition
definition: A cross-sectional field study of the EU Horizon 2020 SPRINT project in which, during the 2021 growing season, conventional and organic farmers and their families, neighbours living next to or near agricultural fields, and consumers living farther away were recruited at ten case study sites in Europe and one in Argentina, and gave urine, blood, faeces and nasal swabs and wore silicone wristbands (with indoor dust sampled in their homes), to measure their exposure to pesticide mixtures for exposure modelling and health risk assessment.
exposures: participants with exposure: exposure to pesticide (ECTO:0000530)

label: Maule Cohort
other synonyms: MAUCO cohort|Maule Cohort Study|Maule cohort
definition: A population-based prospective cohort of adults aged 38 to 74 years living in the agricultural county of Molina, in the Maule Region of central Chile, identified through a household census and enrolled from December 2014 by the Advanced Center for Chronic Diseases (ACCDiS) of the Universidad de Chile and the Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, with questionnaires, physical examinations, ultrasound and a biobank of blood, urine and saliva, and followed with repeat visits and surveillance of hospital events to study the natural history and environmental, lifestyle and social determinants of chronic diseases such as cardiometabolic diseases and cancer.

label: Survey on Health, Well-Being, and Aging in Colombia
other synonyms: SABE (Health, Wellbeing, and Aging) Colombia project|SABE Colombia 2015|SABE-2015 Colombia
definition: A population-based cross-sectional national survey of community-dwelling adults aged 60 years and over in urban and rural areas of Colombia, carried out in 2015 for the Colombian Ministry of Health and Social Protection by the University of Caldas and the Universidad del Valle with the design of the Latin American and Caribbean Survey on Health, Well-Being, and Aging (SABE), to study health, active ageing and the social determinants of health inequities in older people.

label: Encuesta Nacional de Situación Nutricional
other synonyms: 015National Nutrition Survey (ENSIN in Spanish)|2015 National Nutrition Survey|ENSIN 2005|ENSIN 2010|ENSIN 2015|ENSIN-2015|Encuesta Nacional de Situación Nutricional de Colombia|Encuesta Nacional de la Situación Nutricional en Colombia|National Nutrition Survey
definition: A repeated nationally representative cross-sectional household survey of the nutritional situation of the population of Colombia, conducted by the Colombian Institute for Family Welfare (ICBF) with the Ministry of Health in 2005, 2010 and 2015, covering people aged 0 to 64 years and pregnant women, that measures nutritional status, dietary intake, food security, breastfeeding and physical activity to inform public food and nutrition policy.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to eating behavior (ECTO:6000021)|designed to study: exposure to nutrient (ECTO:9001695)

label: Cohorts Consortium of Latin America and the Caribbean
other synonyms: The Cohorts Consortium of Latin America and the Caribbean (CC-LAC)
definition: A consortium of population-based cohort studies from countries of Latin America and the Caribbean, set up with Wellcome Trust funding and run from Imperial College London with a regional network of researchers, that harmonises and pools individual-level data on cardio-metabolic risk factors and fatal and non-fatal cardiovascular outcomes to produce regional risk estimates and tools for cardiovascular prevention.

label: Ecuador Life
other synonyms: ECUAVIDA birth cohort|ECUAVIDA cohort|Ecuador Life study
definition: A prospective birth cohort of newborns recruited from 2006 to 2009 at the hospital serving the rural district of Quinindé, Esmeraldas Province, in tropical coastal Ecuador, run by the Laboratorio de Investigaciones FEPIS with St George's, University of London, that follows the children through childhood to study how soil-transmitted helminth infections and other early-life microbial and environmental exposures affect immune development, atopy, allergic disease and asthma.
diseases: population study of: allergic disease (MONDO:0005271)|population study of: asthma (MONDO:0004979)|population study of: atopic IgE-mediated allergic disorder (MONDO:0005202)
exposures: designed to study: exposure to organism (ECTO:3000000)

label: Banco Nacional de Tumores Terry Fox
other synonyms: Banco Nacional de Tumores Terry Fox (BNTTF)|Banco nacional de tumores terry fox (BNTTF)|National Tumor Biobank Terry Fox|Terry Fox National Tumor Bank
definition: The donors of the Terry Fox National Tumour Bank, the biobank of the Instituto Nacional de Cancerología in Bogotá, Colombia: people with cancer, people without cancer and cancer survivors who gave informed consent, answered an epidemiological questionnaire on clinical, sociodemographic, risk-factor, family cancer and lifestyle information, and donated blood and, at surgery, tumour and adjacent non-tumour tissue, stored for health research with an emphasis on cancer.

label: China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study
definition: A nationally representative longitudinal survey of community-dwelling people aged 45 years and older in China and their spouses, run from the National School of Development of Peking University, with a 2008 pilot in two provinces and a national baseline in 2011-2012 drawn by multistage probability sampling from 150 counties in 28 provinces, followed up every two years and harmonised with the Health and Retirement Study, to study the health, social and economic consequences of population ageing.

label: REal-time Assessment of Community Transmission
other synonyms: REACT Cohort|REACT Study|REACT programme|Real-time Assessment of Community Transmission|Real-time Assessment of Community Transmission (REACT) Study
definition: A national cohort in England of people who took part in the REal-time Assessment of Community Transmission programme of Imperial College London, which from 2020 sent random samples of people aged 5 years and older, drawn from National Health Service general practice registers, SARS-CoV-2 swab tests (REACT-1) and antibody self-tests (REACT-2) for the Department of Health and Social Care, and who consented to recontact and linkage to their health records, used to study the longer-term effects of the COVID-19 pandemic and other factors on health and wellbeing.

label: 3xG study
other synonyms: 3XG study|3xG study (Gezondheid, Gemeenten, Geboorten)|Gezondheid, Gemeenten, Geboorten|Health—Municipalities—Birth
definition: A local birth cohort of children born between 2010 and 2015 to mothers living in the neighbouring rural municipalities of Dessel, Mol and Retie in Flanders, Belgium, run by the Flemish Institute for Technological Research (VITO) and co-financed by the Belgian radioactive waste agency and local consultation bodies, that follows the children with human biomonitoring and questionnaires, alongside the municipalities' disease and mortality registers, to monitor the effects of environmental and lifestyle exposures on health.
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)

label: Cohort ’18, Growing Up in Hungary
other synonyms: Cohort '18 -Growing Up in Hungary|Growing Up In Hungary, HCSO Hungarian Demographic Research Institute|Growing Up in Hungary|Kohorsz ‘18 Magyar Születési Kohorszvizsgálat
definition: A nationally representative longitudinal birth cohort of children born in Hungary between March 2018 and April 2019 and their parents, recruited in pregnancy and run by the Hungarian Demographic Research Institute of the Hungarian Central Statistical Office, to study the circumstances of childbearing and childrearing and the parental, family and social factors that shape children's development.

label: COMmunity-based Behavior and Attitude survey in Tuvalu
other synonyms: COMmunity-based Behaviour and Attitude Study in Tuvalu|Community Behavior and Attitude Survey in Tuvalu|Community-based Behaviour and Attitude Study in Tuvalu
definition: A nationwide community-based survey of adults in Tuvalu, on Funafuti and the eight outer islands, run in waves since 2020 and funded jointly by the Taiwan International Cooperation and Development Fund and the Tuvalu government, studying diet, lifestyle behaviours, climate-related exposures and obesity and other non-communicable diseases; from 2025 it is being continued as a longitudinal cohort with repeated surveys, clinical assessments and biomonitoring.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to climate change (ECTO:8000008)|designed to study: exposure to eating behavior (ECTO:6000021)|designed to study: exposure to lifestyle (ECTO:6000015)

label: São Paulo Western Region Birth Cohort
other synonyms: Região Oeste Coorte|São Paulo Western Region Birth Cohort (ROC)|Western Region Birth Cohort
definition: A prospective birth cohort of babies born at the University Hospital of the University of São Paulo School of Medicine between April 2012 and March 2014 to mothers living in the Butantã-Jaguaré area of São Paulo's Western Region, Brazil, followed to study how social and environmental factors, including toxic stress, affect early childhood development in a low-income urban setting.

label: Next Steps
other synonyms: Longitudinal Study of Young People in England|Longitudinal Study of Young People in England: Next Steps
definition: A national longitudinal cohort of people born in 1989-90 who were in Year 9 of secondary school in England in 2004, sampled through schools with over-sampling of deprived schools and ethnic minorities, begun by the Department for Education and run since 2013 by the Centre for Longitudinal Studies at University College London, following their education, work, economic circumstances, family life, health and wellbeing.

label: PROMESA cohort study
other synonyms: Characterization of the external exposome and its contribution to the clinical respiratory and early biological effects in children: The PROMESA cohort study|Origin of particulate matter and its effect on children's health|PROMESA study
definition: A prospective cohort of children under five years old insured by a single health insurance company in Bogotá and Medellín, Colombia, enrolled from 2021 and followed for one year to study how the external exposome, above all particulate matter air pollution, contributes to acute respiratory infections, asthma and early DNA damage.
diseases: population study of: asthma (MONDO:0004979)|population study of: respiratory tract infectious disorder (MONDO:0024355)
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)|designed to study: exposure to fine respirable suspended particulate matter (ECTO:7000117)|designed to study: exposure to nitrogen dioxide (ECTO:9000252)

label: Butajira Nutrition, Mental Health, and Pregnancy Study
other synonyms: BUNMAP pregnancy cohort|Butajira Nutrition, Mental Health, and Pregnancy|Butajira Nutrition, Mental health, and Pregnancy Project
definition: A population-based prospective mother-child cohort of pregnant women living in the Butajira Health and Demographic Surveillance Site, Meskan and Mareko district, Ethiopia, enrolled from 2017-2018 by the School of Public Health of Addis Ababa University and followed through pregnancy and after birth to study how maternal nutrition, mycotoxin exposure and mental health affect prenatal and postnatal growth and development.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to aflatoxin (ECTO:0001108)|designed to study: exposure to mycotoxin (ECTO:0000524)|designed to study: exposure to pregnancy diet intake (ECTO:2000076)

label: Primeiros Laços
other synonyms: First Ties Program|The Effect of the Young Pregnant Women's Home Visiting Program on Child Development: A Pilot Study|The Effects on Early Brain Development of a Nurse Home Visitation Program for Pregnant Youth and Their Families Living in a Poor Urban Area in Sao Paulo, Brazil|Young Caregiving Mothers Program|Young Caregiving Mothers Program (YCMP)|Young Caring Mothers Programme
definition: The participants of a randomised controlled trial run by the University of São Paulo Medical School from 2015 of Primeiros Laços, a nurse home visiting programme from early pregnancy to the child's age of two years, in low-income first-time pregnant adolescents aged 14-19 recruited through primary healthcare units in the western region of São Paulo, Brazil, and their children, followed to test the programme's effects on child development, maternal and home environment outcomes.

label: Golestan Cohort Study
other synonyms: Golestan cohort study
definition: A population-based prospective cohort of adults aged 40 to 75 years enrolled between 2004 and 2008 from rural and urban areas of Golestan province in northeast Iran, set up to study oesophageal cancer and followed for cancers and other outcomes, including those attributable to opium use and smoking.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to alcohol consumption (ECTO:0001082)|designed to study: exposure to morphiane alkaloid (ECTO:0100006)|designed to study: exposure to occupation (ECTO:0001591)|designed to study: exposure to tea (steeped) via ingestion (ECTO:0070133)|designed to study: exposure to tobacco (ECTO:0100013)

label: Norwegian Family Based Life Course Study
other synonyms: Norwegian Family Based Life Course (NFLC) study|Norwegian family based life course study
definition: A register-based cohort of everyone in Norway who took part in the national censuses from 1960 to 2001, in which family members are linked through personal identity numbers and household and family information from the 1960 census and further linked to health registers and surveys, for multigenerational life-course research in public health.

label: Chilean COVID-19 Biorepository
other synonyms: COVID-19 Genomics Network|Chilean COVID-19 Genomics Network Biorepository|RED GENÓMICA COVID-19
definition: A nationwide multicentre cohort of adults with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection, from asymptomatic to fatal, recruited from September 2020 into 2021 through nine recruitment centres in seven regions of Chile by a network of Chilean universities and health centres coordinated by the University of Chile's Biobank of Tissue and Fluids, with blood samples and clinical data banked for multi-omics studies of host genetics and COVID-19 severity, and recontacted for long COVID follow-up; the network behind it became the COVID-19 Genomics Network (C19-GenoNet).

label: Million Women Study
definition: A population-based prospective cohort of women aged 50–64 years in the United Kingdom, recruited in 1996–2001 when invited to routine mammography by the National Health Service Breast Screening Programme at centres in England and Scotland and coordinated by the Cancer Epidemiology Unit of the University of Oxford, set up to study the effects of hormone replacement therapy on breast cancer and other outcomes and followed for the effects of many other factors on women's health as they age.

label: Saudi Biobank
other synonyms: National Saudi Biobank
definition: A population-based biobank of Saudi nationals aged 10 years and over, recruited since 2017 by the Saudi Biobank Center of King Abdullah International Medical Research Center in Riyadh, in person at Ministry of National Guard Health Affairs hospitals and clinics and at community sites such as blood donation centres, with questionnaires, biological samples and linked electronic health records, to support genetic and epidemiological research on common and rare diseases in Saudi Arabia.

label: Prospective Epidemiological Research Studies in Iran
other synonyms: PERSIAN Cohort|PERSIAN cohort study|Prospective Epidemiological Research Studies in IrAN
definition: An ongoing nationwide population-based prospective cohort of adults aged 35–70 years living in 18 regions of Iran chosen to cover its ethnic, environmental and socioeconomic diversity, enrolled since 2014 through a network of Iranian medical universities coordinated by the Digestive Diseases Research Institute of Tehran University of Medical Sciences, with a biobank, to study environmental, lifestyle and genetic determinants of non-communicable diseases.

label: Generation Victoria
definition: A whole-population birth and parent cohort open to all children born in the state of Victoria, Australia, between October 2021 and October 2023 and their parents, recruited from December 2020 (an Advance Cohort, then newborns at Victorian maternity services and later remote and ongoing enrolment) and led from the Murdoch Children's Research Institute, which combines linked administrative and clinical data, biosamples and phenotypic waves as a platform for discovery and intervention research on child and adult health.

label: South Asia Biobank
other synonyms: South Asia Biobank Study
definition: A population-based study of adults aged 18 years and over of South Asian ethnicity, recruited from 2018 at non-communicable disease surveillance sites centred on primary community health care units in Bangladesh, India, Pakistan and Sri Lanka by a partnership of centres in those countries and the United Kingdom led from Imperial College London, with standardised health assessments, environmental mapping and biological samples, to identify the genetic and environmental causes of type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular and other non-communicable diseases in South Asians.

label: Dementias Platform UK
other synonyms: DPUK Data Portal|Dementias Platform UK Data Portal
definition: A platform established by the UK Medical Research Council to accelerate the development of new treatments for dementia, run from the University of Oxford, whose Data Portal, launched in 2017, brings together data from independent population and clinical cohorts, most of them in the United Kingdom, in a shared remote-access environment for collaborative and multi-cohort research on dementia and neurodegeneration.
diseases: population study of: dementia (MONDO:0001627)|population study of: neurodegenerative disease (MONDO:0005559)

label: Iganga-Mayuge Health and Demographic Surveillance Site
acronyms: IM-HDSS|IMHDSS|Iganga Mayuge HDSS|Iganga Mayuge HDSS, Makerere University Centre for Health and Population Research (MUCHAP)|Iganga-Mayuge HDSS
other synonyms: IMHDSS, Uganda|Iganga-Mayuge Health and Demographic Surveillance Sites|Iganga-Mayuge health and demographic surveillance site
definition: A health and demographic surveillance system following the largely rural population of villages in the Iganga and Mayuge districts of eastern Uganda, established in the mid-2000s by Makerere University with the two districts and Karolinska Institutet and run by the Makerere University Centre for Health and Population Research, which records pregnancies, births, deaths and other events in census rounds and links household data with health facility records, as a platform for population health research and research training.

label: HUNT4 70+
other synonyms: HUNT 70+ study|HUNT4 70+ study
definition: A sub-study of the fourth wave (HUNT4, 2017–2019) of the Trøndelag Health Study in which all inhabitants aged 70 years and older in the northern Trøndelag region of Norway were invited to detailed assessments of cognition and health, used to study the prevalence and incidence of dementia and mild cognitive impairment.
diseases: population study of: cognitive disorder (MONDO:0002039)|population study of: dementia (MONDO:0001627)

label: Coronagenes
other synonyms: Coronagenes study
definition: A cohort of volunteers recruited online from 2020 by the MRC Human Genetics Unit at the University of Edinburgh who shared genotype data from direct-to-consumer genetic testing services and completed questionnaires on their health, lifestyle and COVID-19 symptoms, to identify genes that influence the risk and severity of COVID-19.

label: German National Cohort
other synonyms: German National Cohort health study|NAKO Gesundheitsstudie|NAKO Health Study
definition: A multidisciplinary population-based prospective cohort of men and women aged 19 to 74 years drawn at random from the general population and examined between 2014 and 2019 at 18 study centres across Germany, with interviews, questionnaires, biomedical examinations, biosamples and whole-body magnetic resonance imaging in a subsample, followed up by questionnaires, record linkage and re-examination, to investigate the causes, early detection and prevention of common chronic and infectious diseases.

label: The Malaysian Cohort
other synonyms: Malaysian Cohort|The Malaysian Cohort Study|The Malaysian Cohort project
definition: A nationwide population-based prospective cohort of multi-ethnic Malaysian adults aged 35 to 70 years, recruited from 2006 to 2012 by the UKM Medical Molecular Biology Institute of the National University of Malaysia and followed up by periodic re-surveys, telephone follow-up and registry linkage, to study the causes of non-communicable diseases.

label: Cancer Prevention Study-3
acronyms: American Cancer Society Cancer Prevention Study-3|CPS-3|CPS3
other synonyms: American Cancer Society's Cancer Prevention Study 3|Cancer Prevention Study 3
definition: A prospective cohort of adults in the United States and Puerto Rico recruited by the American Cancer Society between 2006 and 2013, mainly at community events, who gave a blood sample and survey information and are followed through repeat surveys and linkage with cancer registries and the National Death Index, to study lifestyle, genetic and other causes of cancer and other outcomes.

label: Personalized Environment and Genes Study
other synonyms: Environmental Polymorphisms Registry|Personalized Genes and Environment Study
definition: A cohort of demographically diverse adults recruited in North Carolina since 2002 by the National Institute of Environmental Health Sciences, first as the Environmental Polymorphisms Registry, who complete surveys on health, exposures, diet and lifestyle, give biological samples and are genotyped, with geocoded residential data, to study how environment, lifestyle and genes act together on disease.
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)|designed to study: exposure to Physical Activity (ECTO:6000039)|designed to study: exposure to chemical (ECTO:0000231)|designed to study: exposure to eating behavior (ECTO:6000021)|designed to study: exposure to environmental pollution (ECTO:8000019)|designed to study: exposure to pesticide (ECTO:0000530)|designed to study: exposure to ultraviolet radiation (ECTO:0000006)

label: Newfoundland and Labrador Genome Project
other synonyms: NL Genome Project
definition: A general population cohort of adults in Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada, established by the company Sequence Bioinformatics (Sequence Bio) of St. John's and recruiting from 2019, whose participants, aged 18 and over with a valid provincial health card, were recruited at random from general practice clinics across the province and gave medical history and saliva samples for genotyping, to characterise the genetics of the province's founder population and find genetic causes of disease.

label: UKCTOCS Longitudinal Women's Cohort
other synonyms: UK Collaborative Trial of Ovarian Cancer Screening|United Kingdom Collaborative Trial of Ovarian Cancer Screening
definition: A cohort of postmenopausal women aged 50–74 from the general population of England, Wales and Northern Ireland, recruited in 2001–2005 to the United Kingdom Collaborative Trial of Ovarian Cancer Screening (UKCTOCS), a randomised trial of ovarian cancer screening, whose donated serum samples (at recruitment and, in the multimodal screening arm, annually until 2011) and linked national health records are kept by the MRC Clinical Trials Unit at University College London as an open bioresource for studies of common diseases and disease markers.

label: Kilifi Health and Demographic Surveillance System
definition: A population cohort of the residents of a defined area around Kilifi on the Indian Ocean coast of Kenya, established in 2000 by the KEMRI-Wellcome Trust Research Programme with a census and followed by regular household visits recording births, pregnancies, migrations and deaths, with residents' admissions to Kilifi District Hospital linked to the population register, to measure the incidence of local diseases, evaluate community interventions against infectious diseases and provide a sampling frame for epidemiological studies.

label: Cancer Prevention Study II Nutrition Cohort
other synonyms: American Cancer Society Cancer Prevention Study II Nutrition Cohort|CPS-II Nutrition Cohort|Cancer Prevention II Nutrition Cohort|Cancer Prevention Study-II Nutrition Cohort
definition: A subset of the Cancer Prevention Study II participants, men and women living in 21 US states, enrolled by the American Cancer Society through a mailed questionnaire in 1992–1993 and followed by biennial questionnaires, medical records and registry linkage for incident cancer and death, with blood samples from a subgroup, to study diet and other lifestyle factors and exposures in relation to cancer risk, mortality and survival.
exposures: designed to study: exposure to lifestyle (ECTO:6000015)

label: Environmental influences on Child Health Outcomes Cohort
acronyms: ECHO|EWC|Environmental influences on Child Health Outcomes (ECHO) Cohort
other synonyms: ECHO Cohort|ECHO Cohort Study|ECHO-Wide Cohort Study|Environmental Influences on Child Health Outcomes-Wide Cohort Study|Environmental influences on Child Health Outcomes-wide Cohort
definition: A collaborative cohort study funded in 2016 by the US National Institutes of Health within the Environmental influences on Child Health Outcomes (ECHO) Program, bringing together existing and new pregnancy and paediatric cohorts across the United States and Puerto Rico under a common data collection protocol to study how early-life environmental exposures affect pre-, peri- and postnatal outcomes, airway health, obesity, neurodevelopment and positive health in children.
exposures: designed to study: exposure event (ExO:0000002)|designed to study: exposure to Physical Activity (ECTO:6000039)|designed to study: exposure to air pollution (ECTO:8000036)|designed to study: exposure to chemical (ECTO:0000231)|designed to study: exposure to drinking water (ECTO:7000125)|designed to study: exposure to eating behavior (ECTO:6000021)|designed to study: exposure to phthalate ester (ECTO:9000906)

label: Japan Public Health Center-based Prospective Study for the Next Generation
acronyms: JPHC (Japan Public Health Center-based Prospective) Study and JPHC-NEXT Study|JPHC-NEXT
other synonyms: JPHC Study for the Next Generation|JPHC-NEXT Study
definition: A population-based prospective cohort of residents aged 40 to 74 years of 16 municipalities in seven prefectural areas of Japan, enrolled from 2011 to 2016 through a central office at the National Cancer Center and regional public health centres and universities as the successor to the Japan Public Health Center-based Prospective Study, with questionnaires and blood and urine samples, to identify risk factors for lifestyle-related diseases and factors that extend healthy life expectancy.

label: China Patient-centered Evaluative Assessment of Cardiac Events Million Persons Project
acronyms: China PEACE (Patient-centered Evaluative Assessment of Cardiac Events) Million Persons Project|China PEACE MPP|China PEACE-MPP|MPP
other synonyms: China PEACE Million Persons Project|China PEACE million persons project|China PEACE-Million Persons Project|China Patient-Centered Evaluative Assessment of Cardiac Events Million Persons Project|China-PEACE Million Persons Project
definition: A government-funded, population-based cardiovascular screening cohort run by the National Center for Cardiovascular Diseases (Fuwai Hospital, Beijing) that, after a pilot in four provinces, enrolled community-dwelling residents aged 35 to 75 years at urban districts and rural counties in all 31 provinces of mainland China from 2014, with blood pressure, anthropometric and lipid measurements and a health questionnaire, and gave further assessment, counselling and follow-up to those at high risk, to identify people at high risk of cardiovascular disease and support research on its prevention.

label: Africa Centre Demographic Information System
acronyms: ACDIS|AHRI|Africa Health Research Institute (AHRI) Population Cohort|PIP
other synonyms: ACDIS cohort|AHRI Population Cohort|Africa Centre Demographic Information System and population-based HIV survey|Africa Health Research Institute Population Cohort|PIP cohort|Population Intervention Platform|Population Intervention Programme
definition: An open population cohort of all resident and non-resident members of households in a demographic and health surveillance area in the uMkhanyakude district of rural KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa, established in 2000 by the Africa Centre for Health and Population Studies (now the Africa Health Research Institute) and expanded and renamed the Population Intervention Platform in 2017, with repeated household surveillance and population-based HIV surveys, to describe the demographic, social and health impact of the HIV epidemic, and later of tuberculosis and non-communicable diseases, and to evaluate interventions.
diseases: population study of: HIV infectious disease (MONDO:0005109)

label: LifeGene
